sents.en: Overdressed is the fashion world's answer to consumer-activist bestsellers like Michael Pollan's The Omnivore's Dilemma.
sents.cn: 《过度着装》是时尚界对消费者维权类畅销书的回应，可与迈克尔·波伦的《杂食者的两难》相提并论。

sents.en: "Mass-produced clothing, like fast food, fills a hunger and need, yet is non-durable and wasteful," Cline argues.
sents.cn: 克莱恩指出：“批量生产的服装就像快餐一样，满足了人们的饥渴与需求，却既不耐用又造成浪费。”

sents.en: Americans, she finds, buy roughly 20 billion garments a year—about 64 items per person—and no matter how much they give away, this excess leads to waste.
sents.cn: 她发现，美国人每年大约购买二百亿件衣物——人均约六十四件——而无论他们捐出多少，这种过剩都会导致浪费。

sents.en: Towards the end of Overdressed, Cline introduced her ideal, a Brooklyn woman named Sarah Kate Beaumont, who since 2008 has made all of her own clothes—and beautifully.
sents.cn: 在《过度着装》一书的结尾，克莱恩介绍了她心目中的理想人物：布鲁克林一位名叫莎拉·凯特·博蒙特的女士，她自2008年起便亲手缝制自己所有的衣服——而且做得相当漂亮。

sents.en: But as Cline is the first to note, it took Beaumont decades to perfect her craft; her example can't be knocked off.
sents.cn: 但正如克莱恩第一个指出的那样，博蒙特花了数十年才把这门手艺练得炉火纯青；她的榜样无法被照搬复制。

sents.en: Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment—including H&M, with its green Conscious Collection line—Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer.
sents.cn: 尽管包括H&M在内的几家快时尚公司已为减少其对劳工和环境的影响做出了努力——比如H&M推出了环保的“良心系列”——但克莱恩相信，持久的改变只能由消费者来促成。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer（克莱恩认为持久的改变只能由顾客促成）
structure: 让步状语从句(Though)：Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment
└ 不定式作定语〔修饰 efforts〕：to curb their impact on labor and the environment
破折号插入语（举例）：including H&M, with its green Conscious Collection line
主句：Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer
└ 宾语从句(省略 that)：lasting change can only be effected by the customer
analysis.logic: Though 引导让步状语从句；破折号插入举例（including H&M…）；主句 Cline believes (that)…，宾语从句为被动 can only be effected by the customer。
notes: Though 引导让步状语从句（尽管）。
破折号夹的 including H&M… 是插入语（举例）。
can only be effected by the customer 被动（只能由顾客促成）；effect 作动词=促成、实现。

sents.en: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.
sents.cn: 她表现出许多可持续发展倡导者所共有的理想主义，无论是在食品还是能源领域。

sents.en: Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to.
sents.cn: 虚荣是一种不变的人性；只有当人们再也无力承担挥霍的代价时，才会开始更可持续地购物。

sents.en: An old saying has it that half of all advertising budgets are wasted—the trouble is, no one knows which half.
sents.cn: 有一句老话说，所有广告预算中有一半都被浪费了——麻烦在于，没人知道是哪一半。

sents.en: In the internet age, at least in theory, this fraction can be much reduced.
sents.cn: 在互联网时代，至少在理论上，这一比例可以大大降低。

sents.en: By watching what people search for, click on and say online, companies can aim "behavioral" ads at those most likely to buy.
sents.cn: 通过观察人们在网上搜索什么、点击什么、谈论什么，企业可以把“行为定向”广告投放给那些最有可能购买的人。

sents.en: In the past couple of weeks a quarrel has illustrated the value to advertisers of such fine-grained information: Should advertisers assume that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioral ads?
sents.cn: 在过去几周里，一场争论恰好说明了此类精细信息对广告商的价值：广告商是否应当假定人们乐于被追踪并接收行为定向广告？

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：a quarrel has illustrated the value … of such fine-grained information（一场争论显示出这种细颗粒信息的价值）
structure: 状语：In the past couple of weeks
主句：a quarrel has illustrated the value to advertisers of such fine-grained information
└ 两个介词短语都修饰 value（中心词与修饰语分隔）：to advertisers + of such fine-grained information
冒号后（设问）：Should advertisers assume that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioral ads?
└ 宾语从句(that)：that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioral ads
analysis.logic: 主句 a quarrel illustrated the value（to advertisers 与 of … information 两个介词短语都修饰 value，造成中心词与修饰语分隔）；冒号引出一个反问；assume that… 宾语从句。
notes: the value to advertisers of such … information：to advertisers 与 of … information 两个介词短语都修饰 value（分隔）。
冒号后是设问句（引出讨论）。
be tracked and sent behavioral ads：被追踪并被推送行为广告（被动并列）。

sents.en: Or should they have explicit permission?
sents.cn: 还是说，他们应当事先取得明确的许可？

sents.en: In December 2010 America's Federal Trade Commission (FTC) proposed adding a "do not track" (DNT) option to internet browsers, so that users could tell advertisers that they did not want to be followed.
sents.cn: 2010年12月，美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）提议在互联网浏览器中加入一个“禁止追踪”（DNT）选项，以便用户可以告知广告商自己不愿被追踪。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O(动名词)：the FTC proposed adding a 「do not track」 option to internet browsers（联邦贸易委员会提议给浏览器加「禁止追踪」选项）
structure: 状语：In December 2010
主句：America's Federal Trade Commission (FTC) proposed adding a 「do not track」 (DNT) option to internet browsers
└ 动名词作宾语：adding a … option to internet browsers
目的状语从句(so that)：so that users could tell advertisers that they did not want to be followed
└ 宾语从句(that)：that they did not want to be followed
analysis.logic: 主句 proposed adding…（动名词宾语）；so that 引导目的状语从句；tell advertisers that… 为双宾语 + that 宾语从句。
notes: propose doing：proposed adding…（动名词作宾语）。
so that 引导目的状语从句（以便）。
tell sb that…：tell advertisers + that 宾语从句；be followed 被追踪。

sents.en: Microsoft's Internet Explorer and Apple's Safari both offer DNT; Google's Chrome is due to do so this year.
sents.cn: 微软的Internet Explorer和苹果的Safari都已提供DNT功能；谷歌的Chrome也将在今年提供。

sents.en: In February the FTC and Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA) agreed that the industry would get cracking on responding to DNT requests.
sents.cn: 今年2月，联邦贸易委员会与数字广告联盟（DAA）达成一致，业界将着手响应DNT请求。

sents.en: On May 31st Microsoft set off the row: It said that InternetExplorer 10, the version due to appear Windows 8, would have DNT as a default.
sents.cn: 5月31日，微软引发了这场争论：它表示，随Windows 8一同发布的Internet Explorer 10将默认开启DNT。

sents.en: Advertisers are horrified.
sents.cn: 广告商们惊恐万分。

sents.en: Human nature being what it is, most people stick with default settings.
sents.cn: 鉴于人性使然，大多数人都会沿用默认设置。

sents.en: Few switch DNT on now, but if tracking is off it will stay off.
sents.cn: 如今很少有人主动开启DNT，但如果追踪功能默认关闭，它就会一直保持关闭。

sents.en: Bob Liodice, the chief executive of the Association of National Advertisers, says consumers will be worse off if the industry cannot collect information about their preferences.
sents.cn: 美国全国广告商协会的首席执行官鲍勃·利奥迪斯表示，如果业界无法收集消费者的偏好信息，受损的将是消费者。

sents.en: People will not get fewer ads, he says, "they'll get less meaningful, less targeted ads."
sents.cn: 他说，人们看到的广告不会减少，“而是会收到意义更小、针对性更弱的广告”。

sents.en: It is not yet clear how advertisers will respond.
sents.cn: 广告商将如何应对，目前尚不明朗。

sents.en: Getting a DNT signal does not oblige anyone to stop tracking, although some companies have promised to do so.
sents.cn: 收到DNT信号并不强制任何人停止追踪，尽管有些公司已承诺会这样做。

sents.en: Unable to tell whether someone really objects to behavioral ads or whether they are sticking with Microsoft's default, some may ignore a DNT signal and press on anyway.
sents.cn: 由于无法判断某人究竟是真的反对行为定向广告，还是仅仅沿用了微软的默认设置，有些公司可能会无视DNT信号，照旧追踪下去。

sents.en: Also unclear is why Microsoft has gone it alone.
sents.cn: 同样令人不解的是，微软为何要单独行动。

sents.en: After all, it has an ad business too, which it says will comply with DNT requests, though it is still working out how.
sents.cn: 毕竟，它自己也有广告业务，它表示该业务将遵从DNT请求，只是仍在研究具体如何操作。

sents.en: If it is trying to upset Google, which relies almost wholly on advertising, it has chosen an indirect method: There is no guarantee that DNT by default will become the norm.DNT does not seem an obviously huge selling point for Windows 8—though the firm has compared some of its other products favorably with Google's on that count before.
sents.cn: 如果它意在打击几乎完全依赖广告的谷歌，那么它选择的是一种迂回的方式：无法保证默认开启DNT会成为常态；对Windows 8而言，DNT似乎也算不上一个显而易见的巨大卖点——尽管该公司此前曾在这一点上拿自家其他产品与谷歌相比、并自夸更胜一筹。

analysis.trunk: 条件+主句：If it is trying to upset Google …, it has chosen an indirect method（若它意在打击谷歌，那它选了一种迂回手段）
structure: 条件状语从句(If)：If it is trying to upset Google
└ 非限制性定语从句〔which，修饰 Google〕：which relies almost wholly on advertising
主句：it has chosen an indirect method
冒号后（说明）：There is no guarantee that DNT by default will become the norm
└ 同位语从句(that，说明 guarantee)：that DNT by default will become the norm
（后续独立句）：DNT does not seem an obviously huge selling point for Windows 8 — though the firm has compared … before
analysis.logic: If 条件从句（which 非限制定语从句修饰 Google）；主句 it has chosen an indirect method；冒号 + there is no guarantee that…（同位语从句）；末句 + though 让步。
notes: which 非限制性定语从句修饰 Google（几乎全靠广告）。
no guarantee that…：that 同位语从句说明 guarantee（无法保证…）。
本条含两句：句号后 DNT does not seem… 为另一句，though 引导让步；selling point 卖点；on that count 在那一点上。

sents.en: Brendon Lynch, Microsoft's chief privacy officer, blogged: "we believe consumers should have more control."
sents.cn: 微软首席隐私官布伦顿·林奇在博客中写道：“我们认为消费者应当拥有更多的控制权。”

sents.en: Could it really be that simple?
sents.cn: 事情真会这么简单吗？

sents.en: Up until a few decades ago, our visions of the future were largely—though by no means uniformly—glowingly positive.
sents.cn: 直到几十年前，我们对未来的设想在很大程度上还是——尽管绝非千篇一律——充满乐观、一片光明的。

sents.en: Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfillment and opportunity for all.
sents.cn: 科学与技术将治愈人类的一切弊病，让所有人都能过上充实而充满机遇的生活。

sents.en: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu to climate change.
sents.cn: 如今，乌托邦已不再时兴，因为我们对自身所面临的种种威胁有了更深刻的认识，从小行星撞击到流感肆虐，再到气候变化。

sents.en: You might even be tempted to assume that humanity has little future to look forward to.
sents.cn: 你甚至可能不禁会以为，人类已没有多少未来可以期盼了。

sents.en: But such gloominess is misplaced.
sents.cn: 但这种悲观情绪是没有道理的。

sents.en: The fossil record shows that many species have endured for millions of years—so why shouldn't we?
sents.cn: 化石记录表明，许多物种已经延续了数百万年——那么我们为什么不能呢？

sents.en: Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe, and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years.
sents.cn: 如果把眼光放宽一些，去审视我们这一物种在宇宙中所处的位置，就会清楚地看到，我们极有可能再存续数万年，乃至数十万年。

analysis.trunk: 祈使句+and+形式主语：Take a broader look …, and it becomes clear that …（放眼看…，就会清楚…）
structure: 祈使句①：Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe
and 连接②（形式主语 it）：it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years
├ 主语从句(that，it 形式主语)：that we have an excellent chance of surviving …
└ 插入：if not hundreds（即便不是数十万年）
analysis.logic: 「祈使句 + and + it becomes clear that…」表条件结果；it 形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句；if not hundreds 插入（递进让步）。
notes: Take…, and it becomes clear that…：祈使句+and 表条件结果；it 形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句。
tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years：if not hundreds 插入（数万、甚至数十万年）。
chance of surviving：of + 动名词作 chance 的定语。

sents.en: Look up Homo sapiens in the "Red List" of threatened species of the international Union for the Concentration of Nature (IUCN), and you will read: "Listed as Least Concern as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline."
sents.cn: 在世界自然保护联盟（IUCN）的濒危物种“红色名录”中查一查智人，你会读到这样的话：“被列为‘无危’，因为该物种分布极广、适应力强、目前数量正在增长，且不存在导致其总体数量下降的重大威胁。”

analysis.trunk: 祈使句+and+陈述句：Look up Homo sapiens …, and you will read: 「…」（查一下「智人」，你就会读到：「…」）
structure: 祈使句①：Look up Homo sapiens in the 「Red List」 of threatened species of the international Union for the Concentration of Nature (IUCN)
and 连接结果句②：you will read: 「…」
引语：Listed as Least Concern as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats …
├ 过去分词作状语：Listed as Least Concern（被列为「无危」）
└ 原因状语从句(as)：as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline
└ 现在分词作定语〔修饰 threats〕：resulting in an overall population decline
analysis.logic: 「祈使句 + and + 陈述句」表条件结果（去查…，你就会读到…）；引语中 Listed as… 过去分词作状语，as 引导原因从句，resulting in… 现在分词修饰 threats。
notes: Look up…, and you will read…：「祈使句 + and」表条件结果。
Listed as Least Concern：过去分词短语作状语（被列为「无危」物种）。
as 引导原因状语从句；resulting in… 现在分词作定语修饰 threats。（原文 Concentration 应为 Conservation，IUCN=世界自然保护联盟）

sents.en: So what does our deep future hold?
sents.cn: 那么，我们遥远的未来将会如何呢？

sents.en: A growing number of researchers and organizations are now thinking seriously about that question.
sents.cn: 如今，越来越多的研究者和机构开始认真思考这个问题。

sents.en: For example, the Long Now Foundation has as its flagship project a mechanical clock that is designed to still be marking time thousands of years hence.
sents.cn: 例如，“今日永存基金会”的旗舰项目便是一座机械时钟，其设计目标是在数千年之后仍能继续走时计时。

sents.en: Perhaps willfully, it may be easier to think about such lengthy timescales than about the more immediate future.
sents.cn: 或许是出于刻意，思考这样漫长的时间尺度，反倒可能比思考更切近的未来更容易。

sents.en: The potential evolution of today's technology, and its social consequences, is dazzlingly complicated, and it's perhaps best left to science-fiction writers and futurologists to explore the many possibilities we can envisage.
sents.cn: 当今技术的潜在演变及其社会后果错综复杂、令人眼花缭乱，要去探索我们所能设想的种种可能性，这件事或许最好还是交给科幻作家和未来学家去做。

sents.en: That's one reason why we have launched Arc, a new publication dedicated to the near future.
sents.cn: 这正是我们创办《弧》的原因之一，这是一份专注于近未来的全新刊物。

sents.en: But take a longer view and there is a surprising amount that we can say with considerable assurance.
sents.cn: 但只要把眼光放长远一些，就会发现有许多事情是我们能够相当有把握地断言的。

sents.en: As so often, the past holds the key to the future: we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.
sents.cn: 正如常常出现的情形，过去掌握着通向未来的钥匙：我们如今已经辨识出足够多塑造这颗星球及我们这一物种历史的长期规律，从而能够对我们的后代将身处何种境况作出有据可依的预测。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：the past holds the key to the future（过去握有通向未来的钥匙）
structure: 状语：As so often（一如既往）
主句：the past holds the key to the future
冒号后（展开）：we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns … to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations …
├ 现在分词作定语〔修饰 patterns〕：shaping the history of the planet, and our species
├ 不定式作目的(enough…to do)：to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations
└ 定语从句〔in which，修饰 situations〕：in which our descendants will find themselves
analysis.logic: As so often 状语；主句 the past holds the key；冒号展开：identified enough of patterns（shaping… 现在分词定语），enough…to make forecasts（目的）；in which 定语从句修饰 situations。
notes: enough of the … patterns … to make …：enough…to do 结构（已识别出足够多的模式，足以做出…预测）。
shaping the history of the planet 现在分词作定语修饰 patterns。
in which our descendants will find themselves：in which 定语从句修饰 situations（后代将置身其中的处境）。

sents.en: This long perspective makes the pessimistic view of our prospects seem more likely to be a passing fad.
sents.cn: 这种长远的眼光使得对我们前景的悲观看法更像是一种转瞬即逝的流行风潮。

sents.en: To be sure, the future is not all rosy.
sents.cn: 诚然，未来并非一片美好。

sents.en: But we are now knowledgeable enough to reduce many of the risks that threatened the existence of earlier humans, and to improve the lot of those to come.
sents.cn: 但我们如今已掌握了足够的知识，足以降低许多曾威胁早期人类生存的风险，并改善后代的境遇。

sents.en: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday—a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration.
sents.cn: 周一，最高法院以五比三的投票结果推翻了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分内容——这对奥巴马政府而言是一场不大不小的政策胜利。

sents.en: But on the more important matter of the Constitution, the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration's effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.
sents.cn: 但在更为重要的宪法问题上，这一裁决却是政府的一次八比零惨败，使其打破联邦政府与各州之间权力平衡的图谋落空。

analysis.trunk: S+be+表：the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration's effort（这一裁决是对政府那一努力 8 比 0 的挫败）
structure: 状语：But on the more important matter of the Constitution
主句：the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration's effort
└ 不定式作定语〔修饰 effort〕：to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states
analysis.logic: 主系表（the decision was a defeat for the effort）；to upset… 不定式修饰 effort；between… 介词短语修饰 balance of power。
notes: the decision was an 8-0 defeat for … effort：主系表结构。
to upset the balance of power 不定式作定语修饰 effort（打破权力平衡的努力）。
upset 在此=打破、扰乱；between the federal government and the states 修饰 balance of power。

sents.en: In Arizona v. United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona's controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigration law.
sents.cn: 在“亚利桑那州诉合众国”一案中，多数派法官推翻了亚利桑那州那项有争议方案的四条受质疑条款中的三条；该方案旨在让州和地方警察执行联邦移民法。

sents.en: The Constitutional principles that Washington alone has the power to "establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization" and that federal laws precede state laws are noncontroversial.
sents.cn: 唯有联邦政府才有权“确立统一的归化规则”，以及联邦法律高于州法律，这两条宪法原则是没有争议的。

sents.en: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.
sents.cn: 亚利桑那州此前试图制定一些与现行联邦政策并行的州政策。

sents.en: Justice Anthony Kennedy, joined by Chief Justice John Roberts and the Court's liberals, ruled that the state flew too close to the federal sun.
sents.cn: 大法官安东尼·肯尼迪，连同首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨以及最高法院的自由派法官一道裁定，该州过于靠近联邦这个“太阳”了。

sents.en: On the overturned provisions the majority held that Congress had deliberately "occupied the field"and Arizona has thus intruded on the federal's privileged powers.
sents.cn: 对于那些被推翻的条款，多数派法官认为，国会已蓄意“占据了这一领域”，因而亚利桑那州侵犯了联邦政府的专属权力。

sents.en: However, the Justices said that Arizona police would be allowed to verify the legal status of people who come in contact with law enforcement.
sents.cn: 不过，大法官们表示，亚利桑那州警察将被允许核查那些与执法部门发生接触者的合法身份。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：the Justices said that …（法官们表示…）
structure: 状语：However
主句：the Justices said that …
└ 宾语从句(that)：Arizona police would be allowed to verify the legal status of people …
└ 定语从句〔who，修饰 people〕：who come in contact with law enforcement
analysis.logic: that 引导 said 的宾语从句；be allowed to do 被动（获准）；who 定语从句修饰 people。
notes: that 引导 said 的宾语从句。
be allowed to do：被动（获准做…）。
who come in contact with law enforcement：who 定语从句修饰 people；come in contact with 与…接触。

sents.en: That's because Congress has always envisioned joint federal-state immigration enforcement and explicitly encourages state officers to share information and cooperate with federal colleagues.
sents.cn: 这是因为国会一直设想由联邦与各州共同执行移民法，并明确鼓励州级官员与联邦同行分享信息、相互协作。

sents.en: Two of the three objecting Justices—Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas—agreed with this Constitutional logic but disagreed about which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute.
sents.cn: 三位持异议的大法官中有两位——塞缪尔·阿利托和克拉伦斯·托马斯——认同上述宪法逻辑，但在亚利桑那州的哪些规定与联邦法规相冲突这一点上意见相左。

analysis.trunk: S+并列谓语：Two of the three objecting Justices … agreed … but disagreed …（三位持异议法官中的两位 认同…但不认同…）
structure: 主句主语：Two of the three objecting Justices
└ 破折号同位语〔点明那两位〕：Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas
并列谓语(but)：agreed with this Constitutional logic / disagreed about which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute
└ 宾语从句(which，作 about 的宾语)：which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute
analysis.logic: 主语 Two of the three… Justices（破折号同位语点名）；并列谓语 agreed but disagreed；about 后 which 引导宾语从句。
notes: 破折号夹的 Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas 是同位语（点明那两位法官）。
并列谓语：agreed with… but disagreed about…。
which Arizona rules conflicted…：which 引导介词 about 的宾语从句（哪些亚利桑那规定与联邦法冲突）。

sents.en: The only major objection came from Justice Antonin Scalia, who offered an even more robust defense of state privileges going back to the Alien and Sedition Acts.
sents.cn: 唯一重大的异议来自大法官安东宁·斯卡利亚，他对州权提出了更为有力的辩护，其依据甚至可以追溯到《客籍法和惩治煽动叛乱法》。

sents.en: The 8-0 objection to President Obama turns on what Justice Samuel Alito describes in his objection as "a shocking assertion of federal executive power".
sents.cn: 对奥巴马总统这八比零的反对意见，焦点在于大法官塞缪尔·阿利托在其异议中所称的“一种骇人听闻地宣称联邦行政权力的主张”。

sents.en: The White House argued that Arizona's laws conflicted with its enforcement priorities, even if state laws complied with federal statutes to the letter.
sents.cn: 白宫辩称，即便各州法律一字不差地符合联邦法规，亚利桑那州的法律仍与联邦的执法优先事项相冲突。

sents.en: In effect, the White House claimed that it could invalidate any otherwise legitimate state law that it disagrees with.
sents.cn: 实际上，白宫声称它可以宣布任何一项本属合法、但它不赞同的州法律无效。

sents.en: Some powers do belong exclusively to the federal government, and control of citizenship and the borders is among them.
sents.cn: 诚然，有些权力确实专属于联邦政府，对公民身份和边境的管控便在其列。

sents.en: But if Congress wanted to prevent states from using their own resources to check immigration status, it could.
sents.cn: 但是，如果国会想要阻止各州动用自身资源去核查移民身份，它本可以这么做。

sents.en: It never did so.
sents.cn: 可它从未这样做过。

sents.en: The Administration was in essence asserting that because it didn't want to carry out Congress's immigration wishes, no state should be allowed to do so either.
sents.cn: 说到底，政府的主张无非是：因为它自己不愿执行国会在移民问题上的意愿，所以也不应允许任何一个州去执行。

sents.en: Every Justice rightly rejected this remarkable claim.
sents.cn: 每一位大法官都理所应当地驳回了这一惊人的主张。

sents.en: In order to "change lives for the better" and reduce "dependency," George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, introduced the "upfront work search" scheme.
sents.cn: 为了“让生活变得更美好”并减少“依赖”，英国财政大臣乔治·奥斯本推出了“预先求职”计划。

sents.en: Only if the jobless arrive at the job centre with a CV register for online job search, and start looking for work will they be eligible for benefit-and then they should report weekly rather than fortnightly.
sents.cn: 失业者只有带着简历来到就业中心、注册在线求职并开始找工作，才有资格领取救济金——而且此后他们必须每周而非每两周前来报到一次。

analysis.trunk: 部分倒装：Only if … will they be eligible for benefit（只有…他们才有资格领取救济）
structure: 条件状语从句(Only if，置于句首)：Only if the jobless arrive at the job centre with a CV register for online job search, and start looking for work
└ 从句内并列谓语：arrive…, register…, and start looking…
主句（部分倒装）：will they be eligible for benefit
and then 补充：then they should report weekly rather than fortnightly
analysis.logic: Only if 置于句首 → 主句部分倒装（will they be…）；条件从句内三个并列谓语；rather than 对比（每周而非每两周）。
notes: Only if 置于句首 → 主句部分倒装：will they be eligible（只有…他们才…）。
条件从句内并列谓语：arrive…, register…, and start looking…。
weekly rather than fortnightly：rather than 对比（每周而非每两周）。

sents.en: What could be more reasonable?
sents.cn: 还有什么比这更合情合理的呢？

sents.en: More apparent reasonableness followed.
sents.cn: 随后又出现了更多看似合理的举措。

sents.en: There will now be a seven-day wait for the jobseeker's allowance.
sents.cn: 如今申领求职者津贴要先等待七天。

sents.en: "Those first few days should be spent looking for work, not looking to sign on." he claimed.
sents.cn: 他声称：“最初的那几天应当用来找工作，而不是用来登记领取救济。”

sents.en: "We're doing these things because we know they help people say off benefits and help those on benefits get into work faster"
sents.cn: “我们之所以推行这些举措，是因为我们知道它们能帮助人们摆脱对救济金的依赖，并帮助那些领取救济金的人更快地找到工作。”

sents.en: Help?
sents.cn: 帮助？

sents.en: Really?
sents.cn: 真的吗？

sents.en: On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives for the better, complete with "reforms" to an obviously indulgent system that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsides laziness.
sents.cn: 乍一听，这位财政大臣关心社会民生，努力让人们的生活变得更美好，还对一套显然过于纵容的制度进行了“改革”——这套制度对新近失业者的求职努力要求太低，等于在补贴懒惰。

analysis.trunk: S+be+表：this was the socially concerned chancellor（乍一听，这是位关心社会的财政大臣）
structure: 状语：On first hearing
主句：this was the socially concerned chancellor
├ 现在分词作伴随/定语〔修饰 chancellor〕：trying to change lives for the better
└ 形容词短语作伴随/定语〔修饰 chancellor〕：complete with 「reforms」 to an obviously indulgent system
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 system〕：that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsides laziness
└ 从句内并列谓语：demands too little effort… and subsidizes laziness
analysis.logic: 主句 this was the chancellor；trying… 现在分词、complete with… 形容词短语都修饰 chancellor（伴随描述）；that 定语从句修饰 system，从句内并列谓语 demands… and subsidizes…。
notes: trying to change… 与 complete with… 都作 chancellor 的后置修饰/伴随成分。
that demands… and subsidizes…：that 定语从句修饰 system（原文 subsides 应为 subsidizes 补贴/助长）。
demand too little effort … to find work：too little…to 结构；on first hearing 乍一听。

sents.en: What motivated him, we were to understand, was his zeal for "fundamental fairness"-protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending and ensuring that only the most deserving claimants received their benefits.
sents.cn: 我们应当明白，驱使他这样做的，是他对“根本公平”的热忱——保护纳税人、控制开支，并确保只有最应当获得救济的申领者才能领到救济金。

sents.en: Losing a job is hurting: you don't skip down to the jobcentre with a song in your heart, delighted at the prospect of doubling your income from the generous state.
sents.cn: 失业是痛苦的：你不会心怀喜悦、哼着小曲蹦跳着走向就业中心，为有望从慷慨的国家那里把收入翻一番而欣喜。

sents.en: It is financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing and you know that support is minimal and extraordinarily hard to get.
sents.cn: 失业在经济上令人惶恐，在心理上令人难堪，而且你知道能得到的支持微乎其微、极难争取。

sents.en: You are now not wanted; you are now excluded from the work environment that offers purpose and structure in your life.
sents.cn: 如今你不再被需要；你被排斥在那个为你的人生提供目标和秩序的工作环境之外。

sents.en: Worse, the crucial income to feed yourself and your family and pay the bills has disappeared.
sents.cn: 更糟的是，那份用来养活自己和家人、支付各种账单的至关重要的收入也没有了。

sents.en: Ask anyone newly unemployed what they want and the answer is always: a job.
sents.cn: 随便问一个新近失业的人想要什么，答案永远是：一份工作。

sents.en: But in Osborneland, your first instinct is to fall into dependency- permanent dependency if you can get it-supported by a state only too ready to indulge your falsehood.
sents.cn: 但在奥斯本的世界里，你的第一反应却是陷入依赖——如果能办到，最好是永久的依赖——靠一个一味乐于纵容你弄虚作假的国家来供养。

sents.en: It is as though 20 years of ever- tougher reforms of the job search and benefit administration system never happened.
sents.cn: 这仿佛是二十年来对求职和救济金管理制度日益严苛的改革从未发生过一样。

sents.en: The principle of British welfare is no longer that you can insure yourself against the risk of unemployment and receive unconditional payments if the disaster happens.
sents.cn: 英国福利的原则不再是：你可以为失业风险投保，一旦不幸降临便能无条件地领取救济金。

sents.en: Even the very phrase 'jobseeker's allowance'-invented in 1996- is about redefining the unemployed as a "jobseeker" who had no mandatory right to a benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions.
sents.cn: 甚至连“求职者津贴”这个1996年发明出来的说法本身，也是在把失业者重新界定为“求职者”——此人对自己通过缴纳国民保险费而挣得的救济金并不享有强制性的领取权。

sents.en: Instead, the claimant receives a time-limited "allowance," conditional on actively seeking a job; no entitlement and no insurance, at £71.70 a week, one of the least generous in the EU.
sents.cn: 相反，申领者领到的是一笔有时限的“津贴”，前提是积极求职；既无领取资格，也无保险性质，每周71.70英镑，是欧盟中最不慷慨的津贴之一。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：the claimant receives a time-limited 「allowance」（申领者领到一笔有时限的「津贴」）
structure: 状语：Instead
主句：the claimant receives a time-limited 「allowance」
└ 形容词短语作后置定语〔修饰 allowance〕：conditional on actively seeking a job
分号后（对 allowance 的补充/同位说明）：no entitlement and no insurance, at £71.70 a week, one of the least generous in the EU
analysis.logic: 主句 the claimant receives an allowance；conditional on… 形容词短语作定语（以…为条件）；分号后补充说明该津贴（无权益、无保险、每周71.70英镑，欧盟最低之一）。
notes: conditional on actively seeking a job：形容词短语作后置定语修饰 allowance（以积极求职为条件）。
分号后是对该 allowance 的补充/同位说明。
one of the least generous in the EU：one of the + 最高级（欧盟最不慷慨者之一）。

sents.en: All around the world, lawyers generate more hostility than the members of any other profession---with the possible exception of journalism.
sents.cn: 在世界各地，律师招致的敌意比任何其他职业的从业者都要多——也许只有新闻业是个例外。

sents.en: But there are few places where clients have more grounds for complaint than America.
sents.cn: 但很少有哪个地方像美国这样，让客户有如此多的理由抱怨。

sents.en: During the decade before the economic crisis, spending on legal services in America grew twice as fast as inflation.
sents.cn: 在经济危机爆发前的十年里，美国法律服务支出的增长速度是通货膨胀的两倍。

sents.en: The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools.
sents.cn: 最顶尖的律师赚得盆满钵满，赚的钱足以堆满摩天大楼，吸引越来越多的学生涌入法学院。

sents.en: But most law graduates never get a big-firm job.
sents.cn: 但大多数法学院毕业生从未能进入大型律所工作。

sents.en: Many of them instead become the kind of nuisance-lawsuit filer that makes the tort system a costly nightmare.
sents.cn: 相反，他们中的许多人成了那种专门提起无谓诉讼的人，使侵权诉讼制度沦为一场代价高昂的噩梦。

sents.en: There are many reasons for this.
sents.cn: 造成这种状况的原因有很多。

sents.en: One is the excessive costs of a legal education.
sents.cn: 其一是法学教育费用过高。

sents.en: There is just one path for a lawyer in most American states: a four-year undergraduate degree in some unrelated subject,then a three-year law degree at one of 200 law schools authorized by the American Bar Association and an expensive preparation for the bar exam.
sents.cn: 在美国大多数州，要成为律师只有一条路：先在某个不相关的专业读完四年本科，然后到美国律师协会认可的200所法学院之一攻读三年法学学位，再为律师资格考试做一番花费不菲的备考。

analysis.trunk: there be：There is just one path for a lawyer in most American states（在多数美国州，当律师只有一条路）
structure: 主句(there be)：There is just one path for a lawyer in most American states
冒号后（对 path 的同位说明，三项并列）：a four-year undergraduate degree …, then a three-year law degree …, and an expensive preparation for the bar exam
└ 过去分词作定语〔修饰 law schools〕：authorized by the American Bar Association
analysis.logic: there be one path；冒号引出 path 的具体内容（三个并列名词短语：本科学位、法学学位、备考）；authorized by… 过去分词定语修饰 law schools。
notes: 冒号后是对 one path 的同位说明，三个并列名词短语（degree, then degree…, and preparation）。
authorized by the American Bar Association：过去分词作定语修饰 law schools。
there be 结构：真正主语是 one path。

sents.en: This leaves today's average law-school graduate with $100,000 of debt on top of undergraduate debts.
sents.cn: 这使得如今普通的法学院毕业生在本科阶段的债务之外，又背上了10万美元的债务。

sents.en: Law-school debt means that they have to work fearsomely hard.
sents.cn: 法学院的债务意味着他们不得不拼命苦干。

sents.en: Reforming the system would help both lawyers and their customers.
sents.cn: 改革这一制度对律师和他们的客户都有好处。

sents.en: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
sents.cn: 明智的改革设想早已存在，但管理这一行业的各州级机构过于保守，迟迟不肯将其付诸实施。

sents.en: One idea is to allow people to study law as an undergraduate degree.
sents.cn: 一种设想是允许人们把法律作为本科专业来学习。

sents.en: Another is to let students sit for the bar after only two years of law school.
sents.cn: 另一种设想是让学生只读两年法学院就可以参加律师资格考试。

sents.en: If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so.
sents.cn: 如果说律师资格考试对一名准律师而言确实是一项足够严格的检验，那么能够更早参加考试的人就应当被允许这样做。

sents.en: Students who do not need the extra training could cut their debt mountain by a third.
sents.cn: 那些并不需要额外培训的学生，可以借此把堆积如山的债务削减三分之一。

sents.en: The other reason why costs are so high is the restrictive guild-like ownership structure of the business.
sents.cn: 费用如此之高的另一个原因，是这一行业类似行会的、带有限制性的所有权结构。

sents.en: Except in the District of Columbia, non-lawyers may not own any share of a law firm.
sents.cn: 除哥伦比亚特区外，非律师不得持有律所的任何股份。

sents.en: This keeps fees high and innovation slow.
sents.cn: 这使得收费居高不下、创新步履缓慢。

sents.en: There is pressure for change from within the profession, but opponents of change among the regulators insist that keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates lawyers from the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically.
sents.cn: 行业内部要求变革的呼声不断，但监管者中反对变革的人坚持认为，把外人挡在律所之外能使律师免受赚钱压力的影响，从而恪守职业道德为客户服务，而非一味逐利。

analysis.trunk: 并列双分句(but)：① There is pressure for change … ② opponents … insist that …（行业内有变革压力，但反对者坚称…）
structure: 分句①(there be)：There is pressure for change from within the profession
并列(but)分句②：opponents of change among the regulators insist that …
└ 宾语从句(that)：keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates lawyers from the pressure …
├ 动名词作主语：keeping outsiders out of a law firm
└ 不定式作定语〔修饰 pressure〕：to make money rather than serve clients ethically
analysis.logic: but 连接两分句；分句② insist that…，从句主语是动名词 keeping…，谓语 isolates A from B；to make money rather than serve… 修饰 pressure。
notes: that 宾语从句的主语是动名词 keeping outsiders out of a law firm（把外人挡在所外）。
isolate A from B 使 A 与 B 隔绝；the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically：不定式作定语修饰 pressure。
rather than 连接对比（赚钱 而非 有道德地服务客户）。

sents.en: In fact, allowing non-lawyers to own shares in law firms would reduce costs and improve services to customers, by encouraging law firms to use technology and to employ professional managers to focus on improving firms' efficiency.
sents.cn: 事实上，允许非律师持有律所股份将会降低成本、改善对客户的服务，因为这能促使律所运用技术，并聘请专业管理人员专注于提升律所的运营效率。

analysis.trunk: 动名词主语+并列谓语：allowing … would reduce costs and improve services（允许非律师持股 会降成本、提升服务）
structure: 状语：In fact
主句主语（动名词）：allowing non-lawyers to own shares in law firms
并列谓语：would reduce costs and improve services to customers
方式状语(by + V-ing)：by encouraging law firms to use technology and to employ professional managers to focus on improving firms' efficiency
├ encourage sb to do（两个并列不定式）：to use technology / to employ professional managers
└ 不定式作目的：to focus on improving firms' efficiency
analysis.logic: 动名词短语 allowing… 作主语；并列谓语 would reduce… and improve…；by encouraging… 方式状语，其中 encourage sb to do（两个并列不定式）+ to focus on… 目的。
notes: 主语是动名词短语 allowing non-lawyers to own shares…（允许非律师持股）。
by encouraging… 方式状语；encourage sb to do 两个并列不定式 to use… and to employ…。
would reduce costs and improve services 并列谓语；focus on improving 专注于改进。

sents.en: After all, other countries, such as Australia and Britain, have started liberalizing their legal professions.
sents.cn: 毕竟，澳大利亚和英国等其他国家已经开始放开对法律行业的管制。

sents.en: America should follow.
sents.cn: 美国理应效仿。

sents.en: The US$3-million Fundamental physics prize is indeed an interesting experiment, as Alexander Polyakov said when he accepted this year's award in March.
sents.cn: 正如亚历山大·波利亚科夫今年三月领取该奖项时所说，奖金高达300万美元的“基础物理学奖”的确是一项有趣的尝试。

sents.en: And it is far from the only one of its type.
sents.cn: 而且它远非这类奖项中唯一的一个。

sents.en: As a News Feature article in Nature discusses, a string of lucrative awards for researchers have joined the Nobel Prizes in recent years.
sents.cn: 正如《自然》杂志一篇新闻特写所讨论的那样，近年来一系列奖金丰厚的研究奖项与诺贝尔奖并列于世。

sents.en: Many, like the Fundamental Physics Prize, are funded from the telephone-number-sized bank accounts of Internet entrepreneurs.
sents.cn: 其中许多奖项，如基础物理学奖，资金来自互联网企业家那些数字长得像电话号码一样的银行账户。

sents.en: These benefactors have succeeded in their chosen fields, they say, and they want to use their wealth to draw attention to those who have succeeded in science.
sents.cn: 这些捐助者说，他们已在各自选定的领域取得成功，如今想用自己的财富来引起人们对那些在科学上取得成功者的关注。

analysis.trunk: 并列双分句(and)：① These benefactors have succeeded … ② they want to use their wealth to draw attention to …（这些捐助者已在各自领域成功，他们想用财富让人关注…）
structure: 分句①：These benefactors have succeeded in their chosen fields
└ 插入语：they say
并列(and)分句②：they want to use their wealth to draw attention to those …
├ 不定式作目的：to draw attention to those
└ 定语从句〔who，修饰 those〕：who have succeeded in science
analysis.logic: they say 插入语；and 连接两分句；分句② want to do + to draw attention（目的）；who 定语从句修饰 those。
notes: they say 是插入语（他们说），可提出。
use their wealth to draw attention to…：to draw… 不定式作目的状语。
those who have succeeded in science：who 定语从句修饰 those。

sents.en: What's not to like?
sents.cn: 这有什么不好呢？

sents.en: Quite a lot, according to a handful of scientists quoted in the News Feature.
sents.cn: 据新闻特写中援引的少数几位科学家所言，不好之处还真不少。

sents.en: You cannot buy class, as the old saying goes, and these upstart entrepreneurs cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels.
sents.cn: 正如那句老话所说，格调是买不来的，这些暴发户般的企业家也无法为自己设立的奖项买来诺贝尔奖那样的声望。

sents.en: The new awards are an exercise in self-promotion for those behind them, say scientists.
sents.cn: 科学家们说，这些新设的奖项是其幕后出资者自我宣传的手段。

sents.en: They could distort the achievement-based system of peer-review-led research.
sents.cn: 它们可能扭曲那套以成就为本、由同行评议主导的研究体系。

sents.en: They could cement the status quo of peer-reviewed research.
sents.cn: 它们可能固化同行评议研究的现状。

sents.en: They do not fund peer-reviewed research.
sents.cn: 它们并不资助同行评议的研究。

sents.en: They perpetuate the myth of the lone genius.
sents.cn: 它们使“孤胆天才”的神话得以延续。

sents.en: The goals of the prize-givers seem as scattered as the criticism.
sents.cn: 颁奖者的目标似乎和批评意见一样五花八门。

sents.en: Some want to shock, others to draw people into science, or to better reward those who have made their careers in research.
sents.cn: 有人想要语惊四座，有人想把人们吸引到科学中来，还有人想更好地奖励那些以科研为业的人。

sents.en: As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes—both new and old—are distributed.
sents.cn: 正如《自然》杂志此前所指出的，对于科学奖项——无论新旧——如何颁授，确实存在一些合理的担忧。

sents.en: The Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, launched this year, takes an unrepresentative view of what the life sciences include.
sents.cn: 今年设立的“生命科学突破奖”，对生命科学所涵盖的范围持有一种以偏概全的看法。

sents.en: But the Nobel Foundation's limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must still be living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research—as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson.
sents.cn: 但诺贝尔基金会关于每个奖项至多三名得主、且每位得主都必须在世的限制，早已不能适应现代科研的协作性质——当人们要为希格斯玻色子的发现论功行赏时，围绕谁被忽略而必然爆发的争论便会证明这一点。

analysis.trunk: S+V(被动)：the Nobel Foundation's limit … has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research（诺奖「每奖至多三人」的限制 早已被现代科研的协作性所超越）
structure: 主句：the Nobel Foundation's limit of three recipients per prize … has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research
├ 非限制性定语从句〔each of whom，修饰 recipients〕：each of whom must still be living
└ 破折号 + 非限制性定语从句(as)：as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored …
└ 宾语从句(who，作 over 的宾语)：who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson
└ 时间状语从句(when)：when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson
analysis.logic: 主句被动 limit has been outgrown by…；each of whom… 非限制定语从句修饰 recipients（造成主谓分隔）；破折号后 as 引导非限制性定语从句（正如…所示）；row over who…（who 宾语从句）；when it comes to doing 当谈到…时。
notes: 主谓分隔：主语 limit 与谓语 has long been outgrown 被 each of whom must still be living 隔开。
has been outgrown by…：被动（已被…超越/不再适应）。
as will be demonstrated…：as 引导非限制性定语从句（正如…将证明）；when it comes to + doing 当谈及…时。

sents.en: The Nobels were, of course, themselves set up by a very rich individual who had decided what he wanted to do with his own money.
sents.cn: 当然，诺贝尔奖本身也是由一位非常富有的人设立的，是他决定了要拿自己的钱来做什么。

sents.en: Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy.
sents.cn: 赋予这些奖项以正当性的，是时间，而非设立者的初衷。

sents.en: As much as some scientists may complain about the new awards, two things seem clear.
sents.cn: 尽管一些科学家或许会对这些新奖项颇有微词，但有两点似乎是明确的。

sents.en: First, most researchers would accept such a prize if they were offered one.
sents.cn: 第一，倘若有人提供这样一个奖项，大多数研究者都会接受。

sents.en: Second, it is surely a good thing that the money and attention come to science rather than go elsewhere, It is fair to criticize and question the mechanism—that is the culture of research, after all—but it is the prize-givers' money to do with as they please.
sents.cn: 第二，让金钱和关注流向科学而非别处，无疑是一件好事。对其评奖机制加以批评和质疑是无可厚非的——毕竟这正是科研的文化——但这毕竟是颁奖者自己的钱，他们爱怎么用就怎么用。

analysis.trunk: 并列松散句：① it is a good thing that … ② It is fair to … — but ③ it is the prize-givers' money to do with as they please
structure: 分句①（形式主语 it）：it is surely a good thing that the money and attention come to science rather than go elsewhere
└ 主语从句(that)：that the money and attention come to science rather than go elsewhere
分句②（形式主语 it）：It is fair to criticize and question the mechanism
└ 破折号插入：that is the culture of research, after all
but 分句③：it is the prize-givers' money to do with as they please
├ 不定式作定语〔修饰 money〕：to do with
└ 方式状语从句(as)：as they please
analysis.logic: 三个分句：①②均为 it 形式主语（真正主语分别是 that 从句、to criticize… 不定式）；③ it is the … money to do with as they please（这是奖金颁发者的钱，他们爱怎么花就怎么花）；破折号插入解释 mechanism。
notes: ①it is a good thing that…：it 形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句。②It is fair to criticize…：it 形式主语，真正主语是不定式。
破折号夹的 that is the culture of research, after all 是插入解释（毕竟这就是科研文化）。
to do with as they please：to do with 不定式作定语修饰 money，as they please 方式状语（随他们高兴怎么处置）。

sents.en: It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace.
sents.cn: 明智之举是怀着感激与雅量接受这样的馈赠。

sents.en: "The Heart of the Matter," the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.
sents.cn: 美国艺术与科学院刚刚发布的报告《问题的核心》，因肯定了人文学科与社会科学对美国自由民主制度之繁荣与安全的重要性而值得赞许。

sents.en: Regrettably, however, the report's failure to address the true nature of the crisis facing liberal education may cause more harm than good.
sents.cn: 然而遗憾的是，该报告未能触及自由教育所面临危机的真正本质，这或许会弊大于利。

sents.en: In 2010, leading congressional Democrats and Republicans sent letters to the AAAS asking that it identify actions that could be taken by "federal, state and local governments, universities, foundations, educators, individual benefactors and others" to "maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education."In response, the American Academy formed the Commission on the Humanities and Social Sciences.
sents.cn: 2010年，国会民主党与共和党的领袖们致函美国艺术与科学院，请其指明“联邦、州及地方政府、大学、基金会、教育工作者、个人捐助者及其他各方”可以采取哪些行动，以“保持人文学科与社会科学学术研究和教育领域的国家卓越水平”。作为回应，美国艺术与科学院成立了人文与社会科学委员会。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：Democrats and Republicans sent letters to the AAAS …（两党议员致信美国艺术与科学院…）
structure: 状语：In 2010
主句：leading congressional Democrats and Republicans sent letters to the AAAS
└ 现在分词作伴随状语〔修饰寄信动作〕：asking that it identify actions …
└ 宾语从句(that + 虚拟语气)：that it identify actions（ask that + 主语 + (should) do）
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 actions〕：that could be taken by 「…」 to 「maintain national excellence…」
└ 不定式作目的：to 「maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education」
（后续独立句）：In response, the American Academy formed the Commission on the Humanities and Social Sciences
analysis.logic: 主句 sent letters；asking that… 现在分词短语作伴随状语，其中 ask that + (should) identify 虚拟；that could be taken… 定语从句修饰 actions；to maintain… 目的；末句独立。
notes: asking that it identify…：ask that + 主语 + (should) do 的虚拟语气（动词原形 identify）。
actions that could be taken by … to maintain…：that 定语从句修饰 actions，to maintain… 表目的。
本条含两句：In response… 为另一句。

sents.en: Among the commission's 51 members are top-tier-university presidents, scholars, lawyers, judges, and business executives, as well as prominent figures from diplomacy, filmmaking, music and journalism.
sents.cn: 该委员会的51名成员中，既有一流大学的校长、学者、律师、法官和企业高管，也有来自外交、电影制作、音乐和新闻界的知名人士。

sents.en: The goals identified in the report are generally admirable.
sents.cn: 报告中提出的目标总体上令人钦佩。

sents.en: Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy; stresses the study of history and government, particularly American history and American government; and encourages the use of new digital technologies.
sents.cn: 由于代议制政府以公民知情为前提，该报告主张实现全民充分的读写能力；强调对历史和政治、尤其是美国历史和美国政治的研究；并鼓励运用新的数字技术。

sents.en: To encourage innovation and competition, the report calls for increased investment in research, the crafting of coherent curricula that improve students' ability to solve problems and communicate effectively in the 21st century, increased funding for teachers and the encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day.
sents.cn: 为鼓励创新与竞争，该报告呼吁加大科研投入，精心设计连贯的课程以提升学生在21世纪解决问题和有效沟通的能力，增加对教师的经费投入，并鼓励学者运用所学来应对当今的重大挑战。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：the report calls for …（报告呼吁四项并列举措）
structure: 目的状语(不定式)：To encourage innovation and competition
主句：the report calls for …（call for 后四个并列名词宾语）
├ 并列宾语①：increased investment in research
├ 并列宾语②：the crafting of coherent curricula
│   └ 定语从句〔that，修饰 curricula〕：that improve students' ability to solve problems and communicate effectively in the 21st century（不定式 to solve… 修饰 ability）
├ 并列宾语③：increased funding for teachers
└ 并列宾语④：the encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day
analysis.logic: To encourage… 目的状语；主句 calls for + 四个并列名词宾语；其中 curricula 带 that 定语从句（that improve ability to do）；最后 encouragement of scholars to bring…（bring sth to bear on 把…用于）。
notes: calls for 后接四个并列名词宾语：investment, the crafting of curricula, funding, and the encouragement…。
curricula that improve students' ability to do：that 定语从句修饰 curricula；to solve… 不定式修饰 ability。
bring one's learning to bear on…：把学识用于（应对）…；To encourage… 目的状语。

sents.en: The report also advocates greater study of foreign languages, international affairs and the expansion of study abroad programs.
sents.cn: 该报告还提倡加强对外语和国际事务的学习，并扩大海外留学项目。

sents.en: Unfortunately, despite 2½ years in the making, "The Heart of the Matter" never gets to the heart of the matter: the illiberal nature of liberal education at our leading colleges and universities.
sents.cn: 遗憾的是，尽管历时两年半才完成，《问题的核心》却始终未能触及问题的核心：我国一流高校自由教育所具有的反自由本质。

sents.en: The commission ignores that for several decades America's colleges and universities have produced graduates who don't know the content and character of liberal education and are thus deprived of its benefits.
sents.cn: 该委员会无视这样一个事实：几十年来，美国的高校培养出的毕业生并不了解自由教育的内涵与特质，因而也被剥夺了自由教育所能带来的益处。

sents.en: Sadly, the spirit of inquiry once at home on campus has been replaced by the use of the humanities and social sciences as vehicles for publicizing "progressive," or left-liberal propaganda.
sents.cn: 可悲的是，曾经在校园里蔚然成风的探究精神，已被人文学科和社会科学所取代——它们沦为宣扬“进步主义”即左翼自由主义思想的工具。

sents.en: Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas—such as free markets or self-reliance —as falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.
sents.cn: 如今，教授们惯于把对历史的进步主义解读和进步主义的公共政策当作恰当的研究课题，却把保守主义或古典自由主义的理念——如自由市场或自力更生——描绘成超出常规、有时甚至超出正当智识探究范围之外的东西。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O(treat A as B)：professors … treat the progressive interpretation … as the proper subject of study（教授们惯于把进步派解读当作正当研究对象）
structure: 状语：Today
主句：professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study
└ treat A as B：treat 〔进步派历史解读 + 进步派公共政策〕 as the proper subject of study
while + 现在分词作对比状语：while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas … as falling outside the boundaries …
├ portray A as B：portray 〔保守/古典自由派思想〕 as falling outside the boundaries of … investigation
└ 破折号插入（举例）：such as free markets or self-reliance
analysis.logic: 主句 treat A as B（把进步派解读当作正当研究对象）；while portraying… 现在分词作对比状语（同时却把保守/古典自由派思想描绘为…）；portray A as B；破折号插入举例。
notes: treat A as B（把 A 当作 B）与 while portraying A as B（同时把 A 描绘成 B）形成鲜明对比。
while + V-ing 作伴随/对比状语（同时却…）。
破折号夹的 such as free markets or self-reliance 是插入举例；fall outside the boundaries 落在…范围之外。

sents.en: The AAAS displays great enthusiasm for liberal education.
sents.cn: 美国艺术与科学院对自由教育表现出极大的热情。

sents.en: Yet its report may well set back reform by obscuring the depth and breadth of the challenge that Congress asked it to illuminate.
sents.cn: 然而，其报告掩盖了国会请其阐明的这一挑战在深度和广度上的真相，很可能反而会使改革倒退。

sents.en: King Juan Carlos of Spain once insisted "kings don't abdicate, they die in their sleep."
sents.cn: 西班牙国王胡安·卡洛斯曾坚称，“国王不会退位，他们会在睡梦中死去”。

sents.en: But embarrassing scandals and the popularity of the republican left in the recent Euro-elections have forced him to eat his words and stand down.
sents.cn: 但是，一连串令人难堪的丑闻，以及共和派左翼在最近欧洲议会选举中人气高涨，迫使他收回前言、黯然退位。

sents.en: So, does the Spanish crisis suggest that monarchy is seeing its last days?
sents.cn: 那么，西班牙的这场危机是否意味着君主制正走向终结？

sents.en: Does that mean the writing is on the wall for all European royals, with their magnificent uniforms and majestic lifestyles?
sents.cn: 这是否意味着，对所有身着华美制服、过着尊贵生活的欧洲王室成员而言，覆灭的征兆已然显现？

sents.en: The Spanish case provides arguments both for and against monarchy.
sents.cn: 西班牙的例子为君主制提供了支持与反对两方面的论据。

sents.en: When public opinion is particularly polarised, as it was following the end of the Franco regime, monarchs can rise above "mere"politics and "embody" a spirit of national unity.
sents.cn: 当公众舆论严重两极分化时，正如佛朗哥政权终结后的情形那样，君主能够超越“纯粹的”政治，“体现”民族团结的精神。

sents.en: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.
sents.cn: 正是这种对政治的明显超越，解释了君主作为国家元首何以长盛不衰、深得人心。

sents.en: And so, the Middle East excepted, Europe is the most monarch-infested region in the world, with 10 kingdoms (not counting Vatican City and Andorra).
sents.cn: 因此，除中东地区之外，欧洲是世界上君主最为密集的地区，拥有10个王国（梵蒂冈城国和安道尔尚未计入）。

sents.en: But unlike their absolutist counterparts in the Gulf and Asia, most royal families have survived because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure.
sents.cn: 但与海湾地区和亚洲那些专制的同类不同，大多数王室之所以得以延续，是因为它们让选民免去了寻觅一位无争议却又受人尊敬的公众人物这一难题。

analysis.trunk: S+V：most royal families have survived（多数王室得以存续）
structure: 状语(unlike…)：But unlike their absolutist counterparts in the Gulf and Asia
主句：most royal families have survived
原因状语从句(because)：because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure
└ allow sb to do：allow voters to avoid the difficult search
analysis.logic: unlike… 作状语（与…不同）；主句 most royal families have survived；because 原因从句，allow sb to do（让选民得以避免…）。
notes: unlike their absolutist counterparts… 作状语（与海湾和亚洲的专制君主不同）。
because 引导原因状语从句；allow sb to do（让某人得以…）。
non-controversial but respected：并列形容词修饰 public figure（无争议却受尊敬的）。

sents.en: Even so, kings and queens undoubtedly have a downside.
sents.cn: 即便如此，国王和王后无疑也有其弊端。

sents.en: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history—and sometimes the way they behave today—embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities.
sents.cn: 尽管他们自诩为民族团结的象征，但他们的历史本身——有时还有他们今日的行为方式——所体现的，却是过时且站不住脚的特权与不平等。

sents.en: At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.
sents.cn: 当托马斯·皮凯蒂等经济学家正告诫人们不平等日益加剧、继承财富的势力不断膨胀之时，富有的贵族家庭竟仍是现代民主国家象征意义上的核心，这实在是咄咄怪事。

analysis.trunk: 形式主语：it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart …（…仍是…的象征核心，实在离奇）
structure: 状语：At a time
└ 定语从句〔when，修饰 a time〕：when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth
主句（形式主语 it）：it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states
└ 主语从句(that)：that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states
analysis.logic: At a time when… 时间状语（when 定语从句修饰 a time）；it 形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句；should 表「竟然/居然」的情感色彩。
notes: when 引导定语从句修饰 a time（不是状语从句）。
it is bizarre that…：it 形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句。
should still be：should 表惊讶/不解（竟然还…），非「应该」；warn of 警示。

sents.en: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
sents.cn: 最成功的君主制都竭力摒弃或掩饰其陈旧的贵族作风。

sents.en: Princes and princesses have day-jobs and ride bicycles, not horses (or helicopters).
sents.cn: 王子和公主们都有日常工作，骑的是自行车，而非骏马（或直升机）。

sents.en: Even so, these are wealthy families who party with the international 1%, and media intrusiveness makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the right image.
sents.cn: 即便如此，他们仍是与国际上那1%的富人一同寻欢作乐的富裕家庭，而媒体的无孔不入使得维持得体的形象愈发困难。

sents.en: While Europe's monarchies will no doubt be smart enough to survive for some time to come, it is the British royals who have most to fear from the Spanish example.
sents.cn: 尽管欧洲各君主制无疑会足够精明，得以在未来一段时间内继续存续，但最该从西班牙这一例子中感到恐惧的，却是英国王室。

analysis.trunk: 让步+强调句：While …, it is the British royals who have most to fear …（尽管…，最该惧怕的是英国王室）
structure: 让步状语从句(While)：While Europe's monarchies will no doubt be smart enough to survive for some time to come
主句（强调句）：it is the British royals who have most to fear from the Spanish example
analysis.logic: While 引导让步状语从句（尽管）；主句是强调句 it is X who…（强调 the British royals）。
notes: While 引导让步状语从句（尽管）。
it is the British royals who…：强调句（强调 the British royals），删 it is…who 后句子仍成立。
smart enough to survive：enough to do；some time to come 未来一段时间。

sents.en: It is only the Queen who has preserved the monarchy's reputation with her rather ordinary (if well-heeled) granny style.
sents.cn: 唯有女王凭借其相当寻常（虽说颇为优渥）的祖母般作风，才得以维护君主制的声誉。

sents.en: The danger will come with Charles, who has both an expensive taste of lifestyle and a pretty hierarchical view of the world.
sents.cn: 危险将随查尔斯而来，他既有奢华的生活品味，又抱有相当等级森严的世界观。

sents.en: He has failed to understand that monarchies have largely survived because they provide a service—as non-controversial and non-political heads of state.
sents.cn: 他未能理解，君主制之所以大体得以存续，是因为它们提供了一种服务——充当无争议、超党派的国家元首。

sents.en: Charles ought to know that as English history shows, it is kings, not republicans, who are the monarchy's worst enemies.
sents.cn: 查尔斯本应明白，正如英国历史所表明的那样，君主制最大的敌人是国王，而非共和派。

sents.en: Just how much does the Constitution protect your digital data?
sents.cn: 宪法究竟能在多大程度上保护你的数字数据？

sents.en: The Supreme Court will now consider whether police can search the contents of a mobile phone without a warrant if the phone is on or around a person during an arrest.
sents.cn: 最高法院如今将审议这样一个问题：在逮捕过程中，如果手机就在被捕者身上或其周围，警方能否在未获搜查令的情况下搜查手机内容。

sents.en: California has asked the justices to refrain from a sweeping ruling, particularly one that upsets the old assumption that authorities may search through the possessions of suspects at the time of their arrest.
sents.cn: 加利福尼亚州已请求大法官们不要作出大范围的裁决，尤其是那种会颠覆旧有假定的裁决——根据该假定，当局可以在逮捕嫌疑人时搜查其随身物品。

sents.en: It is hard, the state argues, for judges to assess the implications of new and rapidly changing technologies.
sents.cn: 该州辩称，法官很难评估新兴且日新月异的技术所带来的影响。

sents.en: The court would be recklessly modest if it followed California's advice.
sents.cn: 倘若法院听从加州的建议，那将是一种鲁莽的谦逊。

sents.en: Enough of the implications are discernable, even obvious, so that the justices can and should provide updated guidelines to police,lawyers and defendants.
sents.cn: 其中足够多的影响是可以辨识的，甚至是显而易见的，因此大法官们能够、也应当为警方、律师和被告提供更新后的指导原则。

sents.en: They should start by discarding California's lame argument that exploring the contents of a smartphone — a vast storehouse of digital information — is similar to, say, going through a suspect's purse.
sents.cn: 他们首先应当摒弃加州那个站不住脚的论点——即查看智能手机（一个庞大的数字信息库）的内容，与诸如翻查嫌疑人钱包之类的行为相似。

analysis.trunk: S+V+by doing：They should start by discarding California's lame argument …（他们应先摒弃加州那个站不住脚的论点）
structure: 主句：They should start by discarding California's lame argument …
├ 方式状语(by + V-ing)：by discarding California's lame argument
└ 同位语从句〔that，说明 argument〕：that exploring the contents of a smartphone … is similar to … going through a suspect's purse
├ 动名词作主语：exploring the contents of a smartphone
└ 破折号插入（smartphone 的同位语）：a vast storehouse of digital information
analysis.logic: 主句 start by discarding the argument；that 同位语从句说明 argument，其主语是动名词 exploring…，谓语 is similar to going through…；破折号插入 smartphone 的同位说明。
notes: argument that…：that 同位语从句说明 argument（不是定语从句）。
从句主语是动名词 exploring the contents of a smartphone，谓语 is similar to going through…（A is similar to B）。
破折号夹的 a vast storehouse of digital information 是 smartphone 的同位语；say 插入（比如说）。

sents.en: The court has ruled that police don't violate the Fourth Amendment when they go through the wallet or pocketbook of an arrestee without a warrant.
sents.cn: 法院曾裁定，警方在未获搜查令的情况下翻查被捕者的钱夹或钱包，并不违反宪法第四修正案。

sents.en: But exploring one's smartphone is more like entering his or her home.
sents.cn: 但查看一个人的智能手机，则更像是进入了他或她的家。

sents.en: A smartphone may contain an arrestee's reading history, financial history, medical history and comprehensive records of recent correspondence.
sents.cn: 一部智能手机可能包含被捕者的阅读记录、财务记录、就医记录，以及近期通信的完整记载。

sents.en: The development of "cloud computing," meanwhile, has made that exploration so much the easier.
sents.cn: 与此同时，“云计算”的发展使得这种查看变得容易得多。

sents.en: Americans should take steps to protect their digital privacy.
sents.cn: 美国人应当采取措施保护自己的数字隐私。

sents.en: But keeping sensitive information on these devices is increasingly a requirement of normal life.
sents.cn: 但在这些设备上保存敏感信息，正日益成为正常生活的一种必需。

sents.en: Citizens still have a right to expect private documents to remain private and protected by the Constitution's prohibition on unreasonable searches.
sents.cn: 公民仍然有权期望私人文件保持私密，并受到宪法禁止不合理搜查这一条款的保护。

sents.en: As so often is the case, stating that principle doesn't ease the challenge of line-drawing.
sents.cn: 正如常常发生的那样，阐明这一原则并不能减轻划定界限的难度。

sents.en: In many cases, it would not be overly burdensome for authorities to obtain a warrant to search through phone contents.
sents.cn: 在许多情况下，当局为搜查手机内容而申请一张搜查令，并不会构成过重的负担。

sents.en: They could still invalidate Fourth Amendment protections when facing severe,urgent circumstances, and they could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant.
sents.cn: 在面临严峻、紧急的情况时，他们仍可使第四修正案的保护失效；而且在等待搜查令期间，他们也可以采取合理措施，确保手机数据不被删除或篡改。

analysis.trunk: 并列双分句(and)：① They could still invalidate … protections ② they could take reasonable measures to ensure …
structure: 分句①：They could still invalidate Fourth Amendment protections when facing severe,urgent circumstances
└ 时间状语(when + 现在分词)：when facing severe,urgent circumstances
并列(and)分句②：they could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant
├ 不定式作目的：to ensure that …
├ 宾语从句(that)：that phone data are not erased or altered
└ 时间状语(while + V-ing)：while waiting for a warrant
analysis.logic: and 连接两分句；分句① when facing…（现在分词时间状语）；分句② take measures to ensure that…（目的 + 宾语从句），while waiting…（时间状语）。
notes: when facing… / while waiting…：连词 + 现在分词（省略与主句相同的主语）作时间状语。
to ensure that…：不定式作目的；that 引导 ensure 的宾语从句。
phone data are not erased or altered：被动并列（数据不被删除或篡改）。

sents.en: The court, though, may want to allow room for police to cite situations where they are entitled to more freedom.
sents.cn: 不过，法院或许会希望留有余地，让警方得以援引那些他们有权享有更多自由的情形。

sents.en: But the justices should not swallow California's argument whole.
sents.cn: 但大法官们不应全盘接受加州的论点。

sents.en: New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution's protections.
sents.cn: 新兴的、具有颠覆性的技术，有时要求人们以新颖的方式来适用宪法的各项保护。

sents.en: Orin Kerr, a law professor, compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use as a virtual necessity of life in the 20th: The justices had to specify novel rules for the new personal domain of the passenger car then; they must sort out how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information now.
sents.cn: 法学教授奥林·克尔将21世纪数字信息的爆炸式增长及其易得性，与20世纪汽车的使用确立为生活几乎不可或缺之必需这一过程相类比：当年，大法官们不得不为乘用车这一新的私人领域制定新颖的规则；如今，他们则必须厘清第四修正案该如何适用于数字信息。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O(compare A with B)：Orin Kerr … compares the explosion … of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use … in the 20th（克尔把21世纪数字信息的爆炸 与 20世纪汽车的普及相类比）
structure: 主句：Orin Kerr … compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use as a virtual necessity of life in the 20th
├ 同位语〔说明 Orin Kerr〕：a law professor
└ compare A with B：A=21世纪数字信息的爆炸与可得性；B=20世纪汽车成为生活必需
冒号后（对照，两分句分号并列）：
├ 分句①：The justices had to specify novel rules for the new personal domain of the passenger car then
└ 分句②(;)：they must sort out how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information now
└ 宾语从句(how)：how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information
analysis.logic: 主句 compare A(21世纪数字信息) with B(20世纪汽车)；冒号引出对照（then 当年 vs now 如今，两分句分号并列）；how… 宾语从句。
notes: compare A with B：把 A 与 B 类比；a law professor 是 Orin Kerr 的同位语。
冒号后两分句（分号并列）形成 then(当年汽车) vs now(如今数字信息) 的对照。
sort out how…：how 引导宾语从句（厘清第四修正案如何适用于数字信息）。

sents.en: The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today.
sents.cn: 《科学》杂志正在其同行评议流程中增加一道额外的统计学审查，该杂志主编玛西娅·麦克纳特于今日宣布了这一消息。

sents.en: The policy follows similar efforts from other journals, after widespread concern that basic mistakes in data analysis are contributing to the irreproducibility of many published research findings.
sents.cn: 在人们普遍担忧数据分析中的基本错误正导致众多已发表研究结论无法重现之后，这一举措效仿了其他期刊的类似做法。

sents.en: "Readers must have confidence in the conclusions published in our journal," writes McNutt in an editorial.
sents.cn: 麦克纳特在一篇社论中写道：“读者必须对本刊所发表结论抱有信心。”

sents.en: Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistic board of reviewing editors (SBoRE).
sents.cn: 该杂志与美国统计协会合作，任命了七名专家组成统计审稿编辑委员会（SBoRE）。

sents.en: Manuscript will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal's internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers.
sents.cn: 稿件将由杂志内部编辑、现有的审稿编辑委员会或外部同行评审员标记出来，以接受额外的审查。

sents.en: The SBoRE panel will then find external statisticians to review these manuscripts.
sents.cn: 随后，SBoRE专家组将物色外部统计学家来评审这些稿件。

sents.en: Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change, McNutt said: "The creation of the 'statistics board' was motivated by concerns broadly with the application of statistics and data analysis in scientific research and is part of Science's overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish."
sents.cn: 当被问及是否有某些具体论文促成了这一变化时，麦克纳特表示：“设立‘统计委员会’，其动因在于对科学研究中统计学与数据分析之应用的广泛担忧，并且这是《科学》杂志为提高所发表研究之可重现性而做出的整体努力的一部分。”

analysis.trunk: 过去分词状语+主句：Asked whether …, McNutt said: 「…」（被问及是否…时，麦克纳特说：「…」）
structure: 过去分词作状语(被动)：Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change
└ 宾语从句(whether)：whether any particular papers had impelled the change
主句：McNutt said: 「…」
引语：The creation of the 'statistics board' was motivated by … and is part of Science's overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish
├ 并列谓语：was motivated by … / is part of …
├ 不定式作定语〔修饰 drive〕：to increase reproducibility in the research we publish
└ 定语从句〔省略关系词，修饰 research〕：we publish
analysis.logic: Asked whether…（过去分词作状语 = When asked whether…）；主句 McNutt said；引语并列谓语 was motivated by… and is part of…；to increase… 修饰 drive；(that) we publish 定语从句修饰 research。
notes: Asked whether…：过去分词短语作状语（被问及是否…时）。
引语并列谓语：was motivated by… and is part of…。
the research (that) we publish：research 后省略关系词的定语从句；reproducibility 可重复性。

sents.en: Giovanni Parmigiani, a biostatistician at the Harvard School of Public Health, a member of the SBoRE group, says he expects the board to "play primarily an advisory role."
sents.cn: 乔瓦尼·帕尔米贾尼是哈佛大学公共卫生学院的一位生物统计学家，也是SBoRE小组的成员，他表示自己预计该委员会将“主要发挥咨询作用”。

sents.en: He agreed to join because he "found the foresight behind the establishment of the SBoRE to be novel, unique and likely to have a lasting impact. This impact will not only be through the publications in Science itself, but hopefully through a larger group of publishing places that may want to model their approach after Science."
sents.cn: 他之所以同意加入，是因为他“觉得设立SBoRE背后的这份远见新颖、独到，且很可能产生持久的影响。这种影响不仅将通过《科学》杂志自身的出版物得以实现，而且有望波及更广泛的一批出版机构——它们或许会希望仿效《科学》的做法”。

analysis.trunk: S+V：He agreed to join（他同意加入）
structure: 主句：He agreed to join
原因状语从句(because)：because he 「found the foresight … to be novel, unique and likely to have a lasting impact …」
└ find + 宾 + to be + 宾补：found the foresight … to be novel, unique and likely to have a lasting impact
（引语后句）：This impact will not only be through the publications in Science itself, but … through a larger group of publishing places …
├ not only … but … 并列：through the publications… / through a larger group of publishing places
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 publishing places〕：that may want to model their approach after Science
analysis.logic: 主句 He agreed to join；because 原因从句，find sth to be …（认为…是…）；引语后句 not only…but… 并列，that 定语从句修饰 publishing places。
notes: find sth to be …：found the foresight … to be novel…（认为…具有…）。
not only … but (also) …：并列两个 through 短语。
model their approach after Science：仿照《科学》塑造其做法；that 定语从句修饰 publishing places。

sents.en: John Ioannidis, a physician who studies research methodology, says that the policy is "a most welcome step forward" and "long overdue." "Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish. I think that, for the majority of scientific papers nowadays, statistical review is more essential than expert review," he says.
sents.cn: 约翰·约安尼迪斯是一位研究科研方法论的医生，他表示这一举措是“一个极受欢迎的进步”，而且“早就该如此了”。“大多数期刊在统计学审查方面都很薄弱，这损害了它们所发表内容的质量。我认为，对当今绝大多数科学论文而言，统计学审查比专家审查更为关键，”他说。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：John Ioannidis … says that the policy is 「a most welcome step forward」 and 「long overdue」（约安尼迪斯说这一政策「极受欢迎、早该如此」）
structure: 主句：John Ioannidis … says that the policy is 「a most welcome step forward」 and 「long overdue」
├ 同位语〔说明 John Ioannidis〕：a physician
│   └ 定语从句〔who，修饰 a physician〕：who studies research methodology
└ 宾语从句(that)：the policy is 「a most welcome step forward」 and 「long overdue」（并列表语）
（后续引语另为两句）：…damages the quality of what they publish … statistical review is more essential than expert review
├ 名词性从句(what，作 of 的宾语)：what they publish
└ 比较级：more essential than expert review
analysis.logic: 主句 says that…（同位语 a physician who…）；宾语从句并列表语；后续引语含 what 从句、比较结构、I think that…。
notes: a physician who studies research methodology：a physician 是同位语，who 定语从句再修饰之。
the quality of what they publish：what 名词性从句作 of 的宾语。
more essential than：比较级；a most welcome（a + most，「非常受欢迎的一步」）。

sents.en: But he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.
sents.cn: 但他指出，《内科学年鉴》《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》等生物医学期刊，对统计学审查给予了高度重视。

sents.en: Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyze data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist.
sents.cn: 细胞生物学家戴维·沃克斯认为，人们期望专业科学家懂得如何分析数据，但已发表研究中的统计学错误却普遍得令人担忧。

sents.en: Researchers should improve their standards, he wrote in 2012, but journals should also take a tougher line, "engaging reviewers who are statistically literate and editors who can verify the process."
sents.cn: 他在2012年写道，研究人员应当提高自身的标准，但期刊也应采取更为严厉的立场，“聘用具备统计学素养的评审员，以及能够核查整个流程的编辑”。

sents.en: Vaux says that Science's idea to pass some papers to statisticians "has some merit, but a weakness is that it relies on the board of reviewing editors to identify 'the papers that need scrutiny' in the first place".
sents.cn: 沃克斯表示，《科学》杂志将部分论文交由统计学家审阅的设想“有一定可取之处，但其弱点在于，它一开始就依赖审稿编辑委员会去甄别‘那些需要审查的论文’”。

sents.en: Two years ago, Rupert Murdoch's daughter, Elisabeth, spoke of the "unsettling dearth of integrity across so many of our institutions."
sents.cn: 两年前，鲁伯特·默多克的女儿伊丽莎白曾谈到“我们如此众多的机构中普遍存在的令人不安的诚信缺失”。

sents.en: Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only "sorting mechanism" in society should be profit and the market.
sents.cn: 她认为，诚信之所以崩塌，是因为人们集体认同社会中唯一的“筛选机制”理应是利润与市场。

sents.en: But "it's us, human beings, we the people who create the society we want, not profit."
sents.cn: 但“创造我们所向往之社会的，是我们，是人类，是我们普通民众，而不是利润”。

sents.en: Driving her point home, she continued: "It's increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom."
sents.cn: 为了把观点说透，她接着说道：“越来越明显的是，政府、媒体或商界中目标的缺失、道德语言的缺失，可能会成为资本主义与自由所面临的最危险的目标之一。”

analysis.trunk: 现在分词状语+主句：Driving her point home, she continued: 「…」（为强调其观点，她接着说：「…」）
structure: 现在分词作状语：Driving her point home
主句：she continued: 「…」
引语（形式主语 it）：It's increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose … could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom
├ 主语从句(that)：that the absence of purpose … could become …
└ of… 并列补充〔说明 the absence〕：of a moral language within government, media or business
analysis.logic: Driving her point home 现在分词作状语（强调观点）；主句 she continued；引语 it 形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句；of a moral language… 补充说明 the absence。
notes: Driving her point home：现在分词短语作状语（drive one's point home 把观点讲透/强调）。
It's apparent that…：it 形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句。
the absence of purpose, of a moral language…：of… 并列补充（缺乏宗旨、缺乏道德话语）。

sents.en: This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.
sents.cn: 她认为，正是这种道德目标的缺失，正在损害诸如新闻国际公司之类的企业，使其更有可能误入歧途——正如该公司在大规模非法电话窃听一事上所表现的那样。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies …（这种道德目的的缺失正在损害…等公司）
structure: 主句：This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International
└ 插入语：she thought
现在分词作结果状语：making it more likely that it would lose its way …
├ make it（形式宾语）+ more likely + that 从句（真正宾语）：that it would lose its way
└ 方式状语从句(as)：as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking
analysis.logic: 主句 the absence was wounding companies（she thought 插入）；making… 现在分词作结果状语（make it + 形容词 + that 从句，it 形式宾语）；as it had… 方式状语（如同它曾…）。
notes: she thought 是插入语。
making it more likely that…：现在分词作结果状语；make it（形式宾语）+ more likely + that 从句（真正宾语）。
as it had (done) with…：as 引导方式状语从句（如同它在…中曾经那样）；lose one's way 迷失方向。

sents.en: As the hacking trial concludes—finding guilty one ex-editor of the News of the World, Andy Coulson, for conspiring to hack phones, and finding his predecessor, Rebekah Brooks, innocent of the same charge —the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands.Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5,500 people.
sents.cn: 随着窃听案审判落下帷幕——《世界新闻报》前主编安迪·库尔森因密谋窃听电话被判有罪，而其前任丽贝卡·布鲁克斯则被判定不构成同一指控——诚信缺失这一更广泛的问题依然存在。据悉，记者们窃听过多达5500人的电话。

analysis.trunk: S+V：the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands（诚信匮乏这一更广的问题依然存在）
structure: 时间状语从句(As)：As the hacking trial concludes
└ 破折号插入（现在分词作伴随，说明庭审结果）：finding guilty one ex-editor …, and finding his predecessor … innocent of the same charge
└ find + 宾 + 宾补（并列）：finding [one ex-editor] guilty / finding [his predecessor] innocent
主句：the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands
（后续独立句）：Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5,500 people
analysis.logic: As 引导时间状语从句（随着…落幕）；破折号夹的 finding… 现在分词作伴随状语（裁定…有罪、…无罪）；主句 the wider issue still stands；末句独立。
notes: 破折号夹的 finding … guilty … and finding … innocent 是现在分词作伴随状语（find + 宾语 + 宾补）。
As the hacking trial concludes：As 引导时间状语从句（随着庭审落幕）。
本条含两句；dearth of integrity 诚信匮乏；be known to have done 据悉曾…。

sents.en: This is hacking on an industrial scale, as was acknowledged by Glenn Mulcaire, the man hired by the News of the World in 2001 to be the point person for phone hacking.
sents.cn: 这是工业化规模的窃听，正如格伦·穆尔凯尔所承认的那样——他是《世界新闻报》于2001年雇来专门负责电话窃听的人。

sents.en: Others await trial.
sents.cn: 另有一些人正等待受审。

sents.en: This long story still unfolds.
sents.cn: 这个漫长的故事仍在继续上演。

sents.en: In many respects, the dearth of moral purpose frames not only the fact of such widespread phone hacking but the terms on which the trial took place.
sents.cn: 在许多方面，道德目标的缺失不仅勾勒出如此大规模电话窃听这一事实，也勾勒出此次审判得以进行所依据的种种条件。

sents.en: One of the astonishing revelations was how little Rebekah Brooks knew of what went on in her newsroom, how little she thought to ask and the fact that she never inquired how the stories arrived.
sents.cn: 其中一个令人震惊的事实披露是：丽贝卡·布鲁克斯对自己编辑部里所发生的事情竟知之甚少，她几乎没想过要去过问，而且她从不追问那些报道是如何得来的。

sents.en: The core of her successful defence was that she knew nothing.
sents.cn: 她成功辩护的核心，便是她对此一无所知。

sents.en: In today's world, it has become normal that well-paid executives should not be accountable for what happens in the organizations that they run.
sents.cn: 在当今世界，薪酬优厚的高管对其所掌管机构内发生之事不必负责，已经成了一件稀松平常的事。

sents.en: Perhaps we should not be so surprised.
sents.cn: 或许我们本不该如此惊讶。

sents.en: For a generation, the collective doctrine has been that the sorting mechanism of society should be profit.
sents.cn: 一代人以来，集体信奉的教条一直是：社会的筛选机制理应是利润。

sents.en: The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility, shareholder value, business–friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation.
sents.cn: 受到看重的词汇，是效率、灵活、股东价值、利商、财富创造、销售额、影响力，而在报业则是发行量。

sents.en: Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance, proportionality and accountability.
sents.cn: 而被贬至边缘的词汇，则是正义、公平、宽容、相称性与问责。

sents.en: The purpose of editing the News of the World was not to promote reader understanding, to be fair in what was written or to betray any common humanity.
sents.cn: 主编《世界新闻报》的目的，既不是增进读者的理解，也不是在所写内容上做到公正，更不是体现任何共通的人性。

sents.en: It was to ruin lives in the quest for circulation and impact.
sents.cn: 其目的在于，为追逐发行量与影响力而毁掉他人的生活。

sents.en: Ms Brooks may or may not have had suspicions about how her journalists got their stories, but she asked no questions, gave no instructions—nor received traceable, recorded answers.
sents.cn: 布鲁克斯女士对她手下记者如何获取报道也许有所怀疑，也许并无怀疑，但她既不发问，也不下达指令——更没有收到任何有据可查、有案可稽的答复。

sents.en: France, which prides itself as the global innovator of fashion, has decided its fashion industry has lost an absolute right to define physical beauty for woman.
sents.cn: 法国以自身作为全球时尚潮流的引领者而自豪，但它如今认定，本国的时尚业已不再拥有为女性界定身材之美的绝对权力。

sents.en: Its lawmakers gave preliminary approval last week to a law that would make it a crime to employ ultra-thin models on runways.
sents.cn: 上周，法国立法者初步通过了一项法律：在T台上雇用过度纤瘦的模特将被定为犯罪。

sents.en: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that"incite excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.
sents.cn: 议会还同意封禁那些通过鼓吹极端节食而“怂恿人们过度追求纤瘦”的网站。

sents.en: Such measures have a couple of uplifting motives.
sents.cn: 这类举措蕴含着若干令人振奋的动机。

sents.en: They suggest beauty should not be defined by looks that end up impinging on health.
sents.cn: 它们传递出这样的理念：美不应由那些最终危害健康的外貌来界定。

sents.en: That's a start.
sents.cn: 这是一个开端。

sents.en: And the ban on ultra-thin models seems to go beyond protecting models from starving themselves to death –as some have done.
sents.cn: 而禁用过度纤瘦的模特，其意义似乎不止于保护模特免于因节食而把自己饿死——已有一些模特如此丧命。

sents.en: It tells the fashion industry that it must take responsibility for the signal it sends women, especially teenage girls, about the social tape –measure they must use to determine their individual worth.
sents.cn: 它告诫时尚业：对于它向女性、尤其是少女传递的那把用以衡量自身价值的“社会标尺”所发出的信号，时尚业必须承担起责任。

analysis.trunk: S+V+间宾+宾语从句：It tells the fashion industry that …（它告诉时尚业，它必须…负责）
structure: 主句：It tells the fashion industry that …
└ 宾语从句(that)：it must take responsibility for the signal …
└ 定语从句〔省略，修饰 signal〕：it sends women … about the social tape-measure
└ 定语从句〔省略，修饰 tape-measure〕：they must use to determine their individual worth
└ 不定式作目的：to determine their individual worth
analysis.logic: tell sb that… 结构；宾语从句 take responsibility for the signal；(that) it sends women about… 定语从句修饰 signal；(that) they must use 定语从句修饰 tape-measure；to determine… 目的。
notes: that 引导 tells 的宾语从句（tell sb that…）。
the signal (that) it sends women about…：signal 后省略关系词的定语从句（send sb sth）。
the social tape-measure (that) they must use to determine…：再一层省略关系词的定语从句 + to determine 目的（衡量自身价值的社会标尺）。

sents.en: The bans, if fully enforced, would suggest to woman (and many men)that they should not let others be arbiters of their beauty.
sents.cn: 这些禁令若能得到全面落实，便是在提醒女性（以及许多男性）：她们不应让他人来充当评判自身之美的裁判。

sents.en: And perhaps faintly, they hint that people should look to intangible qualities like character and intellect rather than dieting their way to size zero or wasp-waist physiques.
sents.cn: 而且，它们或许还隐约暗示，人们应当看重品格与才智这类无形的品质，而不是靠节食把自己饿成“零号身材”或“蜂腰”体型。

sents.en: The French measures, however, rely too much on severe punishment to change a culture that still regards beauty as skin-deep-and bone-showing.
sents.cn: 然而，法国的这些举措过于依赖严厉的惩罚，去改变一种仍把美看作肤浅外表、看作骨感外露的文化。

sents.en: Under the law, using a fashion model that does not meet a government-defined index of body mass could result in a $85, 000 fine and six months in prison.
sents.cn: 根据该法律，若启用身体质量指数不符合政府规定标准的时装模特，可被处以八万五千美元罚款并监禁六个月。

sents.en: The fashion industry knows it has an inherent problem in focusing on material adornment and idealized body types.
sents.cn: 时尚业清楚，在专注于物质装扮和理想化身材这一点上，它存在着固有的问题。

sents.en: In Denmark, the United States, and a few other countries, it is trying to set voluntary standard for models and fashion images that rely more on peer pressure for enforcement.
sents.cn: 在丹麦、美国以及其他几个国家，时尚业正尝试为模特和时尚形象设立自愿性标准，更多地依靠同行压力来推动落实。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O(不定式)：it is trying to set voluntary standards for models and fashion images …（它正试图为模特与时尚形象设定自愿标准）
structure: 状语：In Denmark, the United States, and a few other countries
主句：it is trying to set voluntary standard for models and fashion images
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 models and fashion images〕：that rely more on peer pressure for enforcement
analysis.logic: 主句 try to do（试图设定自愿标准）；that 定语从句（rely 用复数，按一致应修饰 models and fashion images；语义上亦可指 standards——存疑）。
notes: try to do：试图做…。
that rely more on peer pressure for enforcement：rely 为复数，按主谓一致修饰 models and fashion images；语义上也可理解为修饰 standards（存疑）。rely on … for … 靠…来…。
（standard 此处宜为 standards 复数）。

sents.en: In contrast to France's actions, Denmark's fashion industry agreed last month on rules and sanctions regarding the age, health, and other characteristics of models.
sents.cn: 与法国的做法形成对比，丹麦时尚业上个月就模特的年龄、健康及其他特征方面的规则与处罚达成了一致。

sents.en: The newly revised Danish Fashion Ethical Charter clearly states: "We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals, especially on young people. " The charter's main tool of enforcement is to deny access for designers and modeling agencies to Copenhagen.
sents.cn: 新修订的《丹麦时尚伦理宪章》明确宣告：“我们意识到并愿意承担起时尚业对身材审美、尤其是对年轻人所产生的影响之责任。”该宪章主要的执行手段，是拒绝让设计师和模特经纪公司进入哥本哈根。

analysis.trunk: S+V(states 引语) + 另一句(is to deny…)：宪章声明「…」；其主要执行手段是拒绝…进入哥本哈根
structure: 主句①：The newly revised Danish Fashion Ethical Charter clearly states: 「…」
引语：We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals, especially on young people
├ 并列谓语：are aware of / take responsibility for（共享宾语 the impact）
└ 定语从句〔省略 that，修饰 impact〕：the fashion industry has on body ideals
主句②：The charter's main tool of enforcement is to deny access for designers and modeling agencies to Copenhagen
└ 不定式作表语：to deny access for … to Copenhagen
analysis.logic: 主句① states 引语；引语并列谓语 are aware of and take responsibility for + the impact（(that) the fashion industry has on… 定语从句修饰 impact）；句② is to deny…（不定式作表语）。
notes: are aware of and take responsibility for the impact：并列谓语共享宾语 the impact。
the impact (that) the fashion industry has on body ideals：impact 后省略关系词的定语从句。
本条含两句；is to deny access… 不定式作表语（deny access to 拒绝…进入）。

sents.en: Fashion Week, which is run by the Danish Fashion Institute.
sents.cn: （哥本哈根）时装周由丹麦时尚学院主办。

sents.en: But in general it relies on a name-and –shame method of compliance.
sents.cn: 但总体而言，它依靠的是一种“点名羞辱”的方式来促使各方遵守。

sents.en: Relying on ethical persuasion rather than law to address the misuse of body ideals may be the best step.
sents.cn: 依靠道德劝导而非法律来解决滥用理想身材这一问题，或许是最佳之策。

sents.en: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
sents.cn: 而更好的做法，是帮助人们把美的观念提升到超越某一特定行业物质标准的高度。

sents.en: For the first time in the history more people live in towns than in the country.
sents.cn: 历史上第一次，居住在城镇的人口超过了居住在乡村的人口。

sents.en: In Britain this has had a curious result.
sents.cn: 在英国，这带来了一个耐人寻味的结果。

sents.en: While polls show Britons rate "the countryside" alongside the royal family.
sents.cn: 民意调查显示，英国人把“乡村”与王室、

sents.en: Shakespeare and the National Health Service (NHS) as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.
sents.cn: 莎士比亚以及国民医疗服务体系（NHS）相提并论，视其为最令他们为自己国家感到自豪的事物，然而乡村所获得的政治支持却很有限。

sents.en: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save "the beauty of natural places for everyone forever".
sents.cn: 一个世纪前，奥克塔维娅·希尔创立了国民信托组织，其宗旨并非拯救华美的宅邸，而是为了“永远为每一个人守护自然之地的美”。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：Octavia Hill launched the National Trust …（一个世纪前奥克塔维娅·希尔创立了国民信托）
structure: 状语：A century ago
主句：Octavia Hill launched the National Trust
目的状语(not…but…，并列不定式)：not to rescue stylish houses but to save 「the beauty of natural places for everyone forever」
analysis.logic: 主句 launched the National Trust；not to do… but to do… 并列不定式作目的状语（不是为了…而是为了…）。
notes: not to rescue… but to save…：not…but… 并列两个不定式作目的状语（不是为…而是为…）。
A century ago 时间状语。
for everyone forever 介词短语（为所有人、永远地）。
