主句（形式主语 it）：it is in the best interest of a school to turn out graduates …
└ 真正主语(不定式)：to turn out graduates who are as qualified as possible—or at least appear to be
└ 定语从句〔who，修饰 graduates〕：who are as qualified as possible—or at least appear to be
analysis.logic: Since 原因从句（expect sth to do）；主句 it 形式主语，真正主语是 to turn out graduates…；who 定语从句修饰 graduates（as qualified as possible，or at least appear to be 省略 qualified）。
notes: expect sth to do：expect a college degree to lead to a job。
it is in the best interest of a school to do：it 形式主语，真正主语是 to turn out… 不定式。
who are as qualified as possible—or at least appear to be：who 定语从句修饰 graduates；appear to be 后省略 qualified（或至少看起来是）。

sents.en: On this, students' and colleges' incentives seem to be aligned.
sents.cn: 在这一点上，学生与高校的动机似乎是一致的。

sents.en: This year marks exactly two centuries since the publication of "Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus," by Mary Shelley.
sents.cn: 今年恰逢玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦：或现代普罗米修斯》出版整整两百周年。

sents.en: Even before the invention of the electric light bulb, the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction that would foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come.
sents.cn: 甚至早在电灯泡发明之前，这位作者就创作出了一部非凡的推想小说，预示了日后种种尚未问世的技术将会引发的诸多伦理问题。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction …（早在电灯泡发明之前，作者就写出了一部非凡的思辨小说）
structure: 状语：Even before the invention of the electric light bulb
主句：the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction …
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 work〕：that would foreshadow many ethical questions …
└ 不定式作定语(被动)〔修饰 questions〕：to be raised by technologies yet to come
└ 不定式作定语〔修饰 technologies〕：yet to come
analysis.logic: 主句 the author produced a work；that 定语从句修饰 work（预示许多伦理问题）；to be raised by… 不定式被动修饰 questions；yet to come 不定式修饰 technologies。
notes: that would foreshadow…：that 定语从句修饰 a work（一部…的作品）。
many ethical questions to be raised by technologies：to be raised 不定式被动作定语修饰 questions（将被…提出的问题）。
technologies yet to come：yet to come 不定式作定语（尚未到来的技术）。

sents.en: Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: "What is intelligence, identity, or consciousness? What makes humans humans?"
sents.cn: 如今，人工智能（AI）的迅猛发展引出了一些根本性的问题：“何为智能、身份认同或意识？是什么使人之为人？”

sents.en: What is being called artificial general intelligence, machines that would imitate the way humans think, continues to evade scientists.
sents.cn: 被称为通用人工智能的东西，即能够模仿人类思维方式的机器，依然让科学家们难以企及。

sents.en: Yet humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots that would look, move, and respond like humans, similar to those recently depicted on popular sci-fi TV series such as "West world" and "Humans".
sents.cn: 然而，人类仍然为这样一种设想所着迷：机器人在外形、动作和反应上都像人一样，正如近来在《西部世界》《真实的人类》等热门科幻电视剧中所描绘的那样。

analysis.trunk: S+remain+表：humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots …（人类依然为「像人一样的机器人」这一构想着迷）
structure: 主句：Yet humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots …
├ 定语从句〔that，修饰 robots〕：that would look, move, and respond like humans（并列谓语 look/move/respond）
└ 形容词短语作定语〔修饰 robots〕：similar to those recently depicted on popular sci-fi TV series such as 「West world」 and 「Humans」
└ 过去分词作定语〔修饰 those〕：recently depicted on popular sci-fi TV series
analysis.logic: 主句 humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots；that 定语从句修饰 robots（并列谓语 look/move/respond）；similar to those… 形容词短语修饰 robots，其中 depicted… 过去分词定语修饰 those。
notes: remain fascinated by…：remain + 形容词（依然着迷于…）。
that would look, move, and respond like humans：that 定语从句修饰 robots（并列谓语）。
similar to those recently depicted…：similar to… 形容词短语作定语；depicted… 过去分词修饰 those（科幻剧中刻画的那些）。

sents.en: Just how people think is still far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced, says David Eagleman, a Stanford University neuroscientist.
sents.cn: 斯坦福大学神经科学家戴维·伊格曼说，人究竟是如何思考的，至今仍过于复杂而难以理解，更遑论加以复制。

sents.en: "We are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there."
sents.cn: “我们正处于这样一种境地：没有任何好的理论能够解释意识究竟是什么，以及人怎样才可能造出一台机器达到那种境界。”

sents.en: But that doesn't mean crucial ethical issues involving AI aren't at hand.
sents.cn: 但这并不意味着事关人工智能的重大伦理问题尚未临近。

sents.en: The coming use of autonomous vehicles, for example, poses thorny ethical questions.
sents.cn: 例如，自动驾驶汽车即将投入使用，便带来了棘手的伦理问题。

sents.en: Human drivers sometimes must make split-second decisions.
sents.cn: 人类驾驶员有时必须在瞬间做出决断。

sents.en: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them in that moment.
sents.cn: 他们的反应也许是即时本能反应、以往驾驶经验所提供的信息以及当下耳闻目睹之物的复杂综合。

sents.en: AI "vision" today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans.
sents.cn: 如今人工智能的“视觉”远不及人类的视觉那般精密复杂。

sents.en: And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem.
sents.cn: 而要预先设想到每一种可以想象到的驾驶情形，则是一个棘手的编程难题。

sents.en: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, "you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions," notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI.
sents.cn: 一旦决策建立在海量数据之上，“你很快就会陷入一大堆伦理问题”，陈杰豪指出；他是新加坡一家机构的首席执行官，该机构正协助政府制定一套人工智能合乎伦理使用的自愿性准则。

analysis.trunk: 时间从句+引语+倒装提示语：Whenever …, 「you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions,」 notes Tan Kiat How …
structure: 时间状语从句(Whenever)：Whenever decisions are based on masses of data
引语：you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions
倒装提示语：notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency …（= Tan Kiat How notes）
└ 同位语〔说明 Tan Kiat How〕：chief executive of a Singapore-based agency
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 agency〕：that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI
analysis.logic: Whenever 引导时间状语从句（每当…）；引语；notes + 主语 倒装；chief executive… 同位语，that 定语从句修饰 agency（help sb do）。
notes: Whenever 引导时间状语从句（每当…时）。
notes Tan Kiat How…：引语提示语的倒装（= … notes）；chief executive… 是其同位语。
that is helping the government develop…：that 定语从句修饰 agency；help sb do（帮助政府制定…）。

sents.en: Along with Singapore, other governments and mega-corporations are beginning to establish their own guidelines.
sents.cn: 与新加坡一样，其他一些政府和巨型企业也开始制定各自的准则。

sents.en: Britain is setting up a data ethics center.
sents.cn: 英国正在筹建一个数据伦理中心。

sents.en: India released its AI ethics strategy this spring.
sents.cn: 印度则在今年春天发布了其人工智能伦理战略。

sents.en: On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
sents.cn: 6月7日，谷歌承诺不会“设计或部署”会造成“整体危害”的人工智能，也不会研发由人工智能操控的武器，或将人工智能用于违反国际准则的监控。

sents.en: It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
sents.cn: 它还承诺不会部署其使用会违反国际法或人权的人工智能。

sents.en: While the statement is vague, it represents one starting point.
sents.cn: 尽管这份声明含糊其辞，它却代表了一个起点。

sents.en: So does the idea that decisions made by AI systems should be explainable, transparent, and fair.
sents.cn: 人工智能系统所做的决策应当可解释、透明且公正这一理念，同样是一个起点。

sents.en: To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values?
sents.cn: 换言之：我们怎样才能确保智能机器的思维体现出人类的最高价值观？

sents.en: Only then will they be useful servants and not Frankenstein's out-of-control monster.
sents.cn: 唯有如此，它们才会成为有用的仆人，而不是弗兰肯斯坦那失控的怪物。

sents.en: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states.
sents.cn: 根据最高法院周四作出的一项裁决，各州将能够强制更多的人在网上购物时缴纳销售税；这一裁决会让购物者的钱包更瘪，但对各州而言却是一场重大的财政胜利。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O(force sb to do)：States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax …（各州将能迫使更多人缴销售税）
structure: 主句：States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday …
├ force sb to do：force more people to pay sales tax
├ 时间状语从句(when)：when they make online purchases
├ 状语(under)：under a Supreme Court decision Thursday
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 decision〕：that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states（并列谓语 leave / is）
analysis.logic: 主句 force sb to do（迫使更多人缴税）；when… 时间状语；under… 状语（依据…裁决）；that 定语从句修饰 decision（并列谓语 leave… but is…）。
notes: force sb to do：迫使某人做…。
when they make online purchases：when 时间状语从句。
that will leave… but is…：that 定语从句修饰 decision，含并列谓语（leave shoppers with lighter wallets 让购物者钱包更瘪 / 对各州是财政利好）。

sents.en: The Supreme Court's opinion Thursday overruled a pair of decades-old decisions that states said cost them billions of dollars in lost revenue annually.
sents.cn: 最高法院周四的意见推翻了两项已有数十年之久的判决；各州称，这两项判决每年使它们损失数十亿美元的收入。

sents.en: The decisions made it more difficult for states to collect sales tax on certain online purchases.
sents.cn: 这两项判决使各州更难对某些网上购物征收销售税。

sents.en: The cases the court overturned said that if a business was shipping a customer's purchase to a state where the business didn't have a physical presence such as a warehouse or office, the business didn't have to collect sales tax for the state.
sents.cn: 被法院推翻的这些案件曾裁定：如果一家企业把顾客所购商品运往某个州，而该企业在该州并无仓库、办事处之类的实体存在，那么这家企业就无需为该州代收销售税。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：The cases … said that …（被法院推翻的那些判例曾认定…）
structure: 主句：The cases … said that …
├ 定语从句〔省略关系词，修饰 The cases〕：the court overturned
└ 宾语从句(that)：if a business was shipping …, the business didn't have to collect sales tax for the state
├ 条件状语从句(if)：if a business was shipping a customer's purchase to a state where the business didn't have a physical presence …
│   └ 定语从句〔where，修饰 a state〕：where the business didn't have a physical presence such as a warehouse or office
└ 主句（宾语从句内）：the business didn't have to collect sales tax for the state
analysis.logic: 主语 The cases（(that) the court overturned 定语从句修饰）；said that…（宾语从句）；宾语从句内含 if 条件从句（where 定语从句修饰 a state）+ 主句。
notes: The cases (that) the court overturned：cases 后省略关系词的定语从句（法院推翻的那些判例）。
said that…：宾语从句，内部又含 if 条件从句 + 主句（didn't have to collect tax）。
a state where…：where 定语从句修饰 a state（企业在该州无实体存在）。

sents.en: Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren't charged it, but most didn't realize they owed it and few paid.
sents.cn: 一般而言，如果顾客未被征收销售税，便应由其自行向所在州缴纳，但大多数人并未意识到自己负有此项纳税义务，真正缴纳的人寥寥无几。

sents.en: Justice Anthony Kennedy wrote that the previous decisions were flawed.
sents.cn: 大法官安东尼·肯尼迪写道，先前的那些判决存在缺陷。

sents.en: "Each year the physical presence rule becomes further removed from economic reality and results in significant revenue losses to the States," he wrote in an opinion joined by four other justices.
sents.cn: 他在一份得到另外四位大法官附议的意见书中写道：“实体存在规则逐年与经济现实越发脱节，并导致各州蒙受巨大的收入损失。”

sents.en: Kennedy wrote that the rule "limited state' ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field."
sents.cn: 肯尼迪写道，该规则“限制了各州谋求长期繁荣的能力，并妨碍了市场参与者在公平的环境中展开竞争”。

sents.en: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.
sents.cn: 这一裁决对那些在许多州都设有门店的大型连锁企业来说是一场胜利，因为它们通常本就对网上购物代收销售税。

sents.en: Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn't before.
sents.cn: 如今，它们的竞争对手也将在以往不征税的地方征收销售税。

sents.en: Big chains have been collecting sales tax nationwide because they typically have physical stores in whatever state a purchase is being shipped to.
sents.cn: 大型连锁企业一直在全国范围内代收销售税，因为无论商品被运往哪个州，它们在该州通常都设有实体门店。

sents.en: Amazon.com, with its network of warehouses, also collects sales tax in every state that charges it, though third-party sellers who use the site don't have to.
sents.cn: 亚马逊公司凭借其仓库网络，也在每一个征收销售税的州代收销售税，不过使用该网站的第三方卖家则无需代收。

sents.en: Until now, many sellers that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states.
sents.cn: 迄今为止，许多仅在单一州或少数几个州设有实体存在的卖家，在向这些州以外的地址发货时一直得以免于征收销售税。

analysis.trunk: S+V：many sellers … have been able to avoid charging sales taxes（迄今许多卖家得以避免征收销售税）
structure: 状语：Until now
主句：many sellers … have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states
├ 定语从句〔that，修饰 sellers〕：that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states
├ avoid + V-ing：avoid charging sales taxes
└ 时间状语从句(when)：when they ship to addresses outside those states
analysis.logic: 主语 sellers（that 定语从句修饰，造成主谓分隔），谓语 have been able to avoid charging…；when… 时间状语。
notes: 主谓分隔：主语 many sellers 与谓语 have been able 被 that 定语从句隔开。
avoid charging sales taxes：avoid + 动名词（避免征税）。
when they ship to addresses outside those states：when 时间状语从句。

sents.en: Sellers that use eBay and Etsy, which provide platforms for smaller sellers, also haven't been collecting sales tax nationwide.
sents.cn: 使用为小卖家提供平台的eBay和Etsy的卖家，同样一直未在全国范围内代收销售税。

sents.en: Under the ruling Thursday, states can pass laws requiring out-of-state sellers to collect the state's sales tax from customers and send it to the state.
sents.cn: 根据周四的这项裁决，各州可以通过立法，要求外州卖家向顾客代收本州的销售税并上缴本州。

sents.en: Retail trade groups praised the ruling, saying it levels the playing field for local and online businesses.
sents.cn: 各零售业行业团体对这一裁决表示赞许，称它为本地企业和网络企业营造了公平的竞争环境。

sents.en: The losers, said retail analyst Neil Saunders, are online-only retailers, especially smaller ones.
sents.cn: 零售业分析师尼尔·桑德斯说，输家是那些纯网络零售商，尤其是其中规模较小的那些。

sents.en: Those retailers may face headaches complying with various state sales tax laws.
sents.cn: 这些零售商在遵守各州五花八门的销售税法规时，可能会遇到不少麻烦。

sents.en: The Small Business & Entrepreneurship Council advocacy group said in a statement, "Small businesses and internet entrepreneurs are not well served at all by this decision."
sents.cn: 小企业与创业理事会这一倡导团体在一份声明中表示：“这项裁决对小企业和互联网创业者根本毫无益处。”

sents.en: A group of labour MPs, among them Yvette Cooper, are bringing in the new year with a call to institute a UK "town of culture" award.
sents.cn: 一群工党议员，其中包括伊薇特·库珀，在新年伊始呼吁设立一项英国“文化之镇”奖。

sents.en: The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017 and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021.
sents.cn: 该提议主张，这一奖项应与现有的“文化之城”称号并行设立；2017年赫尔市曾获此殊荣，而考文垂则获得了2021年的称号。

sents.en: Cooper and her colleagues argue that the success of the crown for Hull, where it brought in £220m of investment and an avalanche of arts, ought not to be confined to cities.
sents.cn: 库珀及其同事认为，赫尔市摘得这一桂冠所带来的成功——它为该市引入了2.2亿英镑的投资和大量的艺术活动——不应仅局限于城市。

sents.en: Britain' town, it is true are not prevented from applying, but they generally lack the resources to put together a bid to beat their bigger competitions.
sents.cn: 诚然，英国的城镇并未被禁止申请，但它们通常缺乏足够的资源来组织一份能够击败规模更大的竞争对手的申请。

sents.en: A town of culture award could, it is argued, become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs.
sents.cn: 有人认为，“文化之镇”奖可以成为一项年度盛事，吸引资金并创造就业机会。

sents.en: Some might see the proposal as a booby prize for the fact that Britain is no longer be able to apply for the much more prestigious title of European capital of culture, a sought-after award bagged by Glasgow in 1990 and Liverpool in 2008.
sents.cn: 有人或许会把这一提议看作一种安慰奖，因为英国已不再有资格申请声望高得多的“欧洲文化之都”称号——这是一项备受追捧的荣誉，格拉斯哥曾于1990年、利物浦曾于2008年将其收入囊中。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O(see A as B)：Some might see the proposal as a booby prize …（有人可能把这一提议看作安慰奖）
structure: 主句：Some might see the proposal as a booby prize for the fact …
├ see A as B：see the proposal as a booby prize
├ 同位语从句〔that，说明 the fact〕：that Britain is no longer be able to apply for the much more prestigious title of European capital of culture
└ 同位语〔说明 title〕：a sought-after award bagged by Glasgow in 1990 and Liverpool in 2008
└ 过去分词作定语〔修饰 award〕：bagged by Glasgow in 1990 and Liverpool in 2008
analysis.logic: 主句 see A as B（把提议看作安慰奖）；the fact that… 同位语从句说明 the fact；a sought-after award… 是 title 的同位语（bagged… 过去分词定语）。
notes: see A as B：把 A 视为 B（把提议看作安慰奖）。
the fact that…：that 同位语从句说明 the fact（原文 is no longer be able 应为 is no longer able）。
a sought-after award bagged by…：title 的同位语，bagged… 过去分词作定语；booby prize 安慰奖。

sents.en: A cynic might speculate that the UK is on the verge of disappearing into an endless fever of self-celebration in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world: after town of culture, who knows that will follow— village of culture?
sents.cn: 愤世嫉俗者或许会推测，英国在急于为后脱欧时代重塑自我的过程中，正濒临陷入无休止的自我吹捧狂热之中：继“文化之镇”之后，谁知道接下来还会有什么——“文化之村”？

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：A cynic might speculate that …（愤世者或许会揣测…）
structure: 主句：A cynic might speculate that the UK is on the verge of disappearing into an endless fever of self-celebration in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world
└ 宾语从句(that)：the UK is on the verge of disappearing …
├ on the verge of + 动名词：on the verge of disappearing into…（濒临…）
└ in its desperation to do：to reinvent itself…（不定式修饰 desperation）
冒号后（讽刺设问）：after town of culture, who knows what will follow—village of culture?
analysis.logic: speculate that…（宾语从句）；on the verge of disappearing（濒临…）；in its desperation to reinvent…（to 修饰 desperation）；冒号引出讽刺设问。
notes: speculate that…：宾语从句；on the verge of disappearing into…：濒临陷入…（of + 动名词）。
in its desperation to reinvent itself：to reinvent… 不定式修饰 desperation（急于重塑自我）。
冒号后是讽刺的设问（原文 who knows that will follow 宜为 what will follow）。

sents.en: Suburb of culture?
sents.cn: “文化之郊”？

sents.en: Hamlet of culture?
sents.cn: “文化之乡”？

sents.en: It is also wise to recall that such titles are not a cure-all.
sents.cn: 同样明智的是要记住，这类称号并非包治百病的灵丹妙药。

sents.en: A badly run "year of culture" washes in and out of a place like the tide, bringing prominence for a spell but leaving no lasting benefits to the community.
sents.cn: 一场举办糟糕的“文化年”活动，会像潮水一样涌入又退出一个地方，短暂地带来知名度，却没有给当地社区留下任何持久的益处。

sents.en: The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year.
sents.cn: 真正成功的称号获得者，所做的远不止是让酒店客房住满人、引进备受瞩目的艺术活动以及赢得一年的良好口碑。

sents.en: They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light.
sents.cn: 它们改变了当地居民的追求与抱负；它们促使这座城市的自我形象朝着更加大胆、更加乐观的方向转变。

sents.en: It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations.
sents.cn: 要把这件事做好并非易事，它需要非凡的远见卓识，也需要市政当局、私营部门、社区团体和文化机构之间的通力合作。

sents.en: But it can be done: Glasgow's year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of complex series of factors that have turned the city into the power of art, music and theatre that it remains today.
sents.cn: 但这是可以做到的：格拉斯哥担任“欧洲文化之都”的那一年，无疑可以被视为一系列复杂因素之一，正是这些因素使这座城市成为它如今依然保持的艺术、音乐和戏剧重镇。

analysis.trunk: it can be done + 冒号展开：Glasgow's year … can certainly be seen as one of … factors …（这是能做到的：格拉斯哥…可被视为诸多因素之一）
structure: 主句：But it can be done
冒号后（展开）：Glasgow's year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of complex series of factors …
├ be seen as：被视为
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 factors〕：that have turned the city into the power of art, music and theatre …
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 the power〕：that it remains today
analysis.logic: 主句 it can be done；冒号展开：Glasgow's year can be seen as one of factors（be seen as）；that 定语从句修饰 factors（turn A into B）；其内再套 that 定语从句修饰 the power（它至今仍是的那种…实力）。
notes: be seen as：被视为（one of … factors 诸多因素之一）。
that have turned the city into…：that 定语从句修饰 factors；turn A into B 把 A 变成 B。
the power of art… that it remains today：第二个 that 定语从句修饰 the power（它如今依旧是的那种实力）。

sents.en: A "town of culture" could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town's peculiarities-helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people and turn it into action.
sents.cn: “文化之镇”所关乎的不应仅仅是艺术，更应在于彰显一个城镇的独特之处——帮助维持其商业主街的活力，支持当地的各项设施，尤其是要赞颂当地的人民并将这份赞颂付诸行动。

sents.en: Scientific publishing has long been a licence to print money.
sents.cn: 长期以来，科学出版一直是一门稳赚不赔的生意。

sents.en: Scientists need journals in which to publish their research, so they will supply the articles without monetary reward.
sents.cn: 科学家需要期刊来发表他们的研究成果，因此他们会无偿提供论文。

sents.en: Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.
sents.cn: 其他科学家也免费承担同行评审这项专业性工作，因为这是获取地位和生产科学知识的核心环节。

sents.en: With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only find a market for its journal.
sents.cn: 由于论文内容是免费获得的，出版商只需为其期刊找到市场即可。

sents.en: Until this century, university libraries were not very price sensitive.
sents.cn: 在本世纪之前，大学图书馆对价格并不十分敏感。

sents.en: Scientific publishers routinely report profit margins approaching 40% on their operations, at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis.
sents.cn: 在出版业其他领域陷入生死存亡危机之际，科学出版商却照例报告其业务的利润率接近40%。

sents.en: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research: both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.
sents.cn: 荷兰出版业巨头爱思唯尔声称发表了全球25%的科学论文，去年盈利超过9亿英镑；而仅英国各大学在2016年就花费了超过2.1亿英镑，以便让研究人员能够查阅他们自己用公共资金资助的研究成果：尽管人们日益急切地试图改变这两个数字，但它们似乎都在不可遏制地上涨。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：The Dutch giant Elsevier … made profits of more than £900m last year（荷兰巨头爱思唯尔去年获利逾9亿英镑）
structure: 主句：The Dutch giant Elsevier … made profits of more than £900m last year
└ 非限制性定语从句〔which，修饰 Elsevier〕：which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world（produced… 过去分词修饰 papers）
while 对比状语从句：while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research
└ 不定式作目的：to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research
冒号后（总结）：both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them
analysis.logic: 主语 Elsevier（which 非限制定语从句插入，造成主谓分隔），谓语 made profits；while 对比从句（universities spent…to enable…）；冒号总结（both figures… despite efforts to change them）。
notes: 主谓分隔：主语 Elsevier 与谓语 made 被 which 非限制定语从句隔开。
while 引导对比状语从句（与此同时/相比之下）；to enable sb to do 目的状语。
冒号后是总结；despite + efforts to change them（尽管…努力）；produced in the world 过去分词定语修饰 papers。

sents.en: The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015.
sents.cn: 最激烈、也是彻头彻尾非法的反应，便是“科学中心”（Sci-Hub）网站的出现——它堪称一台面向科学论文的全球复印机，创建于2012年，如今号称能够提供自2015年以来发表的所有付费墙后论文的访问权限。

sents.en: The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed so that it works for all participants.
sents.cn: “科学中心”依靠研究人员转发他们自己合法获取的论文副本而获得成功，这表明这一合法的生态系统已在其用户中丧失了正当性，必须加以改造，使其惠及所有参与者。

sents.en: In Britain the move towards open access publishing has been driven by funding bodies.
sents.cn: 在英国，迈向开放获取出版的进程一直由资助机构推动。

sents.en: In some ways it has been very successful.
sents.cn: 在某些方面，这一进程已取得很大成功。

sents.en: More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms: either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release.
sents.cn: 如今，英国半数以上的科学研究都以开放获取的方式发表：要么自发表之时起便可免费获取，要么先设置一年或更长时间的付费墙，待出版商赚取利润后再向公众全面开放。

analysis.trunk: S+V(被动)：More than half … is now published under open access terms（如今逾半英国科研以开放获取方式发表）
structure: 主句：More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms
冒号后（展开 open access terms，either…or…）：either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more …
├ either…or… 并列：freely available / paywalled
└ 目的状语从句(so that)：so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release
└ 时间状语(before + 动名词被动)：before being placed on general release
analysis.logic: 主句被动 is published under open access terms；冒号引出 terms 的两种形态（either freely available… or paywalled…）；so that 目的从句；before being placed… 时间状语（被动动名词）。
notes: 冒号后 either … or …：并列说明开放获取的两种形态（要么即时免费、要么先付费墙一年以上）。
so that 引导目的状语从句（以便出版商获利）。
before being placed on general release：before + 动名词被动（在公开发布之前）。

sents.en: Yet the new system has not worked out any cheaper for the universities.
sents.cn: 然而，这一新体系对各大学而言并未变得更省钱。

sents.en: Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article.
sents.cn: 面对要求向读者免费提供产品的呼声，出版商的应对之策是向论文作者收取费用，以弥补论文的编辑加工成本。

sents.en: These range from around £500 to $5,000.
sents.cn: 这些费用从约500英镑到5000美元不等。

sents.en: A report last year pointed out that the costs both of subscriptions and of these "article preparation costs" had been steadily rising at a rate above inflation.
sents.cn: 去年的一份报告指出，订阅费和这些“论文编辑加工费”的成本一直在以高于通货膨胀的速度稳步上涨。

sents.en: In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places.
sents.cn: 在某些方面，科学出版模式与社交互联网的经济模式如出一辙：劳动是免费提供的，换来的只是对地位的期望，而巨额利润却被少数几家掌控市场的大公司赚走。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet（科学出版模式与社交网络经济相似）
structure: 状语：In some ways
主句：the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet
冒号后（展开类比）：
├ 分句①：labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status（被动）
└ while 对比状语从句：while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places
└ 定语从句〔who，修饰 firms〕：who run the market places
analysis.logic: 主句 model resembles the economy；冒号引出类比的具体内容：labour is provided free（被动）+ while 对比（profits are made by firms，who 定语从句修饰 firms）。
notes: resemble 与…相似（及物，不接 to）。
冒号引出类比展开；in exchange for 以换取…；while 引导对比状语从句。
huge profits are made by a few big firms who…：被动 + who 定语从句修饰 firms（运营平台的少数大公司）。

sents.en: In both cases, we need a rebalancing of power.
sents.cn: 在这两种情况下，我们都需要重新平衡权力格局。

sents.en: Progressives often support diversity mandates as a path to equality and a way to level the playing field.
sents.cn: 进步派人士常常支持多元化强制规定，将其视为通往平等的途径和创造公平竞争环境的一种方式。

sents.en: But all too often such policies are an insincere form of virtue-signaling that benefits only the most privileged and does little to help average people.
sents.cn: 但这类政策往往是一种虚伪的“美德标榜”，只让最享有特权的人受益，对帮助普通人却几乎毫无作用。

sents.en: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure "gender parity" on boards and commissions, provide a case in point.
sents.cn: 由马萨诸塞州参议员贾森·刘易斯和众议院议长临时代理人帕特里夏·哈达德发起的一对法案，旨在确保各委员会和理事会实现“性别均等”，便是一个恰当的例证。

sents.en: Haddad and Lewis are concerned that more than half the state-government boards are less than 40 percent female.
sents.cn: 哈达德和刘易斯担心，半数以上的州政府理事会中女性所占比例不足40%。

sents.en: In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas.
sents.cn: 为了确保精英女性获得更多此类机会，他们提议强制实行政府配额制。

sents.en: If the bills become law, state boards and commissions will be required to set aside 50 percent of board seats for women by 2022.
sents.cn: 如果这些法案成为法律，州属理事会和委员会将被要求在2022年之前为女性预留50%的席位。

sents.en: The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies.
sents.cn: 这些法案与加利福尼亚州近期通过的一项举措类似；去年，加州成为首个要求私营公司实行性别配额的州。

sents.en: In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional.
sents.cn: 在签署这项举措时，加州州长杰里·布朗承认，这项明确依据性别对人进行分类的法律很可能违宪。

sents.en: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an "important" policy interest, Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
sents.cn: 美国最高法院不赞同基于性别的分类，除非这种分类是为了维护某种“重要的”政策利益。由于加州的这项法律适用于所有理事会，即便在那些此前并无歧视历史的领域也是如此，因此法院很可能裁定该法律违反了宪法所保障的“平等保护”原则。

analysis.trunk: 两句（逗号粘连）：① 最高法不赞成基于性别的分类，除非… ② 因…，法院很可能裁定该法违宪
structure: 句①：The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an 「important」 policy interest
└ 条件状语从句(unless)：unless they are designed to address an 「important」 policy interest
句②：Because …, courts are likely to rule that …
├ 原因状语从句(Because)：Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination
│   └ 让步状语从句(even where)：even where there is no history of prior discrimination
└ 主句：courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of 「equal protection」
└ 宾语从句(that)：that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of 「equal protection」
analysis.logic: 句① frowns on…unless…（条件）；句② Because 原因从句（even where… 让步）+ 主句 courts are likely to rule that…（宾语从句）。
notes: frown on 不赞成；unless 引导条件状语从句（除非…）。
（原文 interest, Because 为逗号粘连，实为两句）。Because 原因从句内含 even where… 让步状语从句。
be likely to do 很可能；rule that… 宾语从句（裁定该法违反「平等保护」的宪法保障）。

sents.en: But are such government mandates even necessary?
sents.cn: 但这类政府强制规定真的有必要吗？

sents.en: Female participation on corporate boards may not currently mirror the percentage of women in the general population.
sents.cn: 女性在公司董事会中的参与比例目前或许并未反映出女性在总人口中所占的比例，

sents.en: but so what?
sents.cn: 但那又怎样呢？

sents.en: The number of women on corporate boards has been steadily increasing without government interference.
sents.cn: 在没有政府干预的情况下，公司董事会中的女性人数一直在稳步增加。

sents.en: According to a study by Catalyst, between 2010 and 2015 the share of women on the boards of global corporations increased by 54 percent.
sents.cn: 根据“凯特琳”（Catalyst）机构的一项研究，在2010年至2015年间，全球各大公司董事会中女性所占的比例增长了54%。

sents.en: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards.
sents.cn: 要求公司把性别作为董事会成员资格的首要条件，将不可避免地导致私营部门董事会的经验更加欠缺。

sents.en: That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota.
sents.cn: 挪威在全国范围内实行公司性别配额制时，所发生的情形正是如此。

sents.en: Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards has led to a "golden skirt" phenomenon, where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards.
sents.cn: 爱丽丝·李在《新共和》杂志上撰文指出，在没有扩大合格女性人选库的情况下增加董事会成员的机会，导致了一种“金裙子”现象，即同一批精英女性在各类董事会中揽得多个席位。

analysis.trunk: 现在分词状语+S+V+O：Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that …（李在《新共和》撰文指出…）
structure: 现在分词作状语：Writing in The New Republic
主句：Alice Lee notes that …
└ 宾语从句(that)：increasing the number of opportunities … has led to a 「golden skirt」 phenomenon
├ 动名词作主语：increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards（to serve… 修饰 women）
└ 非限制性定语从句〔where，修饰 phenomenon〕：where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards
analysis.logic: Writing in… 现在分词状语；主句 Alice Lee notes that…；that 从句主语是动名词 increasing…（without increasing… 修饰），谓语 has led to a phenomenon；where 定语从句修饰 phenomenon。
notes: Writing in The New Republic：现在分词作状语（在《新共和》撰文时）。
that 从句主语是动名词 increasing the number of opportunities…（without increasing… 修饰），谓语 has led to。
where 引导非限制定语从句修饰 phenomenon（在这种现象中，同一批精英女性…）；to serve on such boards 不定式修饰 women。

sents.en: Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.
sents.cn: 下次再有人鼓吹将公司配额制作为促进性别平等的途径时，请记住：这类政策在很大程度上是利己之举，只会让其发起者自我感觉良好，却对帮助普通女性几乎毫无作用。

analysis.trunk: 时间从句+祈使句：Next time …, remember that …（下次当有人…时，记住…）
structure: 时间状语从句(Next time)：Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity（to promote… 修饰 a way）
主句（祈使句）：remember that …
└ 宾语从句(that)：such policies are largely self-serving measures …
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 measures〕：that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women（并列谓语 make / do）
analysis.logic: Next time 引导时间状语从句（下次当…时）；主句是祈使句 remember that…；that 宾语从句；其中 that 定语从句修饰 measures（并列谓语 make… but do little…）。
notes: Next time (somebody…)：相当于连词，引导时间状语从句（下次当…时）。
remember that…：祈使句 + that 宾语从句。
measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to…：that 定语从句修饰 measures，并列谓语（make sb do / do little to do）。

sents.en: Last Thursday, the French Senate passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services to consumers or users in France.
sents.cn: 上周四，法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税，该税将对向法国境内消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收一种全新的税。

sents.en: Digital services include everything from providing a platform for selling goods and services online to targeting advertising based on user data, and the tax applies to gross revenue from such services.
sents.cn: 数字服务涵盖方方面面，从为线上销售商品和服务提供平台，到基于用户数据进行定向广告投放，而该税则针对此类服务所产生的总收入征收。

sents.en: Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a "GAFA tax," meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon—in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States.
sents.cn: 许多法国政界人士和媒体将其称为“GAFA税”，意指它主要针对谷歌、苹果、脸书和亚马逊等公司——换言之，即总部设在美国的跨国科技公司。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O(refer to A as B)：Many … have referred to this as a 「GAFA tax」（许多人把它称为「GAFA 税」）
structure: 主句：Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a 「GAFA tax」
└ refer to A as B：refer to this as a 「GAFA tax」
现在分词作结果状语：meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon
├ 宾语从句(that)：it is designed to apply primarily to companies…
└ 破折号同位/换言：in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States（based… 过去分词修饰 companies）
analysis.logic: 主句 refer to A as B（把它称为…）；meaning that… 现在分词作结果状语（意思是…）；破折号 in other words… 是对前面 companies 的同位换言；based in… 过去分词定语。
notes: refer to A as B：把 A 称为 B。
meaning that…：现在分词作结果/补充状语（意即…）。
in other words, multinational tech companies based in…：破折号引出同位换言；based in… 过去分词作定语。

sents.en: The digital services tax now awaits the signature of President Emmanuel Macron, who has expressed support for the measure, and it could go into effect within the next few weeks.
sents.cn: 这项数字服务税目前正等待总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙签署，他已表示支持这一举措，该税可能在未来几周内生效。

sents.en: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.
sents.cn: 但它已经引发了重大争议，美国贸易代表已就该税是否歧视美国公司展开调查，而这一调查反过来又可能导致针对法国的贸易制裁。

sents.en: The French tax is not just a unilateral move by one country in need of revenue.
sents.cn: 法国的这项税收并非某个亟需财政收入的国家单方面采取的行动。

sents.en: Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions.
sents.cn: 相反，数字服务税是一股大得多的潮流的一部分；过去几年里，各国纷纷提出或出台了名目繁多、令人眼花缭乱的国际税收新规定。

sents.en: These have included Britain's DPT (diverted profits tax), Australia's MAAL (multinational antiavoidance law), and India's SEP (significant economic presence) test, to name but a few.
sents.cn: 这些规定包括英国的DPT（利润转移税）、澳大利亚的MAAL（跨国公司反避税法）以及印度的SEP（重大经济存在）测试，这里仅举数例。

sents.en: At the same time, the European Union, Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes.
sents.cn: 与此同时，欧盟、西班牙、英国及其他若干国家都已认真考虑过征收数字服务税。

sents.en: These unilateral developments differ in their specifics, but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax, even if international tax rules do not grant them that right.
sents.cn: 这些单边举措在具体细节上各不相同，但它们的目的都是要对跨国公司的某些所得和收入征税——各国认为自己理应拥有对这些所得和收入征税的权利，即便现行国际税收规则并未赋予它们这一权利。

analysis.trunk: 并列双分句(but)：① These … developments differ in their specifics ② they are all designed to tax multinationals …
structure: 分句①：These unilateral developments differ in their specifics
并列(but)分句②：they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue …
├ be designed to do：旨在
├ 定语从句〔that，修饰 income and revenue〕：that countries believe they should have a right to tax（countries believe 为插入）
└ 让步状语从句(even if)：even if international tax rules do not grant them that right
analysis.logic: but 连接两分句；分句② be designed to tax…；that 定语从句修饰 income and revenue（countries believe (that) they should have a right to tax，countries believe 插入）；even if 让步从句。
notes: differ in：在…方面不同；be designed to do：旨在做…。
income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax：that 定语从句修饰 income and revenue，countries believe 是插入（各国认为自己有权征税的…）。
even if 引导让步状语从句（即便…）；grant sb sth 授予。

sents.en: In other words, they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy.
sents.cn: 换言之，它们都持有一种看法，即国际税收体系未能跟上当前经济的发展步伐。

sents.en: In response to these many unilateral measures, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) is currently working with 131 countries to reach a consensus by the end of 2020 on an international solution.
sents.cn: 为应对这众多的单边措施，经济合作与发展组织（OECD）目前正与131个国家携手合作，力争在2020年底之前就一项国际性解决方案达成共识。

sents.en: Both France and the United States are involved in the organization's work, but France's digital services tax and the American response raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system.
sents.cn: 法国和美国都参与了该组织的这项工作，但法国的数字服务税以及美国的回应，引发了人们对国际税收体系未来走向的疑问。

sents.en: France's planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
sents.cn: 法国拟征收的这项税收是一个明确的警示：除非各方能就改革国际税收体系达成广泛共识，否则其他国家很可能会群起效仿，美国公司将面临来自数十个国家的一连串五花八门的税收，而这些税收终将被证明是沉重而高昂的负担。

analysis.trunk: S+be+表 + 冒号展开：France's planned tax is a clear warning（法国拟征之税是一记明确警告）
structure: 主句：France's planned tax is a clear warning
冒号后（展开警告内容）：Unless …, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes …
├ 条件状语从句(Unless)：Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system
└ 并列主句(and)：other nations are likely to follow suit / American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 taxes〕：that will prove burdensome and costly
analysis.logic: 主句 tax is a warning；冒号展开：Unless 条件从句 + 两个并列主句（nations follow suit / companies will face taxes）；that 定语从句修饰 taxes（将被证明…）。
notes: 冒号后展开警告的内容；Unless 引导条件状语从句（除非…）。
and 连接两个并列主句（other nations… / American companies…）；follow suit 仿效跟进。
taxes … that will prove burdensome and costly：that 定语从句修饰 taxes（prove + 形容词 终将证明是…）。

sents.en: People often complain that plastics are too durable.
sents.cn: 人们常常抱怨塑料过于经久耐用。

sents.en: Water bottles, shopping bags, and other trash litter the planet, from Mount Everest to the Mariana Trench, because plastics are everywhere and don't break down easily.
sents.cn: 从珠穆朗玛峰到马里亚纳海沟，水瓶、购物袋以及其他垃圾遍布整个地球，因为塑料无处不在，而且难以降解。

sents.en: But some plastic materials change over time.
sents.cn: 但有些塑料材料会随时间发生变化。

sents.en: They crack and frizzle.
sents.cn: 它们会开裂、卷曲。

sents.en: They"weep"out additives.
sents.cn: 它们会“渗出”添加剂。

sents.en: They melt into sludge.
sents.cn: 它们会融化成黏稠的泥状物。

sents.en: All of which creates huge headaches for institutions, such as museums, trying to preserve culturally important objects.
sents.cn: 所有这些都给那些试图保存具有重要文化价值物品的机构（如博物馆）带来了极大的难题。

sents.en: The variety of plastic objects at risk is dizzying: early radios, avant-garde sculptures, celluloid animation stills from Disney films, the first artificial heart.
sents.cn: 面临风险的塑料制品种类繁多，令人眼花缭乱：早期的收音机、前卫的雕塑、迪士尼电影中赛璐珞动画定格画面，还有第一颗人造心脏。

sents.en: Certain artifacts are especially vulnerable because some pioneers in plastic art didn't always know how to mix ingredients properly, says Thea van Oosten, a polymer chemist who, until retiring a few years ago, worked for decades at the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands.
sents.cn: 某些艺术品尤其脆弱，因为一些塑料艺术的先驱者并不总是知道如何正确地调配原料，泰娅·范·奥斯滕（Thea van Oosten）如是说；她是一位高分子化学家，在几年前退休之前，曾在荷兰文化遗产署（Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands）工作了数十年。

analysis.trunk: 引语(主句+because) + 倒装提示语：「Certain artifacts are especially vulnerable because …」 says Thea van Oosten …
structure: 引语：Certain artifacts are especially vulnerable because some pioneers in plastic art didn't always know how to mix ingredients properly
└ 原因状语从句(because)：because some pioneers … didn't always know how to mix ingredients properly（how + 不定式作 know 的宾语）
倒装提示语：says Thea van Oosten, a polymer chemist who …（= Thea van Oosten says）
└ 同位语〔说明 Thea van Oosten〕：a polymer chemist
└ 定语从句〔who，修饰 a polymer chemist〕：who, until retiring a few years ago, worked for decades at the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands
analysis.logic: 引语 artifacts are vulnerable because…（how to mix… 宾语）；says + 主语 倒装；a polymer chemist 同位语，who 定语从句修饰（until retiring… 插入时间状语）。
notes: says Thea van Oosten…：引语提示语的倒装（= … says）；a polymer chemist 是其同位语。
know how to mix ingredients properly：how + 不定式作 know 的宾语。
who, until retiring a few years ago, worked…：who 定语从句修饰 a polymer chemist，until retiring… 是插入的时间状语。

sents.en: "The object you make is already a time bomb."
sents.cn: “你制作出来的物品本身就已经是一颗定时炸弹。”

sents.en: And sometimes, its not the artist's fault.
sents.cn: 而且有时候，这并不是艺术家的过错。

sents.en: In the 1960s, the Italian artist Piero Gilardi began to create hundreds of bright, colorful foam pieces.
sents.cn: 20 世纪 60 年代，意大利艺术家皮耶罗·吉拉尔迪（Piero Gilardi）开始创作数百件色彩鲜艳的泡沫作品。

sents.en: Those pieces included small beds of roses and other items as well as a few dozen"nature carpets"-large rectangles decorated with foam pumpkins cabbages, and watermelons.
sents.cn: 这些作品包括一小片一小片的玫瑰花床和其他物件，还有几十块“自然地毯”——上面装饰着泡沫制成的南瓜、卷心菜和西瓜的大块长方形作品。

sents.en: He wanted viewers to walk around on the carpets-which meant they had to be durable.
sents.cn: 他希望观众能在这些地毯上四处走动——这就意味着它们必须经久耐用。

sents.en: It's especially vulnerable to light damage, and by the mid-1990s, Gilardi's pumpkins, roses, and other figures were splitting and crumbling.
sents.cn: 它尤其容易受到光照的损害，到 20 世纪 90 年代中期，吉拉尔迪的南瓜、玫瑰以及其他造型的作品开始开裂、破碎。

sents.en: Museums locked some of them away in the dark.
sents.cn: 博物馆把其中一些作品锁进了暗处。

sents.en: So van Oosten and her colleagues worked to preserve Gilardi's sculptures.
sents.cn: 于是范·奥斯滕和她的同事们着手保护吉拉尔迪的雕塑作品。

sents.en: Van Oosten calls those chemicals"sunscreens"because their goal was to prevent further light damage and rebuild worn polymer fibers.
sents.cn: 范·奥斯滕把那些化学物质称为“防晒霜”，因为它们的作用是防止光照造成进一步损害，并修复磨损的聚合物纤维。

sents.en: She is proud that several sculptures have even gone on display again, albeit sometimes beneath protective cases.
sents.cn: 令她自豪的是，有几件雕塑作品甚至再次得以展出，尽管有时是被罩在保护罩之下。

sents.en: Despite success stories like van Oosten's, preservation of plastics will likely get harder.
sents.cn: 尽管有像范·奥斯滕这样的成功案例，但塑料制品的保存工作很可能会变得越来越艰难。

sents.en: Old objects continue to deteriorate.
sents.cn: 旧的物品仍在不断老化变质。

sents.en: Worse, biodegradable plastics designed to disintegrate, are increasingly common.
sents.cn: 更糟糕的是，那些被设计成可以自行分解的可生物降解塑料正变得越来越常见。

sents.en: Joana Lia Ferreira, an assistant professor of conservation and restoration at the NOVA School of Science and Technology, notes that archaeologists first defined the great material ages of human history-Stone Age, Iron Age, and so on-after examining artifacts in museums.
sents.cn: 若阿娜·利亚·费雷拉（Joana Lia Ferreira）是诺瓦科技学院（NOVA School of Science and Technology）文物保护与修复专业的助理教授，她指出，考古学家最初正是在考察了博物馆中的文物之后，才划分出人类历史上几个重大的材料时代——石器时代、铁器时代等等。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：Joana Lia Ferreira … notes that …（费雷拉指出…）
structure: 主句：Joana Lia Ferreira … notes that …
├ 同位语〔说明 Ferreira〕：an assistant professor of conservation and restoration at the NOVA School of Science and Technology
└ 宾语从句(that)：archaeologists first defined the great material ages of human history … after examining artifacts in museums
├ 破折号同位列举〔说明 the great material ages〕：Stone Age, Iron Age, and so on
└ 时间状语(after + V-ing)：after examining artifacts in museums
analysis.logic: 主语 Ferreira（同位语很长，造成主谓分隔），谓语 notes that…；宾语从句 defined the great material ages（破折号列举 Stone Age… 同位）；after examining… 时间状语。
notes: 主谓分隔：主语 Joana Lia Ferreira 与谓语 notes 被长同位语隔开。
破折号夹的 Stone Age, Iron Age, and so on 是 the great material ages 的同位列举。
after examining artifacts in museums：after + 动名词作时间状语（在考察…之后）。

sents.en: We now live in an age of plastic, she says, "and what we decide to collect today, what we decide to preserve…will have a strong impact on how in the future we'll be seen."
sents.cn: 她说，我们如今生活在一个塑料的时代，“而我们今天决定收藏什么、决定保存什么……将会对未来人们如何看待我们产生重大影响。”

analysis.trunk: S+V：We now live in an age of plastic（我们如今生活在塑料时代）
structure: 主句：We now live in an age of plastic
└ 插入语：she says
引语：what we decide to collect today, what we decide to preserve … will have a strong impact on how in the future we'll be seen
├ 并列主语从句(what)：what we decide to collect today / what we decide to preserve
├ 谓语：will have a strong impact on …
└ 介词宾语从句(how)：how in the future we'll be seen
analysis.logic: 主句 We live in an age of plastic（she says 插入）；引语主语是两个并列 what 从句，谓语 will have impact on…；how… 宾语从句。
notes: she says 是插入语。
what we decide to collect…, what we decide to preserve…：两个并列 what 主语从句作引语主语。
a strong impact on how … we'll be seen：how 引导介词 on 的宾语从句（对将来我们如何被看待…）。

sents.en: As the latest crop of students pen their undergraduate application form and weigh up their options, it may be worth considering just how the point, purpose and value of a degree has changed and what Generation Z need to consider as they start the third stage of their educational journey.
sents.cn: 当最新一批学生填写本科申请表、权衡他们的选择时，或许值得思考一下，学位的意义、目的与价值究竟发生了怎样的变化，以及Z世代在开启教育旅程的第三阶段时需要考虑些什么。

analysis.trunk: 时间从句+形式主语：As …, it may be worth considering …（当…时，或许值得思考…）
structure: 时间状语从句(As)：As the latest crop of students pen their undergraduate application form and weigh up their options（并列谓语 pen / weigh up）
主句（形式主语 it）：it may be worth considering just how … and what …
├ 真正主语(动名词)：considering just how the point, purpose and value of a degree has changed and what Generation Z need to consider
│   └ 并列宾语从句(how… and what…)：how … has changed / what Generation Z need to consider
└ 时间状语从句(as)：as they start the third stage of their educational journey
analysis.logic: As 时间从句（并列谓语 pen/weigh up）；主句 it 形式主语，worth considering（动名词）后接 how… and what… 并列宾语从句；as they start… 时间状语。
notes: it may be worth considering…：it 形式主语，worth + 动名词（值得考虑…）。
how … has changed and what … need to consider：considering 后两个并列宾语从句。
As… 与 as they start…：两处时间状语从句（当…时）；pen 作动词=书写。

sents.en: Millennials were told that if you did well in school, got a decent degree, you would be set up for life.
sents.cn: 千禧一代被告知，如果你在学校表现优异，拿到一个像样的学位，便会一生衣食无忧。

sents.en: But that promise has been found wanting.
sents.cn: 但这一承诺已被证明难以兑现。

sents.en: As degrees became universal, they became devalued.
sents.cn: 随着学位变得普遍，它们也随之贬值。

sents.en: Education was no longer a secure route of social mobility.
sents.cn: 教育不再是实现社会阶层流动的可靠途径。

sents.en: Today, 28 per cent of graduates in the UK are in non-graduate roles, a percentage which is double the average among OECD countries.
sents.cn: 如今，英国有28%的毕业生从事着不需要学位的工作，这一比例是经合组织（OECD）国家平均水平的两倍。

sents.en: This is not to say that there is no point in getting a degree, but rather stress that a degree is not for everyone, that the switch from classroom to lecture hall is not an inevitable one and that other options are available.
sents.cn: 这并不是说取得学位毫无意义，而是要强调学位并非适合所有人，从教室到大学讲堂的转变并非必然之选，而且还有其他选择可供考虑。

analysis.trunk: be+不定式表语(not…but…)：This is not to say … but rather (to) stress …（这并非要说…而是要强调…）
structure: 主句：This is not to say that … but rather stress that …, that … and that …
├ not…but… 并列不定式表语：not to say… but (to) rather stress…
├ say 的宾语从句(that)：that there is no point in getting a degree
└ stress 的三个并列宾语从句(that…, that… and that…)：that a degree is not for everyone / that the switch from classroom to lecture hall is not an inevitable one / that other options are available
analysis.logic: This is not to say… but rather (to) stress…（be + 不定式表语，not…but… 并列）；say + that 宾语从句；stress + 三个并列 that 宾语从句。
notes: This is not to say … but rather (to) stress …：not…but… 并列不定式作表语（这并非要说…而是要强调…）。
stress that…, that… and that…：stress 后三个并列 that 宾语从句。
there is no point in getting a degree：there be no point in doing（做…没有意义）。

sents.en: Thankfully, there are signs that this is already happening, with Generation Z seeking to learn from their millennial predecessors, even if parents and teachers tend to be still set in the degree mindset.
sents.cn: 可喜的是，有迹象表明这种情况已经在发生：Z世代正力图从他们的千禧一代前辈身上汲取经验教训，尽管家长和老师往往仍固守着唯学位论的思维定式。

sents.en: Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers who often prove themselves to be more committed and loyal employees than graduates.
sents.cn: 长期以来，雇主们已经看到了招聘中学毕业生的好处，这些人往往证明自己是比大学毕业生更敬业、更忠诚的员工。

sents.en: Many too are seeing the advantages of scrapping a degree requirement for certain roles.
sents.cn: 许多雇主也认识到了取消某些岗位学位要求的好处。

sents.en: For those for whom a degree is the desired route, consider that this may well be the first of many.
sents.cn: 对于那些把学位作为理想路径的人来说，要意识到这很可能只是众多学位中的第一个。

sents.en: In this age of generalists, it pays to have specific knowledge or skills.
sents.cn: 在这个通才辈出的时代，拥有专门的知识或技能是划算的。

sents.en: Postgraduates now earn 40 per cent more than graduates.
sents.cn: 如今研究生的收入比本科毕业生高出40%。

sents.en: When more and more of us have a degree, it makes sense to have two.
sents.cn: 当越来越多的人都拥有一个学位时，拥有两个学位就变得合情合理了。

sents.en: It is unlikely that Generation Z will be done with education at 18 or 21; they will need to be constantly up-skilling throughout their career to stay employable.
sents.cn: Z世代不太可能在18岁或21岁时就结束受教育的历程；他们将需要在整个职业生涯中不断提升技能，以保持自身的就业竞争力。

sents.en: It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfilment and desire for diversity, will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers.
sents.cn: 据估计，由于技术带来的压力、对个人价值实现的渴望以及对多样化的追求，这一代人在其整个职业生涯中将为17家不同的雇主工作，并拥有五种不同的职业。

analysis.trunk: 形式主语 It + that 主语从句(被动)：It has been estimated that …（据估计…）
structure: 主句（形式主语 It）：It has been estimated that …
└ 主语从句(that)：this generation … will work for 17 different employers … and have five different careers
├ 插入（原因状语）：due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfilment and desire for diversity
└ 并列谓语：will work for… and have…
analysis.logic: It has been estimated that…（it 形式主语 + 被动；真正主语是 that 从句）；that 从句主语 this generation（due to… 插入）+ 并列谓语 will work… and have…。
notes: It has been estimated that…：it 形式主语 + 被动；真正主语是 that 从句。
due to…：插入的原因状语，夹在主语 this generation 与谓语之间（主谓分隔）。
will work for… and have…：that 从句内的并列谓语；over the course of 在…期间。

sents.en: Education, and not just knowledge gained on campus, will be a core part of Generation Z's career trajectory.
sents.cn: 教育——而不仅仅是在校园里获得的知识——将成为Z世代职业发展轨迹的核心组成部分。

sents.en: 'Their sons or daughters would never say such a thing; it's as if they already know that their degree won't define them in the same way.
sents.cn: 他们的儿女绝不会说出这样的话；这就好像他们已经明白，自己的学位不会再以同样的方式来定义他们。

sents.en: Enlightening, challenging, stimulating, fun.
sents.cn: 富有启发性、极具挑战性、令人振奋、充满乐趣。

sents.en: These were some of the words that Nature readers used to describe their experience of art-science collaborations in a series of articles on partnerships between artists and researchers.
sents.cn: 在一系列关于艺术家与研究者合作的文章中，《自然》杂志的读者用这些词来形容他们对艺术与科学合作的体验。

sents.en: Nearly 40% of the roughly 350 people who responded to an accompanying poll said, they had collaborated with artists; and almost all said they would consider doing so in future.
sents.cn: 在回应随附民意调查的约350人中，近40%的人表示自己曾与艺术家合作过；而且几乎所有人都表示今后会考虑这样做。

analysis.trunk: 并列双分句(;and)：① Nearly 40% … said they had collaborated … ② almost all said they would consider doing so …
structure: 分句①：Nearly 40% of the roughly 350 people … said (that) they had collaborated with artists
├ 定语从句〔who，修饰 people〕：who responded to an accompanying poll
└ 宾语从句(省略 that)：they had collaborated with artists
分号 + and 分句②：almost all said they would consider doing so in future
└ 宾语从句(省略 that)：they would consider doing so in future
analysis.logic: 分句① 主语 40% of the people（who 定语从句修饰），said (that)…；分号+and 接分句② almost all said (that)…；doing so 替代前文动作。
notes: who responded to an accompanying poll：who 定语从句修饰 people。
said (that) they had collaborated…：省略 that 的宾语从句。
consider doing so：consider + 动名词；doing so 替代 collaborating with artists。

sents.en: Such an encouraging results is not surprising.
sents.cn: 如此令人鼓舞的结果并不令人意外。

sents.en: "One respondent said.
sents.cn: 一位受访者说道。

sents.en: One example of how artists and scientists have together rocked the scenes came last month when the Sydney Symphony Orchestra performed a reworked version of Antonio Vivaldi's The Four Seasons.
sents.cn: 上个月，悉尼交响乐团演奏了安东尼奥·维瓦尔第《四季》的改编版本，这正是艺术家与科学家携手震撼舞台的一个例子。

sents.en: They reimagined the 300-year-old score by injecting the latest climate prediction data for each season-provided by Monash Univerity's Climate Change Communication Research Hub.
sents.cn: 他们为这部有着300年历史的乐谱注入了每个季节的最新气候预测数据——这些数据由莫纳什大学的气候变化传播研究中心提供——从而对其进行了重新构想。

sents.en: The performance was a creative call to action ahead of November's United Nations Climate Change Conference in Glasgow, UK.
sents.cn: 这场演出是在英国格拉斯哥即将于11月召开联合国气候变化大会之前发出的一次富有创意的行动号召。

sents.en: But a genuine partnership must be a two-way street.
sents.cn: 但真正的合作必须是双向的。

sents.en: Nor should their work be considered only as an object of study.
sents.cn: 他们的作品也不应仅仅被视为研究的对象。

sents.en: The alliances are most valuable when scientists and artists have a shared stake in a project, are able to jointly design it and can critique each other's work.
sents.cn: 当科学家和艺术家在一个项目中拥有共同的利益、能够共同设计项目并能相互评判对方的工作时，这种合作最具价值。

sents.en: Such an approach can both prompt new research as well as result in powerful art.
sents.cn: 这样的做法既能催生新的研究，又能产生震撼人心的艺术作品。

sents.en: More than half a century ago, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology opened its Center for Advanced Visual Studies(CAVS) to explore the role of technology in culture.
sents.cn: 半个多世纪以前，麻省理工学院创办了高等视觉研究中心（CAVS），以探索技术在文化中的作用。

sents.en: The founders deliberately focused their projects around light-hance the "visual studies" in the name.
sents.cn: 创办者们刻意将他们的项目聚焦于光——这也正是其名称中“视觉研究”的由来。

sents.en: Light was a something that both artists and scientists had an interest in, and therefore could form the basis of collaboration.
sents.cn: 光是艺术家和科学家都感兴趣的东西，因此能够成为合作的基础。

sents.en: As science and technology progressed, and divided into more sub-disciplines, the centre was simultaneously looking to a time when leading researchers could also be artists, writers and poets, and vice versa.
sents.cn: 随着科学技术不断进步并细分为更多的子学科，该中心同时也在展望这样一个时代：顶尖的研究者也可以是艺术家、作家和诗人，反之亦然。

analysis.trunk: 时间从句+主句：As …, the centre was … looking to a time when …（随着…，该中心同时憧憬着一个…的时代）
structure: 时间状语从句(As)：As science and technology progressed, and divided into more sub-disciplines（并列谓语 progressed / divided）
主句：the centre was simultaneously looking to a time …
└ 定语从句〔when，修饰 a time〕：when leading researchers could also be artists, writers and poets, and vice versa
analysis.logic: As 时间从句（随着…，并列谓语 progressed/divided）；主句 the centre was looking to a time；when 定语从句修饰 a time（and vice versa 反之亦然）。
notes: As 引导时间状语从句（随着…），从句内并列谓语 progressed and divided。
look to a time when…：when 定语从句修饰 a time（憧憬一个…的时代）。
and vice versa：反之亦然（艺术家也可以是科学家）。

sents.en: Nature's poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time, and embrace surprise and challenge.
sents.cn: 《自然》杂志的调查结果表明，这一趋势依然强劲，但要使合作取得成效，双方都需要投入时间，并欣然接受意外与挑战。

analysis.trunk: 并列双分句(but)：① findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever ② both sides need to invest time, and embrace …
structure: 分句①：Nature's poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever
└ 宾语从句(that)：this trend is as strong as ever
并列(but)分句②：both sides need to invest time, and embrace surprise and challenge
├ 不定式作目的状语(插入)：to make a collaboration work（make + 宾 + 宾补 work）
└ 并列不定式(need to)：to invest time, and (to) embrace surprise and challenge
analysis.logic: but 连接两分句；分句① suggest that…（as strong as ever）；分句② to make…work 目的状语插入，主句 both sides need to invest… and embrace…（并列不定式）。
notes: as strong as ever：as…as ever（一如既往地强劲）。
to make a collaboration work：不定式作目的状语（make + 宾语 + 宾补 work，使合作奏效）。
need to invest… and embrace…：need to 后并列不定式。

sents.en: The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication, and participants.
sents.cn: 艺术与科学合作的影响力，需要超越研究传播这一必要目的以及参与者本身。

sents.en: Artists and scientists alike are immersed in discovery and invention, and challenge and critique are core to both, too.
sents.cn: 艺术家和科学家一样，都沉浸于发现与创造之中，而挑战与评判对双方而言也都至关重要。

sents.en: Instead, dismissals must be justified.
sents.cn: 相反，解雇必须有正当理由。

sents.en: Employers must both show cause and act in a procedurally fair way.
sents.cn: 雇主既要拿出正当理由，又要在程序上以公平的方式行事。

sents.en: Personal grievance were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from"unjustified dismissals".
sents.cn: 设立个人申诉制度，是为了保护普通劳动者的工作免遭“无正当理由的解雇”。

sents.en: The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management.
sents.cn: 其前提在于：普通合同法对于劳动者免受管理层任意行为侵害缺乏足够的保障。

sents.en: Long gone are the days when a boss could simply give an employee contractual notice.
sents.cn: 老板只需依合同向雇员发出通知便可解雇的日子早已一去不复返。

sents.en: But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives.
sents.cn: 但是，当这些条款适用于高薪的经理和高管时，便给企业带来了种种困难。

sents.en: As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance.
sents.cn: 正如无数董事会和企业主所证实的那样，限制企业解雇业绩不佳、收入高昂的经理，无异于给提升生产率和整体业绩拉上了手刹。

sents.en: The difference between C-grade and A-grade managers may very well be the difference between business success or failure.
sents.cn: C级经理与A级经理之间的差别，很可能就是企业成败之间的差别。

sents.en: Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal.
sents.cn: 然而，平庸已不再足以构成解雇的正当理由。

sents.en: Consequently -and paradoxically-laws introduced to protect the jobs of ordinary workers may be placing those jobs at risk.
sents.cn: 因此——而且自相矛盾的是——为保护普通劳动者工作而出台的法律，可能反而使这些工作岌岌可危。

sents.en: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers' wages.
sents.cn: 即便没有使工作面临风险，就业保护法在多大程度上限制企业主解雇业绩不佳的经理，这些法律就会在多大程度上成为对企业生产率、进而对劳动者工资的束缚。

analysis.trunk: S+V：those laws act as a constraint on …（那些法律就成了对…的制约）
structure: 让步/条件状语(If not + V-ing)：If not placing jobs at risk（即便不至于危及就业）
程度状语从句(to the extent)：to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers（constrain sb from doing）
主句：those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers' wages
└ act as + 并列介词宾语：on firm productivity and … on workers' wages
analysis.logic: If not placing…（省略式条件状语，即便不…）；to the extent (that)… 程度状语从句（在…的程度上）；主句 those laws act as a constraint on… and on…。
notes: If not placing jobs at risk：省略式状语（= even if they do not place jobs at risk）。
to the extent (that) … constrain … from doing：to the extent 引导程度状语从句；constrain sb from doing 阻止/限制某人做。
act as a constraint on A and … on B：充当对 A 以及 B 的制约（并列介词宾语）。

sents.en: Indeed, in "An International Perspective on New Zealand's Productivity Paradox"(2014), the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country's poor productivity growth record.
sents.cn: 事实上，在《从国际视角看新西兰的生产率悖论》(2014年)一文中，生产率委员会特别指出，管理能力低下是该国生产率增长记录不佳的一个原因。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O(single out A as B)：the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause …（生产率委员会把管理能力低下列为…的一个原因）
structure: 状语：Indeed, in 「An International Perspective on New Zealand's Productivity Paradox」(2014)
主句：the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country's poor productivity growth record
└ single out A as B：singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause…
analysis.logic: 主句 single out A as B（把…单独挑出作为…）；in 「…」(2014) 状语（在…报告中）。
notes: single out A as B：把 A 单独挑出作为 B（认定…为…的一个原因）。
the low quality of managerial capabilities：管理能力的低下；productivity growth record 生产率增长记录。

sents.en: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA's unjustified dismissal procedures.
sents.cn: 高薪经理本身也无法幸免于《就业关系法》中无正当理由解雇程序所造成的伤害。

sents.en: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
sents.cn: 由于就业保护法使解雇雇员的成本更高，雇主在招聘新员工时也就更为谨慎。

sents.en: This makes it harder for the marginal manager to gain employment.
sents.cn: 这就使得那些处于边缘的经理更难获得工作。

sents.en: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
sents.cn: 而且企业付给员工的薪酬也更低，因为一旦雇佣关系出了问题，要承担后果的是企业。

sents.en: Society also suffers from excessive employment protections.
sents.cn: 社会同样深受过度就业保护之害。

sents.en: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being Across the Tasman Sea, Australia deals with the unjustified dismissal paradox by excluding employees earning above a specified "high-income threshold"from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws.
sents.cn: 严苛的解雇规定对生产率增长产生不利影响，并阻碍繁荣与整体福祉。在塔斯曼海对岸，澳大利亚处理无正当理由解雇悖论的办法是：将收入超过特定“高收入门槛”的雇员排除在其不公平解雇法的保护之外。

analysis.trunk: 两句（漏句点）：① 严苛的解雇规定…损害…；② 澳大利亚通过把高收入雇员排除在保护之外来应对…
structure: 句①：Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being
└ 并列谓语：affect… and hamper both… and…
句②：Across the Tasman Sea, Australia deals with the unjustified dismissal paradox by excluding employees … from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws
├ 方式状语(by + V-ing)：by excluding employees … from the protection
└ 现在分词作定语〔修饰 employees〕：earning above a specified 「high-income threshold」
analysis.logic: 句① regulations affect… and hamper…（并列谓语，both…and… 并列宾语）；句② Australia deals with…by excluding…（方式状语，exclude A from B，earning… 现在分词定语修饰 employees）。
notes: （原文 well-being 后漏句点，实为两句）。句① 并列谓语 affect… and hamper…。
deal with … by doing：通过…来应对；exclude A from B 把 A 排除在 B 之外。
employees earning above a specified threshold：earning… 现在分词作定语修饰 employees（收入高于…门槛的雇员）。

sents.en: In New Zealand, a 2016 private members'Bill tried to permit firms and high-income employees to contract out of the unjustified dismissal regime.
sents.cn: 在新西兰，2016年的一项议员个人提案曾试图允许企业与高收入雇员通过约定排除适用无正当理由解雇制度。

sents.en: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
sents.cn: 然而，所提议的机制过于繁琐，该提案在当年晚些时候政府换届后被否决。

sents.en: The weather in Texas may have cooled since the recent extreme heat, but the temperature will be high at the State Board of Education meeting in Austin this month as officials debate how climate change is taught in Texas schools.
sents.cn: 尽管得克萨斯州的天气在近来的极端高温后或许已经转凉，但本月在奥斯汀召开的州教育委员会会议上，气氛却将十分火热，因为官员们要就得克萨斯州的学校如何讲授气候变化展开辩论。

sents.en: Pat Hardy, who sympathized with views of the energy sector, is resisting the proposed change to science standards for pre-teen pupils.
sents.cn: 帕特·哈迪对能源行业的观点深表赞同，他正在抵制这项针对青春期前学生科学课程标准的改革提案。

sents.en: These would emphasise the primacy of human activity in recent climate change and encourage discussion of mitigation measures.
sents.cn: 这些（改革）将强调人类活动在近来气候变化中的首要作用，并鼓励就缓解措施展开讨论。

sents.en: Most scientists and experts sharply dispute Hardy's views.
sents.cn: 大多数科学家和专家都强烈反对哈迪的观点。

sents.en: "They casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion."
sents.cn: “他们轻率地将学者和科学家毕生的研究成果斥为又一种被误导的看法。”

sents.en: says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network, a non-profit group that monitors public education, "What millions of Texas kids learn in their public schools is determined too often by the political ideology of partisan board members, rather than facts and sound scholarship."
sents.cn: 得克萨斯自由网络（一个监督公共教育的非营利组织）的高级传播策略师丹·奎因如是说，“数百万得克萨斯州儿童在公立学校里学到的东西，往往不是由事实和扎实的学问决定的，而是由带有党派偏见的委员会成员的政治意识形态决定的。”

analysis.trunk: 倒装提示语 + 引语(what 主语从句)：says Dan Quinn …，「What … kids learn … is determined … by …」
structure: 倒装提示语：says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network, a non-profit group that monitors public education（= Dan Quinn says）
├ 同位语①〔说明 Dan Quinn〕：senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network
└ 同位语②〔说明 the Texas Freedom Network〕：a non-profit group（定语从句 that monitors public education 修饰之）
引语：What millions of Texas kids learn in their public schools is determined too often by the political ideology of partisan board members, rather than facts and sound scholarship
├ 主语从句(What)：What millions of Texas kids learn in their public schools
└ 谓语(被动) + 对比：is determined too often by … , rather than facts and sound scholarship
analysis.logic: says + 主语 倒装；多重同位语（strategist…、a non-profit group that…）；引语主语是 What 从句，谓语被动 is determined by…（rather than 对比）。
notes: says Dan Quinn…：引语提示语的倒装；后接多重同位语（strategist… / a non-profit group that monitors…）。
What millions of Texas kids learn…：what 主语从句作引语主语。
is determined … by … rather than …：被动 + rather than 对比（由…而非…决定）。

sents.en: Such debate reflects fierce discussions across the US and around the world, as researchers, policymakers, teachers and students step up demands for a greater focus on teaching about the facts of climate change in schools.
sents.cn: 这样的辩论反映了全美乃至全世界激烈的讨论，因为研究人员、政策制定者、教师和学生都在加紧呼吁，要求学校更加注重讲授气候变化的事实。

sents.en: A study last year by the National Center for Science Education, a non-profit group of scientists and teachers, looking at how state public schools across the country address climate change in science classes, gave barely half of US states a grade B+ or higher.
sents.cn: 去年，由科学家和教师组成的非营利组织“国家科学教育中心”开展了一项研究，考察全国各州公立学校在科学课上如何处理气候变化这一议题，结果给予 B+ 及以上等级的州还不到全美的一半。

analysis.trunk: S+V+双宾：A study … gave barely half of US states a grade B+ or higher（一项研究只给约一半的美国各州评了 B+ 或以上）
structure: 主句：A study last year by the National Center for Science Education … gave barely half of US states a grade B+ or higher
├ 同位语〔说明 the National Center for Science Education〕：a non-profit group of scientists and teachers
├ 现在分词作定语〔修饰 A study〕：looking at how state public schools across the country address climate change in science classes
│   └ 介词宾语从句(how，作 looking at 的宾语)：how state public schools … address climate change
└ 双宾语：gave [barely half of US states] [a grade B+ or higher]
analysis.logic: 主语 A study（同位语 + looking at… 现在分词定语，造成主谓分隔），谓语 gave sb sth（双宾语）；how… 是 looking at 的宾语从句。
notes: 主谓分隔：主语 A study 与谓语 gave 被长同位语和 looking at… 现在分词定语隔开。
looking at how…：现在分词作定语修饰 A study；how 引导宾语从句（考察…如何应对气候变化）。
gave barely half of US states a grade B+ or higher：give sb sth 双宾语（给…评了 B+ 或以上）。

sents.en: Among the 10 worst performers were some of the most populous states, including Texas, which was given the lowest grade (F) and has a disproportionate influence because its textbooks are widely sold elsewhere.
sents.cn: 在表现最差的 10 个州中，有一些是人口最多的州，包括得克萨斯州，它被评为最低等级（F 级），而且影响格外大，因为其教科书在其他地方也广泛销售。

sents.en: Glenn Branch, the centre's deputy director, cautions that setting state-level science standards is only one limited benchmark in a country that decentralises decisions to local school boards.
sents.cn: 该中心副主任格伦·布兰奇告诫说，在一个把决策权下放给地方学校委员会的国家里，制定州一级的科学课程标准只是一项有限的衡量标准。

sents.en: Even if a state is considered a high performer in its science standards, "that does not mean it will be taught", he says.
sents.cn: 他说，即便某个州被认为在科学课程标准方面表现优异，“这也并不意味着相关内容就会被讲授”。

sents.en: Another issue is that while climate change is well integrated into some subjects and at some ages — such as earth and space sciences in high schools — it is not as well represented in curricula for younger children and in subjects that are more widely taught, such as biology and chemistry.
sents.cn: 另一个问题在于，虽然气候变化在某些学科、某些年龄段已得到很好的融入——比如高中的地球与空间科学——但在面向更低龄儿童的课程中，以及在生物、化学等更为普及的学科中，它的体现却并不充分。

analysis.trunk: S+be+表语从句：Another issue is that …（另一个问题是…）
structure: 主句：Another issue is that …
└ 表语从句(that)：while climate change is well integrated …, it is not as well represented …
├ 让步状语从句(while)：while climate change is well integrated into some subjects and at some ages（破折号插入举例：such as earth and space sciences in high schools）
└ 主句（表语从句内）：it is not as well represented in curricula for younger children and in subjects that are more widely taught
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 subjects〕：that are more widely taught（such as biology and chemistry 举例）
analysis.logic: 主句 Another issue is that…（表语从句）；表语从句内含 while 让步从句 + 主句 it is not as well represented…；that 定语从句修饰 subjects。
notes: Another issue is that…：that 引导表语从句。
while climate change is well integrated…, it is not as well represented…：表语从句内的 while 让步从句 + 主句（虽…但…）。
subjects that are more widely taught：that 定语从句修饰 subjects；not as well represented 没有那么好地体现（as…as 的省略比较）。

sents.en: It is also less prominent in many social studies courses.
sents.cn: 在许多社会研究课程中，它的地位也不那么突出。

sents.en: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers.
sents.cn: 布兰奇指出，即便越来越多的官方指南和教科书反映了科学界对气候变化的共识，传递更为偏颇观点的非官方教育材料仍在被分发给教师。

sents.en: They include materials sponsored by libertarian think-tanks and energy industry associations.
sents.cn: 其中包括由自由意志主义智库和能源行业协会赞助的材料。

sents.en: Communities throughout the region have been attempting to regulate short-term rentals since sites like Airbnb took off in the 2010s.
sents.cn: 自从Airbnb等网站在2010年代兴起以来，该地区各地的社区一直试图对短期租赁加以监管。

sents.en: Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory, there's an increased urgency in such regulation, particularly among those who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market.
sents.cn: 如今，房价创下历史新高，而库存却处于历史低位，此类监管的紧迫性随之增强，尤其是那些担心开发商会进场大量收购房产、再转手到短期租赁市场上牟取暴利的人。

analysis.trunk: there be：there's an increased urgency in such regulation（如今对此类监管的紧迫性增强了）
structure: 状语(with 复合结构)：Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory
主句(there be)：there's an increased urgency in such regulation
状语：particularly among those …
└ 定语从句〔who，修饰 those〕：who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market
├ 宾语从句(that)：developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing（并列谓语 come in / buy up）
└ 不定式作目的：to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market
analysis.logic: with… 复合结构状语；there be 主句；among those who… 状语（who 定语从句修饰 those，worry that… 宾语从句，并列谓语 come in and buy up，to flip… 目的）。
notes: with record-high home prices and historically low inventory：with 复合结构作状语（在…的情况下）。
those who worry that…：who 定语从句修饰 those；worry that… 宾语从句。
buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune：to flip… 目的状语（大量买进房产以转手牟利）；flip 转手倒卖。

sents.en: In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market.
sents.cn: 在新罕布什尔州，租房空置率已跌破1%，住房权益倡导者担心，不受约束的短期租赁会给本已紧张的市场带来进一步压力。

sents.en: The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
sents.cn: 该州议会最近否决了一项法案，该法案原本会使各城镇制定限制短期租赁的立法成为非法行为。

sents.en: "We are at a crisis level on the supply of rental housing, so anytime you're taking the tool out of the toolkit for communities to address this, you're potentially taking supply off the market that's already incredibly stressed," said Nick Taylor, executive director of the Workforce Housing Coalition of the Greater Seacoast.
sents.cn: 大海岸地区劳动力住房联盟执行主任尼克·泰勒说：“我们的租赁住房供应已处于危机水平，所以你每次把这个工具从社区应对这一问题的工具箱中拿走，就有可能让本已极度紧张的市场再减少供应。”

analysis.trunk: 引语(主句+so+anytime 从句) + 倒装提示语：「We are at a crisis level …, so anytime …, you're … taking supply off the market …」 said Nick Taylor …
structure: 引语分句①：We are at a crisis level on the supply of rental housing
so 结果分句②：so anytime you're taking the tool out of the toolkit …, you're potentially taking supply off the market …
├ 时间状语从句(anytime)：anytime you're taking the tool out of the toolkit for communities to address this（for+名词+to do）
└ 主句：you're potentially taking supply off the market that's already incredibly stressed
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 the market〕：that's already incredibly stressed
倒装提示语：said Nick Taylor, executive director of the Workforce Housing Coalition of the Greater Seacoast
analysis.logic: 引语 We are at a crisis level…，so + anytime 从句（时间状语，for communities to address 不定式）+ 主句（taking supply off the market，that 定语从句修饰 market）；said + 主语 倒装。
notes: anytime (you're…)：相当于连词，引导时间状语从句（每当…时）。
the tool out of the toolkit for communities to address this：for + 名词 + to do 不定式（供社区应对此事的工具）。
the market that's already incredibly stressed：that 定语从句修饰 the market；said Nick Taylor… 倒装。

sents.en: Without enough affordable housing in southern New Hampshire towns, "employers are having a hard time attracting employees, and workers are having a hard time finding a place to live," Taylor said.
sents.cn: 泰勒说，新罕布什尔州南部各城镇缺乏足够的可负担住房，“雇主很难吸引到员工，工人也很难找到落脚之处”。

sents.en: However, short-term rentals also provide housing for tourists, a crucial part of the economies in places like Nantucket, Cape Cod, or the towns that make up New Hampshire's Seacoast and Lakes Region, pointed out Ryan Castle, CEO of the Cape Cod & Islands Association of Realtors.
sents.cn: 然而，科德角及群岛房地产经纪人协会首席执行官瑞安·卡斯尔指出，短期租赁也为游客提供了住处，而游客是楠塔基特、科德角，或是构成新罕布什尔州海岸地区和湖区的那些城镇等地经济中至关重要的一环。

analysis.trunk: 引语(主句) + 倒装提示语：「short-term rentals also provide housing for tourists …」 pointed out Ryan Castle …
structure: 引语：short-term rentals also provide housing for tourists, a crucial part of the economies in places like …
└ 同位语〔补充说明前述「为游客供房/旅游业」〕：a crucial part of the economies in places like Nantucket, Cape Cod, or the towns
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 the towns〕：that make up New Hampshire's Seacoast and Lakes Region
倒装提示语：pointed out Ryan Castle, CEO of the Cape Cod & Islands Association of Realtors（= Ryan Castle pointed out）
└ 同位语〔说明 Ryan Castle〕：CEO of the Cape Cod & Islands Association of Realtors
analysis.logic: 引语 rentals provide housing for tourists（a crucial part… 同位语，that 定语从句修饰 the towns）；pointed out + 主语 倒装（CEO… 同位语）。
notes: pointed out Ryan Castle…：引语提示语的倒装（= … pointed out）；CEO… 是其同位语。
a crucial part of the economies…：同位语，补充说明「为游客提供住房（即旅游业）」。
the towns that make up …：that 定语从句修饰 the towns（构成…地区的那些城镇）。

sents.en: "A lot of workers are servicing the tourist industry, and the tourism industry is serviced by those people coming in short term," Castle said, "and so it's a cyclical effect."
sents.cn: 卡斯尔说：“很多工人在为旅游业服务，而旅游业又靠那些短期入住的人来支撑，”他说，“所以这是一种循环效应。”

sents.en: Short-term rentals themselves are not the crux of the issue, said Keren Horn, an affordable housing policy expert at the University of Massachusetts Boston.
sents.cn: 马萨诸塞大学波士顿分校的可负担住房政策专家克伦·霍恩说，短期租赁本身并不是问题的症结所在。

sents.en: "I think individuals being able to rent out their second home is a good thing.
sents.cn: “我认为，个人能够把自己的第二套住房出租出去是一件好事。

sents.en: If it's their vacation home anyway, and it's just empty, why can't you make money off it?"
sents.cn: 如果那本来就是他们的度假屋，又一直空着，为什么不能靠它赚点钱呢？”

sents.en: Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities — de facto hotels — to bypass taxes and regulations.
sents.cn: 然而，当开发商试图建造大规模的短期租赁设施——实质上的酒店——以此规避税收和监管时，问题就出现了。

sents.en: "I think the question is, shouldn't a developer who's really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel?"
sents.cn: “我认为问题在于，一个开发商实际上是在建造酒店，却把它伪装成不是酒店，难道不应当把它当作酒店来对待、征税和监管吗？”

sents.en: At the end of 2018, Governor Charlie Baker signed a bill to rein in those potential investor-buyers.
sents.cn: 2018年年底，州长查理·贝克签署了一项法案，以遏制这些潜在的投资型购房者。

sents.en: "The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy," the Globe reported.
sents.cn: 《波士顿环球报》报道称：“该法案要求每一位出租房东都向州政府登记注册，强制他们购买保险，并为在新的州级征税之上再征收地方税开启了可能。”

sents.en: Boston took things even further, limiting who is authorized to rent out their home, and requiring renters to register with the city's Inspectional Services Department.
sents.cn: 波士顿则更进一步，限制了谁有资格出租自己的住房，并要求出租人向该市的检查服务部门登记注册。

sents.en: Horn said similar registration requirements could benefit other struggling cities and towns.
sents.cn: 霍恩说，类似的登记要求或许能让其他陷入困境的城市和城镇受益。

sents.en: The only way to solve the issue, however, is by creating more housing.
sents.cn: 然而，解决这一问题的唯一办法，就是建造更多的住房。

sents.en: "If we want to make a change in the housing market, the main one is we have to build a lot more."
sents.cn: “如果我们想改变住房市场，最主要的一点就是我们必须大量地多盖房子。”

sents.en: If you're heading for your nearest branch of Waterstones in search of the Duchess of Sussex's new children's book The Bench, you might have to be prepared to hunt around a bit; the same may be true of The President's Daughter, the new thriller by Bill Clinton and James Patterson.
sents.cn: 如果你正前往离你最近的沃特斯通书店(Waterstones)分店，想寻找苏塞克斯公爵夫人的新童书《长椅》(The Bench)，那你或许得做好四处搜寻一番的准备；比尔·克林顿(Bill Clinton)与詹姆斯·帕特森(James Patterson)合著的新惊悚小说《总统千金》(The President's Daughter)恐怕也是如此。

analysis.trunk: 条件+主句；分号并列：If you're heading for …, you might have to be prepared to hunt around a bit; the same may be true of …
structure: 条件状语从句(If)：If you're heading for your nearest branch of Waterstones in search of the Duchess of Sussex's new children's book The Bench（The Bench 为同位语）
主句：you might have to be prepared to hunt around a bit
分号并列分句：the same may be true of The President's Daughter, the new thriller by Bill Clinton and James Patterson（同位语补充）
analysis.logic: If 条件从句（in search of… 状语，The Bench 同位语）；主句 you might have to be prepared to…；分号接并列分句（the same may be true of…，同位语补充）。
notes: If 引导条件状语从句；in search of 寻找；The Bench 是 book 的同位语。
be prepared to do：准备好做…；hunt around 四处搜寻。
the same may be true of…：分号并列分句（…也是如此）；the new thriller… 是 The President's Daughter 的同位语。

sents.en: Both of these books are published next week by Penguin Random House, a company currently involved in a stand-off with Waterstones.
sents.cn: 这两本书都将于下周由企鹅兰登书屋(Penguin Random House)出版，而该公司目前正与沃特斯通书店陷入僵持。

sents.en: The problem began late last year, when Penguin Random House confirmed that it had introduced a credit limit with Waterstones "at a very significant level".
sents.cn: 问题始于去年年底，当时企鹅兰登书屋证实，它已对沃特斯通书店设定了一个“相当高的”信用额度。

sents.en: The trade magazine The Bookseller reported that Waterstones branch managers were being told to remove PRH books from prominent areas such as tables, display spaces and windows, and were "quietly retiring them to their relevant sections".
sents.cn: 行业杂志《书商》(The Bookseller)报道称，沃特斯通各门店的经理被要求把企鹅兰登书屋的图书从展示桌、陈列区和橱窗等显眼位置撤下，并“悄悄地把它们归回各自所属的分类书架”。
