sents.en: PRH declined to comment on the issue, but a spokesperson for Waterstones told me: "Waterstones are currently operating with reduced credit terms from PRH, the only publisher in the UK to place any limitations on our ability to trade.
sents.cn: 企鹅兰登书屋拒绝就此事置评，但沃特斯通书店的一位发言人告诉我：“沃特斯通目前是在企鹅兰登书屋削减后的信用条件下经营的，该公司是英国唯一一家对我们的经营能力施加任何限制的出版商。

sents.en: We are not holding PRH titles but we are doing our utmost to ensure that availability for customers remains good despite the lower overall levels of stock.
sents.cn: 我们并没有扣下企鹅兰登书屋的书目不卖，但我们正竭尽全力，确保尽管整体库存水平降低，顾客仍能买到这些书。

sents.en: We do this generally by giving their titles less prominent positioning within our bookshops.
sents.cn: 我们通常的做法是，在书店内把它们的书目摆放在不那么显眼的位置。

sents.en: "We are hopeful with our shops now open again that normality will return and that we will be allowed to buy appropriately.
sents.cn: 如今我们的门店重新开业，我们希望一切能恢复正常，希望我们能被允许正常进货。

sents.en: Certainly, our shops are exceptionally busy and book sales are very strong.
sents.cn: 可以肯定的是，我们的门店异常繁忙，图书销量非常强劲。

sents.en: The sales for our May Books of the Month surpassed any month since 2018."
sents.cn: 我们五月份“本月之书”的销量超过了自2018年以来的任何一个月。”

sents.en: In the meantime, PRH authors have been the losers - as have customers, who might expect the new titles from the country's biggest publisher to be prominently displayed by its biggest book retailer.
sents.cn: 与此同时，企鹅兰登书屋的作者们成了输家——顾客也是如此，他们本来或许期待，来自这家全国最大出版商的新书，能被其最大的图书零售商摆在显眼处。

sents.en: Big-name PRH authors may suffer a bit, but it's those mid-list authors, who normally rely on Waterstones staff's passion for promoting books by lesser-known writers, who will be praying for an end to the dispute.
sents.cn: 企鹅兰登书屋的大牌作者或许会受些影响，但真正会祈盼这场争端尽快结束的，是那些处于中游的作者——他们通常依赖沃特斯通店员推介不太知名作家作品的那份热情。

sents.en: It comes at a time when authors are already worried about the consequences of the proposed merger between PRH and another big publisher, Simon & Schuster - the reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published.
sents.cn: 这件事发生之际，作者们已经在担忧企鹅兰登书屋与另一家大出版商西蒙与舒斯特(Simon & Schuster)拟议合并所带来的后果——英国独立出版商数量的减少，很可能导致竞价之争减少、预付稿酬降低，以及出版内容上更趋同质化。

analysis.trunk: S+V：It comes at a time when …（此事发生之际，作者们正担忧…）
structure: 主句：It comes at a time
└ 定语从句〔when，修饰 a time〕：when authors are already worried about the consequences of the proposed merger between PRH and another big publisher
└ 同位语〔说明 another big publisher〕：Simon & Schuster
破折号后（补充说明/独立分句）：the reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published
├ lead to + 三个并列宾语：fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity
└ 介词宾语从句(what)：what is published（in terms of 的宾语）
analysis.logic: 主句 It comes at a time（when 定语从句修饰 a time，Simon & Schuster 同位语）；破折号后补充说明（the reduction… is likely to lead to… 三个并列宾语，what is published 宾语从句）。
notes: a time when…：when 定语从句修饰 a time；Simon & Schuster 是 another big publisher 的同位语。
破折号后是补充说明（合并的后果）；lead to + 三个并列宾语。
in terms of what is published：what 引导介词 in terms of 的宾语从句（在所出版内容方面）。

sents.en: And one wonders if PRH would have been confident enough to deal with Waterstones in the way it has if it weren't quite such a big company (it was formed with the merger of Penguin and Random House in 2013) and likely to get bigger.
sents.cn: 人们不禁会想，假如企鹅兰登书屋不是这样一家庞大的公司(它由企鹅出版社与兰登书屋于2013年合并而成)、而且很可能还会变得更大，它是否还会有足够的底气以这种方式对待沃特斯通书店。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O(if 宾语从句，错综虚拟)：one wonders if PRH would have been confident enough … if it weren't … such a big company …
structure: 主句：And one wonders if …
└ 宾语从句(if)：PRH would have been confident enough to deal with Waterstones in the way it has if it weren't quite such a big company … and likely to get bigger
├ 定语从句〔省略 that，修饰 the way〕：it has (dealt)〔the way (that) it has，句末省略 dealt〕
└ 虚拟条件从句(if)：if it weren't quite such a big company … and likely to get bigger（括号插入：it was formed with the merger of Penguin and Random House in 2013）
analysis.logic: one wonders if…（if 宾语从句，含虚拟）；in the way (that) it has (done) 定语从句修饰 the way；嵌套 if 虚拟条件从句（if it weren't… and (weren't) likely to get bigger）；括号插入补充。
notes: wonders if…：if 引导 wonder 的宾语从句（是否…）。
would have been … if it weren't …：错综虚拟（主句对过去 would have been，条件对现在 weren't）。
in the way (that) it has：the way 后省略关系词的定语从句，句末省略 dealt；括号内是插入补充。

sents.en: "This is all part of a wider change towards concentration of power and cartels.
sents.cn: “这一切都是权力集中和卡特尔化这一更大变化趋势的一部分。

sents.en: Literary agencies are getting bigger to have the clout to negotiate better terms with publishers, publishers consolidating to deal with Amazon," says Lownie.
sents.cn: 文学代理机构正变得越来越大，以便有足够的实力与出版商谈成更有利的条件，出版商则不断整合以应对亚马逊，”洛尼(Lownie)说道。

sents.en: "The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.
sents.cn: “出版业谈论多样性时，关注的是作者和员工，但它同样需要在传递思想交流、提供选择和呈现不同声音的方式上实现多元化。

sents.en: After all, many of the most interesting books in recent years have come from small publishers."
sents.cn: 毕竟，近年来许多最有趣的书都出自小型出版商之手。”

sents.en: Scientific papers are the recordkeepers of progress in research.
sents.cn: 科学论文是研究进展的记录者。

sents.en: Each year researchers publish millions of papers in more than 30,000 journals.
sents.cn: 每年研究人员在三万多种期刊上发表数以百万计的论文。

sents.en: The scientific community measures the quality of those papers in a number of ways, including the perceived quality of the journal (as reflected by the title's impact factor) and the number of citations a specific paper accumulates.
sents.cn: 科学界以多种方式衡量这些论文的质量，包括期刊给人的质量印象（体现为该刊物的影响因子）以及某篇具体论文所累积的被引次数。

sents.en: The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce, but even more so on the citations attracted by these papers.
sents.cn: 科学家的职业前途和所在机构的声誉，取决于他们所发表论文的数量与声望，但更取决于这些论文所吸引的被引次数。

sents.en: Citation cartels.
sents.cn: 引用卡特尔，

sents.en: where journals, authors, and institutions conspire to inflate citation numbers, have existed for a long time.
sents.cn: 即期刊、作者和机构合谋抬高被引数字的现象，早已存在。

sents.en: In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns, including groups of authors that disproportionately cite one another and groups of journals that cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors of their publications.
sents.cn: 2016年，研究人员开发出一种算法，用以识别可疑的引用模式，包括相互引用比例失常的作者群体，以及为提高自身刊物影响因子而频繁相互引用的期刊群体。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns（研究者开发了一种算法以识别可疑的引用模式）
structure: 状语：In 2016
主句：researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns
├ 不定式作定语〔修饰 algorithm〕：to recognize suspicious citation patterns
└ including… 作定语/补充〔列举 patterns〕：including groups of authors … and groups of journals …
├ 定语从句〔that，修饰 groups of authors〕：that disproportionately cite one another
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 groups of journals〕：that cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors of their publications（to increase… 目的）
analysis.logic: 主句 developed an algorithm（to recognize… 不定式定语）；including… 列举 patterns（两个 that 定语从句分别修饰 groups of authors 和 groups of journals）；to increase… 目的。
notes: to recognize suspicious citation patterns：不定式作定语修饰 algorithm。
including groups of authors that… and groups of journals that…：including 列举，两个 that 定语从句各修饰自己的中心词。
cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors：to increase… 目的状语（互引以抬高影响因子）。

sents.en: Recently, another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged: so-called support service consultancies that provide language and other editorial support to individual authors and to journals sometimes advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles.
sents.cn: 最近，这种掠夺性行为又出现了另一种表现形式：所谓的支持服务咨询机构（为个人作者和期刊提供语言及其他编辑方面的支持）有时会建议投稿人在其文章中添加若干引用。

analysis.trunk: S+V + 冒号展开：another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged（这种掠夺行为的又一表现已经出现）
structure: 主句：Recently, another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged
冒号后（展开）：so-called support service consultancies … sometimes advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles
├ 定语从句〔that，修饰 consultancies〕：that provide language and other editorial support to individual authors and to journals
└ advise sb to do：advise contributors to add…
analysis.logic: 主句 another expression has emerged；冒号引出具体内容：consultancies（that 定语从句修饰）advise sb to do（建议…添加引用）。
notes: 冒号后展开 emerged 的具体内容。
consultancies that provide … support to …：that 定语从句修饰 consultancies（主谓被定语从句隔开）。
advise sb to do：建议某人做…（advise contributors to add citations）。

sents.en: The advent of electronic publishing and authors' need to find outlets for their papers resulted in thousands of new journals.
sents.cn: 电子出版的兴起以及作者为论文寻找发表渠道的需求，催生了数以千计的新期刊。

sents.en: The birth of predatory journals wasn't far behind.
sents.cn: 掠夺性期刊的诞生随之而来，相距不远。

sents.en: These journals can act as milk cows where every single article in an issue may cite a specific paper or a series of papers.
sents.cn: 这些期刊可以充当“摇钱牛”，某一期中的每一篇文章都可能引用某篇特定论文或一系列论文。

sents.en: In some instances, there is absolutely no relationship between the content of the article and the citations.
sents.cn: 在某些情况下，文章内容与其引用之间根本毫无关联。

sents.en: The peculiar part is that the journal that the editor is supposedly working for is not profiting at all—it is just providing citations to other journals.
sents.cn: 蹊跷之处在于，那位编辑名义上所效力的期刊根本没有从中获利——它只是在为其他期刊提供引用而已。

sents.en: Such practices can lead an article to accrue more than 150 citations in the same year that it was published.
sents.cn: 此类做法可使一篇文章在其发表的同一年内累积超过150次被引。

sents.en: How insidious is this type of citation manipulation?
sents.cn: 这种引用操纵手段隐蔽到何种程度？

sents.en: In one example, an individual-acting as author, editor, and consultant - was able to use at least 15 journals as citation providers to articles published by five scientists at three universities.
sents.cn: 在一个例子中，某个人——身兼作者、编辑和顾问数职——竟能动用至少15种期刊，为三所大学的五名科学家所发表的文章提供引用。

sents.en: The problem is rampant in Scopus, a citation database, which includes a high number of the new "international"journals.
sents.cn: 这一问题在引用数据库Scopus中十分猖獗，该数据库收录了大量新兴的“国际”期刊。

sents.en: In fact, a listing in Scopus seems to be a criterion to be targeted in this type of citation manipulation Scopus itself has all the data necessary to detect this malpractice.
sents.cn: 事实上，被Scopus收录似乎成了沦为此类引用操纵目标的一个条件；而Scopus本身拥有检测这种不当行为所需的全部数据。

sents.en: Red flags include a large number of citations to an article within the first year.
sents.cn: 危险信号之一便是某篇文章在发表第一年内就获得大量被引。

sents.en: And for authors who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities:when an editor, a reviewer, or a support service asks you to add inappropriate references, do not oblige and do report the request to the journal.
sents.cn: 对于希望远离引用卡特尔活动的作者：当某位编辑、审稿人或支持服务机构要求你添加不恰当的参考文献时，切勿顺从，而应将这一要求如实报告给期刊。

analysis.trunk: 状语 + 冒号 + 祈使句：for authors who …: when …, do not oblige and do report …（对希望远离引用卡特尔的作者：当…时，请勿照办，并务必上报）
structure: 状语(for…)：And for authors who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities
└ 定语从句〔who，修饰 authors〕：who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities
冒号后（祈使句）：
├ 时间状语从句(when)：when an editor, a reviewer, or a support service asks you to add inappropriate references（ask sb to do）
└ 并列祈使句：do not oblige and do report the request to the journal（do report 中 do 表强调）
analysis.logic: for authors who…（who 定语从句修饰 authors）作状语；冒号引出建议（祈使句）；when… 时间状语从句（ask sb to do）；并列祈使 do not oblige and do report（do 强调）。
notes: for authors who wish to steer clear of…：who 定语从句修饰 authors；steer clear of 避开。
when … asks you to add …：when 时间状语从句；ask sb to do。
do not oblige and do report：并列祈使句；do report 中 do 表强调（务必上报）。

sents.en: The longest bull run in a century of art-market history ended on a dramatic note with a sale of 56 works by Damien Hirst, Beautiful Inside My Head Forever, at Sotheby's in London on September 15th 2008.
sents.cn: 艺术品市场百年历史中持续时间最长的一轮牛市，以一个戏剧性的事件宣告结束：2008年9月15日，达米恩·赫斯特题为《我脑海中永恒的美》的56件作品在伦敦苏富比拍卖行出售。

analysis.trunk: S+V：The longest bull run ended（持续时间最长的一轮牛市结束了）
structure: 主句：The longest bull run in a century of art-market history ended on a dramatic note
└ 方式/伴随状语(with)：with a sale of 56 works by Damien Hirst
├ 作品标题同位语：Beautiful Inside My Head Forever
└ 地点与时间状语：at Sotheby's in London on September 15th 2008
analysis.logic: 句子主干很短，核心是 bull run ended；其余信息层层放在 with 引出的拍卖事件中。作品标题是同位语，不是第二个谓语。
notes: bull run 指价格持续上涨的牛市行情。
end on a dramatic note 意为“以戏剧性的事件收场”。
a sale of 56 works 是拍卖56件作品，不是出售56份工作。

sents.en: All but two pieces sold, fetching more than £70m, a record for a sale by a single artist.
sents.cn: 除两件外，其余作品全部售出，总成交额超过7000万英镑，创下单一艺术家专场拍卖的纪录。

sents.en: It was a last victory.
sents.cn: 这是最后一次胜利。

sents.en: As the auctioneer called out bids, in New York one of the oldest banks on Wall Street, Lehman Brothers, filed for bankruptcy.
sents.cn: 就在拍卖师高声报出竞价时，纽约华尔街历史最悠久的银行之一——雷曼兄弟公司——申请了破产保护。

sents.en: The world art market had already been losing momentum for a while after rising bewilderingly since 2003.
sents.cn: 世界艺术品市场自2003年以来以令人困惑的速度上涨，但在此后的一段时间里早已开始失去增长势头。

sents.en: At its peak in 2007 it was worth some $65 billion, reckons Clare McAndrew, founder of Arts Economics, a research firm - double the figure five years earlier.
sents.cn: 研究公司“艺术经济学”的创始人克莱尔·麦克安德鲁估计，2007年市场达到顶峰时价值约650亿美元，是五年前的两倍。

sents.en: Since then it may have come down to $50 billion.
sents.cn: 此后，它可能已经回落到500亿美元。

sents.en: But the market generates interest far beyond its size because it brings together great wealth, enormous egos, greed, passion and controversy in a way matched by few other industries.
sents.cn: 然而，艺术品市场引起的关注远远超出其规模，因为它以几乎没有其他行业能比拟的方式，把巨额财富、极度膨胀的自我、贪婪、激情和争议汇聚在一起。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：The market generates interest（该市场引发关注）
structure: 主句：But the market generates interest far beyond its size
└ 原因状语从句(because)：because it brings together great wealth, enormous egos, greed, passion and controversy
└ 方式状语：in a way
└ 过去分词短语〔修饰 way〕：matched by few other industries
analysis.logic: because 解释“为何关注度远超市场规模”；matched by few other industries 修饰 way，表示这种汇聚方式鲜有行业能比。
notes: far beyond its size 不是“规模以外”，而是“影响/关注度与规模不成比例地高”。
bring together 在此意为“把多种力量汇聚在一起”。
enormous egos 指极度膨胀的自我意识。

sents.en: In the weeks and months that followed Mr. Hirst's sale, spending of any sort became deeply unfashionable.
sents.cn: 在赫斯特拍卖会之后的几周乃至几个月里，任何形式的消费都变得极不合时宜。

sents.en: In the art world that meant collectors stayed away from galleries and salerooms.
sents.cn: 在艺术界，这意味着收藏家不再光顾画廊和拍卖场。

sents.en: Sales of contemporary art fell by two-thirds, and in the most overheated sector, they were down by nearly 90% in the year to November 2008.
sents.cn: 当代艺术品的销售额下降了三分之二，而在泡沫最严重的领域，截至2008年11月的一年内，销售额下降了近90%。

sents.en: Within weeks the world's two biggest auction houses, Sotheby's and Christie's, had to pay out nearly $200m in guarantees to clients who had placed works for sale with them.
sents.cn: 短短几周内，世界两大拍卖行苏富比和佳士得不得不向委托它们出售作品的客户支付近2亿美元的保价款。

sents.en: The current downturn in the art market is the worst since the Japanese stopped buying Impressionists at the end of 1989.
sents.cn: 当前艺术品市场的低迷，是自1989年底日本买家停止购买印象派作品以来最严重的一次。

sents.en: This time experts reckon that prices are about 40% down on their peak on average, though some have been far more fluctuant.
sents.cn: 专家估计，这一次价格平均比峰值低约40%，不过有些作品的价格波动要大得多。

sents.en: But Edward Dolman, Christie's chief executive, says: "I'm pretty confident we're at the bottom."
sents.cn: 但佳士得首席执行官爱德华·多尔曼说：“我相当有信心，我们已经触底。”

sents.en: What makes this slump different from the last, he says, is that there are still buyers in the market.
sents.cn: 他说，这次衰退与上一次不同之处在于，市场上仍然有买家。

sents.en: Almost everyone who was interviewed for this special report said that the biggest problem at the moment is not a lack of demand but a lack of good work to sell.
sents.cn: 几乎每一位接受这份专题报道采访的人都表示，目前最大的问题并非缺少需求，而是缺少值得出售的好作品。

analysis.trunk: S+V+宾语从句：Almost everyone said that the biggest problem is not A but B（几乎所有人都说最大问题不是A而是B）
structure: 主句：Almost everyone said
├ 定语从句〔who，修饰 everyone〕：who was interviewed for this special report
└ 宾语从句(that)：that the biggest problem at the moment is not a lack of demand but a lack of good work to sell
├ 表语并列：not a lack of demand but a lack of good work
└ 不定式后置定语〔修饰 work〕：to sell
analysis.logic: who 从句限定受访者；that 从句作 said 的宾语，其中 not A but B 给出核心对比：不是需求不足，而是优质供给不足。
notes: not A but B 应整体识别为“不是A，而是B”。
work 在艺术语境中是“作品”，不是“工作”。
to sell 修饰 good work，可译为“可供出售的好作品”。

sents.en: The three Ds - death, debt and divorce - still deliver works of art to the market.
sents.cn: 死亡、债务和离婚这三个以D开头的因素，仍会把艺术品带入市场。

sents.en: But anyone who does not have to sell is keeping away, waiting for confidence to return.
sents.cn: 但凡不是非卖不可的人都选择暂不入市，等待信心恢复。

sents.en: I was addressing a small gathering in a suburban Virginia living room - a women's group that had invited men to join them.
sents.cn: 当时，我正在弗吉尼亚州郊区的一间客厅里，对一个小型聚会发表讲话——这是一个邀请了男士参加的女性团体。

sents.en: Throughout the evening, one man had been particularly talkative, frequently offering ideas and anecdotes, while his wife sat silently beside him on the couch.
sents.cn: 整个晚上，一名男子格外健谈，不时提出看法、讲述趣闻，而他的妻子则坐在他身旁的沙发上一言不发。

sents.en: Toward the end of the evening, I commented that women frequently complain that their husbands don't talk to them.
sents.cn: 临近当晚活动结束时，我提到女性常常抱怨丈夫不与自己交谈。

sents.en: This man quickly nodded in agreement.
sents.cn: 这名男子立刻点头表示赞同。

sents.en: He gestured toward his wife and said, "She's the talker in our family."
sents.cn: 他朝妻子比了个手势，说：“我们家她才是爱说话的那个。”

sents.en: The room burst into laughter; the man looked puzzled and hurt.
sents.cn: 房间里顿时爆发出笑声；那名男子却显得困惑而受伤。

sents.en: "It's true," he explained.
sents.cn: “确实如此，”他解释道。

sents.en: "When I come home from work I have nothing to say.
sents.cn: “我下班回家时没什么可说的。

sents.en: If she didn't keep the conversation going, we'd spend the whole evening in silence."
sents.cn: 如果不是她一直找话题，我们整个晚上都会在沉默中度过。”

sents.en: This episode crystallizes the irony that although American men tend to talk more than women in public situations, they often talk less at home.
sents.cn: 这段插曲鲜明地揭示了一个反差：美国男性在公共场合往往比女性说得多，在家里却常常说得更少。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：This episode crystallizes the irony（这段插曲鲜明揭示了反差）
structure: 主句：This episode crystallizes the irony
└ 同位语从句(that)〔说明 irony 的内容〕：that ... they often talk less at home
└ 让步状语从句(although)：although American men tend to talk more than women in public situations
└ 主句：they often talk less at home
analysis.logic: that 从句具体说明 irony 是什么；从句内部用 although 构成“公共场合说得更多—家里说得更少”的反差。
notes: crystallize 在此意为“使清楚呈现、使具体化”。
that 引导的是解释 irony 内容的同位语从句。
more than women 与 less at home 的比较维度不同，翻译时要保留场景对照。

sents.en: And this pattern is wreaking havoc with marriage.
sents.cn: 而这种模式正在严重破坏婚姻。

sents.en: The pattern was observed by political scientist Andrew Hacker in the late 1970s.
sents.cn: 政治学家安德鲁·哈克在20世纪70年代末便观察到了这种模式。

sents.en: Sociologist Catherine Kohler Riessman reports in her new book Divorce Talk that most of the women she interviewed - but only a few of the men - gave lack of communication as the reason for their divorces.
sents.cn: 社会学家凯瑟琳·科勒·里斯曼在新书《离婚谈话》中指出，她采访的大多数女性——而男性只有少数——都把缺乏沟通列为离婚的原因。

sents.en: Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
sents.cn: 鉴于目前离婚率接近50%，这意味着美国每年有数百万起这样的案例，堪称一场“沟通失败”的流行病。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：That amounts to millions of cases（那相当于数百万起案例）
structure: 背景状语：Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent
主句：that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year
└ 破折号同位说明：a virtual epidemic of failed conversation
analysis.logic: Given... 提供计算背景；that 回指上一句所说因缺乏沟通而离婚的情况；破折号后的名词短语对数百万案例作总结性评价。
notes: given 作介词，意为“考虑到、鉴于”。
amount to 在此意为“总计达到、相当于”。
virtual epidemic 是比喻，表示问题普遍得如同流行病。

sents.en: In my own research, complaints from women about their husbands most often focused not on tangible inequities such as having given up the chance for a career to accompany a husband to his, or doing far more than their share of daily life-support work like cleaning, cooking and social arrangements.
sents.cn: 在我自己的研究中，女性对丈夫的抱怨，最常针对的并不是切实可见的不平等，例如为了陪丈夫追求事业而放弃自己的职业机会，或在清洁、做饭和社交安排等日常生活维持工作中承担远超自己应有份额的劳动。

analysis.trunk: S+V：Complaints ... focused not on tangible inequities（抱怨并不主要集中在有形的不平等上）
structure: 范围状语：In my own research
主句：complaints from women about their husbands most often focused not on tangible inequities
└ 举例(such as)并列①：having given up the chance for a career
└ 目的状语(to)：to accompany a husband to his〔his 后省略 career〕
└ 举例并列②(or)：doing far more than their share of daily life-support work
└ 举例(like)：cleaning, cooking and social arrangements
analysis.logic: not on... 与下一句 Instead... 形成跨句对照；such as 后有两个动名词结构，由 or 并列，分别说明职业牺牲和家务负担。
notes: his 是名词性替代，完整含义为 his career。
far more than their share 指“远超她们应承担的份额”。
life-support work 在此不是医疗“生命支持”，而是维持日常生活运转的劳动。

sents.en: Instead, they focused on communication: "He doesn't listen to me."
sents.cn: 相反，她们关注的是沟通：“他不听我说话。”

sents.en: "He doesn't talk to me."
sents.cn: “他不跟我说话。”

sents.en: I found, as Hacker observed years before, that most wives want their husbands to be, first and foremost, conversational partners, but few husbands share this expectation of their wives.
sents.cn: 我发现，正如哈克多年前观察到的那样，大多数妻子首先希望丈夫成为自己的谈话伙伴，但很少有丈夫对妻子抱有同样的期待。

sents.en: In short, the image that best represents the current crisis is the stereotypical cartoon scene of a man sitting at the breakfast table with a newspaper held up in front of his face, while a woman glares at the back of it, wanting to talk.
sents.cn: 简而言之，最能代表当前危机的形象，是一幅典型的漫画场景：男人坐在早餐桌旁，把报纸举在面前；女人则瞪着报纸背面，想和他说话。

sents.en: Over the past decade, many companies had perfected the art of creating automatic behaviors - habits - among consumers.
sents.cn: 在过去十年中，许多公司已经精通了让消费者形成自动化行为——也就是习惯——的技巧。

sents.en: These habits have helped companies earn billions of dollars when customers eat snacks or wipe counters almost without thinking, often in response to a carefully designed set of daily cues.
sents.cn: 当顾客几乎不假思索地吃零食或擦拭台面时，这些习惯已经帮助企业赚取数十亿美元，而这些行为往往是对一套精心设计的日常提示所作的反应。

sents.en: "There are fundamental public health problems, like dirty hands instead of a soap habit, that remain killers only because we can't figure out how to change people's habits," said Dr. Curtis, the director of the Hygiene Center at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine.
sents.cn: 伦敦卫生与热带医学学院卫生中心主任柯蒂斯博士说：“有些根本性的公共卫生问题，例如人们手很脏却没有养成用肥皂洗手的习惯，之所以至今仍能致命，仅仅是因为我们还不知道如何改变人们的习惯。”

analysis.trunk: 引语主干：There are public health problems that remain killers（有些公共卫生问题仍会致命）
structure: 直接引语主句：There are fundamental public health problems
├ 举例插入语：like dirty hands instead of a soap habit
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 problems〕：that remain killers
└ 原因状语从句(only because)：only because we can't figure out
└ 疑问词+不定式作宾语：how to change people's habits
引语后的报告语：said Dr. Curtis
└ 同位语：the director of the Hygiene Center at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine
analysis.logic: 核心因果是“问题仍致命，只因不会改变习惯”；that 限定 problems，only because 强调原因单一。
notes: remain killers 表示“仍然是致命因素”，不是“杀手仍存在”。
figure out how to... 意为“弄明白如何……”。
instead of a soap habit 表示缺少使用肥皂的习惯。

sents.en: "We wanted to learn from private industry how to create new behaviors that happen automatically."
sents.cn: “我们希望向私营企业学习，了解如何创造能够自动发生的新行为。”

sents.en: The companies that Dr. Curtis turned to - Procter & Gamble, Colgate-Palmolive and Unilever - had invested hundreds of millions of dollars finding the subtle cues in consumers' lives that corporations could use to introduce new routines.
sents.cn: 柯蒂斯博士求助的公司——宝洁、高露洁-棕榄和联合利华——已经投入数亿美元，寻找消费者生活中那些可供企业用来引入新惯例的细微信号。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：The companies had invested hundreds of millions of dollars（这些公司已投入数亿美元）
structure: 主句：The companies ... had invested hundreds of millions of dollars
├ 定语从句〔that，修饰 companies〕：that Dr. Curtis turned to
├ 破折号同位列举：Procter & Gamble, Colgate-Palmolive and Unilever
└ 方式/内容状语：finding the subtle cues in consumers' lives
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 cues〕：that corporations could use to introduce new routines
└ 目的状语(to)：to introduce new routines
analysis.logic: 第一个 that 说明她求助于哪些公司；第二个 that 说明公司要寻找什么样的 cues；finding 表明巨额投入用于寻找线索。
notes: turn to somebody 意为“向某人求助”。
invest money doing 在此表示“投入资金做某事”。
cue 指触发习惯行为的“提示、信号”。

sents.en: If you look hard enough, you'll find that many of the products we use every day - chewing gums, skin moisturizers, disinfecting wipes, air fresheners, water purifiers, health snacks, teeth whiteners, fabric softeners, vitamins - are results of manufactured habits.
sents.cn: 只要仔细观察，你就会发现，我们每天使用的许多产品——口香糖、润肤霜、消毒湿巾、空气清新剂、净水器、健康零食、牙齿美白剂、衣物柔顺剂和维生素——都是人为塑造习惯的产物。

sents.en: A century ago, few people regularly brushed their teeth multiple times a day.
sents.cn: 一个世纪前，很少有人每天多次定期刷牙。

sents.en: Today, because of shrewd advertising and public health campaigns, many Americans habitually give their pearly whites a cavity-preventing scrub twice a day, often with Colgate, Crest or one of the other brands.
sents.cn: 如今，由于精明的广告和公共卫生宣传，许多美国人已经习惯每天两次擦洗自己洁白的牙齿以预防蛀牙，常用的是高露洁、佳洁士或其他品牌。

sents.en: A few decades ago, many people didn't drink water outside of a meal.
sents.cn: 几十年前，许多人在用餐之外并不喝水。

sents.en: Then beverage companies started bottling the production of far-off springs, and now office workers unthinkingly sip bottled water all day long.
sents.cn: 后来，饮料公司开始把远方泉水生产并装瓶，如今办公室职员会整天不假思索地啜饮瓶装水。

sents.en: Chewing gum, once bought primarily by adolescent boys, is now featured in commercials as a breath freshener and teeth cleanser for use after a meal.
sents.cn: 口香糖过去主要由青春期男孩购买，如今在广告中则被塑造成饭后使用的清新口气和洁牙产品。

sents.en: Skin moisturizers are advertised as part of morning beauty rituals, slipped in between hair brushing and putting on makeup.
sents.cn: 润肤霜被宣传成晨间美容仪式的一部分，安插在梳头和化妆之间。

sents.en: "Our products succeed when they become part of daily or weekly patterns," said Carol Berning, a consumer psychologist who recently retired from Procter & Gamble, the company that sold $76 billion of Tide, Crest and other products last year.
sents.cn: 宝洁公司最近退休的消费者心理学家卡罗尔·伯宁说：“当我们的产品成为日常或每周惯例的一部分时，它们就成功了。”该公司去年销售了价值760亿美元的汰渍、佳洁士及其他产品。

analysis.trunk: 引语主干：Our products succeed when they become part of patterns（产品成为惯例的一部分时就成功了）
structure: 直接引语：Our products succeed
└ 时间状语从句(when)：when they become part of daily or weekly patterns
报告语：said Carol Berning
└ 同位语：a consumer psychologist
└ 定语从句〔who，修饰 psychologist〕：who recently retired from Procter & Gamble
└ Procter & Gamble 的同位说明：the company
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 company〕：that sold $76 billion of Tide, Crest and other products last year
analysis.logic: 引语给出产品成功的条件；said 后人物身份通过同位语和两层定语关系连续补充，阅读时应先抓住引语和报告语。
notes: patterns 在语境中指反复发生的日常/每周惯例。
$76 billion of... 表示价值760亿美元的产品销售额。
who 修饰 Carol Berning 的职业身份，that 则修饰 Procter & Gamble。

sents.en: "Creating positive habits is a huge part of improving our consumers' lives, and it's essential to making new products commercially viable."
sents.cn: “培养积极习惯是改善消费者生活的一个极其重要的部分，也是让新产品具备商业可行性的关键。”

sents.en: Through experiments and observation, social scientists like Dr. Berning have learned that there is power in tying certain behaviors to habitual cues through ruthless advertising.
sents.cn: 通过实验和观察，伯宁博士等社会科学家已经认识到，借助强势广告把某些行为与习惯性提示联系起来，能够产生强大的力量。

sents.en: As this new science of habit has emerged, controversies have erupted when the tactics have been used to sell questionable beauty creams or unhealthy foods.
sents.cn: 随着这门新兴的习惯科学逐渐形成，当这些手段被用来推销功效可疑的美容霜或不健康食品时，争议也随之爆发。

sents.en: Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values, including the principles that all citizens who meet minimal qualifications of age and literacy are equally competent to serve on juries; that jurors should be selected randomly from a representative cross section of the community; that no citizen should be denied the right to serve on a jury on account of race, religion, sex, or national origin; that defendants are entitled to trial by their peers; and that verdicts should represent the conscience of the community and not just the letter of the law.
sents.cn: 许多美国人把陪审团制度视为重要民主价值观的具体体现，其中包括以下原则：凡年龄和读写能力达到最低要求的公民，都同样有能力担任陪审员；陪审员应从具有社区代表性的各阶层中随机选出；任何公民都不应因种族、宗教、性别或国籍而被剥夺担任陪审员的权利；被告有权接受同等身份者的审判；裁决应代表社区的良知，而不应只是拘泥于法律条文。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O+C：Many Americans regard the jury system as an expression of values（许多美国人把陪审团制度视为民主价值观的体现）
structure: 主句：Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values
└ 补充说明(including)：including the principles
├ 同位语从句①(that)：all citizens who meet minimal qualifications ... are equally competent to serve on juries
├ 同位语从句②(that)：jurors should be selected randomly from a representative cross section of the community
├ 同位语从句③(that)：no citizen should be denied the right ... on account of race, religion, sex, or national origin
├ 同位语从句④(that)：defendants are entitled to trial by their peers
└ 同位语从句⑤(that)：verdicts should represent the conscience of the community and not just the letter of the law
analysis.logic: 主干之后由 including 引出 principles，五个平行的 that 从句逐项说明民主原则；分号是并列项目的分隔标志。
notes: regard A as B：把A视为B。
who meet... 是修饰 all citizens 的定语从句。
the conscience of the community 与 the letter of the law 构成“社会良知—法律字面”的对照。

sents.en: The jury is also said to be the best surviving example of direct rather than representative democracy.
sents.cn: 陪审团还被称为现存最好的直接民主实例，而非代议制民主的实例。

sents.en: In a direct democracy, citizens take turns governing themselves, rather than electing representatives to govern for them.
sents.cn: 在直接民主制度中，公民轮流管理自身事务，而不是选出代表替他们治理。

sents.en: But as recently as in 1968, jury selection procedures conflicted with these democratic ideals.
sents.cn: 然而，直到不久前的1968年，陪审员遴选程序仍与这些民主理想相冲突。

sents.en: In some states, for example, jury duty was limited to persons of supposedly superior intelligence, education, and moral character.
sents.cn: 例如，在一些州，只有那些被认为智力、教育水平和道德品质更优越的人才有资格履行陪审义务。

sents.en: Although the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v. West Virginia, the practice of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws.
sents.cn: 尽管早在1880年的“斯特劳德诉西弗吉尼亚州案”中，美国最高法院就已禁止在遴选陪审员时进行蓄意的种族歧视，但遴选所谓精英陪审团或“蓝丝带陪审团”的做法，为规避这项及其他反歧视法律提供了便利途径。

analysis.trunk: 让步复句主干：Although the Supreme Court had prohibited discrimination, the practice provided a way around laws（尽管最高法院已禁止歧视，这种做法仍提供了规避法律的途径）
structure: 让步状语从句(Although)：the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection
└ 时间/案件背景：as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v. West Virginia
主句：the practice ... provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws
└ 动名词短语作后置说明〔修饰 practice〕：of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries
analysis.logic: Although 建立“法律已明令禁止—实际仍可绕开”的让步转折；主句真正的施事是 the practice，而不是 juries。
notes: as early as 强调“早在……”。
a way around laws 指规避法律的方法，并非围绕法律。
blue-ribbon jury 指由所谓优秀或精英人士组成的陪审团。

sents.en: The system also failed to regularly include women on juries until the mid-20th century.
sents.cn: 直到20世纪中叶，这一制度也一直未能经常把女性纳入陪审团。

sents.en: Although women first served on state juries in Utah in 1898, it was not until the 1940s that a majority of states made women eligible for jury duty.
sents.cn: 虽然早在1898年，女性就在犹他州首次担任州法院陪审员，但直到20世纪40年代，大多数州才允许女性履行陪审义务。

sents.en: Even then several states automatically exempted women from jury duty unless they personally asked to have their names included on the jury list.
sents.cn: 即便到了那时，仍有几个州会自动免除女性的陪审义务，除非她们亲自要求把自己的名字列入陪审员名单。

sents.en: This practice was justified by the claim that women were needed at home, and it kept juries unrepresentative of women through the 1960s.
sents.cn: 这种做法以“家庭需要女性”为由获得辩护，并使陪审团在整个20世纪60年代始终无法充分代表女性。

sents.en: In 1968, the Congress of the United States passed the Jury Selection and Service Act, ushering in a new era of democratic reforms for the jury.
sents.cn: 1968年，美国国会通过《陪审员遴选与服务法》，由此开启了陪审团民主改革的新时代。

sents.en: This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from a cross section of the entire community.
sents.cn: 该法废除了对联邦陪审员的特殊教育要求，并规定陪审员必须从整个社区的各阶层中随机选出。

sents.en: In the landmark 1975 decision Taylor v. Louisiana, the Supreme Court extended the requirement that juries be representative of all parts of the community to the state level.
sents.cn: 在具有里程碑意义的1975年“泰勒诉路易斯安那州案”判决中，最高法院把陪审团必须代表社区所有群体这一要求扩展到了州一级。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：The Supreme Court extended the requirement to the state level（最高法院把该要求扩展到州一级）
structure: 背景状语：In the landmark 1975 decision Taylor v. Louisiana
主句：the Supreme Court extended the requirement ... to the state level
└ 同位语从句(that)〔说明 requirement〕：that juries be representative of all parts of the community
analysis.logic: 句首介词短语交代案件；that 从句不是普通宾语从句，而是说明 requirement 的具体内容；extend A to B 表示把要求适用到州层面。
notes: landmark decision 指具有里程碑意义的判决。
requirement 后的 that 从句使用 be 原形，体现要求/规定类名词后的虚拟语气。
all parts of the community 指社区各个群体或阶层。

sents.en: The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
sents.cn: 泰勒案判决还宣布，陪审员遴选中的性别歧视违反宪法，并命令各州采用相同程序遴选男性和女性陪审员。

sents.en: Ruth Simmons joined Goldman Sachs's board as an outside director in January 2000; a year later she became president of Brown University.
sents.cn: 2000年1月，露丝·西蒙斯以外部董事身份加入高盛董事会；一年后，她出任布朗大学校长。

sents.en: For the rest of the decade she apparently managed both roles without attracting much criticism.
sents.cn: 在此后十年剩余的时间里，她显然兼顾了这两个职位，并未招致太多批评。

sents.en: But by the end of 2009 Ms. Simmons was under fire for having sat on Goldman's compensation committee; how could she have let those enormous bonus payouts pass unremarked?
sents.cn: 但到2009年底，西蒙斯女士因曾任高盛薪酬委员会委员而饱受抨击：她怎么会任由那些巨额奖金发放而不置一词？

analysis.trunk: 分号连接两部分：Ms. Simmons was under fire; how could she have let payouts pass unremarked?（西蒙斯受抨击；她怎能对奖金发放不置一词？）
structure: 陈述句：Ms. Simmons was under fire
├ 时间状语：by the end of 2009
└ 原因状语(for)：for having sat on Goldman's compensation committee
分号后反问句：how could she have let those enormous bonus payouts pass unremarked?
└ 使役结构：let + payouts + pass + unremarked
analysis.logic: 前半句交代遭批评的事实和原因，分号后的反问把批评内容直接说出；could have done 表示对过去行为的质疑。
notes: be under fire 意为“受到猛烈批评”。
having sat on... 是完成式动名词，说明因曾担任委员会成员而受批评。
let...pass unremarked 指任由某事发生而不评论、不质疑。

sents.en: By February the next year Ms. Simmons had left the board.
sents.cn: 到次年2月，西蒙斯女士已经离开董事会。

sents.en: The position was just taking up too much time, she said.
sents.cn: 她说，这个职位实在占用了太多时间。

sents.en: Outside directors are supposed to serve as helpful, yet less biased, advisers on a firm's board.
sents.cn: 外部董事理应在公司董事会中担任有助益但偏见较少的顾问。

sents.en: Having made their wealth and their reputations elsewhere, they presumably have enough independence to disagree with the chief executive's proposals.
sents.cn: 由于他们在别处积累了财富和声誉，想必拥有足够的独立性，可以反对首席执行官的提议。

sents.en: If the sky, and the share price is falling, outside directors should be able to give advice based on having weathered their own crises.
sents.cn: 如果形势以及股价都在下跌，外部董事应该能够凭借自己曾渡过危机的经验提出建议。

sents.en: The researchers from Ohio University used a database that covered more than 10,000 firms and more than 64,000 different directors between 1989 and 2004.
sents.cn: 俄亥俄大学的研究人员使用了一个数据库，其中涵盖1989年至2004年间一万多家公司和六万四千多名不同董事。

sents.en: Then they simply checked which directors stayed from one proxy statement to the next.
sents.cn: 随后，他们只需核对从一份股东委托书到下一份之间，哪些董事仍然留任。

sents.en: The most likely reason for departing a board was age, so the researchers concentrated on those "surprise" disappearances by directors under the age of 70.
sents.cn: 离开董事会最可能的原因是年龄，因此研究人员把注意力集中在70岁以下董事那些“出人意料”的离任上。

sents.en: They found that after a surprise departure, the probability that the company will subsequently have to restate earnings increases by nearly 20%.
sents.cn: 他们发现，一名董事意外离任之后，该公司随后不得不重报收益的概率会增加近20%。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：They found that the probability increases（他们发现这种概率会上升）
structure: 主句：They found
└ 宾语从句(that)：the probability ... increases by nearly 20%
├ 时间状语：after a surprise departure
└ 同位语从句〔that，说明 probability 的内容〕：that the company will subsequently have to restate earnings
analysis.logic: 外层 that 引导 found 的宾语；内层 that 紧跟 probability，说明“哪件事发生的概率”，真正谓语 increases 位于较后位置。
notes: 不要把 company 误当作 increases 的主语，主语是 probability。
restate earnings 指更正并重新公布收益数据。
subsequently 表示董事离任之后的后续时间。

sents.en: The likelihood of being named in a federal class-action lawsuit also increases, and the stock is likely to perform worse.
sents.cn: 公司在联邦集体诉讼中被列为被告的可能性也会增加，其股票表现也可能更差。

sents.en: The effect tended to be larger for larger firms.
sents.cn: 这种影响往往在规模较大的公司中更为明显。

sents.en: Although a correlation between them leaving and subsequent bad performance at the firm is suggestive, it does not mean that such directors are always jumping off a sinking ship.
sents.cn: 尽管董事离任与公司随后表现不佳之间的相关性颇具暗示性，但这并不意味着这些董事总是在弃沉船而逃。

sents.en: Often they "trade up," leaving riskier, smaller firms for larger and more stable firms.
sents.cn: 他们常常是在“向上跳槽”，即离开风险更高的小公司，转投规模更大、更稳定的公司。

sents.en: But the researchers believe that outside directors have an easier time of avoiding a blow to their reputations if they leave a firm before bad news breaks, even if a review of history shows they were on the board at the time any wrongdoing occurred.
sents.cn: 但研究人员认为，如果外部董事在坏消息传出前离开公司，就更容易避免声誉受损，即使回顾历史会发现，在不当行为发生时他们其实仍在董事会任职。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：The researchers believe that outside directors have an easier time（研究人员认为外部董事会更容易……）
structure: 主句：the researchers believe
└ 宾语从句(that)：outside directors have an easier time of avoiding a blow to their reputations
├ 条件状语从句(if)：if they leave a firm before bad news breaks
└ 让步状语从句(even if)：even if a review of history shows
└ 宾语从句〔省略 that〕：they were on the board at the time
└ 定语从句〔省略 when，修饰 time〕：any wrongdoing occurred
analysis.logic: 核心判断是“提前离开可更容易保住声誉”；if 给出实现条件，even if 再补充让步：历史记录仍可能证明其当时在任。
notes: have an easier time of doing：做某事更容易。
bad news breaks 指坏消息突然传出。
a blow to one's reputation 指声誉受到打击。

sents.en: Firms who want to keep their outside directors through tough times may have to create incentives.
sents.cn: 希望外部董事在艰难时期仍然留任的公司，可能不得不设置激励措施。

sents.en: Otherwise outside directors will follow the example of Ms. Simmons, once again very popular on campus.
sents.cn: 否则，外部董事就会效仿西蒙斯女士，离开董事会，再次成为校园里广受欢迎的人物。

sents.en: Whatever happened to the death of newspapers?
sents.cn: 报纸不是说要消亡吗，后来怎么样了？

sents.en: A year ago the end seemed near.
sents.cn: 一年前，末日似乎近在眼前。

sents.en: The recession threatened to remove the advertising and readers that had not already fled to the internet.
sents.cn: 经济衰退威胁着要夺走那些尚未转向互联网的广告商和读者。

sents.en: Newspapers like the San Francisco Chronicle were chronicling their own doom.
sents.cn: 《旧金山纪事报》等报纸当时正在报道自己的末日。

sents.en: America's Federal Trade Commission launched a round of talks about how to save newspapers.
sents.cn: 美国联邦贸易委员会发起了一轮讨论，主题是如何挽救报纸。

sents.en: Should they become charitable corporations?
sents.cn: 报纸是否应该转变为慈善性质的公司？

sents.en: Should the state subsidize them?
sents.cn: 政府是否应该补贴它们？

sents.en: It will hold another meeting soon.
sents.cn: 该委员会很快还将再举行一次会议。

sents.en: But the discussions now seem out of date.
sents.cn: 然而，这些讨论如今似乎已经过时。

sents.en: In much of the world there is little sign of crisis.
sents.cn: 在世界许多地方，几乎看不到危机的迹象。

sents.en: German and Brazilian papers have shrugged off the recession.
sents.cn: 德国和巴西的报纸已经摆脱了经济衰退的影响。

sents.en: Even American newspapers, which inhabit the most troubled corner of the global industry, have not only survived but often returned to profit.
sents.cn: 即使是身处全球报业困境最严重角落的美国报纸，也不仅生存了下来，而且往往已经恢复盈利。

analysis.trunk: S+V：Even American newspapers have not only survived but returned to profit（即使美国报纸也不仅存活下来，而且恢复盈利）
structure: 主句：Even American newspapers have not only survived but often returned to profit
└ 非限制性定语从句〔which，修饰 American newspapers〕：which inhabit the most troubled corner of the global industry
analysis.logic: 主句用 not only...but... 并列两个谓语；which 从句插入说明美国报纸处境最艰难，因而强化 even 所表达的出乎意料。
notes: inhabit the most troubled corner 是比喻，意为处在行业困境最严重的部分。
return to profit 指恢复盈利。
not only 与 but 后分别对应 survived 和 returned。

sents.en: Not the 20% profit margins that were routine a few years ago, but profit all the same.
sents.cn: 虽然不是几年前那种司空见惯的20%利润率，但终究还是有利润。

sents.en: It has not been much fun.
sents.cn: 这个过程并不好受。

sents.en: Many papers stayed afloat by pushing journalists overboard.
sents.cn: 许多报纸通过把记者“扔下船”才勉强维持运营。

sents.en: The American Society of News Editors reckons that 13,500 newsroom jobs have gone since 2007.
sents.cn: 美国新闻编辑协会估计，自2007年以来，新闻编辑部已经减少了13500个职位。

sents.en: Readers are paying more for slimmer products.
sents.cn: 读者正在为内容更少的报纸支付更高的价格。

sents.en: Some papers even had the nerve to refuse delivery to distant suburbs.
sents.cn: 有些报纸甚至胆敢拒绝向偏远郊区送报。

sents.en: Yet these desperate measures have proved the right ones and, sadly for many journalists, they can be pushed further.
sents.cn: 然而事实证明，这些孤注一掷的措施是正确的；令许多记者难过的是，这些措施还可以进一步推进。

analysis.trunk: 并列主干：These measures have proved the right ones, and they can be pushed further（这些措施已证明正确，而且还可进一步实施）
structure: 分句①：Yet these desperate measures have proved the right ones
并列分句②(and)：they can be pushed further
└ 评注插入语：sadly for many journalists
analysis.logic: Yet 承接前文那些令人不快的削减措施并转折评价其有效；and 后继续指出还有进一步削减空间，插入语点出记者将承担代价。
notes: prove + 名词补语：事实证明是……。
the right ones 中 ones 替代 measures。
push measures further 指把措施进一步推进或加码。

sents.en: Newspapers are becoming more balanced businesses, with a healthier mix of revenues from readers and advertisers.
sents.cn: 报纸正在成为收入结构更加均衡的企业，来自读者和广告商的收入组合也更加健康。

sents.en: American papers have long been highly unusual in their reliance on ads.
sents.cn: 长期以来，美国报纸对广告的依赖程度一直高得异乎寻常。

sents.en: Fully 87% of their revenues came from advertising in 2008, according to the Organization for Economic Cooperation & Development (OECD).
sents.cn: 经济合作与发展组织（OECD）的数据显示，2008年，美国报纸足足有87%的收入来自广告。

sents.en: In Japan the proportion is 35%.
sents.cn: 在日本，这一比例为35%。

sents.en: Not surprisingly, Japanese newspapers are much more stable.
sents.cn: 毫不奇怪，日本报纸稳定得多。

sents.en: The whirlwind that swept through newsrooms harmed everybody, but much of the damage has been concentrated in areas where newspapers are least distinctive.
sents.cn: 席卷各新闻编辑部的旋风伤害了所有人，但大部分损失集中在报纸最缺乏独特性的领域。

analysis.trunk: 转折复句：The whirlwind harmed everybody, but much damage has been concentrated in areas（风暴伤害所有人，但损失集中在一些领域）
structure: 分句①：The whirlwind harmed everybody
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 whirlwind〕：that swept through newsrooms
转折分句②(but)：much of the damage has been concentrated in areas
└ 定语从句(where)〔修饰 areas〕：where newspapers are least distinctive
analysis.logic: 先用 whirlwind 比喻行业裁员冲击，再用 but 缩小范围：受损最重的是报纸最没有独特优势的内容领域。
notes: sweep through 表示迅速席卷。
newsroom 指新闻编辑部，不只是实体房间。
least distinctive 指最缺少报纸独有价值，而不是最不显眼。

sents.en: Car and film reviewers have gone.
sents.cn: 汽车和电影评论员已经消失。

sents.en: So have science and general business reporters.
sents.cn: 科学记者和综合商业记者也同样如此。

sents.en: Foreign bureaus have been savagely cut off.
sents.cn: 驻外记者站遭到了大幅裁撤。

sents.en: Newspapers are less complete as a result.
sents.cn: 因此，报纸的内容不再那么全面。

sents.en: But completeness is no longer a virtue in the newspaper business.
sents.cn: 但在报业中，内容全面已不再是一种优点。

sents.en: We tend to think of the decades immediately following World War II as a time of prosperity and growth, with soldiers returning home by the millions, going off to college on the G. I. Bill and lining up at the marriage bureaus.
sents.cn: 我们往往把第二次世界大战结束后紧接着的几十年视为繁荣与增长的时期：数百万士兵返乡，凭借《退伍军人权利法案》上大学，并在婚姻登记处排起长队。

sents.en: But when it came to their houses, it was a time of common sense and a belief that less could truly be more.
sents.cn: 但说到他们的住房，那却是一个崇尚常识、相信“少确实可以胜过多”的时代。

sents.en: During the Depression and the war, Americans had learned to live with less, and that restraint, in combination with the postwar confidence in the future, made small, efficient housing positively stylish.
sents.cn: 在大萧条和战争期间，美国人已经学会用更少的东西生活；这种克制与战后对未来的信心结合起来，使小巧高效的住宅成为一种十足的时尚。

sents.en: Economic condition was only a stimulus for the trend toward efficient living.
sents.cn: 经济状况只是推动高效生活趋势的一个因素。

sents.en: The phrase "less is more" was actually first popularized by a German, the architect Ludwig Mies van der Rohe, who like other people associated with the Bauhaus, a school of design, emigrated to the United States before World War II and took up posts at American architecture schools.
sents.cn: “少即是多”这句话其实最先由一位德国人推广开来，他就是建筑师路德维希·密斯·凡德罗；与包豪斯设计学院的其他相关人士一样，他在二战前移居美国，并在美国建筑院校任职。

analysis.trunk: S+V：The phrase was first popularized by a German（这句话最先由一位德国人推广）
structure: 主句：The phrase "less is more" was actually first popularized by a German
└ 同位语：the architect Ludwig Mies van der Rohe
└ 非限制性定语从句〔who，修饰 Mies〕：who ... emigrated to the United States ... and took up posts at American architecture schools
├ 比较/伴随插入语：like other people associated with the Bauhaus
│   ├ 过去分词短语〔修饰 people〕：associated with the Bauhaus
│   └ the Bauhaus 的同位语：a school of design
└ 并列谓语：emigrated ... and took up posts ...
analysis.logic: 主句被动说明名言的推广者；German 后以同位语点名密斯，再由 who 从句补充其移民和任教经历。
notes: popularize 指“使普及、推广开来”。
like other people... 是插入比较，不是 who 的谓语。
take up posts 指就任职位。

sents.en: These designers came to exert enormous influence on the course of American architecture, but none more so than Mies.
sents.cn: 这些设计师开始对美国建筑的发展进程产生巨大影响，但没有谁的影响超过密斯。

sents.en: Mies's signature phrase means that less decoration, properly organized, has more impact than a lot.
sents.cn: 密斯的标志性名言意为：经过恰当组织的少量装饰，比大量装饰更具感染力。

sents.en: Elegance, he believed, did not derive from abundance.
sents.cn: 他认为，优雅并非源于丰盛。

sents.en: Like other modern architects, he employed metal, glass and laminated wood - materials that we take for granted today but that in the 1940s symbolized the future.
sents.cn: 与其他现代主义建筑师一样，他使用金属、玻璃和层压木材；这些材料如今被我们视为理所当然，在20世纪40年代却象征着未来。

sents.en: Mies's sophisticated presentation masked the fact that the spaces he designed were small and efficient, rather than big and often empty.
sents.cn: 密斯精巧的设计呈现掩盖了这样一个事实：他设计的空间小巧高效，而不是宽大却常常空旷。

sents.en: The apartments in the elegant towers Mies built on Chicago's Lake Shore Drive, for example, were smaller - two-bedroom units under 1,000 square feet - than those in their older neighbors along the city's Gold Coast.
sents.cn: 例如，密斯在芝加哥湖滨大道建造的优雅高楼中，公寓面积比该市黄金海岸沿线那些年代更久的邻近公寓还小，其中两居室不到1000平方英尺。

analysis.trunk: S+V+C：The apartments were smaller than those（这些公寓比那些公寓更小）
structure: 主句：The apartments ... were smaller ... than those in their older neighbors along the city's Gold Coast
├ 地点定语：in the elegant towers
│   └ 定语从句〔省略 that，修饰 towers〕：Mies built on Chicago's Lake Shore Drive
├ 插入语：for example
└ 破折号同位说明：two-bedroom units under 1,000 square feet
analysis.logic: 比较主干是 apartments were smaller than those；those 替代 apartments，避免重复；两个破折号间补充说明其面积。
notes: Mies built... 是省略关系代词的定语从句，不能把 Mies 当主句主语。
those 指 older neighboring buildings 中的公寓，而不是建筑本身。
under 1,000 square feet 表示不足1000平方英尺。

sents.en: But they were popular because of their airy glass walls, the views they afforded and the elegance of the buildings' details and proportions, the architectural equivalent of the abstract art so popular at the time.
sents.cn: 但这些公寓很受欢迎，因为它们拥有通透的玻璃墙、开阔的景观，以及建筑细部和比例的优雅；这种建筑风格相当于当时广受欢迎的抽象艺术。

sents.en: The trend toward "less" was not entirely foreign.
sents.cn: 这种走向“少”的趋势并不完全来自国外。

sents.en: In the 1930s Frank Lloyd Wright started building more modest and efficient houses - usually around 1,200 square feet - than the spreading two-story ones he had designed in the 1890s and the early 20th century.
sents.cn: 20世纪30年代，弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特开始建造更加朴素高效的住宅，通常约1200平方英尺；这些住宅比他在19世纪90年代和20世纪初设计的宽展两层住宅更小。

sents.en: The "Case Study Houses" commissioned from talented modern architects by California Arts & Architecture magazine between 1945 and 1962 were yet another homegrown influence on the "less is more" trend.
sents.cn: 1945年至1962年间，《加州艺术与建筑》杂志委托才华出众的现代主义建筑师设计的“案例研究住宅”，是“少即是多”趋势的又一项本土影响。

sents.en: Aesthetic effect came from the landscape, new materials and forthright detailing.
sents.cn: 审美效果来自景观、新材料以及直截了当的细部处理。

sents.en: In his Case Study House, Ralph Rapson may have mispredicted just how the mechanical revolution would impact everyday life - few American families acquired helicopters, though most eventually got clothes dryers - but his belief that self-sufficiency was both desirable and inevitable was widely shared.
sents.cn: 在自己的案例研究住宅中，拉尔夫·拉普森也许误判了机械革命将如何影响日常生活——很少有美国家庭购置直升机，尽管大多数家庭最终都有了干衣机——但他关于自给自足既值得追求又不可避免的信念，当时得到了广泛认同。

analysis.trunk: 转折主干：Ralph Rapson may have mispredicted..., but his belief was widely shared（拉普森或许误判了……，但他的信念广受认同）
structure: 分句①：Ralph Rapson may have mispredicted
└ 宾语从句(how)：how the mechanical revolution would impact everyday life
└ 破折号插入例证：few American families acquired helicopters, though most eventually got clothes dryers
转折分句②(but)：his belief ... was widely shared
└ 同位语从句(that)〔说明 belief〕：that self-sufficiency was both desirable and inevitable
analysis.logic: may have done 对过去判断作保留性批评；破折号用现实结果举证；but 转向作者真正肯定的信念内容。
notes: mispredict how... 指对……将如何发展作出错误预测。
though 在插入例证内部形成“直升机少见—干衣机普及”的让步对照。
both desirable and inevitable：既值得追求，又不可避免。

sents.en: Will the European Union make it?
sents.cn: 欧盟能挺过去吗？

sents.en: The question would have sounded strange not long ago.
sents.cn: 就在不久前，这个问题听起来还会很奇怪。

sents.en: Now even the project's greatest cheerleaders talk of a continent facing a "Bermuda triangle" of debt, population decline and lower growth.
sents.cn: 如今，就连欧洲一体化计划最热情的支持者也开始谈论一个正面临债务、人口下降和低增长这一“百慕大三角”的大陆。

sents.en: As well as those chronic problems, the EU faces an acute crisis in its economic core, the 16 countries that use the single currency.
sents.cn: 除了这些长期问题，欧盟的经济核心——使用单一货币的16个国家——还面临一场急性危机。

sents.en: Markets have lost faith that the euro zone's economies, weaker or stronger, will one day converge thanks to the discipline of sharing a single currency, which denies uncompetitive members the quick fix of devaluation.
sents.cn: 市场已经不再相信，欧元区各经济体无论强弱，终有一天会因共享单一货币所带来的纪律约束而趋同；这种货币安排使缺乏竞争力的成员国无法通过货币贬值迅速脱困。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：Markets have lost faith that the economies will converge（市场已不再相信各经济体会趋同）
structure: 主句：Markets have lost faith
└ 同位语从句(that)〔说明 faith 的内容〕：that the euro zone's economies ... will one day converge
├ 插入概括：weaker or stronger
├ 原因状语：thanks to the discipline of sharing a single currency
└ 非限制性定语从句〔which，修饰 sharing a single currency 这一安排〕：which denies uncompetitive members the quick fix of devaluation
analysis.logic: that 说明市场失去的是何种信心；thanks to 提出原本被寄望的趋同机制；which 补充单一货币如何约束竞争力不足的成员。
notes: lose faith that... 可译为“不再相信……”。
weaker or stronger 是插入语，表示无论经济强弱。
quick fix 指快速但往往治标不治本的解决办法。

sents.en: Yet the debate about how to save Europe's single currency from disintegration is stuck.
sents.cn: 然而，关于如何挽救欧洲单一货币、避免其解体的辩论陷入了僵局。

sents.en: It is stuck because the euro zone's dominant powers, France and Germany, agree on the need for greater harmonisation within the euro zone, but disagree about what to harmonise.
sents.cn: 僵局产生的原因是，欧元区的主导力量法国和德国都认为有必要在区内进一步协调一致，却对应该协调什么意见不一。

sents.en: Germany thinks the euro must be saved by stricter rules on borrowing, spending and competitiveness, backed by quasi-automatic sanctions for governments that do not obey.
sents.cn: 德国认为，要挽救欧元，就必须对借贷、支出和竞争力制定更严格的规则，并辅以针对违规政府的准自动制裁。

sents.en: These might include threats to freeze EU funds for poorer regions and EU mega-projects, and even the suspension of a country's voting rights in EU ministerial councils.
sents.cn: 这些制裁可能包括威胁冻结面向较贫困地区和欧盟大型项目的资金，甚至暂停某国在欧盟部长理事会中的投票权。

sents.en: It insists that economic co-ordination should involve all 27 members of the EU club, among whom there is a small majority for free-market liberalism and economic rigour; in the inner core alone, Germany fears, a small majority favour French interference.
sents.cn: 德国坚持，经济协调应让欧盟俱乐部全部27个成员国参与；在这些国家中，支持自由市场的自由主义和严格经济纪律者占微弱多数，而德国担心，仅在内部核心国家中，支持法国式干预的反而会占微弱多数。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：It insists that co-ordination should involve all 27 members（德国坚持经济协调应包括全部27国）
structure: 主句：It〔Germany〕 insists
└ 宾语从句(that)：economic co-ordination should involve all 27 members of the EU club
└ 非限制性定语从句(among whom)〔修饰 members〕：among whom there is a small majority for free-market liberalism and economic rigour
分号后对比分句：in the inner core alone, ... a small majority favour French interference
└ 插入语：Germany fears
analysis.logic: 句子用分号对比两个范围：欧盟27国整体中自由市场派占微弱多数，而仅限核心国家时法国式干预派可能占多数。
notes: It 回指上一句的 Germany。
among whom 是“在这些成员中”，whom 指27个成员国。
Germany fears 是插入评注，主句仍是 a small majority favour...。

sents.en: A "southern" camp headed by France wants something different: "European economic government" within an inner core of euro-zone members.
sents.cn: 以法国为首的“南方”阵营想要另一套方案：在欧元区成员组成的内部核心中实行“欧洲经济政府”。

sents.en: Translated, that means politicians intervening in monetary policy and a system of redistribution from richer to poorer members, via cheaper borrowing for governments through common Eurobonds or complete fiscal transfers.
sents.cn: 换句话说，这意味着政客干预货币政策，并建立一套从富裕成员向较贫困成员再分配的制度，具体方式包括通过共同发行欧洲债券让各国政府以更低成本借款，或直接进行财政转移。

analysis.trunk: S+V+C：That means A and B（那意味着A以及B）
structure: 评注状语：Translated〔换句话说〕
主句：that means
├ 宾语①：politicians intervening in monetary policy
└ 宾语②：a system of redistribution from richer to poorer members
└ 方式状语(via)：via cheaper borrowing for governments ... or complete fiscal transfers
└ 方式状语(through)：through common Eurobonds
analysis.logic: means 后并列“政治干预货币政策”和“成员间再分配制度”；via 后再并列两种再分配路径：共同欧债带来的低成本借款，或直接财政转移。
notes: Translated 是省略式评注，可译为“换句话说”。
intervening 与 redistribution 在语义上是并列内容。
Eurobonds 在此指由成员共同承担的欧洲债券。

sents.en: Finally, figures close to the French government have murmured, euro-zone members should agree to some fiscal and social harmonisation: e.g., curbing competition in corporate-tax rates or labour costs.
sents.cn: 最后，据接近法国政府的人士低声透露，欧元区成员国应在财政和社会政策上达成一定程度的协调，例如限制企业税率或劳动力成本方面的竞争。

sents.en: It is too soon to write off the EU.
sents.cn: 现在就断言欧盟失败还为时过早。

sents.en: It remains the world's largest trading block.
sents.cn: 它仍是世界上最大的贸易集团。

sents.en: At its best, the European project is remarkably liberal: built around a single market of 27 rich and poor countries, its internal borders are far more open to goods, capital and labour than any comparable trading area.
sents.cn: 在其最佳状态下，欧洲一体化计划具有显著的自由主义色彩：它围绕由27个贫富国家组成的单一市场建立，内部边界对商品、资本和劳动力的开放程度远高于任何同类贸易区。

sents.en: It is an ambitious attempt to blunt the sharpest edges of globalisation, and make capitalism benign.
sents.cn: 这是一项雄心勃勃的尝试，旨在磨平全球化最尖锐的棱角，使资本主义变得温和。

sents.en: Homework has never been terribly popular with students and even many parents, but in recent years it has been particularly scorned.
sents.cn: 家庭作业从来都不太受学生、甚至许多家长欢迎，而近年来它尤其受到轻视。

sents.en: School districts across the country, most recently Los Angeles Unified, are revising their thinking on this educational ritual.
sents.cn: 全国各地的学区——最近一个是洛杉矶联合学区——都在重新审视对这一教育惯例的看法。

sents.en: Unfortunately, L.A. Unified has produced an inflexible policy which mandates that with the exception of some advanced courses, homework may no longer count for more than 10% of a student's academic grade.
sents.cn: 遗憾的是，洛杉矶联合学区制定了一项僵化政策，规定除少数高级课程外，家庭作业在学生学业成绩中所占比例不得超过10%。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：L.A. Unified has produced an inflexible policy（洛杉矶联合学区制定了一项僵化政策）
structure: 主句：Unfortunately, L.A. Unified has produced an inflexible policy
└ 定语从句〔which，修饰 policy〕：which mandates
└ 宾语从句(that)：homework may no longer count for more than 10% of a student's academic grade
└ 例外状语：with the exception of some advanced courses
analysis.logic: which 从句说明政策内容；mandates 后 that 从句给出具体规定，with the exception of... 限定规定的适用范围。
notes: mandate 在此是动词，意为“强制规定”。
count for more than 10% 指在总成绩中占比超过10%。
with the exception of：除……之外。

sents.en: This rule is meant to address the difficulty that students from impoverished or chaotic homes might have in completing their homework.
sents.cn: 这项规定旨在解决来自贫困或混乱家庭的学生完成作业时可能遇到的困难。

sents.en: But the policy is unclear and contradictory.
sents.cn: 然而，这项政策含糊不清且自相矛盾。

sents.en: Certainly, no homework should be assigned that students cannot complete on their own or that they cannot do without expensive equipment.
sents.cn: 当然，不应布置学生无法独立完成，或必须依靠昂贵设备才能完成的作业。

sents.en: But if the district is essentially giving a pass to students who do not do their homework because of complicated family lives, it is going riskily close to the implication that standards need to be lowered for poor children.
sents.cn: 但如果学区实质上因为学生家庭生活复杂，就放过那些不做作业的学生，那便危险地接近于暗示：针对贫困儿童，标准需要降低。

analysis.trunk: 条件复句：If the district is giving a pass..., it is going close to the implication...（如果学区放过……，就接近于暗示……）
structure: 条件状语从句(if)：the district is essentially giving a pass to students
├ 定语从句〔who，修饰 students〕：who do not do their homework
└ 原因状语：because of complicated family lives
主句：it is going riskily close to the implication
└ 同位语从句(that)〔说明 implication〕：that standards need to be lowered for poor children
analysis.logic: if 建立政策做法与危险含义之间的条件推论；who 说明被放过的学生；that 从句把潜在暗示具体化。
notes: give a pass to somebody 指对某人免予追究、放宽要求。
go close to the implication 可理解为“几乎等于暗示”。
need to be lowered 是被动结构，指标准被降低。

sents.en: District administrators say that homework will still be a part of schooling; teachers are allowed to assign as much of it as they want.
sents.cn: 学区管理人员表示，家庭作业仍会是学校教育的一部分；教师想布置多少都可以。

sents.en: But with homework counting for no more than 10% of their grades, students can easily skip half their homework and see very little difference on their report cards.
sents.cn: 但由于作业在总成绩中所占比例不超过10%，学生即便轻易少做一半作业，成绩单也几乎不会有什么变化。

sents.en: Some students might do well on state tests without completing their homework, but what about the students who performed well on the tests and did their homework?
sents.cn: 有些学生不完成作业也可能在州统考中表现不错，但那些既考得好又完成了作业的学生又该怎么说呢？

sents.en: It is quite possible that the homework helped.
sents.cn: 很可能正是家庭作业起了帮助作用。

sents.en: Yet rather than empowering teachers to find what works best for their students, the policy imposes a flat, across-the-board rule.
sents.cn: 然而，这项政策没有赋予教师权力去寻找最适合自己学生的方法，反而强加了一条统一适用于所有人的僵化规定。

sents.en: At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework.
sents.cn: 与此同时，这项政策没有处理任何有关家庭作业的真正棘手问题。

sents.en: If the district finds homework to be unimportant to its students' academic achievement, it should move to reduce or eliminate the assignments, not make them count for almost nothing.
sents.cn: 如果学区认定家庭作业对学生的学业成绩并不重要，就应着手减少或取消作业，而不是让它几乎不计入成绩。

sents.en: Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade.
sents.cn: 反过来说，如果家庭作业确实重要，它就应在成绩中占据相当大的比重。

sents.en: Meanwhile, this policy does nothing to ensure that the homework students receive is meaningful or appropriate to their age and the subject, or that teachers are not assigning more than they are willing to review and correct.
sents.cn: 同时，这项政策完全无法确保学生收到的作业有意义、符合其年龄和学科特点，也无法确保教师不会布置超出自己愿意审阅和批改范围的作业。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：This policy does nothing to ensure A or B（这项政策无法确保A或B）
structure: 主句：this policy does nothing
└ 目的/结果不定式：to ensure
├ 宾语从句①(that)：that the homework students receive is meaningful or appropriate to their age and the subject
│   └ 定语从句〔省略 that，修饰 homework〕：students receive
└ 并列宾语从句②(or that)：that teachers are not assigning more than they are willing to review and correct
└ 比较从句(than)：than they are willing to review and correct
analysis.logic: ensure 后有两个并列 that 从句：一是作业本身合适，二是教师布置量不超过其批改能力；第一个从句内部 meaningful 与 appropriate 并列。
notes: does nothing to ensure 表示“完全没有保障”。
the homework students receive 中省略了关系代词 that。
more than they are willing to review and correct 指超过教师愿意审阅、批改的数量。

sents.en: The homework rules should be put on hold while the school board, which is responsible for setting educational policy, looks into the matter and conducts public hearings.
sents.cn: 在负责制定教育政策的校董会调查此事并举行公开听证会期间，应暂缓实施这些作业规定。

sents.en: It is not too late for L.A. Unified to do homework right.
sents.cn: 洛杉矶联合学区现在把“作业”做好，还为时不晚。

sents.en: Pretty in pink: adult women do not remember being so obsessed with the colour, yet it is pervasive in our young girls' lives.
sents.cn: 粉红扮靓：成年女性并不记得自己小时候曾如此痴迷粉红色，但这种颜色如今充斥着小女孩的生活。

sents.en: It is not that pink is intrinsically bad, but it is such a tiny slice of the rainbow and, though it may celebrate girlhood in one way, it also repeatedly and firmly fuses girls' identity to appearance.
sents.cn: 问题并不在于粉红色本身不好，而在于它只是彩虹中如此狭小的一部分；它或许以某种方式赞美女孩时代，却也反复而牢固地把女孩的身份认同与外表捆绑在一起。

analysis.trunk: 转折主干：It is not that pink is bad, but it is a tiny slice and it fuses identity to appearance（并非粉红色不好，而是它范围狭窄并把身份与外表捆绑）
structure: 结构①：It is not that pink is intrinsically bad
转折结构②(but)：it is such a tiny slice of the rainbow
并列结构③(and)：it also repeatedly and firmly fuses girls' identity to appearance
└ 让步状语从句(though)：though it may celebrate girlhood in one way
analysis.logic: not that...but... 先排除对颜色本身的道德判断，再指出问题；though 插入承认其积极一面，主句用 also 转回更深层的负面影响。
notes: intrinsically 指“本质上、内在地”。
a tiny slice of the rainbow 比喻女孩可选择的色彩和想象空间被压缩。
fuse A to B：把A牢牢连接/捆绑到B上。

sents.en: Then it presents that connection, even among two-year-olds, between girls as not only innocent but as evidence of innocence.
sents.cn: 随后，它又把女孩之间的这种联系——甚至在两岁幼儿中也如此——呈现为不但天真无邪，而且是天真无邪的证明。

sents.en: Looking around, I despaired at the singular lack of imagination about girls' lives and interests.
sents.cn: 环顾四周，面对人们对女孩生活和兴趣极度缺乏想象力的现状，我感到绝望。

sents.en: Girls' attraction to pink may seem unavoidable, somehow encoded in their DNA, but according to Jo Paoletti, an associate professor of American Studies, it is not.
sents.cn: 女孩对粉红色的喜爱看似不可避免，仿佛以某种方式写进了她们的DNA，但美国研究副教授乔·保莱蒂指出，事实并非如此。

sents.en: Children were not colour-coded at all until the early 20th century: in the era before domestic washing machines all babies wore white as a practical matter, since the only way of getting clothes clean was to boil them.
sents.cn: 直到20世纪初，儿童才开始按颜色区分性别；在家用洗衣机出现以前，所有婴儿出于实用考虑都穿白色，因为当时洗净衣服的唯一方法就是煮洗。

analysis.trunk: S+V：Children were not colour-coded until the early 20th century（直到20世纪初才按颜色区分儿童性别）
structure: 主句：Children were not colour-coded at all until the early 20th century
冒号后解释：in the era before domestic washing machines all babies wore white as a practical matter
└ 原因状语从句(since)：since the only way of getting clothes clean was to boil them
analysis.logic: not...until... 表示“直到……才”；冒号后的历史事实解释此前为什么婴儿统一穿白色，since 再给出便于煮洗的原因。
notes: colour-code 在此指用不同颜色标记或区分性别。
as a practical matter 指出于实际、实用考虑。
getting clothes clean 是使衣服变干净。

sents.en: What's more, both boys and girls wore what were thought of as gender-neutral dresses.
sents.cn: 不仅如此，男孩和女孩当时都穿着被视为不分性别的裙装。

sents.en: When nursery colours were introduced, pink was actually considered the more masculine colour, a pastel version of red, which was associated with strength.
sents.cn: 育儿用色刚被引入时，粉红色实际上被视为更具男性气质的颜色，因为它是红色的浅色版本，而红色与力量相关。

sents.en: Blue, with its intimations of the Virgin Mary, constancy and faithfulness, symbolised femininity.
sents.cn: 蓝色因使人联想到圣母玛利亚、忠贞和忠诚，反而象征着女性气质。

sents.en: It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children's marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherently attractive to girls, part of what defined them as female, at least for the first few critical years.
sents.cn: 直到20世纪80年代中期，放大年龄和性别差异成为儿童营销的主导策略，粉红色才真正大行其道；它开始显得天生就吸引女孩，成为界定女性身份的一部分，至少在最初几个关键成长年份是如此。

analysis.trunk: 强调句：It was not until the mid-1980s that pink fully came into its own（直到20世纪80年代中期，粉红色才真正流行起来）
structure: not until 强调结构：It was not until the mid-1980s ... that pink fully came into its own
└ 时间定语从句(when)：when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children's marketing strategy
补充时间从句(when)：when it began to seem inherently attractive to girls
├ 同位补充：part of what defined them as female
│   └ 宾语从句(what)：what defined them as female
└ 范围状语：at least for the first few critical years
analysis.logic: 主轴是 not until...that...；第一个 when 界定80年代中期的营销变化，第二个 when 说明粉红色“大行其道”的具体表现。
notes: come into one's own 指开始充分展现影响力、真正走红。
amplifying differences 指人为放大差异。
what defined them as female 中 what 同时作 define 的主语并引导名词性从句。

sents.en: I had not realised how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development.
sents.cn: 我此前没有意识到，营销趋势竟如此深刻地支配着我们对“什么对儿童而言是自然的”这一问题的认识，甚至影响我们关于儿童心理发展的核心信念。

sents.en: Take the toddler.
sents.cn: 以“学步期儿童”这个概念为例。

sents.en: I assumed that phase was something experts developed after years of research into children's behaviour: wrong.
sents.cn: 我原以为，这一成长阶段是专家经过多年儿童行为研究后提出的；错了。

sents.en: Turns out, according to Daniel Cook, a historian of childhood consumerism, it was popularised as a marketing trick by clothing manufacturers in the 1930s.
sents.cn: 研究儿童消费主义的历史学家丹尼尔·库克指出，事实是，这个概念在20世纪30年代被服装制造商当作营销手段推广开来。

sents.en: Trade publications counselled department stores that, in order to increase sales, they should create a "third stepping stone" between infant wear and older kids' clothes.
sents.cn: 行业刊物建议百货商店，为了增加销售额，应在婴儿服装与大龄儿童服装之间创造一个“第三块垫脚石”。

sents.en: It was only after "toddler" became a common shoppers' term that it evolved into a broadly accepted developmental stage.
sents.cn: 只是在“学步期儿童”成为消费者常用术语之后，它才逐渐演变成一个被广泛接受的发展阶段。

sents.en: Splitting kids, or adults, into ever-tinier categories has proved a sure-fire way to boost profits.
sents.cn: 事实证明，把儿童或成年人划分成越来越细小的类别，是提高利润的可靠方法。

sents.en: And one of the easiest ways to segment a market is to magnify gender differences - or invent them where they did not previously exist.
sents.cn: 而细分市场最容易的方法之一，就是放大性别差异——或者在原本不存在差异的地方把它们凭空创造出来。

sents.en: In 2010, a federal judge shook America's biotech industry to its core.
sents.cn: 2010年，一名联邦法官的判决从根本上震动了美国生物技术行业。

sents.en: Companies had won patents for isolated DNA for decades - by 2005 some 20% of human genes were patented.
sents.cn: 几十年来，企业一直能够为分离出的DNA取得专利；到2005年，人类基因中约有20%已被申请专利。

sents.en: But in March 2010 a judge ruled that genes were unpatentable.
sents.cn: 但2010年3月，一名法官裁定基因不能获得专利。

sents.en: Executives were violently agitated.
sents.cn: 企业高管对此极为激动不安。

sents.en: The Biotechnology Industry Organisation (BIO), a trade group, assured members that this was just a "preliminary step" in a longer battle.
sents.cn: 行业组织“生物技术产业组织”（BIO）向会员保证，这只是一场长期斗争中的“初步步骤”。

sents.en: On July 29th they were relieved, at least temporarily.
sents.cn: 7月29日，他们终于松了一口气，至少暂时如此。

sents.en: A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman's risk of breast cancer.
sents.cn: 一家联邦上诉法院推翻了先前的判决，裁定万基遗传公司确实可以持有两种基因的专利，这两种基因有助于预测女性患乳腺癌的风险。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision（联邦上诉法院推翻了先前判决）
structure: 主句：A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision
└ 现在分词短语作结果/伴随状语：ruling
└ 宾语从句(that)：that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes
└ 定语从句〔that，修饰 genes〕：that help forecast a woman's risk of breast cancer
analysis.logic: 主句先给出推翻判决的动作；ruling 说明新判决内容；最内层 that 限定两种基因的功能。
notes: appeals court 指上诉法院。
rule that... 指法院裁定……。
forecast a risk 不是预言必然患病，而是预测风险。

sents.en: The chief executive of Myriad, a company in Utah, said the ruling was a blessing to firms and patients alike.
sents.cn: 这家犹他州公司的首席执行官表示，该裁决对企业和患者都是福音。

sents.en: But as companies continue their attempts at personalised medicine, the courts will remain rather busy.
sents.cn: 但随着企业继续尝试发展个性化医疗，法院仍会相当忙碌。

sents.en: The Myriad case itself is probably not over.
sents.cn: 万基案本身很可能尚未结束。

sents.en: Critics make three main arguments against gene patents: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents' monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad's.
sents.cn: 批评者反对基因专利主要有三条理由：基因是自然产物，因而不应获专利；基因专利压制创新，而非奖励创新；专利造成的垄断会限制人们获得万基公司这类基因检测服务。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：Critics make three main arguments against gene patents（批评者提出三条反对基因专利的理由）
structure: 总领句：Critics make three main arguments against gene patents
冒号后理由①：a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented
理由②：gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it
理由③：patents' monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad's
analysis.logic: 冒号引出三项平行论据，由分号清晰分隔；第一项内部用 so 表因果，第二项用 rather than 表对照。
notes: may not be patented 在法律语境中指不具备可专利性。
rather than：而不是。
Myriad's 省略了 genetic tests，指万基公司的基因检测。

sents.en: A growing number seem to agree.
sents.cn: 似乎有越来越多的人赞同这些观点。

sents.en: Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests.
sents.cn: 去年，一个联邦工作组敦促对与基因检测有关的专利制度进行改革。

sents.en: In October the Department of Justice filed a brief in the Myriad case, arguing that an isolated DNA molecule "is no less a product of nature…than are cotton fibres that have been separated from cotton seeds."
sents.cn: 10月，美国司法部在万基案中提交了一份意见书，主张分离出的DNA分子“与从棉籽中分离出的棉纤维相比，同样都是自然产物”。

sents.en: Despite the appeals court's decision, big questions remain unanswered.
sents.cn: 尽管上诉法院已经作出判决，重大问题仍未得到解答。

sents.en: For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it.
sents.cn: 例如，对完整基因组进行测序是否侵犯其中单个基因的专利，目前尚不明确。

sents.en: The case may yet reach the Supreme Court.
sents.cn: 此案最终仍可能提交最高法院审理。

sents.en: As the industry advances, however, other suits may have an even greater impact.
sents.cn: 然而，随着行业发展，其他诉讼可能产生更为重大的影响。

sents.en: Companies are unlikely to file many more patents for human DNA molecules - most are already patented or in the public domain.
sents.cn: 企业不太可能再为人类DNA分子申请太多新专利，因为大多数分子要么已经获得专利，要么已进入公有领域。

sents.en: Firms are now studying how genes interact, looking for correlations that might be used to determine the causes of disease or predict a drug's efficacy.
sents.cn: 企业如今正在研究基因如何相互作用，寻找可用于确定疾病成因或预测药物疗效的关联。

sents.en: Companies are eager to win patents for "connecting the dots," explains Hans Sauer, a lawyer for the BIO.
sents.cn: BIO的律师汉斯·绍尔解释说，企业都急于为“把各个点连接起来”申请专利。

sents.en: Their success may be determined by a suit related to this issue, brought by the Mayo Clinic, which the Supreme Court will hear in its next term.
sents.cn: 它们能否成功，可能取决于梅奥诊所就这一问题提起的一宗诉讼；最高法院将在下一个审期审理此案。

analysis.trunk: S+V：Their success may be determined by a suit（它们能否成功可能由一宗诉讼决定）
structure: 主句：Their success may be determined by a suit related to this issue
├ 过去分词短语〔修饰 suit〕：brought by the Mayo Clinic
└ 非限制性定语从句〔which，修饰 suit〕：which the Supreme Court will hear in its next term
analysis.logic: 两个后置成分连续修饰 suit：先说明起诉方是梅奥诊所，再说明最高法院将在下一审期审理。
notes: Their success 回指企业取得“连接各点”相关专利的成功与否。
bring a suit 指提起诉讼。
hear a case 指法院审理案件，不是单纯“听取”。

sents.en: The BIO recently held a convention which included sessions to coach lawyers on the shifting landscape for patents.
sents.cn: BIO最近举行了一次大会，其中设有若干培训环节，指导律师应对不断变化的专利形势。

sents.en: Each meeting was packed.
sents.cn: 每场会议都座无虚席。

sents.en: The great recession may be over, but this era of high joblessness is probably beginning.
sents.cn: 大衰退或许已经结束，但这个高失业率时代可能才刚刚开始。

sents.en: Before it ends, it will likely change the life course and character of a generation of young adults.
sents.cn: 在它结束之前，很可能会改变一代年轻人的人生轨迹和性格。

sents.en: And ultimately, it is likely to reshape our politics, our culture, and the character of our society for years.
sents.cn: 最终，它还可能在未来多年重塑我们的政治、文化以及整个社会的特征。

sents.en: No one tries harder than the jobless to find silver linings in this national economic disaster.
sents.cn: 没有谁比失业者更努力地从这场全国性经济灾难中寻找一线希望。

sents.en: Many said that unemployment, while extremely painful, had improved them in some ways: they had become less materialistic and more financially prudent; they were more aware of the struggles of others.
sents.cn: 许多人说，失业虽然极其痛苦，却在某些方面使自己变得更好：他们不再那么崇尚物质，在财务上更加谨慎，也更能体会他人的困境。

sents.en: In limited respects, perhaps the recession will leave society better off.
sents.cn: 或许在有限的几个方面，这场衰退会让社会状况有所改善。

sents.en: At the very least, it has awoken us from our national fever dream of easy riches and bigger houses, and put a necessary end to an era of reckless personal spending.
sents.cn: 至少，它已把我们从轻松致富、追求更大房屋的全民狂热美梦中唤醒，并为一个个人消费毫无节制的时代画上了必要的句号。

sents.en: But for the most part, these benefits seem thin, uncertain, and far off.
sents.cn: 但总体而言，这些益处似乎很微弱、很不确定，而且遥不可及。

sents.en: In The Moral Consequences of Economic Growth, the economic historian Benjamin Friedman argues that both inside and outside the U.S., lengthy periods of economic stagnation or decline have almost always left society more mean-spirited and less inclusive, and have usually stopped or reversed the advance of rights and freedoms.
sents.cn: 经济史学家本杰明·弗里德曼在《经济增长的道德后果》中指出，无论在美国国内还是国外，经济长期停滞或衰退几乎总会使社会变得更刻薄、更缺乏包容，并且通常会阻止甚至逆转权利与自由的进步。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：Benjamin Friedman argues that lengthy periods have left society..., and have stopped or reversed...（弗里德曼指出，长期停滞会使社会……并阻碍或逆转……）
structure: 出处状语：In The Moral Consequences of Economic Growth
主句：the economic historian Benjamin Friedman argues
└ 宾语从句(that)：both inside and outside the U.S., lengthy periods of economic stagnation or decline have ...
├ 并列谓语①：have almost always left society more mean-spirited and less inclusive
└ 并列谓语②(and)：have usually stopped or reversed the advance of rights and freedoms
analysis.logic: that 从句是整句论点；主语 lengthy periods 带两个并列谓语，分别描述社会性格恶化和权利自由进程受阻。
notes: leave + 宾语 + 形容词：使社会处于某种状态。
mean-spirited 指刻薄、缺乏善意。
the advance of rights and freedoms 指权利与自由的发展进程。

sents.en: Anti-immigrant sentiment typically increases, as does conflict between races and classes.
sents.cn: 反移民情绪通常会上升，种族与阶级之间的冲突也是如此。

sents.en: Income inequality usually falls during a recession, but it has not shrunk in this one.
sents.cn: 收入不平等通常会在经济衰退期间缩小，但在这场衰退中却没有。

sents.en: Indeed, this period of economic weakness may reinforce class divides, and decrease opportunities to cross them - especially for young people.
sents.cn: 事实上，这段经济疲软期可能会加深阶级鸿沟，减少跨越鸿沟的机会，尤其会影响年轻人。

sents.en: The research of Till Von Wachter, the economist at Columbia University, suggests that not all people graduating into a recession see their life chances dimmed: those with degrees from elite universities catch up fairly quickly to where they otherwise would have been if they had graduated in better times; it is the masses beneath them that are left behind.
sents.cn: 哥伦比亚大学经济学家蒂尔·冯·瓦赫特的研究表明，并非所有在经济衰退期毕业的人都会看到人生机会黯淡：名校毕业生会相当快地追赶上假如自己在景气时期毕业本可达到的水平；真正被甩在后面的是他们之下的广大人群。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：The research suggests that not all graduates see their chances dimmed（研究表明并非所有毕业生的机会都会变差）
structure: 主句：The research of Till Von Wachter ... suggests
├ 同位语插入：the economist at Columbia University
└ 宾语从句(that)：not all people graduating into a recession see their life chances dimmed
冒号后分项解释①：those with degrees from elite universities catch up fairly quickly
└ 地点/程度从句(where)：to where they otherwise would have been
└ 条件状语从句(if)：if they had graduated in better times
分号后强调解释②：it is the masses beneath them that are left behind
analysis.logic: not all 是部分否定；冒号后解释哪些人能追上、哪些人会掉队；末尾用 it is...that... 强调真正受损的是普通大众。
notes: graduating into a recession 指毕业时恰逢经济衰退。
would have been if... 是对过去相反情况的虚拟假设。
see their life chances dimmed 可理解为“发现人生机会变得黯淡”。

sents.en: In the Internet age, it is particularly easy to see the resentment that has always been hidden within American society.
sents.cn: 在互联网时代，人们尤其容易看到美国社会中一直潜藏的怨恨。

sents.en: More difficult, in the moment, is discerning precisely how these lean times are affecting society's character.
sents.cn: 眼下更难做到的，是准确判断这些艰难岁月正在如何影响社会的性格。

sents.en: In many respects, the U.S. was more socially tolerant entering this recession than at any time in its history, and a variety of national polls on social conflict since then have shown mixed results.
sents.cn: 在许多方面，美国进入这次衰退时的社会宽容程度超过历史上任何时期；但此后围绕社会冲突开展的多项全国性民意调查却给出了喜忧参半的结果。

analysis.trunk: 并列主干：The U.S. was more tolerant..., and polls have shown mixed results（美国当时更宽容，但多项调查结果不一）
structure: 范围状语：In many respects
分句①：the U.S. was more socially tolerant ... than at any time in its history
└ 时间状语：entering this recession
并列分句②(and)：a variety of national polls on social conflict since then have shown mixed results
analysis.logic: 前半句给出进入衰退时较高的社会宽容基线，后半句说明衰退后的调查并未呈现单一方向，因此影响仍难判断。
notes: entering this recession 是时间压缩表达，相当于 when it entered this recession。
more...than at any time in its history 表示高于历史上任何时候。
mixed results 指结果有好有坏、没有一致结论。

sents.en: We will have to wait and see exactly how these hard times will reshape our social fabric.
sents.cn: 我们必须等待并观察，这些艰难岁月究竟会怎样重塑我们的社会结构。

sents.en: But they certainly will reshape it, and all the more so the longer they extend.
sents.cn: 但它们肯定会重塑社会结构，而且持续时间越长，重塑的程度就越深。

sents.en: In an essay entitled "Making It in America," the author Adam Davidson relates a joke from cotton country about just how much a modern textile mill has been automated: The average mill has only two employees today, "a man and a dog.
sents.cn: 在题为《在美国获得成功》的一篇文章中，作者亚当·戴维森讲了一个来自棉花产区的笑话，用来说明现代纺织厂的自动化程度有多高：如今，一家普通工厂只有两名“员工”——“一个人和一条狗”。

sents.en: The man is there to feed the dog, and the dog is there to keep the man away from the machines."
sents.cn: 这个人负责喂狗，而这条狗负责让这个人远离机器。

sents.en: Davidson's article is one of a number of pieces that have recently appeared making the point that the reason we have such stubbornly high unemployment and declining middle-class incomes today is largely because of the big drop in demand because of the Great Recession, but it is also because of the advances in both globalization and the information technology revolution, which are more rapidly than ever replacing labor with machines or foreign workers.
sents.cn: 戴维森的文章是近期出现的众多同类文章之一；这些文章指出，如今失业率居高不下、中产阶级收入下降，很大程度上是因为“大衰退”造成需求骤降，但也因为全球化和信息技术革命不断推进，它们正以前所未有的速度用机器或外国劳工取代本国劳动力。

analysis.trunk: 主干：Davidson's article is one of a number of pieces（戴维森的文章是众多文章之一）
structure: 定语从句(that，修饰 pieces)：that have recently appeared
现在分词短语作伴随/结果说明：making the point
同位语从句(that，解释 point)：the reason ... is largely because of A, but it is also because of B
定语从句(which，指代 advances)：which are ... replacing labor with machines or foreign workers
analysis.logic: 句子先界定文章类别，再用 point 的同位语从句提出“双重原因”：大衰退导致需求下降，同时全球化和信息技术进步加速替代劳动。
notes: the reason ... is because ... 在原文口语化论述中用于解释原因。
which 的先行内容是 advances，而不是 revolution 单独一词。
stubbornly high 表示“居高不下”；replace A with B 表示“用B取代A”。

sents.en: In the past, workers with average skills, doing an average job, could earn an average lifestyle.
sents.cn: 过去，技能一般的工人做着普通工作，也能过上普通的生活。

sents.en: But, today, average is officially over.
sents.cn: 但如今，“普通”这个时代已经正式结束。

sents.en: Being average just won't earn you what it used to.
sents.cn: 仅仅达到普通水平，已无法再给你带来过去那样的收入。

sents.en: It can't when so many more employers have so much more access to so much more above average cheap foreign labor, cheap robotics, cheap software, cheap automation and cheap genius.
sents.cn: 当越来越多的雇主能够获得大量高于平均水平且价格低廉的外国劳动力、机器人、软件、自动化技术乃至廉价天才时，普通水平当然不再管用。

analysis.trunk: 主干：It can't（普通水平不可能再带来过去的回报）
structure: It 承接上一句 Being average，can't 后省略 earn you what it used to
时间/原因状语从句(when)：when so many more employers have ... access to ...
宾语中心：cheap foreign labor, robotics, software, automation and genius
above average 同时限定后列的高水平资源，多个 so much more 强化数量和可获得性
analysis.logic: 本句用 when 给出“普通不再值钱”的现实条件：雇主能在全球范围内低成本取得更多、更优秀的人力与技术。
notes: can't 是省略表达，理解时要从上一句补出完整谓语。
have access to 意为“能够获得/使用”。
cheap genius 并非贬低天才，而是强调高端才智的获取成本下降。

sents.en: Therefore, everyone needs to find their extra – their unique value contribution that makes them stand out in whatever is their field of employment.
sents.cn: 因此，每个人都需要找到自己的“额外价值”——一种独特的价值贡献，使自己无论身处哪个就业领域都能脱颖而出。

sents.en: Yes, new technology has been eating jobs forever, and always will.
sents.cn: 没错，新技术一直都在吞噬就业岗位，而且今后也会如此。

sents.en: But there's been an acceleration.
sents.cn: 但这一过程已经加速。

sents.en: As Davidson notes, "In the 10 years ending in 2009, [U.S.] factories shed workers so fast that they erased almost all the gains of the previous 70 years; roughly one out of every three manufacturing jobs – about 6 million in total – disappeared."
sents.cn: 正如戴维森所指出的：“截至2009年的十年间，美国工厂裁员速度之快，几乎抹去了此前70年取得的全部就业增长；大约每三个制造业岗位中就有一个消失，总计约600万个。”

sents.en: There will always be change – new jobs, new products, new services.
