sents.cn: 变化总会存在——会有新工作、新产品和新服务。

sents.en: But the one thing we know for sure is that with each advance in globalization and the I.T. revolution, the best jobs will require workers to have more and better education to make themselves above average.
sents.cn: 但我们唯一能够确定的是：全球化和信息技术革命每推进一步，最好的工作岗位就越要求劳动者接受更多、更好的教育，从而使自己达到平均水平之上。

sents.en: In a world where average is officially over, there are many things we need to do to support employment, but nothing would be more important than passing some kind of G.I. Bill for the 21st century that ensures that every American has access to post-high school education.
sents.cn: 在一个“普通时代已经结束”的世界里，我们需要采取许多措施来支持就业，但最重要的莫过于为21世纪通过某种类似《退伍军人权利法案》的教育法案，确保每个美国人都有机会接受高中后的教育。

analysis.trunk: 并列主干：there are many things ..., but nothing would be more important than passing ...
structure: 地点/背景状语：In a world where average is officially over
定语从句(where，修饰 world)：where average is officially over
定语从句〔省略 that，修饰 things〕：we need to do
比较结构：nothing would be more important than passing some kind of G.I. Bill
定语从句(that，修饰 Bill)：that ensures that every American has access to post-high school education
analysis.logic: but 把“许多可做之事”收束到最优先的一项；nothing ... more important than 是最高级含义，强调教育法案最重要。
notes: G.I. Bill 原指美国为退伍军人提供教育等福利的法案，此处借指全民继续教育支持。
where 引导定语从句，不是单纯地点状语从句。
ensure 后的 that 从句是宾语从句；have access to 表示“有机会获得”。

sents.en: A century ago, the immigrants from across the Atlantic included settlers and sojourners.
sents.cn: 一个世纪以前，横渡大西洋而来的移民中，既有定居者，也有短暂停留者。

sents.en: Along with the many folks looking to make a permanent home in the United States came those who had no intention to stay, and who would make some money and then go home.
sents.cn: 在众多打算在美国永久安家的人之外，也有一些人无意久留；他们赚上一些钱后便会回国。

analysis.trunk: 倒装主干：Along with A came those ...（与A一同到来的还有那些人）
structure: 句首介词短语：Along with the many folks looking to make a permanent home in the United States
完全倒装：came those（正常语序为 those came）
定语从句①(who，修饰 those)：who had no intention to stay
并列定语从句②(and who)：who would make some money and then go home
analysis.logic: 作者用 along with 引出的倒装，把永久定居者与赚够钱便返乡的短期移民并置，突出历史移民形态的多样性。
notes: 句首较长的 Along with 短语触发完全倒装，真正主语是 those。
looking to... 是现在分词短语，修饰 folks。
have no intention to do 表示“无意做某事”。

sents.en: Between 1908 and 1915, about 7 million people arrived while about 2 million departed.
sents.cn: 1908年至1915年间，约有700万人入境，同时约有200万人离境。

sents.en: About a quarter of all Italian immigrants, for example, eventually returned to Italy for good.
sents.cn: 例如，所有意大利移民中约有四分之一最终永久返回了意大利。

sents.en: They even had an affectionate nickname, "uccelli di passaggio," birds of passage.
sents.cn: 人们甚至给他们起了一个亲切的昵称“uccelli di passaggio”，意为“候鸟”。

sents.en: Today, we are much more rigid about immigrants.
sents.cn: 如今，我们对移民的划分要僵化得多。

sents.en: We divide newcomers into two categories: legal or illegal, good or bad.
sents.cn: 我们把新来者分成两类：合法或非法，好人或坏人。

sents.en: We hail them as Americans in the making, or brand them as aliens to be kicked out.
sents.cn: 我们要么赞扬他们是正在成为美国人的人，要么给他们贴上应被驱逐的异乡人标签。

sents.en: That framework has contributed mightily to our broken immigration system and the long political paralysis over how to fix it.
sents.cn: 这种思维框架极大地造成了美国移民制度的失灵，也导致了围绕如何修复该制度的长期政治僵局。

sents.en: We don't need more categories, but we need to change the way we think about categories.
sents.cn: 我们并不需要更多类别，而需要改变看待这些类别的方式。

sents.en: We need to look beyond strict definitions of legal and illegal.
sents.cn: 我们需要超越对“合法”与“非法”的严格界定。

sents.en: To start, we can recognize the new birds of passage, those living and thriving in the gray areas.
sents.cn: 首先，我们可以承认新一代“候鸟”的存在，也就是那些在灰色地带生活并发展得很好的人。

sents.en: We might then begin to solve our immigration challenges.
sents.cn: 这样一来，我们或许就能开始解决移民难题。

sents.en: Crop pickers, violinists, construction workers, entrepreneurs, engineers, home health-care aides and physicists are among today's birds of passage.
sents.cn: 农作物采摘工、小提琴手、建筑工人、企业家、工程师、居家医疗护理员和物理学家，都属于今天的“候鸟”。

sents.en: They are energetic participants in a global economy driven by the flow of work, money and ideas.
sents.cn: 他们积极参与着由工作、资金和思想流动所驱动的全球经济。

sents.en: They prefer to come and go as opportunity calls them.
sents.cn: 他们更愿意在机会召唤时来去自由。

sents.en: They can manage to have a job in one place and a family in another.
sents.cn: 他们能够做到在一个地方工作、在另一个地方安家。

sents.en: With or without permission, they straddle laws, jurisdictions and identities with ease.
sents.cn: 无论有无许可，他们都能轻松跨越法律、司法管辖区和身份认同的边界。

sents.en: We need them to imagine the United States as a place where they can be productive for a while without committing themselves to staying forever.
sents.cn: 我们需要让他们把美国设想成这样一个地方：可以在这里高效工作一段时间，却不必承诺永久留下。

analysis.trunk: 主干：We need them to imagine the United States as a place（我们需要他们把美国想象成一个地方）
structure: need + 宾语 + 不定式：need them to imagine ...
imagine A as B：把 the United States 设想为 a place
定语从句(where，修饰 place)：where they can be productive for a while
伴随状语(without)：without committing themselves to staying forever
analysis.logic: 句子提出一种新的移民预期：允许移民阶段性贡献，而不把永久定居作为获得接纳的前提。
notes: need them to do 是“需要他们做”，不是“需要他们来做某物”。
commit oneself to 中 to 是介词，后接 staying。
productive 在此指“从事生产性工作、作出贡献”。

sents.en: We need them to feel that home can be both here and there and that they can belong to two nations honorably.
sents.cn: 我们需要让他们感到，家既可以在这里，也可以在那里，而且他们能够体面地归属于两个国家。

sents.en: Accommodating this new world of people in motion will require new attitudes on both sides of the immigration battle.
sents.cn: 要适应这个人员不断流动的新世界，移民争论的双方都必须形成新的态度。

sents.en: Looking beyond the culture war logic of right or wrong means opening up the middle ground and understanding that managing immigration today requires multiple paths and multiple outcomes, including some that are not easy to accomplish legally in the existing system.
sents.cn: 超越非对即错的文化战争逻辑，意味着要开辟中间地带，并认识到当今的移民管理需要多种路径和多种结果，其中有些结果在现行制度下很难通过合法途径实现。

analysis.trunk: 主干：Looking beyond ... means opening up ... and understanding ...
structure: 动名词短语作主语：Looking beyond the culture war logic of right or wrong
并列宾语①：opening up the middle ground
并列宾语②：understanding that managing immigration today requires ...
that 宾语从句内，动名词短语 managing immigration today 作主语
including 后置补充 outcomes；定语从句(that)：that are not easy to accomplish legally in the existing system
analysis.logic: 本句把“超越二元对立”具体化为两步：开辟中间地带，并接受移民治理需要多路径、多结果。
notes: look beyond 意为“越过表面框架来看”。
means 后的 opening 与 understanding 平行。
including some 中 some 指代 outcomes；定语从句说明部分结果在现行制度下难以合法实现。

sents.en: Scientists have found that although we are prone to snap overreactions, if we take a moment and think about how we are likely to react, we can reduce or even eliminate the negative effects of our quick, hard-wired responses.
sents.cn: 科学家发现，尽管我们容易瞬间反应过度，但如果能停顿片刻，想一想自己可能会如何反应，就可以减轻甚至消除这种快速、本能反应所产生的负面影响。

analysis.trunk: 主干：Scientists have found that we can reduce or eliminate the negative effects ...
structure: 宾语从句(that)：that ... we can reduce or even eliminate ...
让步状语从句(although)：although we are prone to snap overreactions
条件状语从句(if)：if we take a moment and think about ...
宾语从句(how)：how we are likely to react
介词短语：of our quick, hard-wired responses，修饰 negative effects
analysis.logic: although 先承认人类容易本能过度反应，if 再提出“暂停并预判”的条件，主句给出可减轻负面影响的结果。
notes: be prone to 意为“容易/倾向于”，to 后接名词。
take a moment 不是“花很久”，而是“稍作停顿”。
hard-wired 比喻“天生设定的、本能的”。

sents.en: Snap decisions can be important defense mechanisms; if we are judging whether someone is dangerous, our brains and bodies are hard-wired to react very quickly, within milliseconds.
sents.cn: 瞬间判断可能是一种重要的防御机制；当我们判断某人是否危险时，大脑和身体天生就会在几毫秒内迅速作出反应。

sents.en: But we need more time to assess other factors.
sents.cn: 但要评估其他因素，我们需要更多时间。

sents.en: To accurately tell whether someone is sociable, studies show, we need at least a minute, preferably five.
sents.cn: 研究表明，要准确判断一个人是否善于交际，我们至少需要一分钟，最好是五分钟。

sents.en: It takes a while to judge complex aspects of personality, like neuroticism or open-mindedness.
sents.cn: 判断人格中较复杂的方面需要一段时间，例如神经质程度或思想开放程度。

sents.en: But snap decisions in reaction to rapid stimuli aren't exclusive to the interpersonal realm.
sents.cn: 不过，对快速刺激作出的瞬间判断并非只存在于人际交往领域。

sents.en: Psychologists at the University of Toronto found that viewing a fast-food logo for just a few milliseconds primes us to read 20 percent faster, even though reading has little to do with eating.
sents.cn: 多伦多大学的心理学家发现，只看几毫秒的快餐标志，就会促使我们的阅读速度提高20%，尽管阅读与进食几乎毫无关系。

sents.en: We unconsciously associate fast food with speed and impatience and carry those impulses into whatever else we're doing.
sents.cn: 我们会无意识地把快餐与速度和不耐烦联系起来，并把这些冲动带入正在做的其他任何事情中。

sents.en: Subjects exposed to fast-food flashes also tend to think a musical piece lasts too long.
sents.cn: 接触过一闪而过的快餐画面的受试者，也往往会觉得一段乐曲持续得太久。

sents.en: Yet we can reverse such influences.
sents.cn: 然而，我们能够逆转这类影响。

sents.en: If we know we will overreact to consumer products or housing options when we see a happy face (one reason good sales representatives and real estate agents are always smiling), we can take a moment before buying.
sents.cn: 如果我们知道，看见一张笑脸会使自己对消费品或住房选择反应过度——这也是优秀销售人员和房地产经纪人总是面带微笑的一个原因——那么就可以在购买前停顿片刻。

sents.en: If we know female job screeners are more likely to reject attractive female applicants, we can help screeners understand their biases – or hire outside screeners.
sents.cn: 如果我们知道女性招聘筛选者更可能淘汰外貌出众的女性求职者，就可以帮助筛选者认识这种偏见，或者聘用外部筛选人员。

sents.en: John Gottman, the marriage expert, explains that we quickly "thin slice" information reliably only after we ground such snap reactions in "thick sliced" long-term study.
sents.cn: 婚姻专家约翰·戈特曼解释说，只有先把这类瞬间反应建立在“厚切片”式的长期研究之上，我们才能可靠地对信息进行快速的“薄切片”判断。

analysis.trunk: 主干：John Gottman explains that we ... 'thin slice' information reliably only after ...
structure: 同位语插入：the marriage expert，补充说明 John Gottman
宾语从句(that)：that we quickly 'thin slice' information reliably
时间限制：only after we ground such snap reactions in ... long-term study
ground A in B：把 such snap reactions 建立在 'thick sliced' long-term study 之上
analysis.logic: only after 限定“快速判断可靠”的前提：长期、充分观察先提供基础，随后形成的瞬间判断才可信。
notes: thin slice 作动词，指凭少量信息快速判断。
thick sliced 与 thin slice 构成概念对照，强调长期、丰富的信息基础。
only after 位于句中，因此这里不发生主谓倒装。

sents.en: When Dr. Gottman really wants to assess whether a couple will stay together, he invites them to his island retreat for a much longer evaluation: two days, not two seconds.
sents.cn: 当戈特曼博士确实想判断一对伴侣能否长久相守时，他会邀请他们到自己的海岛休养地接受更长时间的评估：两天，而不是两秒。

sents.en: Our ability to mute our hard-wired reactions by pausing is what differentiates us from animals: dogs can think about the future only intermittently or for a few minutes.
sents.cn: 我们通过停顿来抑制本能反应的能力，正是我们区别于动物之处：狗只能偶尔思考未来，或者只能思考几分钟。

analysis.trunk: 主干：Our ability ... is what differentiates us from animals
structure: 主语中心：Our ability
不定式作后置定语：to mute our hard-wired reactions
方式状语：by pausing
表语从句(what)：what differentiates us from animals
冒号后解释说明：dogs can think about the future only intermittently or for a few minutes
analysis.logic: 冒号前提出人与动物的关键差异是“暂停并抑制本能反应”，冒号后以狗对未来思考能力有限作为具体对照。
notes: what = the thing that，在表语从句中兼作 differentiates 的主语。
differentiate A from B 表示“把A与B区分开”。
by pausing 是手段，不是时间状语。

sents.en: But historically we have spent about 12 percent of our days contemplating the longer term.
sents.cn: 然而，从历史上看，我们每天大约会用12%的时间思考更长远的问题。

sents.en: Although technology might change the way we react, it hasn't changed our nature.
sents.cn: 技术或许会改变我们的反应方式，但并没有改变我们的本性。

sents.en: We still have the imaginative capacity to rise above temptation and reverse the high-speed trend.
sents.cn: 我们仍然拥有超越诱惑、扭转高速化趋势的想象能力。

sents.en: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven.
sents.cn: 欧洲并不是一个实现了性别平等的天堂。

sents.en: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.
sents.cn: 尤其是，只有女性参与高级管理层的决策，企业职场才可能真正做到对家庭友好；而欧洲企业治理的最高职位目前仍由男性占据绝对多数。

analysis.trunk: 并列主干：the corporate workplace will never be ... until ..., and Europe's top ... positions remain ... male
structure: 状语：In particular
主句①：the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly
时间/条件从句(until)：until women are part of senior management decisions
并列主句②(and)：Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male
analysis.logic: 前半句提出职场真正家庭友好的必要条件，后半句转入现实：女性尚未充分进入最高决策层。
notes: not ... until 表示“直到……才”，翻译时宜正向处理。
be part of decisions 指参与决策过程。
overwhelmingly 在此表示比例上“压倒性地”。

sents.en: Indeed, women hold only 14 per cent of positions on European corporate boards.
sents.cn: 事实上，欧洲公司董事会中的女性席位仅占14%。

sents.en: The European Union is now considering legislation to compel corporate boards to maintain a certain proportion of women – up to 60 per cent.
sents.cn: 欧盟目前正在考虑立法，强制公司董事会保持一定的女性比例，最高可达60%。

sents.en: This proposed mandate was born of frustration.
sents.cn: 这项拟议中的强制规定源于失望。

sents.en: Last year, European Commission Vice President Viviane Reding issued a call to voluntary action.
sents.cn: 去年，欧盟委员会副主席维维亚娜·雷丁发出了自愿采取行动的号召。

sents.en: Reding invited corporations to sign up for gender balance goals of 40 per cent female board membership.
sents.cn: 雷丁邀请企业签署承诺，将女性董事会成员的比例目标定为40%。

sents.en: But her appeal was considered a failure: only 24 companies took it up.
sents.cn: 但她的呼吁被认为失败了：只有24家公司响应。

sents.en: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?
sents.cn: 我们是否需要配额制度，才能确保女性在兼顾工作与家庭的同时，继续公平地沿着企业晋升阶梯向上发展？

sents.en: "Personally, I don't like quotas," Reding said recently.
sents.cn: “就我个人而言，我不喜欢配额，”雷丁最近说道。

sents.en: "But I like what the quotas do."
sents.cn: “但我喜欢配额所产生的效果。”

sents.en: Quotas get action: they "open the way to equality and they break through the glass ceiling," according to Reding, a result seen in France and other countries with legally binding provisions on placing women in top business positions.
sents.cn: 配额能够促成行动：用雷丁的话说，它们“为平等铺平道路，并打破玻璃天花板”；法国以及其他对女性进入企业高层设有法律约束性规定的国家已经出现了这种效果。

analysis.trunk: 主干：Quotas get action: they open the way ... and break through ...
structure: 冒号前总述：Quotas get action
冒号后并列谓语：open the way to equality and break through the glass ceiling
插入来源状语：according to Reding
同位语总结：a result
过去分词短语作后置定语：seen in France and other countries with legally binding provisions ...
analysis.logic: 先用简短判断说明配额能推动行动，再引用雷丁概括其两种效果，最后以法国等国的制度实践作证。
notes: get action 意为“促成实际行动”。
glass ceiling 是阻碍女性等群体晋升的“玻璃天花板”。
a result 指代前面“打开平等道路并突破障碍”这一整体结果。

sents.en: I understand Reding's reluctance – and her frustration.
sents.cn: 我理解雷丁的不情愿，也理解她的挫败感。

sents.en: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.
sents.cn: 我也不喜欢配额；它违背了我对任人唯贤制度的信念，也就是由有能力者进行管理。

sents.en: But, when one considers the obstacles to achieving the meritocratic ideal, it does look as if a fairer world must be temporarily ordered.
sents.cn: 但是，当人们考虑到实现任人唯贤理想所面临的障碍时，似乎确实必须暂时通过强制规定来建立一个更公平的世界。

sents.en: After all, four decades of evidence has now shown that corporations in Europe as well as the US are evading the meritocratic hiring and promotion of women to top positions – no matter how much "soft pressure" is put upon them.
sents.cn: 毕竟，四十年来的证据已经表明，欧洲和美国的企业一直在回避以能力为标准聘用和提拔女性进入高层职位，无论施加多少“软性压力”都无济于事。

sents.en: When women do break through to the summit of corporate power – as, for example, Sheryl Sandberg recently did at Facebook – they attract massive attention precisely because they remain the exception to the rule.
sents.cn: 当女性确实突破障碍、登上企业权力顶峰时——例如谢丽尔·桑德伯格最近在脸书所做到的那样——她们会受到极大关注，恰恰因为她们仍然只是规则之外的例外。

sents.en: If appropriate public policies were in place to help all women – whether CEOs or their children's caregivers – and all families, Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person living in a more just society.
sents.cn: 如果已有适当的公共政策来帮助所有女性——无论是首席执行官，还是照顾她们孩子的人——以及所有家庭，那么在一个更加公正的社会里，桑德伯格就不会比任何其他能力出众的人更具新闻价值。

analysis.trunk: 虚拟条件主干：If appropriate policies were in place ..., Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than ...
structure: 与现在事实相反的条件从句：If appropriate public policies were in place
不定式表目的：to help all women ... and all families
插入让步范围：whether CEOs or their children's caregivers
主句：Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person
现在分词短语作后置定语：living in a more just society
analysis.logic: 作者用虚拟条件句反推：如果制度已普遍支持女性和家庭，女性高管就不会因其性别而成为罕见新闻。
notes: were ... would be 是对当前未实现状态的虚拟。
no more ... than 表示“并不比……更……”。
whether A or B 在此强调政策应覆盖不同社会角色的女性。

sents.en: What would you do with $590m?
sents.cn: 如果有5.9亿美元，你会怎么花？

sents.en: This is now a question for Gloria MacKenzie, an 84-year-old widow who recently emerged from her small, tin-roofed house in Florida to collect the biggest undivided lottery jackpot in history.
sents.cn: 如今，这个问题摆在格洛丽亚·麦肯齐面前。这位84岁的寡妇最近走出佛罗里达州那座铁皮屋顶的小房子，领取了历史上金额最大的单人彩票头奖。

sents.en: If she hopes her new-found fortune will yield lasting feelings of fulfilment, she could do worse than read Happy Money by Elizabeth Dunn and Michael Norton.
sents.cn: 如果她希望这笔新获得的财富带来持久的满足感，那么读一读伊丽莎白·邓恩和迈克尔·诺顿合著的《快乐金钱》会是个很好的选择。

sents.en: These two academics use an array of behavioral research to show that the most rewarding ways to spend money can be counterintuitive.
sents.cn: 这两位学者借助大量行为研究说明，最有回报的花钱方式可能与直觉相反。

sents.en: Fantasies of great wealth often involve visions of fancy cars and extravagant homes.
sents.cn: 人们幻想巨额财富时，常会想到豪华汽车和奢华住宅。

sents.en: Yet satisfaction with these material purchases wears off fairly quickly.
sents.cn: 然而，这些物质消费带来的满足感消退得相当快。

sents.en: What was once exciting and new becomes old-hat; regret creeps in.
sents.cn: 曾经令人兴奋而新鲜的东西会变得陈旧乏味，懊悔也会悄然滋生。

sents.en: It is far better to spend money on experiences, say Ms Dunn and Mr Norton, like interesting trips, unique meals or even going to the cinema.
sents.cn: 邓恩女士和诺顿先生认为，把钱花在体验上要好得多，例如有趣的旅行、独特的餐饮，甚至只是去看电影。

analysis.trunk: 主干：It is far better to spend money on experiences
structure: It 作形式主语，真正主语是不定式：to spend money on experiences
比较评价：far better，far 强化比较级
插入语：say Ms Dunn and Mr Norton
举例同位说明：like interesting trips, unique meals or even going to the cinema
analysis.logic: 句子把研究结论先明确提出，再用插入语标明观点来源，并列举三类体验型消费。
notes: spend money on 表示“把钱花在……上”。
say ... 是报道式倒装插入语，不是句子主干。
like 在此表示“例如”，后列名词短语和动名词短语。

sents.en: These purchases often become more valuable with time – as stories or memories – particularly if they involve feeling more connected to others.
sents.cn: 这些消费往往会随着时间推移而变得更有价值，因为它们会化为故事或回忆；如果这些经历能让人与他人联系得更紧密，尤其如此。

sents.en: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most "happiness bang for your buck."
sents.cn: 这本篇幅不长的书充满实用建议，既能帮助工薪族，也能帮助彩票赢家，让每一块钱都换来尽可能多的幸福。

sents.en: It seems most people would be better off if they could shorten their commutes to work, spend more time with friends and family and less of it watching television (something the average American spends a whopping two months a year doing, and is hardly jollier for it).
sents.cn: 如果人们能缩短通勤时间，多陪伴亲友，少看些电视，似乎大多数人都会过得更好；普通美国人每年竟花整整两个月看电视，却几乎没有因此更快乐。

analysis.trunk: 主干：It seems (that) most people would be better off if ...
structure: It seems 后省略连接词 that，后接主语从句内容
条件从句(if)：if they could shorten ..., spend more time ... and less of it watching television
三个并列动作：shorten / spend more / (spend) less
括号内同位说明 something，指 watching television
定语从句〔省略 that，修饰 something〕：the average American spends ... doing, and is hardly jollier for it
analysis.logic: 主句提出改善幸福感的条件，括号则用美国人的看电视时长与低幸福收益形成反讽式证据。
notes: be better off 表示“处境更好”。
less of it 中 it 指 time。
spend time doing 是固定结构；be jollier for it 表示“因此更快乐”。

sents.en: Buying gifts or giving to charity is often more pleasurable than purchasing things for oneself, and luxuries are most enjoyable when they are consumed sparingly.
sents.cn: 购买礼物或捐助慈善通常比给自己买东西更令人愉快，而奢侈品只有偶尔享用时最能带来乐趣。

sents.en: This is apparently the reason McDonald's restricts the availability of its popular McRib – a marketing trick that has turned the pork sandwich into an object of obsession.
sents.cn: 这显然正是麦当劳限制其热门产品“烤汁猪排堡”供应时间的原因；这一营销手段把这种猪肉三明治变成了人们痴迷的对象。

sents.en: Readers of Happy Money are clearly a privileged lot, anxious about fulfilment, not hunger.
sents.cn: 《快乐金钱》的读者显然是一群生活优渥的人；他们焦虑的是满足感，而不是饥饿。

sents.en: Money may not quite buy happiness, but people in wealthier countries are generally happier than those in poor ones.
sents.cn: 金钱或许不能完全买来幸福，但富裕国家的人总体上确实比贫穷国家的人更快乐。

sents.en: Yet the link between feeling good and spending money on others can be seen among rich and poor people around the world, and scarcity enhances the pleasure of most things for most people.
sents.cn: 不过，无论贫富，在世界各地都能看到为他人花钱与良好感受之间的联系；而且对大多数人而言，稀缺会增强大多数事物带来的愉悦。

analysis.trunk: 并列主干：the link ... can be seen ..., and scarcity enhances the pleasure ...
structure: 主句①主语：the link between feeling good and spending money on others
被动谓语：can be seen among rich and poor people around the world
并列主句②(and)：scarcity enhances the pleasure of most things
范围状语：for most people
analysis.logic: 句子并列给出两项跨人群规律：利他消费与良好感受相关，稀缺性则会提升享用事物的愉悦。
notes: between A and B 连接 feeling 与 spending 两个动名词结构。
among rich and poor people 强调该联系并不限于富人。
scarcity 在此指供应有限或不常获得。

sents.en: Not everyone will agree with the authors' policy ideas, which range from mandating more holiday time to reducing tax incentives for American homebuyers.
sents.cn: 并非所有人都会赞同作者的政策主张，这些主张从强制增加休假时间，到减少美国购房者的税收优惠，不一而足。

sents.en: But most people will come away from this book believing it was money well spent.
sents.cn: 但多数人读完这本书时都会相信，买它的钱花得值。

sents.en: An article in Scientific American has pointed out that empirical research says that, actually, you think you're more beautiful than you are.
sents.cn: 《科学美国人》的一篇文章指出，实证研究表明，实际上你认为自己比真实的自己更漂亮。

sents.en: We have a deep-seated need to feel good about ourselves and we naturally employ a number of self-enhancing strategies to achieve this.
sents.cn: 我们内心深处需要对自己感觉良好，因此会自然而然地采用多种自我美化策略来达到这一目的。

sents.en: Social psychologists have amassed oceans of research into what they call the "above average effect", or "illusory superiority", and shown that, for example, 70% of us rate ourselves as above average in leadership, 93% in driving and 85% at getting on well with others – all obviously statistical impossibilities.
sents.cn: 社会心理学家对所谓的“高于平均效应”或“虚幻优越感”积累了海量研究，并发现，例如，70%的人认为自己的领导力高于平均水平，93%的人认为自己的驾驶水平高于平均水平，85%的人认为自己比一般人更善于与人相处——这些在统计上显然都不可能。

analysis.trunk: 并列谓语主干：Social psychologists have amassed ... and shown that ...
structure: 谓语①：have amassed oceans of research into what they call ...
what 宾语从句：what they call the 'above average effect' or 'illusory superiority'
谓语②(and)：(have) shown that ...
that 从句列举三项自评比例：70% ... leadership, 93% ... driving, 85% ... getting on well with others
破折号总结：all obviously statistical impossibilities
analysis.logic: 先说明研究积累，再用三组不可能同时成立的高比例，实证展示人们普遍高估自己的“虚幻优越感”。
notes: what = the phenomenon that，同时作 call 的宾语。
rate ourselves as above average 意为“把自己评为高于平均水平”。
oceans of 是夸张表达，意为“海量的”。

sents.en: We rose-tint our memories and put ourselves into self-affirming situations.
sents.cn: 我们会给记忆蒙上一层玫瑰色，并把自己置于能够肯定自我的情境中。

sents.en: We become defensive when criticised, and apply negative stereotypes to others to boost our own esteem.
sents.cn: 受到批评时，我们会采取防御姿态，还会把负面刻板印象加在别人身上，以提升自尊。

sents.en: We stalk around thinking we're hot stuff.
sents.cn: 我们昂首阔步，觉得自己魅力非凡。

sents.en: Psychologist and behavioural scientist Nicholas Epley oversaw a key study into self-enhancement and attractiveness.
sents.cn: 心理学家兼行为科学家尼古拉斯·埃普利主持了一项有关自我美化与外貌吸引力的重要研究。

sents.en: Rather than have people simply rate their beauty compared with others, he asked them to identify an original photograph of themselves from a lineup including versions that had been altered to appear more and less attractive.
sents.cn: 他没有让人们简单地把自己的外貌与他人比较并评分，而是让他们从一组照片中找出自己的原始照片；这组照片还包括经过处理、显得更漂亮或更不漂亮的版本。

analysis.trunk: 主干：he asked them to identify an original photograph of themselves
structure: 取舍状语：Rather than have people simply rate their beauty compared with others
主句结构：ask + 宾语 them + 不定式 to identify
来源范围：from a lineup
现在分词短语修饰 lineup：including versions
定语从句(that，修饰 versions)：that had been altered to appear more and less attractive
analysis.logic: 研究设计避开主观打分，改用看似更自动的照片识别任务，以检验受试者是否真的把美化后的形象当作自己。
notes: rather than 后与主句形成“不是……而是……”的选择。
have people rate 中 have 是使役动词。
had been altered 是过去完成时的被动，表示照片在识别前已被处理。

sents.en: Visual recognition, reads the study, is "an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation".
sents.cn: 研究报告写道，视觉识别是“一种自动的心理过程，它迅速而直觉地发生，几乎不需要或完全不需要明显的有意识思考”。

sents.en: If the subjects quickly chose a falsely flattering image – which most did – they genuinely believed it was really how they looked.
sents.cn: 如果受试者迅速选中一张经过虚假美化的照片——大多数人确实如此——那么他们是真的相信自己原本就长成那样。

sents.en: Epley found no significant gender difference in responses.
sents.cn: 埃普利发现，不同性别的反应并无显著差异。

sents.en: Nor was there any evidence that those who self-enhanced the most (that is, the participants who thought the most positively doctored pictures were real) were doing so to make up for profound insecurities.
sents.cn: 也没有证据表明，自我美化程度最高的人——也就是把美化程度最高的照片当成真实照片的参与者——这样做是为了弥补深层的不安全感。

sents.en: In fact, those who thought that the images higher up the attractiveness scale were real directly corresponded with those who showed other markers for having higher self-esteem.
sents.cn: 事实上，把吸引力等级中更漂亮的照片当成真实照片的人，恰好也是在其他指标上表现出较高自尊的人。

analysis.trunk: 主干：those ... directly corresponded with those ...
structure: 主语：those who thought that the images higher up the attractiveness scale were real
定语从句①(who，修饰前一 those)：who thought that ...
thought 的宾语从句(that)：the images ... were real
谓语：directly corresponded with
宾语：those who showed other markers for having higher self-esteem；who 引导定语从句
analysis.logic: 两组“those”其实指同一趋势：越把更美化照片认作真实自我的人，也越表现出其他高自尊指标。
notes: higher up the attractiveness scale 是后置修饰 images。
correspond with 在此表示“与……相对应”。
markers for having higher self-esteem 指显示较高自尊的其他指标。

sents.en: "I don't think the findings that we have are any evidence of personal delusion," says Epley.
sents.cn: 埃普利说：“我不认为我们的研究结果能证明个人存在自我欺骗。”

sents.en: "It's a reflection simply of people generally thinking well of themselves."
sents.cn: “它只不过反映出，人们通常对自己评价良好。”

sents.en: If you are depressed, you won't be self-enhancing.
sents.cn: 如果你处于抑郁状态，就不会进行自我美化。

sents.en: Knowing the results of Epley's study, it makes sense that many people hate photographs of themselves viscerally – on one level, they don't even recognise the person in the picture as themselves.
sents.cn: 了解埃普利的研究结果后，就不难理解为什么许多人会本能地讨厌自己的照片：在某种层面上，他们甚至认不出照片里的人就是自己。

sents.en: Facebook, therefore, is a self-enhancer's paradise, where people can share only the most flattering photos, the cream of their wit, style, beauty, intellect and lifestyles.
sents.cn: 因此，脸书是自我美化者的天堂；人们可以只分享最上镜的照片，以及自己才智、风格、容貌、智力和生活方式中最精华的部分。

sents.en: It's not that people's profiles are dishonest, says Catalina Toma of Wisconsin-Madison University, "but they portray an idealised version of themselves."
sents.cn: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的卡塔利娜·托马说，人们的个人资料并非不诚实，“只是呈现了一个理想化的自己”。

sents.en: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution, but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries.
sents.cn: 人与机器对抗的概念至少和工业革命一样古老，但在经济衰退和脆弱复苏时期，人们往往最强烈地感受到这一现象。

sents.en: And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle.
sents.cn: 然而，如果以为我们眼下只是在经历繁荣—萧条周期中痛苦的一面，那就错了。

sents.en: Certain jobs have gone away for good, outmoded by machines.
sents.cn: 某些工作已经永远消失，被机器淘汰了。

sents.en: Since technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs, this phenomenon will continue to restructure our economy in ways we cannot immediately foresee.
sents.cn: 由于技术对吞噬人类工作岗位有着永不满足的胃口，这一现象将继续以我们一时无法预见的方式重塑经济。

analysis.trunk: 主干：this phenomenon will continue to restructure our economy
structure: 原因状语从句(Since)：Since technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs
主句谓语：will continue to restructure
方式介词短语：in ways
定语从句〔省略 that，修饰 ways〕：we cannot immediately foresee
analysis.logic: Since 给出持续重构的动力——技术不断吞噬岗位；主句进一步强调这种重构方式目前难以预见。
notes: since 在此表示原因，不是“自从”。
have an appetite for 是比喻性表达，指强烈且持续的需求。
eat up human jobs 指技术大量取代就业岗位。

sents.en: When there is rapid improvement in the price and performance of technology, jobs that were once thought to be immune from automation suddenly become threatened.
sents.cn: 当技术的价格和性能迅速改善时，曾被认为不会受到自动化影响的工作会突然面临威胁。

sents.en: This argument has attracted a lot of attention, via the success of the book Race Against the Machine, by Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee, who both hail from MIT's Center for Digital Business.
sents.cn: 埃里克·布莱恩约尔松和安德鲁·麦卡菲合著的《与机器赛跑》大获成功，使这一论点受到广泛关注；两位作者都来自麻省理工学院数字商业中心。

analysis.trunk: 主干：This argument has attracted a lot of attention
structure: 方式/原因补充：via the success of the book Race Against the Machine
同位作者信息：by Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee
非限制性定语从句(who，修饰两位作者)：who both hail from MIT's Center for Digital Business
analysis.logic: 句子先说明论点受到关注，再把关注度归因于相关著作的成功，最后补充两位作者的机构背景以增强权威性。
notes: via 表示“通过、凭借”。
by ... 说明书的作者。
hail from 在此意为“来自”，并非“向……欢呼”。

sents.en: This is a powerful argument, and a scary one.
sents.cn: 这是一个有力的论点，也是一个令人恐惧的论点。

sents.en: And yet, John Hagel, author of The Power of Pull and other books, says Brynjolfsson and McAfee miss the reason why these jobs are so vulnerable to technology in the first place.
sents.cn: 然而，《拉动力》等书的作者约翰·哈格尔认为，布莱恩约尔松和麦卡菲忽略了这些工作最初为何如此容易受到技术冲击。

sents.en: Hagel says we have designed jobs in the U.S. that tend to be "tightly scripted" and "highly standardized" ones that leave no room for "individual initiative or creativity".
sents.cn: 哈格尔说，我们在美国设计出的工作往往“按严格脚本执行”且“高度标准化”，不给“个人主动性或创造力”留下任何空间。

analysis.trunk: 宾语从句主干：Hagel says (that) we have designed jobs in the U.S.
structure: says 后省略连接词 that
定语从句①(that，修饰 jobs)：that tend to be 'tightly scripted' and 'highly standardized' ones
并列表语：tightly scripted / highly standardized
定语从句②(that，修饰 ones/jobs)：that leave no room for individual initiative or creativity
analysis.logic: 哈格尔把岗位易被机器替代的根源归于岗位设计本身：流程被严密规定并高度标准化，排除了人的主动性和创造性。
notes: scripted 在此不是“写了剧本”，而是“按预设流程执行”。
leave no room for 表示“不给……留下空间”。
ones 回指 jobs，用于承接后面的定语从句。

sents.en: In short, these are the types of jobs that machines can perform much better at than human beings.
sents.cn: 简言之，机器完成这类工作的能力远胜于人类。

sents.en: That is how we have put a giant target sign on the backs of American workers, Hagel says.
sents.cn: 哈格尔说，正是这样，我们在美国劳动者背后放上了一个巨大的靶标。

sents.en: It's time to reinvent the formula for how work is conducted, since we are still relying on a very 20th century notion of work, Hagel says.
sents.cn: 哈格尔认为，我们仍依赖一种非常具有20世纪色彩的工作观念，因此现在该重新设计工作的运行方式了。

sents.en: In our rapidly changing economy, we more than ever need people in the workplace who can take initiative and exercise their imagination "to respond to unexpected events".
sents.cn: 在迅速变化的经济中，我们比以往任何时候都更需要能够主动行动、发挥想象力来“应对突发事件”的职场人士。

sents.en: That is not something machines are good at.
sents.cn: 这并不是机器擅长的事情。

sents.en: They are designed to perform very predictable activities.
sents.cn: 机器被设计用来执行高度可预测的活动。

sents.en: As Hagel notes, Brynjolfsson and McAfee indeed touched on this point in their book.
sents.cn: 正如哈格尔指出的，布莱恩约尔松和麦卡菲确实在书中谈到了这一点。

sents.en: We need to reframe race against the machine as race with the machine.
sents.cn: 我们需要把“与机器对抗的竞赛”重新表述为“与机器协作的竞赛”。

sents.en: In other words, we need to look at the ways in which machines can augment human labor rather than replace it.
sents.cn: 换言之，我们应当研究机器如何增强人类劳动，而不是取代人类劳动。

sents.en: So then the problem is not really about technology, but rather, "how do we innovate our institutions and our work practices?"
sents.cn: 因此，问题其实不在技术本身，而在于“我们该如何革新制度和工作实践？”

sents.en: When the government talks about infrastructure contributing to the economy the focus is usually on roads, railways, broadband and energy.
sents.cn: 政府谈到基础设施对经济的贡献时，关注点通常是公路、铁路、宽带和能源。

sents.en: Housing is seldom mentioned.
sents.cn: 住房很少被提及。

sents.en: Why is that?
sents.cn: 为什么会这样？

sents.en: To some extent the housing sector must shoulder the blame.
sents.cn: 在某种程度上，住房行业必须承担责任。

sents.en: We have not been good at communicating the real value that housing can contribute to economic growth.
sents.cn: 我们一直不善于说明住房能够为经济增长贡献的真正价值。

sents.en: Then there is the scale of the typical housing project.
sents.cn: 此外，还有普通住房项目规模较小的问题。

sents.en: It is hard to shove for attention among multibillion-pound infrastructure projects, so it is inevitable that the attention is focused elsewhere.
sents.cn: 在耗资数十亿英镑的基础设施项目中，住房项目很难争得关注，因此人们的注意力不可避免地投向别处。

sents.en: But perhaps the most significant reason is that the issue has always been so politically charged.
sents.cn: 但最重要的原因或许是，住房问题一直具有强烈的政治敏感性。

sents.en: Nevertheless, the affordable housing situation is desperate.
sents.cn: 尽管如此，经济适用房的形势已经十分严峻。

sents.en: Waiting lists increase all the time and we are simply not building enough new homes.
sents.cn: 等候名单不断变长，而我们新建的住房根本不够。

sents.en: The comprehensive spending review offers an opportunity for the government to help rectify this.
sents.cn: 全面支出审查为政府帮助纠正这一局面提供了机会。

sents.en: It needs to put historical prejudices to one side and take some steps to address our urgent housing need.
sents.cn: 政府需要把历史偏见搁在一边，采取一些措施来解决迫切的住房需求。

sents.en: There are some indications that it is preparing to do just that.
sents.cn: 有些迹象表明，政府正准备这样做。

sents.en: The communities minister, Don Foster, has hinted that George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, may introduce more flexibility to the current cap on the amount that local authorities can borrow against their housing stock debt.
sents.cn: 社区事务大臣唐·福斯特暗示，财政大臣乔治·奥斯本可能会提高现行上限的灵活性；这一上限限制地方政府以其住房存量债务为基础所能借入的金额。

analysis.trunk: 主干：Don Foster has hinted that George Osborne may introduce more flexibility to the current cap
structure: 同位语①：The communities minister，说明 Don Foster 身份
宾语从句(that)：George Osborne ... may introduce more flexibility to the current cap
同位语②：Chancellor of the Exchequer，说明 George Osborne 身份
介词短语：on the amount
定语从句(that，修饰 amount)：that local authorities can borrow against their housing stock debt
analysis.logic: 句子通过两处同位语交代官员身份，再把政策变化具体限定为地方政府住房债务融资上限的灵活化。
notes: hint that 表示“暗示可能……”。
cap on the amount 指“金额上限”。
borrow against 表示以某项资产或债务安排为依据融资。

sents.en: Evidence shows that 60,000 extra new homes could be built over the next five years if the cap were lifted, increasing GDP by 0.6%.
sents.cn: 证据表明，如果取消这一上限，未来五年可额外建成6万套新房，使国内生产总值增长0.6%。

analysis.trunk: 主干：Evidence shows that 60,000 extra new homes could be built
structure: 宾语从句(that)：60,000 extra new homes could be built over the next five years
条件状语从句(if)：if the cap were lifted
现在分词短语作结果状语：increasing GDP by 0.6%
analysis.logic: 本句用量化证据建立政策链条：取消借款上限→新增住房建设→GDP增长。
notes: could be built 是情态动词加被动语态。
lift the cap 表示“取消/解除上限”。
increasing 的逻辑主语是前面整个新增住房建设结果，而非 homes 本身。

sents.en: Ministers should also look at creating greater certainty in the rental environment, which would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues.
sents.cn: 大臣们还应考虑提高租赁环境的确定性，这将显著增强注册住房提供机构利用收入为新开发项目融资的能力。

sents.en: But it is not just down to the government.
sents.cn: 但这并不只是政府的责任。

sents.en: While these measures would be welcome in the short term, we must face up to the fact that the existing £4.5bn programme of grants to fund new affordable housing, set to expire in 2015, is unlikely to be extended beyond then.
sents.cn: 这些措施短期内会受到欢迎，但我们必须正视这样一个事实：现有45亿英镑的经济适用房建设拨款计划将在2015年到期，此后不太可能延长。

analysis.trunk: 主干：we must face up to the fact
structure: 让步状语从句(While)：While these measures would be welcome in the short term
主句：we must face up to the fact
同位语从句(that，解释 fact)：the existing £4.5bn programme ... is unlikely to be extended beyond then
介词短语修饰 programme：of grants to fund new affordable housing
过去分词短语作后置定语：set to expire in 2015
analysis.logic: 作者先承认短期措施有益，再用 while 转折，强调公共拨款计划到期且难以续期这一长期财政现实。
notes: face up to 表示“正视、勇敢面对”。
set to do 表示“预计/安排将……”。
beyond then 中 then 指2015年计划到期之时。

sents.en: The Labour party has recently announced that it will retain a large part of the coalition's spending plans if it returns to power.
sents.cn: 工党最近宣布，如果重新执政，将保留联合政府支出计划中的很大一部分。

sents.en: The housing sector needs to accept that we are very unlikely to ever return to the era of large-scale public grants.
sents.cn: 住房行业必须接受这样一个事实：我们极不可能再回到大规模公共拨款的时代。

sents.en: We need to adjust to this changing climate.
sents.cn: 我们需要适应这种正在变化的环境。

sents.en: While the government's commitment to long-term funding may have changed, the very pressing need for more affordable housing is real and is not going away.
sents.cn: 政府对长期资金支持的承诺或许已经改变，但增加经济适用房这一极其迫切的需求真实存在，而且不会消失。

sents.en: A new study suggests that contrary to most surveys, people are actually more stressed at home than at work.
sents.cn: 一项新研究表明，与多数调查的结论相反，人们实际上在家承受的压力比在工作场所更大。

sents.en: Researchers measured people's cortisol, which is a stress marker, while they were at work and while they were at home and found it higher at what is supposed to be a place of refuge.
sents.cn: 研究人员测量了受试者工作时和在家时的皮质醇水平；皮质醇是一项压力指标，而结果显示，它在人们本应视为避风港的家中反而更高。

analysis.trunk: 并列谓语主干：Researchers measured people's cortisol ... and found it higher ...
structure: 非限制性定语从句(which，修饰 cortisol)：which is a stress marker
两个并列时间状语从句：while they were at work / while they were at home
并列谓语：measured ... and found ...
宾语补足结构：found it higher
介词宾语从句(what)：at what is supposed to be a place of refuge
analysis.logic: 研究在工作与家庭两种场景测量同一压力指标，结果却发现本应是避风港的家中数值更高。
notes: it 指 cortisol 的水平。
find + 宾语 + 形容词 是宾补结构。
what = the place that；be supposed to 表示“按理应当”。

sents.en: "Further contradicting conventional wisdom, we found that women as well as men have lower levels of stress at work than at home," writes one of the researchers, Sarah Damaske.
sents.cn: 研究人员之一莎拉·达马斯克写道：“更有悖于传统看法的是，我们发现无论女性还是男性，在工作场所的压力水平都低于在家时。”

sents.en: In fact women even say they feel better at work, she notes.
sents.cn: 她指出，事实上女性甚至表示自己在工作时感觉更好。

sents.en: "It is men, not women, who report being happier at home than at work."
sents.cn: “报告称在家比在工作场所更快乐的是男性，而不是女性。”

sents.en: Another surprise is that the findings hold true for both those with children and without, but more so for nonparents.
sents.cn: 另一个出人意料之处是，无论有没有孩子，这些结论都成立，只是对没有孩子的人表现得更明显。

sents.en: This is why people who work outside the home have better health.
sents.cn: 这就是在外工作的人健康状况更好的原因。

sents.en: What the study doesn't measure is whether people are still doing work when they're at home, whether it is household work or work brought home from the office.
sents.cn: 这项研究没有衡量的是，人们回到家后是否仍在工作，无论做的是家务，还是从办公室带回来的工作。

sents.en: For many men, the end of the workday is a time to kick back.
sents.cn: 对许多男性而言，下班意味着可以放松休息。

sents.en: For women who stay home, they never get to leave the office.
sents.cn: 对于留在家中的女性来说，她们从来没有机会离开“办公室”。

sents.en: And for women who work outside the home, they often are playing catch-up-with-household tasks.
sents.cn: 而对在外工作的女性来说，她们回家后往往还要赶着补做家务。

sents.en: With the blurring of roles, and the fact that the home front lags well behind the workplace in making adjustments for working women, it's not surprising that women are more stressed at home.
sents.cn: 由于工作与家庭角色的界线日益模糊，而且家庭在为职业女性作出调整方面远远落后于职场，女性在家承受更大压力也就不足为奇。

analysis.trunk: 主干：it's not surprising that women are more stressed at home
structure: 句首 with 复合背景①：With the blurring of roles
并列背景②：and the fact
同位语从句(that，解释 fact)：that the home front lags well behind the workplace ...
现在分词短语：in making adjustments for working women
it 作形式主语；真正主语为 that women are more stressed at home
analysis.logic: 句子把家庭压力归因于两层背景：角色边界模糊，以及家庭制度对职业女性的适应远落后于职场。
notes: home front 在此指家庭生活这一面。
lag behind ... in doing 表示“在某方面落后于……”。
working women 指职业女性，不是“正在工作的女性”这一临时状态。

sents.en: But it's not just a gender thing.
sents.cn: 但这并不只是性别问题。

sents.en: At work, people pretty much know what they're supposed to be doing: working, making money, doing the tasks they have to do in order to draw an income.
sents.cn: 在工作中，人们大体知道自己该做什么：工作、挣钱，并完成为了获得收入而必须完成的任务。

sents.en: The bargain is very pure: Employee puts in hours of physical or mental labor and employee draws out life-sustaining moola.
sents.cn: 这笔交换十分直接：雇员投入若干小时的体力或脑力劳动，再领取维持生活的钱。

sents.en: On the home front, however, people have no such clarity.
sents.cn: 然而，在家庭这一边，人们并没有这样的清晰分工。

sents.en: Rare is the household in which the division of labor is so clinically and methodically laid out.
sents.cn: 很少有家庭能把劳动分工安排得如此精确而有条理。

sents.en: There are a lot of tasks to be done, there are inadequate rewards for most of them.
sents.cn: 需要完成的任务很多，但其中大多数任务得到的回报都不足。

sents.en: Your home colleagues – your family – have no clear rewards for their labor; they need to be talked into it, or if they're teenagers, threatened with complete removal of all electronic devices.
sents.cn: 你在家里的同事——也就是家人——劳动时没有明确回报；你必须劝他们去做，或者如果他们是青少年，就威胁要没收全部电子设备。

analysis.trunk: 主干：Your home colleagues have no clear rewards for their labor
structure: 破折号同位语：your family，解释 home colleagues
分号连接后续结果：they need to be talked into it
被动结构：need to be talked into it
选择并列(or)：or ... (need to be) threatened with complete removal ...
条件插入(if)：if they're teenagers
analysis.logic: 作者把家人比作同事，说明家庭协作缺乏明确激励，只能靠劝说，甚至用没收电子设备来威胁青少年。
notes: talk someone into something 表示“说服某人做某事”；被动后施事省略。
it 指参与家务劳动。
threaten someone with something 表示“以某事威胁某人”。

sents.en: Plus, they're your family.
sents.cn: 而且，他们是你的家人。

sents.en: You cannot fire your family.
sents.cn: 你不能解雇自己的家人。

sents.en: You never really get to go home from home.
sents.cn: 你永远无法真正从“家”这份工作中下班回家。

sents.en: So it's not surprising that people are more stressed at home.
sents.cn: 所以，人们在家压力更大并不奇怪。

sents.en: Not only are the tasks apparently infinite, the co-workers are much harder to motivate.
sents.cn: 不仅任务似乎无穷无尽，“同事”也更难调动积极性。

sents.en: For years, studies have found that first-generation college students – those who do not have a parent with a college degree – lag other students on a range of education achievement factors.
sents.cn: 多年来，研究一直发现，第一代大学生——也就是父母都没有大学学位的学生——在多项教育成就指标上落后于其他学生。

sents.en: Their grades are lower and their dropout rates are higher.
sents.cn: 他们的成绩更低，退学率更高。

sents.en: But since such students are most likely to advance economically if they succeed in higher education, colleges and universities have pushed for decades to recruit more of them.
sents.cn: 但由于这些学生一旦在高等教育中取得成功，最有可能实现经济地位提升，各学院和大学几十年来一直努力招收更多第一代大学生。

sents.en: This has created "a paradox" in that recruiting first-generation students, but then watching many of them fail, means that higher education has "continued to reproduce and widen, rather than close" an achievement gap based on social class, according to the depressing beginning of a paper forthcoming in the journal Psychological Science.
sents.cn: 即将发表于《心理科学》期刊的一篇论文在令人沮丧的开头指出，这造成了一个“悖论”：招收第一代大学生后却眼看许多人失败，意味着高等教育“没有缩小，反而继续复制并扩大”由社会阶层造成的成就差距。

analysis.trunk: 主干：This has created 'a paradox'
structure: 解释结构(in that)：in that recruiting first-generation students, but then watching many of them fail, means that ...
动名词并列主语：recruiting ... but then watching ...
means 的宾语从句(that)：higher education has continued to reproduce and widen ... an achievement gap
插入对比：rather than close
来源状语：according to the depressing beginning of a paper forthcoming ...
analysis.logic: 悖论在于，高校一边扩大第一代学生招生，一边未能帮助许多人成功，结果反而复制并扩大阶层成就差距。
notes: in that 用来具体解释 paradox，意为“因为/体现在”。
recruiting 与 watching 共同构成长主语，谓语用单数 means。
forthcoming 表示论文“即将发表”。

sents.en: But the article is actually quite optimistic, as it outlines a potential solution to this problem, suggesting that an approach (which involves a one-hour, next-to-no-cost program) can close 63 percent of the achievement gap (measured by such factors as grades) between first-generation and other students.
sents.cn: 不过，这篇论文实际上相当乐观，因为它提出了一种可能的解决办法：一项只需一小时、几乎没有成本的干预项目，可能缩小第一代大学生与其他学生之间63%的成就差距；该差距以成绩等因素衡量。

analysis.trunk: 主干：the article is actually quite optimistic
structure: 原因状语从句(as)：as it outlines a potential solution to this problem
现在分词短语作进一步说明：suggesting that an approach ... can close 63 percent of the achievement gap
定语从句(which，修饰 approach)：which involves a one-hour, next-to-no-cost program
过去分词括注：measured by such factors as grades，修饰 achievement gap
介词结构：between first-generation and other students
analysis.logic: 先以 optimistic 反转上一句的悲观基调，再逐层说明方案的低成本、短时长与可量化效果。
notes: as 在此表原因。
next-to-no-cost 表示“几乎零成本”。
suggesting 的逻辑主语是前面整件“文章提出方案”的事实。

sents.en: The authors of the paper are from different universities, and their findings are based on a study involving 147 students (who completed the project) at an unnamed private university.
sents.cn: 论文作者来自不同大学，其发现基于一项在某所未具名私立大学开展的研究，共有147名学生完成了项目。

sents.en: First generation was defined as not having a parent with a four-year college degree.
sents.cn: “第一代”被定义为父母均没有四年制大学学位。

sents.en: Most of the first-generation students (59.1 percent) were recipients of Pell Grants, a federal grant for undergraduates with financial need, while this was true only for 8.6 percent of the students with at least one parent with a four-year degree.
sents.cn: 第一代大学生中，大多数人（59.1%）领取佩尔助学金——这是一种面向有经济困难本科生的联邦助学金；而在父母至少一方拥有四年制大学学位的学生中，这一比例仅为8.6%。

analysis.trunk: 对比主干：Most of the first-generation students were recipients of Pell Grants, while this was true only for 8.6 percent ...
structure: 主句①：Most ... (59.1 percent) were recipients of Pell Grants
同位语解释：a federal grant for undergraduates with financial need
对比并列从句(while)：while this was true only for 8.6 percent of the students
介词宾语扩展：with at least one parent with a four-year degree
analysis.logic: 59.1%与8.6%的鲜明对比，用经济资助数据呈现第一代大学生更明显的阶层劣势。
notes: while 在此表示对比“而”，不是时间。
this was true 指“领取 Pell Grants”这一情况。
两个 with 分别表示“学生具有某父母条件”和“父母具有某学位”。

sents.en: Their thesis – that a relatively modest intervention could have a big impact – was based on the view that first-generation students may be most lacking not in potential but in practical knowledge about how to deal with the issues that face most college students.
sents.cn: 作者的论点是，一项相对温和的干预可能产生巨大影响；其依据是，第一代大学生最欠缺的或许不是潜力，而是处理大多数大学生都会遇到的问题所需的实用知识。

sents.en: They cite past research by several authors to show that this is the gap that must be narrowed to close the achievement gap.
sents.cn: 他们引用多位作者此前的研究来说明，要弥合成就差距，就必须缩小这一知识差距。

sents.en: Many first-generation students "struggle to navigate the middle-class culture of higher education, learn the 'rules of the game,' and take advantage of college resources," they write.
sents.cn: 他们写道，许多第一代大学生“难以适应高等教育中的中产阶级文化、学会‘游戏规则’并利用大学资源”。

sents.en: And this becomes more of a problem when colleges don't talk about the class advantages and disadvantages of different groups of students.
sents.cn: 当大学不谈论不同学生群体在阶层上的优势和劣势时，这一问题会变得更加严重。

sents.en: "Because US colleges and universities seldom acknowledge how social class can affect students' educational experiences, many first-generation students lack insight about why they are struggling and do not understand how students 'like them' can improve."
sents.cn: “由于美国各学院和大学很少承认社会阶层会如何影响学生的教育经历，许多第一代大学生不明白自己为何陷入困境，也不知道‘像他们这样的’学生该如何取得进步。”

sents.en: Even in traditional offices, "the lingua franca of corporate America has gotten much more emotional and much more right-brained than it was 20 years ago," said Harvard Business School professor Nancy Koehn.
sents.cn: 哈佛商学院教授南希·科恩说，即便在传统办公室中，“美国企业的通用语言也比20年前情绪化得多，也更偏重右脑思维”。

analysis.trunk: 引语主干：the lingua franca of corporate America has gotten much more emotional and much more right-brained
structure: 让步范围状语：Even in traditional offices
引语主语：the lingua franca of corporate America
并列表语比较：much more emotional and much more right-brained
比较从句(than)：than it was 20 years ago
引语后的信息来源：said Harvard Business School professor Nancy Koehn
analysis.logic: 句子借科恩的判断建立全文主题：企业语言在二十年间从理性、任务导向转向更情绪化、更重直觉的表达。
notes: lingua franca 原指通用语，此处指企业共同使用的话语体系。
get + 形容词表示状态变化。
right-brained 是比喻说法，指更直觉、情感化。

sents.en: She started spinning off examples.
sents.cn: 接着，她一连举出了许多例子。

sents.en: "If you and I parachuted back to Fortune 500 companies in 1990, we would see much less frequent use of terms like journey, mission, passion.
sents.cn: “如果你我空降回1990年的《财富》500强企业，就会发现‘历程’‘使命’‘激情’之类词语的使用频率低得多。”

sents.en: There were goals, there were strategies, there were objectives, but we didn't talk about energy; we didn't talk about passion."
sents.cn: “当时有目标、有战略、有具体任务，但我们不谈能量，也不谈激情。”

sents.en: Koehn pointed out that this new era of corporate vocabulary is very "team"-oriented – and not by coincidence.
sents.cn: 科恩指出，企业词汇的这个新时代非常强调“团队”导向，而这并非偶然。

sents.en: "Let's not forget sports – in male-dominated corporate America, it's still a big deal.
sents.cn: “别忘了体育运动——在男性主导的美国企业界，体育仍然很重要。”

sents.en: It's not explicitly conscious; it's the idea that I'm a coach, and you're my team, and we're in this together.
sents.cn: “这并非明确而有意识的想法，而是一种观念：我是教练，你们是我的团队，我们共同进退。”

sents.en: There are lots and lots of CEOs in very different companies, but most think of themselves as coaches and this is their team and they want to win."
sents.cn: “形形色色的公司里有许许多多首席执行官，但大多数人都把自己当成教练，把员工当成自己的团队，并且想要获胜。”

sents.en: These terms are also intended to infuse work with meaning – and, as Rakesh Khurana, another professor, points out, increase allegiance to the firm.
sents.cn: 这些词语还旨在为工作注入意义，并且正如另一位教授拉凯什·库拉纳指出的那样，提高员工对公司的忠诚度。

sents.en: "You have the importation of terminology that historically used to be associated with non-profit organizations and religious organizations: terms like vision, values, passion, and purpose," said Khurana.
sents.cn: 库拉纳说：“这里引入了一些过去通常与非营利组织和宗教组织相联系的术语，比如愿景、价值观、激情和使命。”

sents.en: This new focus on personal fulfillment can help keep employees motivated amid increasingly loud debates over work-life balance.
sents.cn: 在围绕工作与生活平衡的争论日益喧嚣之际，这种对个人满足感的新关注有助于保持员工的工作动力。

sents.en: The "mommy wars" of the 1990s are still going on today, prompting arguments about why women still can't have it all and books like Sheryl Sandberg's Lean In, whose title has become a buzzword in its own right.
sents.cn: 20世纪90年代的“妈妈之战”如今仍在继续，引发了关于女性为何仍无法兼得一切的争论，也催生了谢丽尔·桑德伯格的《向前一步》等书；这本书的标题本身已经成了一个流行语。

analysis.trunk: 主干：The 'mommy wars' of the 1990s are still going on today
structure: 现在分词短语作结果/伴随：prompting arguments ... and books ...
并列宾语：arguments about ... / books like Sheryl Sandberg's Lean In
介词宾语从句(why)：why women still can't have it all
非限制性定语从句(whose，修饰 Lean In)：whose title has become a buzzword
状语：in its own right
analysis.logic: “妈妈之战”延续至今，并产生两类文化结果：关于女性能否兼得一切的争论，以及以《向前一步》为代表的畅销话语。
notes: have it all 指事业、家庭等“兼得一切”。
whose title 中 whose 指这本书。
in its own right 表示“凭自身、就其本身而言”。

sents.en: Terms like unplug, offline, life-hack, bandwidth, and capacity are all about setting boundaries between the office and the home.
sents.cn: “断开连接”“离线”“生活妙招”“带宽”和“容量”等词语，都围绕着如何在办公室与家庭之间划定界线。

sents.en: But if your work is your "passion," you'll be more likely to devote yourself to it, even if that means going home for dinner and then working long after the kids are in bed.
sents.cn: 但如果工作就是你的“激情”，你就更可能全身心投入，即使这意味着回家吃过晚饭后，还要在孩子们入睡很久以后继续工作。

sents.en: But this seems to be the irony of office speak: Everyone makes fun of it, but managers love it, companies depend on it, and regular people willingly absorb it.
sents.cn: 然而，这似乎正是办公室套话的讽刺之处：人人都拿它开玩笑，管理者却喜爱它，公司依赖它，普通人也心甘情愿地把它吸收进自己的语言。

sents.en: As a linguist once said, "You can get people to think it's nonsense at the same time that you buy into it."
sents.cn: 正如一位语言学家曾说：“你可以让人们一边认为它是胡说八道，一边又接受并相信它。”

sents.en: In a workplace that's fundamentally indifferent to your life and its meaning, office speak can help you figure out how you relate to your work – and how your work defines who you are.
sents.cn: 在一个从根本上并不关心你的生活及其意义的职场中，办公室套话能帮助你弄清自己与工作的关系，也能帮助你理解工作如何定义了你是谁。

analysis.trunk: 主干：office speak can help you figure out A and B
structure: 地点背景：In a workplace
定语从句(that，修饰 workplace)：that's fundamentally indifferent to your life and its meaning
help + 宾语 + 动词原形：help you figure out
宾语从句①(how)：how you relate to your work
并列宾语从句②(and how)：how your work defines who you are
defines 的宾语从句(who)：who you are
analysis.logic: 在组织本身不提供人生意义的前提下，办公室话语反而帮助个人解释自己与工作的关系，并借工作建构身份。
notes: be indifferent to 表示“对……漠不关心”。
relate to 在此指“与……形成何种关系”。
who you are 不是疑问句，而是名词性从句。

sents.en: Many people talked of the 288,000 new jobs the Labor Department reported for June, along with the drop in the unemployment rate to 6.1 percent, as good news.
sents.cn: 许多人把劳工部报告的6月份新增28.8万个工作岗位，以及失业率降至6.1%，视为好消息。

sents.en: And they were right.
sents.cn: 他们的看法是对的。

sents.en: For now it appears the economy is creating jobs at a decent pace.
sents.cn: 目前看来，经济正在以不错的速度创造就业岗位。

sents.en: We still have a long way to go to get back to full employment, but at least we are now finally moving forward at a faster pace.
sents.cn: 我们距离恢复充分就业仍有很长的路要走，但至少现在终于在以更快的速度前进。

sents.en: However, there is another important part of the jobs picture that was largely overlooked.
sents.cn: 然而，就业图景中还有另一个重要部分在很大程度上被忽视了。

sents.en: There was a big jump in the number of people who report voluntarily working part-time.
sents.cn: 自愿从事兼职工作的人数大幅增加。

sents.en: This figure is now 830,000 (4.4 percent) above its year ago level.
sents.cn: 这一数字目前比一年前高出83万人，即增长4.4%。

sents.en: Before explaining the connection to the Obamacare, it is worth making an important distinction.
sents.cn: 在说明这与“奥巴马医改”的联系之前，有必要作出一个重要区分。

sents.en: Many people who work part-time jobs actually want full-time jobs.
sents.cn: 许多从事兼职工作的人实际上想要全职工作。

sents.en: They take part-time work because this is all they can get.
sents.cn: 他们接受兼职，只是因为只能找到这样的工作。

sents.en: An increase in involuntary part-time work is evidence of weakness in the labor market and it means that many people will be having a very hard time making ends meet.
sents.cn: 非自愿兼职增加表明劳动力市场疲弱，也意味着许多人将很难维持收支平衡。

analysis.trunk: 并列主干：An increase ... is evidence ..., and it means that ...
structure: 主语：An increase in involuntary part-time work
系表结构①：is evidence of weakness in the labor market
并列分句②(and)：it means that ...
宾语从句(that)：many people will be having a very hard time making ends meet
analysis.logic: 句子把非自愿兼职增加解释为双重警报：宏观上说明劳动力市场疲弱，微观上意味着个人收支困难。
notes: it 回指 An increase in involuntary part-time work。
have a hard time doing 表示“做某事很困难”。
make ends meet 表示“维持收支平衡”。

sents.en: There was an increase in involuntary part-time in June, but the general direction has been down.
sents.cn: 6月份非自愿兼职人数有所增加，但总体趋势一直向下。

sents.en: Involuntary part-time employment is still far higher than before the recession, but it is down by 640,000 (7.9 percent) from its year ago level.
sents.cn: 非自愿兼职就业人数仍远高于经济衰退前的水平，但已经比一年前减少64万人，即下降7.9%。

sents.en: We know the difference between voluntary and involuntary part-time employment because people tell us.
sents.cn: 我们之所以知道自愿兼职与非自愿兼职的区别，是因为人们会亲口告诉调查人员。

sents.en: The survey used by the Labor Department asks people if they worked less than 35 hours in the reference week.
sents.cn: 劳工部采用的调查会询问受访者在调查所指的那一周是否工作不足35小时。

sents.en: If the answer is "yes," they are classified as working part-time.
sents.cn: 如果回答“是”，他们就被归类为兼职工作者。

sents.en: The survey then asks whether they worked less than 35 hours in that week because they wanted to work less than full time or because they had no choice.
sents.cn: 随后，调查会询问他们那一周工作不足35小时，是因为自己想少于全职工时，还是因为别无选择。

analysis.trunk: 主干：The survey then asks whether A or B
structure: whether 引导宾语从句：whether they worked less than 35 hours ... because ... or because ...
时间限定：in that week
原因分支①：because they wanted to work less than full time
原因分支②：or because they had no choice
analysis.logic: 调查以受访者陈述的原因划分兼职性质：主动减少工时属于自愿兼职，因无其他选择而减少则属于非自愿兼职。
notes: whether ... or ... 构成二选一。
less than full time 指少于全职工时。
have no choice 表示“别无选择”，后文据此完成分类。

sents.en: They are only classified as voluntary part-time workers if they tell the survey taker they chose to work less than 35 hours a week.
sents.cn: 只有当受访者告诉调查员自己主动选择每周工作不足35小时，他们才会被归类为自愿兼职工作者。

sents.en: The issue of voluntary part-time relates to Obamacare because one of the main purposes was to allow people to get insurance outside of employment.
sents.cn: 自愿兼职之所以与“奥巴马医改”有关，是因为这项改革的主要目的之一，就是让人们能够在雇佣关系之外获得医疗保险。

sents.en: For many people, especially those with serious health conditions or family members with serious health conditions, before Obamacare the only way to get insurance was through a job that provided health insurance.
sents.cn: 对许多人而言，尤其是自己或家人患有严重疾病的人，医改之前获得保险的唯一办法，是找到一份提供医疗保险的工作。

analysis.trunk: 主干：the only way to get insurance was through a job
structure: 范围状语：For many people
插入具体化：especially those with serious health conditions or family members with serious health conditions
时间状语：before Obamacare
主语中心：the only way；不定式后置定语：to get insurance
介词表途径：through a job
定语从句(that，修饰 job)：that provided health insurance
analysis.logic: 句子说明医改前“就业绑定保险”的现实，尤其突出患重病者及其家庭为获得保险而不得不依赖全职岗位。
notes: those 指 people。
with serious health conditions 可修饰本人，也在后半并列中修饰 family members。
through a job 表示“通过一份工作这一渠道”。

sents.en: However, Obamacare has allowed more than 12 million people to either get insurance through Medicaid or the exchanges.
sents.cn: 然而，“奥巴马医改”已经让超过1200万人能够通过医疗补助计划或保险交易平台获得保险。

sents.en: These are people who may previously have felt the need to get a full-time job that provided insurance in order to cover themselves and their families.
sents.cn: 这些人此前可能觉得，必须找到一份提供保险的全职工作，才能保障自己和家人。

sents.en: With Obamacare there is no longer a link between employment and insurance.
sents.cn: 有了“奥巴马医改”，就业与医疗保险之间不再存在必然联系。

sents.en: It's true that high-school coding classes aren't essential for learning computer science in college.
sents.cn: 诚然，高中的编程课并不是在大学学习计算机科学的必备条件。

sents.en: Students without experience can catch up after a few introductory courses, said Tom Cortina, the assistant dean at Carnegie Mellon's School of Computer Science.
sents.cn: 卡内基梅隆大学计算机科学学院副院长汤姆·科尔蒂纳说，没有相关经验的学生上过几门入门课程后也能赶上来。

sents.en: However, Cortina said, early exposure is beneficial.
sents.cn: 不过，科尔蒂纳表示，早期接触编程是有益的。

sents.en: When younger kids learn computer science, they learn that it's not just a confusing, endless string of letters and numbers - but a tool to build apps, or create artwork, or test hypotheses.
sents.cn: 年龄较小的孩子学习计算机科学时会明白，它不只是一串令人困惑、似乎无穷无尽的字母和数字，而是一种可以用来开发应用、创作艺术作品或检验假设的工具。

analysis.trunk: 主句：they learn that it is not just A but B（他们认识到，计算机科学不只是A，而是B）
structure: 时间状语从句(when)：When younger kids learn computer science
主句：they learn
└ 宾语从句(that)：that it's not just a confusing, endless string of letters and numbers - but a tool
└ 不定式并列作后置定语〔修饰 tool〕：to build apps, or create artwork, or test hypotheses
analysis.logic: when交代条件与时间；that从句用not just…but…纠正对计算机科学的误解；三个并列不定式说明工具的用途。
notes: not just A but B 表示“不只是A，而是B”。
build、create、test由or连接，结构平行。
hypothesis意为“假设”，复数为hypotheses。

sents.en: It's not as hard for them to transform their thought processes as it is for older students.
sents.cn: 与年龄较大的学生相比，他们转变思维方式并没有那么困难。

sents.en: Breaking down problems into bite-sized chunks and using code to solve them becomes normal.
sents.cn: 把问题分解成便于处理的小块，再用代码解决问题，会成为一种习惯。

sents.en: Giving more children this training could increase the number of people interested in the field and help fill the jobs gap, Cortina said.
sents.cn: 科尔蒂纳说，让更多孩子接受这种训练，可能会增加对该领域感兴趣的人数，并帮助填补人才缺口。

sents.en: Students also benefit from learning something about coding before they get to college, where introductory computer-science classes are packed to the brim, which can drive the less-experienced or -determined students away.
sents.cn: 学生在进入大学前先学一点编程也会受益；大学的计算机科学入门课常常人满为患，这可能把经验较少或意志不够坚定的学生拒之门外。

analysis.trunk: 主句：Students also benefit from learning something about coding（学生也会从先学一点编程中受益）
structure: 主句：Students also benefit from learning something about coding
└ 时间状语从句(before)：before they get to college
└ 非限制性定语从句(where，修饰 college)：where introductory computer-science classes are packed to the brim
└ 非限制性定语从句(which，指代前述拥挤情形)：which can drive the less-experienced or -determined students away
analysis.logic: 句子先给出“提前学编程有益”的结论，再用where说明大学入门课拥挤，并用which补充这一情况可能造成的后果。
notes: be packed to the brim意为“挤得满满当当、爆满”。
which在此指代前面整个“课程爆满”的事实，而非只指classes。
less-experienced or -determined中第二个连字符表示省略less，即less experienced or less determined。

sents.en: The Flatiron School, where people pay to learn programming, started as one of the many coding bootcamps that's become popular for adults looking for a career change.
sents.cn: 人们付费学习编程的弗莱铁伦学校，最初是众多编程训练营之一；这类训练营在希望转行的成年人中日益流行。

sents.en: The high-schoolers get the same curriculum, but "we try to gear lessons toward things they're interested in," said Victoria Friedman, an instructor.
sents.cn: 高中生学习同样的课程，但授课教师维多利亚·弗里德曼说：“我们会尽量让课程内容贴近他们感兴趣的事物。”

sents.en: For instance, one of the apps the students are developing suggests movies based on your mood.
sents.cn: 例如，学生正在开发的一款应用会根据你的心情推荐电影。

sents.en: The students in the Flatiron class probably won't drop out of high school and build the next Facebook.
sents.cn: 弗莱铁伦班上的学生大概不会辍学去创建下一个脸书。

sents.en: Programming languages have a quick turnover, so the "Ruby on Rails" language they learned may not even be relevant by the time they enter the job market.
sents.cn: 编程语言更新换代很快，因此等他们进入就业市场时，所学的“Ruby on Rails”语言甚至可能已经不再适用。

sents.en: But the skills they learn - how to think logically through a problem and organize the results - apply to any coding language, said Deborah Seehom, an education consultant for the state of North Carolina.
sents.cn: 不过，北卡罗来纳州教育顾问黛博拉·西霍恩说，他们学到的技能——如何围绕问题进行逻辑思考并整理结果——适用于任何编程语言。

sents.en: Indeed, the Flatiron students might not go into IT at all.
sents.cn: 事实上，弗莱铁伦的学生以后可能根本不会进入信息技术行业。

sents.en: But creating a future army of coders is not the sole purpose of the classes.
sents.cn: 但培养一支未来的程序员大军并不是这些课程的唯一目的。

sents.en: These kids are going to be surrounded by computers - in their pockets, in their offices, in their homes - for the rest of their lives.
sents.cn: 这些孩子的余生都将被计算机包围——口袋里、办公室里和家里，到处都是。

sents.en: The younger they learn how computers think, how to coax the machine into producing what they want - the earlier they learn that they have the power to do that - the better.
sents.cn: 他们越早学会计算机如何思考、如何诱导机器产出自己想要的结果，也就越早明白自己有能力做到这一点，因而越好。

analysis.trunk: 关联比较结构：The younger…, the earlier…, the better（越早……就越早……也就越好）
structure: 第一层the+比较级：The younger they learn
├ 宾语从句①(how)：how computers think
└ 宾语从句②(how)：how to coax the machine into producing what they want
└ 宾语从句(what)：what they want
第二层the+比较级：the earlier they learn
└ 宾语从句(that)：that they have the power to do that
结论：the better
analysis.logic: 连续使用the+比较级构成递进关系：越早理解计算机并学会操控机器，就越早意识到自身能力，结果也越有利。
notes: coax A into doing B意为“诱导/设法使A做B”。
how to coax是“疑问词+不定式”，与how computers think并列作learn的宾语。
最后的the better省略了完整主句，属于固定的比较级关联结构。

sents.en: Biologists estimate that as many as 2 million lesser prairie chickens - a kind of bird living on stretching grasslands - once lent red to the often grey landscape of the midwestern and southwestern United States.
sents.cn: 生物学家估计，曾经多达200万只小草原松鸡——一种生活在绵延草原上的鸟——为美国中西部和西南部时常灰暗的景观增添了一抹红色。

sents.en: But just some 22,000 birds remain today, occupying about 16% of the species' historic range.
sents.cn: 然而如今只剩约2.2万只，其栖息范围大约仅占该物种历史分布区的16%。

sents.en: The crash was a major reason the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) decided to formally list the bird as threatened.
sents.cn: 数量暴跌是美国鱼类及野生动物管理局决定正式把这种鸟列为“受威胁物种”的一个主要原因。

sents.en: "The lesser prairie chicken is in a desperate situation," said USFWS Director Daniel Ashe.
sents.cn: 该局局长丹尼尔·阿什说：“小草原松鸡的处境十分危急。”

sents.en: Some environmentalists, however, were disappointed.
sents.cn: 不过，一些环保人士感到失望。

sents.en: They had pushed the agency to designate the bird as "endangered," a status that gives federal officials greater regulatory power to crack down on threats.
sents.cn: 他们曾敦促该机构将这种鸟列为“濒危物种”；这一身份能赋予联邦官员更大的监管权，以严厉打击各种威胁。

sents.en: But Ashe and others argued that the "threatened" tag gave the federal government flexibility to try out new, potentially less confrontational conservation approaches.
sents.cn: 但阿什等人认为，“受威胁”这一标签使联邦政府可以灵活尝试新的、可能较少引发对抗的保护办法。

sents.en: In particular, they called for forging closer collaborations with western state governments, which are often uneasy with federal action, and with the private landowners who control an estimated 95% of the prairie chicken's habitat.
sents.cn: 具体而言，他们呼吁同往往对联邦行动心存不安的西部各州政府，以及控制着约95%小草原松鸡栖息地的私人土地所有者，建立更紧密的合作。

analysis.trunk: 主句：they called for forging closer collaborations（他们呼吁建立更紧密的合作）
structure: 状语：In particular
主句：they called for forging closer collaborations
├ 介词宾语①：with western state governments
│   └ 非限制性定语从句(which)：which are often uneasy with federal action
└ 介词宾语②：and with the private landowners
└ 定语从句(who)：who control an estimated 95% of the prairie chicken's habitat
analysis.logic: collaborations之后用两个with并列列出合作对象；两个定语从句分别解释州政府的顾虑和私人地主的重要性。
notes: call for doing表示“呼吁/要求做某事”。
be uneasy with表示“对……感到不安或有顾虑”。
an estimated 95%意为“估计约95%”。

sents.en: Under the plan, for example, the agency said it would not prosecute landowners or businesses that unintentionally kill, harm, or disturb the bird, as long as they had signed a range-wide management plan to restore prairie chicken habitat.
sents.cn: 例如，根据该计划，该机构表示，只要土地所有者或企业已经签署一项覆盖整个分布区、旨在恢复小草原松鸡栖息地的管理方案，就不会因其无意杀死、伤害或惊扰这种鸟而起诉他们。

analysis.trunk: 主句：the agency said it would not prosecute landowners or businesses（该机构称不会起诉土地所有者或企业）
structure: 状语：Under the plan, for example
主句：the agency said
└ 宾语从句〔省略that〕：it would not prosecute landowners or businesses
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 landowners or businesses)：that unintentionally kill, harm, or disturb the bird
条件状语从句(as long as)：as long as they had signed a range-wide management plan
└ 不定式作后置定语〔修饰 plan〕：to restore prairie chicken habitat
analysis.logic: 主句转述机构承诺；that从句限定不起诉的对象；as long as提出豁免起诉的前提条件。
notes: prosecute表示“起诉”，不是一般的“迫害”。
as long as在此表示条件“只要”。
range-wide指覆盖该物种整个分布范围。

sents.en: Negotiated by USFWS and the states, the plan requires individuals and businesses that damage habitat as part of their operations to pay into a fund to replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres of suitable habitat.
sents.cn: 该计划由美国鱼类及野生动物管理局与各州协商制定，要求在经营活动中破坏栖息地的个人和企业向基金缴款，以便每破坏一英亩土地，就用两英亩新的适宜栖息地加以补偿。

analysis.trunk: 主句：the plan requires individuals and businesses to pay into a fund（该计划要求个人和企业向基金缴款）
structure: 过去分词短语作状语：Negotiated by USFWS and the states
主句：the plan requires individuals and businesses to pay into a fund
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 individuals and businesses)：that damage habitat as part of their operations
└ 不定式作目的状语：to replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres of suitable habitat
└ 过去分词作后置定语：destroyed〔修饰 every acre〕
analysis.logic: 句首分词说明计划由谁协商制定；require A to do B给出义务；末尾不定式说明基金用途及二比一补偿规则。
notes: require sb to do sth表示“要求某人做某事”。
pay into a fund意为“向基金缴款”。
replace A with B表示“用B替代/补偿A”。

sents.en: The fund will also be used to compensate landowners who set aside habitat.
sents.cn: 这笔基金还将用于补偿那些划出土地作为栖息地的土地所有者。

sents.en: USFWS also set an interim goal of restoring prairie chicken populations to an annual average of 67,000 birds over the next 10 years.
sents.cn: 该局还设定了一个阶段性目标：未来十年把小草原松鸡种群恢复到年均6.7万只。

sents.en: And it gives the Western Association of Fish and Wildlife Agencies (WAFWA), a coalition of state agencies, the job of monitoring progress.
sents.cn: 该计划还把监督进展的任务交给了由各州机构组成的西部鱼类和野生动物管理机构协会。

sents.en: Overall, the idea is to let "states remain in the driver's seat for managing the species," Ashe said.
sents.cn: 阿什说，总体思路是让“各州继续在该物种的管理中掌握主导权”。

sents.en: Not everyone buys the win-win rhetoric.
sents.cn: 并非所有人都相信这种双赢说辞。

sents.en: Some Congress members are trying to block the plan, and at least a dozen industry groups, four states, and three environmental groups are challenging it in federal court.
sents.cn: 一些国会议员正试图阻止这项计划，至少十几个行业团体、四个州和三个环保组织也正在联邦法院对它提出质疑。

sents.en: Not surprisingly, industry groups and states generally argue it goes too far; environmentalists say it doesn't go far enough.
sents.cn: 不出所料，行业团体和各州通常认为计划做得过头了，而环保人士则说它做得还远远不够。

sents.en: "The federal government is giving responsibility for managing the bird to the same industries that are pushing it to extinction," says biologist Jay Lininger.
sents.cn: 生物学家杰伊·利宁格说：“联邦政府正把管理这种鸟的责任交给那些正在将它推向灭绝的行业。”

sents.en: That everyone's too busy these days is a cliché.
sents.cn: 如今人人都太忙，这已经是老生常谈。

sents.en: But one specific complaint is made especially mournfully: There's never any time to read.
sents.cn: 但有一种具体的抱怨说起来尤其令人伤感：根本没有时间读书。

sents.en: What makes the problem thornier is that the usual time-management techniques don't seem sufficient.
sents.cn: 让这个问题更加棘手的是，通常的时间管理技巧似乎并不足以解决它。

sents.en: The web's full of articles offering tips on making time to read: "Give up TV" or "Carry a book with you at all times."
sents.cn: 网上到处都是教人如何挤出时间阅读的文章，例如“别看电视”或“随身带一本书”。

sents.en: But in my experience, using such methods to free up the odd 30 minutes doesn't work.
sents.cn: 但依我的经验，靠这类办法腾出零散的30分钟并不起作用。

sents.en: Sit down to read and the flywheel of work-related thoughts keeps spinning - or else you're so exhausted that a challenging book's the last thing you need.
sents.cn: 你坐下来读书，工作相关的念头却像飞轮一样不停旋转；要不就是你已经累得筋疲力尽，最不需要的恰恰是一本有难度的书。

sents.en: The modern mind, Tim Parks, a novelist and critic, writes, "is overwhelmingly inclined toward communication… It is not simply that one is interrupted; it is that one is actually inclined to interruption."
sents.cn: 小说家兼评论家蒂姆·帕克斯写道，现代人的头脑“极度倾向于交流……问题不只在于一个人会被打断，还在于他实际上乐于被打断”。

analysis.trunk: 引语主干：The modern mind is overwhelmingly inclined toward communication（现代人的头脑极度倾向于交流）
structure: 引语主语：The modern mind
插入语：Tim Parks, a novelist and critic, writes
引语谓语：is overwhelmingly inclined toward communication
解释性并列：It is not simply that one is interrupted; it is that one is actually inclined to interruption
analysis.logic: 作者署名插在主语和谓语之间；后半用not simply that A; it is that B强调问题不只是被动受扰，更是主动倾向于中断。
notes: 读句时先移开插入语，把The modern mind与is复位。
be inclined toward表示“倾向于”。
interrupted强调被动事件，inclined to interruption强调心理倾向。

sents.en: Deep reading requires not just time, but a special kind of time which can't be obtained merely by becoming more efficient.
sents.cn: 深度阅读不仅需要时间，还需要一种特殊的时间，而这种时间无法仅靠提高效率来获得。

sents.en: In fact, "becoming more efficient" is part of the problem.
sents.cn: 事实上，“提高效率”本身就是问题的一部分。

sents.en: Thinking of time as a resource to be maximised means you approach it instrumentally, judging any given moment as well spent only in so far as it advances progress toward some goal.
sents.cn: 把时间看成一种需要最大限度利用的资源，意味着你会以工具性的方式对待它；只有当某一刻推动你朝某个目标前进时，你才会认为这一刻没有虚度。

analysis.trunk: 主句：Thinking of time as a resource means you approach it instrumentally（把时间看成资源意味着以工具性方式对待时间）
structure: 动名词短语作主语：Thinking of time as a resource
└ 不定式作后置定语：to be maximised〔修饰 resource〕
谓语：means
宾语从句〔省略that〕：you approach it instrumentally
└ 现在分词作伴随状语：judging any given moment as well spent
└ 条件限制：only in so far as it advances progress toward some goal
analysis.logic: 动名词主语提出一种时间观；means引出后果；judging补充说明这种工具性态度如何评价每一刻。
notes: think of A as B意为“把A看作B”。
judge A as well spent意为“认为A没有虚度/花得值得”。
in so far as相当于insofar as，表示“在……范围内；只要”。

sents.en: Immersive reading, by contrast, depends on being willing to risk inefficiency, goallessness, even time-wasting.
sents.cn: 相比之下，沉浸式阅读有赖于你愿意承担低效、没有目标甚至浪费时间的风险。

sents.en: Try to slot it in as a to-do list item and you'll manage only goal-focused reading - useful, sometimes, but not the most fulfilling kind.
sents.cn: 如果你试图把阅读塞进待办事项清单，就只能做到目标导向型阅读——它有时确实有用，却不是最令人满足的阅读。

sents.en: "The future comes at us like empty bottles along an unstoppable and nearly infinite conveyor belt," writes Gary Eberle in his book Sacred Time, and "we feel a pressure to fill these different-sized bottles (days, hours, minutes) as they pass, for if they get by without being filled, we will have wasted them."
sents.cn: 加里·埃伯利在《神圣时间》一书中写道：“未来像空瓶一样，沿着一条无法停下、近乎无穷的传送带向我们涌来；我们感到一种压力，要在这些大小不一的瓶子（日、小时、分钟）经过时把它们装满，因为如果它们空着过去，我们就算浪费了它们。”

analysis.trunk: 两段引语并列：The future comes at us… and we feel a pressure to fill…（未来向我们涌来，我们因而感到必须填满时间）
structure: 引语①：The future comes at us like empty bottles along an unstoppable and nearly infinite conveyor belt
插入性引述：writes Gary Eberle in his book Sacred Time
并列引语②：and we feel a pressure to fill these different-sized bottles
├ 同位说明：(days, hours, minutes)
├ 时间状语从句(as)：as they pass
└ 原因状语从句(for)：for if they get by without being filled, we will have wasted them
└ 条件状语从句(if)：if they get by without being filled
analysis.logic: 整句以传送带上的空瓶比喻不断流逝的时间；第二段引语用as说明瓶子经过，用for if解释人们急于填满它们的原因。
notes: come at sb表示“向某人逼近/涌来”。
get by在此表示“经过、过去”，不是“勉强度日”。
for是并列连词，表示补充原因；其内部又包含if条件句。

sents.en: No mind-set could be worse for losing yourself in a book.
sents.cn: 再没有哪种心态比这更不利于让人沉浸在书中了。

sents.en: So what does work?
sents.cn: 那么，什么办法有效呢？

sents.en: Perhaps surprisingly, scheduling regular times for reading.
sents.cn: 答案也许出人意料：固定安排规律的阅读时间。

sents.en: You'd think this might fuel the efficiency mind-set, but in fact, Eberle notes, such ritualistic behaviour helps us "step outside time's flow" into "soul time."
sents.cn: 你可能以为这会助长效率至上的心态，但埃伯利指出，事实上，这种仪式化的行为能帮助我们“走出时间之流”，进入“心灵时间”。

sents.en: You could limit distractions by reading only physical books, or on single-purpose e-readers.
sents.cn: 你可以只读纸质书，或者只使用功能单一的电子阅读器，以减少干扰。

sents.en: "Carry a book with you at all times" can actually work, too - providing you dip in often enough, so that reading becomes the default state from which you temporarily surface to take care of business, before dropping back down.
sents.cn: “始终随身带一本书”其实也能奏效——前提是你足够频繁地翻开它，让阅读成为默认状态：你只是偶尔从中浮出水面处理事务，之后再潜回去。

sents.en: On a really good day, it no longer feels as if you're "making time to read," but just reading, and making time for everything else.
sents.cn: 在状态特别好的一天，你不再觉得自己是在“挤时间阅读”，而只是自然而然地读书，并为其他一切事情另作安排。

sents.en: Against a backdrop of drastic changes in economy and population structure, younger Americans are drawing a new 21st-century road map to success, a latest poll has found.
sents.cn: 一项最新民调发现，在经济和人口结构发生剧烈变化的背景下，美国年轻人正在绘制一幅新的21世纪成功路线图。

sents.en: Across generational lines, Americans continue to prize many of the same traditional milestones of a successful life, including getting married, having children, owning a home, and retiring in their sixties.
sents.cn: 跨越代际界限，美国人依然看重成功人生中的许多相同传统里程碑，包括结婚、生子、拥有住房以及六十多岁退休。

sents.en: But while young and old mostly agree on what constitutes the finish line of a fulfilling life, they offer strikingly different paths for reaching it.
sents.cn: 然而，尽管年轻人和老年人大体认同充实人生的终点是什么，他们为到达终点选择的道路却截然不同。

sents.en: Young people who are still getting started in life were more likely than older adults to prioritize personal fulfillment in their work, to believe they will advance their careers most by regularly changing jobs, to favor communities with more public services and a faster pace of life, to agree that couples should be financially secure before getting married or having children, and to maintain that children are best served by two parents working outside the home, the survey found.
sents.cn: 调查发现，与年长者相比，刚刚开始独立生活的年轻人更可能优先追求工作中的个人满足感，更相信定期跳槽最能推动职业发展，更青睐公共服务较多、生活节奏较快的社区，更赞同伴侣应在经济稳定后再结婚或生子，也更坚持认为父母双方都在外工作最有利于孩子。

analysis.trunk: 主句：Young people were more likely than older adults to…（年轻人比年长者更可能……）
structure: 主语：Young people
└ 定语从句(who)：who are still getting started in life
谓语：were more likely than older adults
├ 并列不定式①：to prioritize personal fulfillment in their work
├ 并列不定式②：to believe〔that〕they will advance their careers most by regularly changing jobs
├ 并列不定式③：to favor communities with more public services and a faster pace of life
├ 并列不定式④：to agree that couples should be financially secure before getting married or having children
└ 并列不定式⑤：and to maintain that children are best served by two parents working outside the home
插入性来源说明：the survey found
analysis.logic: more likely than构成代际比较，后接五个平行不定式，系统列举年轻人在工作、社区、婚育和育儿方面的不同取向。
notes: 主句很长的原因是五个to do结构平行，而非多层从属。
advance their careers by doing表示“通过……推进职业发展”。
be best served by在此意为“由……最能保障其利益”。

sents.en: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.
sents.cn: 从职业、社区到家庭，这些差异表明，在那场惨烈的大衰退之后，刚刚踏上人生道路的人正在确立新的优先事项和预期，而这些观念将日益渗透美国生活的几乎所有方面，从消费偏好、住房模式一直到政治。

analysis.trunk: 主句：these contrasts suggest that…（这些差异表明……）
structure: 范围状语：From career to community and family
主句：these contrasts suggest
└ 宾语从句(that)：those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations
├ 时间/背景状语：in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 priorities and expectations)：that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life
└ 范围列举：from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics
analysis.logic: 句首概括差异覆盖的领域；that从句给出趋势判断；定语从句继续说明这些新观念未来的扩散范围。
notes: those just starting out in life指“刚刚开始独立生活/初入社会的人”。
in the aftermath of表示“在……之后及其影响下”。
searing在此强调大衰退造成的剧烈、痛苦影响。

sents.en: Young and old converge on one key point: Overwhelming majorities of both groups said they believe it is harder for young people today to get started in life than it was for earlier generations.
sents.cn: 年轻人与老年人在一个关键点上意见一致：两个群体中的绝大多数人都认为，与前几代人相比，如今的年轻人更难开启人生。

sents.en: While younger people are somewhat more optimistic than their elders about the prospects for those starting out today, big majorities in both groups believe those "just getting started in life" face a tougher climb than earlier generations in reaching such signpost achievements as securing a good-paying job, starting a family, managing debt, and finding affordable housing.
sents.cn: 尽管年轻人比年长者稍微更看好当今初入社会者的前景，但两个群体中的绝大多数人都认为，这些“刚刚开始生活”的人在取得找到高薪工作、组建家庭、管理债务和找到买得起的住房等标志性成就时，要比前几代人攀登得更加艰难。

analysis.trunk: 主句：big majorities in both groups believe…（两个群体中的绝大多数人都认为……）
structure: 让步状语从句(while)：While younger people are somewhat more optimistic than their elders about the prospects for those starting out today
主句：big majorities in both groups believe
└ 宾语从句〔省略that〕：those 'just getting started in life' face a tougher climb than earlier generations
└ 方面状语：in reaching such signpost achievements
└ 举例(as)：as securing a good-paying job, starting a family, managing debt, and finding affordable housing
analysis.logic: while先承认年轻人相对乐观，主句随后转折指出两代中的多数仍认同当代年轻人的人生起步更加艰难。
notes: prospects for…表示“……的前景”。
face a tougher climb是比喻，指“面临更艰难的奋斗过程”。
such…as…用于列举，后面四个动名词短语结构平行。

sents.en: Pete Schneider considers the climb tougher today.
sents.cn: 皮特·施奈德认为，如今的攀登更加艰难。

sents.en: Schneider, a 27-year-old auto technician from the Chicago suburbs, says he struggled to find a job after graduating from college.
sents.cn: 施奈德是一名来自芝加哥郊区的27岁汽车技师，他说自己大学毕业后找工作十分艰难。

sents.en: Even now that he is working steadily, he said, "I can't afford to pay my monthly mortgage payments on my own, so I have to rent rooms out to people to make that happen."
sents.cn: 他说，即使现在工作已经稳定，“我仍然无力独自支付每月的房贷，所以不得不把房间租给别人，才能把房贷还上”。

sents.en: Looking back, he is struck that his parents could provide a comfortable life for their children even though neither had completed college when he was young.
sents.cn: 回首往事，他惊讶地发现，在他小时候，尽管父母都没有读完大学，却仍能为孩子提供舒适的生活。

sents.en: "I still grew up in an upper middle-class home with parents who didn't have college degrees," Schneider said.
sents.cn: 施奈德说：“我仍然是在一个中上阶层家庭长大的，父母都没有大学学位。”

sents.en: "I don't think people are capable of that anymore."
sents.cn: “我不认为现在的人还能做到这一点。”

sents.en: Every Saturday morning, at 9 am, more than 50,000 runners set off to run 5km around their local park.
sents.cn: 每周六上午9点，超过5万名跑者从各自所在的社区公园出发，完成5公里跑。

sents.en: The Parkrun phenomenon began with a dozen friends and has inspired 400 events in the UK and more abroad.
sents.cn: “公园跑”这一现象始于十几个朋友，如今已催生英国境内400场活动，并传播到更多海外地区。

sents.en: Events are free, staffed by thousands of volunteers.
sents.cn: 这些活动免费参加，由数千名志愿者负责组织。

sents.en: Runners range from four years old to grandparents; their times range from Andrew Baddeley's world record 13 minutes 48 seconds up to an hour.
sents.cn: 跑者小到4岁孩童、大到祖父母辈；成绩则从安德鲁·巴德利13分48秒的世界纪录，到一小时不等。

sents.en: Parkrun is succeeding where London's Olympic "legacy" is failing.
sents.cn: “公园跑”在取得成功，而伦敦奥运会所谓的“遗产”却在失败。

sents.en: Ten years ago on Monday, it was announced that the Games of the 30th Olympiad would be in London.
sents.cn: 十年前的那个星期一，人们宣布第30届奥运会将在伦敦举行。

sents.en: Planning documents pledged that the great legacy of the Games would be to lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches.
