sents.cn: 规划文件承诺，奥运会留下的重要遗产将是把一个热爱体育的民族从沙发上拉起来。

analysis.trunk: 主句：Planning documents pledged that the great legacy would be to lever a nation…away from their couches（规划文件承诺，重要遗产将是让全民离开沙发去运动）
structure: 主句：Planning documents pledged
└ 宾语从句(that)：that the great legacy of the Games would be to lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches
├ 主语：the great legacy of the Games
└ 表语不定式：to lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches
analysis.logic: pledged后接that从句说明奥运规划的承诺；从句用不定式定义所谓“重要遗产”的具体内容。
notes: lever在此作动词，意为“撬动、促使”。
lever A away from B可理解为“把A从B处拉开”。
a nation of sport lovers是集合性表达，指整个热爱体育的民族。

sents.en: The population would be fitter, healthier and produce more winners.
sents.cn: 民众会更强健、更健康，也会涌现出更多优胜者。

sents.en: It has not happened.
sents.cn: 然而，这并没有发生。

sents.en: The number of adults doing weekly sport did rise, by nearly 2 million in the run-up to 2012 - but the general population was growing faster.
sents.cn: 每周参加体育运动的成年人数量在2012年奥运会前夕确实增加了近200万，但总人口增长得更快。

sents.en: Worse, the numbers are now falling at an accelerating rate.
sents.cn: 更糟的是，如今这一人数正以越来越快的速度下降。

sents.en: The opposition claims primary school pupils doing at least two hours of sport a week have nearly halved.
sents.cn: 反对党声称，每周至少锻炼两小时的小学生人数已减少近一半。

sents.en: Obesity has risen among adults and children.
sents.cn: 成年人和儿童中的肥胖率都上升了。

sents.en: Official retrospections continue as to why London 2012 failed to "inspire a generation."
sents.cn: 官方仍在不断反思，为何2012年伦敦奥运会未能“激励一代人”。

sents.en: The success of Parkrun offers answers.
sents.cn: “公园跑”的成功给出了答案。

sents.en: Parkrun is not a race but a time trial: Your only competitor is the clock.
sents.cn: “公园跑”不是竞赛，而是计时跑：你唯一的对手是时钟。

sents.en: The ethos welcomes anybody.
sents.cn: 这种理念欢迎任何人参与。

sents.en: There is as much joy over a puffed-out first-timer being clapped over the line as there is about top talent shining.
sents.cn: 人们为气喘吁吁的初跑者鼓掌越过终点线所感到的喜悦，丝毫不亚于看到顶尖选手大放异彩。

analysis.trunk: 比较结构：There is as much joy over A as there is about B（人们为A感到的喜悦与为B感到的一样多）
structure: 主句前半：There is as much joy over a puffed-out first-timer being clapped over the line
└ 动名词复合结构：a puffed-out first-timer being clapped over the line
比较从句(as)：as there is about top talent shining
└ 动名词复合结构：top talent shining
analysis.logic: as much…as…把初跑者完赛与高手出彩带来的喜悦等量比较，突出活动不只重视精英成绩。
notes: puffed-out意为“上气不接下气的”。
clap sb over the line指“鼓掌为某人加油，直到其越过终点”。
being clapped是被动动名词，first-timer是其逻辑主语。

sents.en: The Olympic bidders, by contrast, wanted to get more people doing sport and to produce more elite athletes.
sents.cn: 相比之下，奥运会申办者既想让更多人参加体育运动，又想培养更多精英运动员。

sents.en: The dual aim was mixed up: The stress on success over taking part was intimidating for newcomers.
sents.cn: 这两个目标被混为一谈：比起参与本身，人们更强调成功，这让新手望而生畏。

sents.en: Indeed, there is something a little absurd in the state getting involved in the planning of such a fundamentally "grassroots" concept as community sports associations.
sents.cn: 事实上，让政府参与规划社区体育协会这种本质上属于“草根”的组织，多少有些荒谬。

sents.en: If there is a role for government, it should really be getting involved in providing common goods - making sure there is space for playing fields and the money to pave tennis and netball courts, and encouraging the provision of all these activities in schools.
sents.cn: 如果政府确有角色，那就应当切实参与公共资源的供给——确保有运动场地和铺设网球场、无挡板篮球场的资金，并鼓励学校开展所有这些活动。

analysis.trunk: 条件句主干：If there is a role for government, it should be getting involved in providing common goods（如果政府有角色，就应参与提供公共资源）
structure: 条件状语从句(if)：If there is a role for government
主句：it should really be getting involved in providing common goods
破折号后具体解释providing common goods：
├ making sure there is space for playing fields and the money to pave tennis and netball courts
└ and encouraging the provision of all these activities in schools
analysis.logic: if先限定政府介入的前提与边界；破折号后的两个并列动名词说明政府应提供哪些基础条件。
notes: common goods在此指公共资源或公共产品。
make sure后接两个由and连接的存在句成分：space与money。
the money to pave…中的不定式修饰money，说明资金用途。

sents.en: But successive governments have presided over selling green spaces, squeezing money from local authorities and declining attention on sport in education.
sents.cn: 然而，历届政府眼看着绿地被出售，削减地方政府资金，并日益忽视教育中的体育。

sents.en: Instead of wordy, worthy strategies, future governments need to do more to provide the conditions for sport to thrive.
sents.cn: 未来的政府需要少一些冗长而冠冕堂皇的战略，多为体育蓬勃发展创造条件。

sents.en: Or at least not make them worse.
sents.cn: 或者至少别让情况变得更糟。

sents.en: With so much focus on children's use of screens, it's easy for parents to forget about their own screen use.
sents.cn: 人们如此关注孩子使用电子屏幕的情况，父母很容易忘记自己也在使用屏幕。

sents.en: "Tech is designed to really suck you in," says Jenny Radesky in her study of digital play, "and digital products are there to promote maximal engagement.
sents.cn: 珍妮·拉德斯基在关于数字娱乐的研究中说：“科技产品就是为了真正把你吸引进去而设计的，而数字产品的目的就是最大限度地让人持续投入。

sents.en: It makes it hard to disengage, and leads to a lot of bleed-over into the family routine."
sents.cn: 这让人很难抽身，并导致数字活动大量渗入家庭的日常生活。”

sents.en: Radesky has studied the use of mobile phones and tablets at mealtimes by giving mother-child pairs a food-testing exercise.
sents.cn: 拉德斯基让一组组母子完成食物品尝练习，以此研究用餐时使用手机和平板电脑的情况。

sents.en: She found that mothers who used devices during the exercise started 20 per cent fewer verbal and 39 per cent fewer nonverbal interactions with their children.
sents.cn: 她发现，在练习过程中使用电子设备的母亲，与孩子发起的语言互动少了20%，非语言互动少了39%。

sents.en: During a separate observation, she saw that phones became a source of tension in the family.
sents.cn: 在另一项观察中，她发现手机成了家庭关系紧张的一个来源。

sents.en: Parents would be looking at their emails while the children would be making excited bids for their attention.
sents.cn: 父母会一直查看邮件，而孩子则会兴奋地试图吸引他们的注意。

sents.en: Infants are wired to look at parents' faces to try to understand their world, and if those faces are blank and unresponsive - as they often are when absorbed in a device - it can be extremely disconcerting for the children.
sents.cn: 婴幼儿天生会观察父母的面孔，试图借此理解周围的世界；如果这些面孔毫无表情、没有回应——父母沉浸于电子设备时往往如此——孩子就会感到极度不安。

analysis.trunk: 并列句：Infants are wired to look at parents' faces…, and if those faces are blank…, it can be disconcerting（婴儿天生观察父母面孔；若面孔无回应，孩子会不安）
structure: 分句①：Infants are wired to look at parents' faces
└ 目的状语：to try to understand their world
并列分句②(and)：if those faces are blank and unresponsive, it can be extremely disconcerting for the children
├ 条件状语从句(if)：if those faces are blank and unresponsive
│   └ 插入性方式从句(as)：as they often are when absorbed in a device
└ 主句：it can be extremely disconcerting for the children
analysis.logic: 第一分句说明婴儿观察面孔的本能；第二分句以if推出父母沉浸设备、面无回应时给孩子造成的后果。
notes: be wired to do表示“天生/生理上被设定为会做某事”。
as they often are中的are后省略blank and unresponsive。
when absorbed in a device是when they are absorbed的省略形式。

sents.en: Radesky cites the "still face experiment" devised by developmental psychologist Ed Tronick in the 1970s.
sents.cn: 拉德斯基援引了发展心理学家埃德·特罗尼克在20世纪70年代设计的“静止脸实验”。

sents.en: In it, a mother is asked to interact with her child in a normal way before putting on a blank expression and not giving them any visual social feedback: The child becomes increasingly distressed as she tries to capture her mother's attention.
sents.cn: 在实验中，母亲先被要求以正常方式与孩子互动，随后摆出一张毫无表情的脸，不再提供任何视觉上的社交反馈；孩子在试图吸引母亲注意时会变得越来越痛苦。

analysis.trunk: 主干：a mother is asked to interact… before putting on…; the child becomes increasingly distressed（母亲先互动再面无表情；孩子越来越痛苦）
structure: 主句①：a mother is asked to interact with her child in a normal way
└ 时间状语(before)：before putting on a blank expression and not giving them any visual social feedback
冒号后结果分句：The child becomes increasingly distressed
└ 时间状语从句(as)：as she tries to capture her mother's attention
analysis.logic: before连接实验的两个阶段；冒号后的独立分句描述母亲停止反馈后，孩子试图重新获得注意并逐渐痛苦的结果。
notes: be asked to do是被动结构“被要求做”。
putting与giving共享before，且由and并列。
capture one's attention意为“吸引某人的注意”。

sents.en: "Parents don't have to be exquisitely present at all times, but there needs to be a balance and parents need to be responsive and sensitive to a child's verbal or nonverbal expressions of an emotional need," says Radesky.
sents.cn: 拉德斯基说：“父母不必时刻全神贯注地陪在孩子身边，但必须保持平衡；他们需要回应孩子，并敏锐察觉孩子通过语言或非语言方式表达的情感需求。”

sents.en: On the other hand, Tronick himself is concerned that the worries about kids' use of screens are born out of an "oppressive ideology that demands that parents should always be interacting" with their children: "It's based on a somewhat fantasised, very white, very upper-middle-class ideology that says if you're failing to expose your child to 30,000 words you are neglecting them."
sents.cn: 另一方面，特罗尼克本人担心，对儿童使用屏幕的忧虑源自一种“强迫父母必须始终与孩子互动的压迫性观念”；他说：“它建立在一种多少有些幻想化、非常白人化、非常中上阶层化的观念之上，这种观念声称，如果你没让孩子接触到3万个单词，就是在疏于照顾他们。”

analysis.trunk: 主句：Tronick is concerned that the worries are born out of an ideology（特罗尼克担心这些忧虑源于一种观念）
structure: 转折状语：On the other hand
主句：Tronick himself is concerned
└ 宾语从句(that)：that the worries about kids' use of screens are born out of an oppressive ideology
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 ideology)：that demands that parents should always be interacting with their children
冒号后直接引语：It's based on a somewhat fantasised…ideology
└ 定语从句(that)：that says
└ 宾语从句：if you're failing to expose your child to 30,000 words, you are neglecting them
analysis.logic: 前半指出忧虑背后的意识形态来源；冒号后引语进一步批评这种意识形态的阶层与族群局限，并概括其条件式判断。
notes: be born out of表示“源于、产生于”。
第一个that引导concerned的宾语从句；第二个that引导修饰ideology的定语从句。
expose a child to words指“让孩子接触语言输入”。

sents.en: Tronick believes that just because a child isn't learning from the screen doesn't mean there's no value to it - particularly if it gives parents time to have a shower, do housework or simply have a break from their child.
sents.cn: 特罗尼克认为，孩子没有从屏幕中学到东西，并不意味着屏幕毫无价值——尤其当它能给父母留出时间洗澡、做家务，或者只是暂时从照看孩子中喘口气时。

sents.en: Parents, he says, can get a lot out of using their devices to speak to a friend or get some work out of the way.
sents.cn: 他说，父母用设备和朋友交谈，或把一些工作处理完，也能从中获益良多。

sents.en: This can make them feel happier, which lets them be more available to their child the rest of the time.
sents.cn: 这会让父母感觉更快乐，从而在其余时间里能更充分地陪伴孩子。

sents.en: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year.
sents.cn: 如今，在一个快速变化的世界里，立即上大学的广泛社会压力与日益升高的期望共同作用，常常使学生完全忽略休学间隔年这种可能性。

analysis.trunk: 主句：social pressure…often causes students to overlook the possibility（社会压力常使学生忽略这种可能性）
structure: 主语：widespread social pressure to immediately go to college
├ 不定式作后置定语：to immediately go to college
└ 介词结构：in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world
谓语：often causes
宾语+宾补：students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year
analysis.logic: 长主语由“立即上大学的社会压力”构成，并用in conjunction with加入高期望这一共同因素；cause A to do B说明二者造成的结果。
notes: in conjunction with意为“与……共同、结合”。
cause sb to do sth表示“导致某人做某事”。
the possibility of doing中的of taking a gap year具体说明possibility。

sents.en: After all, if everyone you know is going to college in the fall, it seems silly to stay back a year, doesn't it?
sents.cn: 毕竟，如果你认识的所有人都将在秋季上大学，自己却推迟一年，看起来很傻，不是吗？

sents.en: And after going to school for 12 years, it doesn't feel natural to spend a year doing something that isn't academic.
sents.cn: 而且，上了12年学以后，花一年时间做与学业无关的事，也会让人觉得不自然。

sents.en: But while this may be true, it's not a good enough reason to condemn gap years.
sents.cn: 然而，即便这些情况属实，也不足以成为否定间隔年的理由。

sents.en: There's always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated "race to the finish line," whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or a lucrative career.
sents.cn: 人们总是担心自己在社会持续推动的“冲向终点的竞赛”中落后于所有人，无论那个终点是研究生院、医学院，还是高收入职业。

sents.en: But despite common misconceptions, a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits - in fact, it probably enhances it.
sents.cn: 但与常见误解相反，间隔年并不会妨碍学业成功；事实上，它很可能会促进学业成功。

sents.en: Studies from the United States and Australia show that students who take a gap year are generally better prepared for and perform better in college than those who do not.
sents.cn: 美国和澳大利亚的研究表明，与不休间隔年的学生相比，选择间隔年的学生通常为大学生活准备得更充分，学业表现也更好。

sents.en: Rather than pulling students back, a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for independence, new responsibilities and environmental changes - all things that first-year students often struggle with the most.
sents.cn: 间隔年不会拖学生后腿，反而会让他们提前做好准备，去面对独立生活、新的责任和环境变化——这些恰恰是大学一年级学生往往最难应对的事情。

analysis.trunk: 主句：a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for…（间隔年通过让学生做好准备来推动他们前进）
structure: 对比状语：Rather than pulling students back
主句：a gap year pushes them ahead
└ 方式状语(by)：by preparing them for independence, new responsibilities and environmental changes
同位概括：all things
└ 定语从句(that)：that first-year students often struggle with the most
analysis.logic: rather than先否定“拖后腿”的误解，主句转而说明间隔年的推进作用；破折号后的all things概括前三项并补充其现实难度。
notes: rather than doing表示“不是……而是……”，句中与pushes形成语义对照。
prepare sb for sth意为“使某人为……做好准备”。
struggle with的介词with被保留在定语从句末尾。

sents.en: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
sents.cn: 在适应大学、突然进入全新环境时，间隔年的经历能减轻冲击，使学生更容易专注于学业和活动，而不是犯下适应不良造成的错误。

sents.en: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
sents.cn: 如果你仍不相信花一年时间探索兴趣本身具有价值，那就考虑一下它对未来学业选择所产生的经济影响。

sents.en: According to the National Center for Education Statistics, nearly 80 percent of college students end up changing their majors at least once.
sents.cn: 美国国家教育统计中心的数据显示，近80%的大学生最终至少会更换一次专业。

sents.en: This isn't surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college.
sents.cn: 这并不奇怪，因为高中基础必修课程使学生难以充分了解大学里等待着他们的众多学术可能性。

sents.en: Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes.
sents.cn: 许多学生在大学申请中填写一个专业，上过大学课程后却转向另一个专业。

sents.en: It's not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game.
sents.cn: 这未必是坏事，但视学校而定，如果转专业太晚，为补足学分可能要付出高昂代价。

sents.en: At Boston College, for example, you would have to complete an extra year were you to switch to the nursing school from another department.
sents.cn: 例如，在波士顿学院，如果你从其他院系转入护理学院，就必须额外读一年。

analysis.trunk: 主句：you would have to complete an extra year（你将不得不多读一年）
structure: 举例状语：At Boston College, for example
主句：you would have to complete an extra year
倒装条件句：were you to switch to the nursing school from another department
└ 还原：if you were to switch to the nursing school from another department
analysis.logic: 句子先给出转专业的额外成本，随后用省略if的虚拟条件倒装限定这一结果发生的条件。
notes: were you to do是正式语体的虚拟条件句，等于if you were to do。
have to complete an extra year表示“必须额外修读一年”。
switch to A from B表示“从B转入A”。

sents.en: Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on.
sents.cn: 先用一个间隔年把事情想清楚，有助于日后减轻压力并节省金钱。

sents.en: Though often viewed as a problem for western states, the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern because of its impact on federal tax dollars, says Professor Max Moritz, a specialist in fire ecology and management.
sents.cn: 火灾生态与管理专家马克斯·莫里茨教授表示，野火愈发频繁虽然常被视为西部各州的问题，但由于它影响联邦税款的使用，因此也是全国性关切。

analysis.trunk: 主句：the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern（野火日益频繁是全国性关切）
structure: 让步状语〔过去分词省略结构〕：Though often viewed as a problem for western states
主句：the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern
└ 原因状语(because of)：because of its impact on federal tax dollars
插入性引述：says Professor Max Moritz
└ 同位语：a specialist in fire ecology and management
analysis.logic: though先承认常见的地区性看法，主句转而将问题提升为全国性关切，并用because of解释财政原因。
notes: Though often viewed…补全为Though it is often viewed…。
frequency在这里指火灾发生频率，而非“频繁程度”的简单形容。
says Professor…是新闻报道中的倒装引述结构。

sents.en: In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires - nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago.
sents.cn: 2015年，美国林务局有史以来首次把55亿美元年度预算的一半以上用于扑灭山火，这一占比几乎是20年前的两倍。

sents.en: In effect, fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency's other work - such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management, and infrastructure upkeep - that affect the lives of all Americans.
sents.cn: 实际上，如今用于该机构其他工作的联邦资金变少了；这些工作包括森林保护、流域及文化资源管理和基础设施维护，都会影响全体美国人的生活。

analysis.trunk: 主句：fewer federal funds are going towards the agency's other work（用于该机构其他工作的联邦资金减少了）
structure: 总结状语：In effect
主句：fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency's other work
破折号内举例：such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management, and infrastructure upkeep
定语从句(that，修饰 other work)：that affect the lives of all Americans
analysis.logic: 主句说明扑火预算挤占其他项目；破折号列举受挤压的工作；that从句强调这些工作与所有美国人都有关。
notes: go towards表示“被用于、投入”。
upkeep意为“维护、保养”。
that的先行词是work，破折号中的列举不改变句法主线。

sents.en: Another nationwide concern is whether public funds from other agencies are going into construction in fire-prone districts.
sents.cn: 另一个全国性关切是，其他机构的公共资金是否正被投入到火灾高风险地区的建设中。

sents.en: As Moritz puts it, how often are federal dollars building homes that are likely to be lost to a wildfire?
sents.cn: 正如莫里茨所问：联邦资金究竟多频繁地被用来建造那些很可能毁于野火的房屋？

sents.en: "It's already a huge problem from a public expenditure perspective for the whole country," he says.
sents.cn: 他说：“从公共支出的角度看，这已经是整个国家面临的一个巨大问题。

sents.en: "We need to take a magnifying glass to that.
sents.cn: 我们需要拿放大镜仔细审视这件事。

sents.en: Like, 'Wait a minute, is this OK?'
sents.cn: 比如问一句：‘等一下，这样做合适吗？’

sents.en: Do we want instead to redirect those funds to concentrate on lower-hazard parts of the landscape?"
sents.cn: 我们是否应该转而把这些资金集中投向火灾风险较低的地区？”

sents.en: Such a view would require a corresponding shift in the way US society today views fire, researchers say.
sents.cn: 研究人员说，这种观点要求美国社会相应地改变如今看待火灾的方式。

sents.en: For one thing, conversations about wildfires need to be more inclusive.
sents.cn: 首先，有关野火的讨论需要更具包容性。

sents.en: Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change - how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires.
sents.cn: 过去十年，关注点一直是气候变化——地球因温室气体排放而变暖，如何造成了加剧火灾的条件。

sents.en: While climate is a key element, Moritz says, it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation.
sents.cn: 莫里茨说，气候固然是关键因素，但不能因此忽视整个问题中的其他部分。

sents.en: "The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked, and the interactions go both ways," he says.
sents.cn: 他说：“人类系统与我们生活其上的景观相互关联，二者的作用是双向的。”

sents.en: Failing to recognize that, he notes, leads to "an overly simplified view of what the solutions might be.
sents.cn: 他指出，如果认识不到这一点，就会导致“对可能解决方案的过度简化认识。

sents.en: Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited."
sents.cn: 我们对问题以及解决方案的认识都会变得非常有限”。

sents.en: At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity, says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado.
sents.cn: 与此同时，科罗拉多大学的巴尔奇教授说，人们仍把火视为一种必须完全加以控制、只有在必要时才可放任发生的事件。

sents.en: But acknowledging fire's inevitable presence in human life is an attitude crucial to developing the laws, policies, and practices that make it as safe as possible, she says.
sents.cn: 但她表示，承认火在人类生活中不可避免，是制定法律、政策和实践、尽可能降低火灾风险的关键态度。

analysis.trunk: 主句：acknowledging fire's inevitable presence…is an attitude crucial to developing…（承认火不可避免是一种制定安全制度所必需的态度）
structure: 转折连词：But
动名词短语作主语：acknowledging fire's inevitable presence in human life
系表结构：is an attitude
└ 形容词短语作后置定语：crucial to developing the laws, policies, and practices
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 laws, policies, and practices)：that make it as safe as possible
插入性引述：she says
analysis.logic: 动名词短语概括应有的认知态度；crucial to说明这种态度对制度建设的重要性；that从句给出制度建设的目标。
notes: acknowledging是全句主语，谓语是is。
be crucial to中的to是介词，后接developing。
make it as safe as possible中的it指与火共存的处境或火的存在。

sents.en: "We've disconnected ourselves from living with fire," Balch says.
sents.cn: 巴尔奇说：“我们已经让自己脱离了与火共存的生活方式。

sents.en: "It is really important to understand and try and tease out what is the human connection with fire today."
sents.cn: 真正重要的是，要理解并努力梳理当今人类与火之间究竟存在怎样的联系。”

sents.en: It is curious that Stephen Koziatek feels almost as though he has to justify his efforts to give his students a better future.
sents.cn: 令人不解的是，斯蒂芬·科齐亚特克觉得自己仿佛必须为帮助学生拥有更美好未来所付出的努力辩解。

sents.en: Mr. Koziatek is part of something pioneering.
sents.cn: 科齐亚特克先生正在参与一项开创性的事业。

sents.en: He is a teacher at a New Hampshire high school where learning is not something of books and tests and mechanical memorization, but practical.
sents.cn: 他在新罕布什尔州一所高中任教；在那里，学习并非只是书本、考试和机械记忆，而是具有实践性的。

sents.en: When did it become accepted wisdom that students should be able to name the 13th president of the United States but be utterly overwhelmed by a broken bike chain?
sents.cn: 学生能说出美国第13任总统的名字，却面对一根断掉的自行车链条便完全不知所措——这种看法从何时起成了公认的道理？

analysis.trunk: 疑问主干：When did it become accepted wisdom that…?（何时……成了公认的道理？）
structure: 特殊疑问句：When did it become accepted wisdom
└ 同位/内容从句(that)：that students should be able to name the 13th president of the United States but be utterly overwhelmed by a broken bike chain
├ 并列谓语①：should be able to name…
└ 并列谓语②(but)：〔should〕be utterly overwhelmed by…
analysis.logic: it作形式主语或泛指情形，that从句给出所谓“公认道理”的具体内容；but并列强烈反差，构成反问。
notes: accepted wisdom指“普遍接受的看法、公认道理”。
but后省略与前面共享的should。
be overwhelmed by在此表示“面对……完全不知所措”。

sents.en: As Koziatek knows, there is learning in just about everything.
sents.cn: 正如科齐亚特克所知，几乎所有事情中都蕴含着学习。

sents.en: Nothing is necessarily gained by forcing students to learn geometry at a graffitied desk stuck with generations of discarded chewing gum.
sents.cn: 强迫学生坐在涂满涂鸦、粘着一届又一届学生丢弃的口香糖的课桌前学习几何，并不一定会让他们有所收获。

sents.en: They can also learn geometry by assembling a bicycle.
sents.cn: 他们同样可以通过组装自行车来学习几何。

sents.en: But he's also found a kind of insidious prejudice.
sents.cn: 但他也发现了一种潜藏而有害的偏见。

sents.en: Working with your hands is seen as almost a mark of inferiority.
sents.cn: 动手劳动几乎被视为低人一等的标志。

sents.en: Schools in the family of vocational education "have that stereotype…that it's for kids who can't make it academically," he says.
sents.cn: 他说，人们对职业教育类学校“抱有那种成见……认为它只适合学业上无法取得成功的孩子”。

sents.en: On one hand, that viewpoint is a logical product of America's evolution.
sents.cn: 一方面，这种观点是美国发展演变的合乎逻辑的产物。

sents.en: Manufacturing is not the economic engine that it once was.
sents.cn: 制造业已不再是过去那样的经济引擎。

sents.en: The job security that the US economy once offered to high school graduates has largely evaporated.
sents.cn: 美国经济曾为高中毕业生提供的就业保障，如今已基本消失。

sents.en: More education is the new principle.
sents.cn: 接受更多教育成了新的准则。

sents.en: We want more for our kids, and rightfully so.
sents.cn: 我们希望孩子得到更多，这完全合情合理。

sents.en: But the headlong push into bachelor's degrees for all - and the subtle devaluing of anything less - misses an important point: That's not the only thing the American economy needs.
sents.cn: 但是，所有人一窝蜂地追求学士学位，并暗中贬低低于学士学位的任何选择，却忽略了一个要点：美国经济需要的并不只有学士学位。

analysis.trunk: 主句：the push…and the devaluing…miss an important point（对学位的盲目追逐和对其他选择的贬低忽略了一个要点）
structure: 并列主语①：the headlong push into bachelor's degrees for all
并列主语②：and the subtle devaluing of anything less
谓语宾语：misses an important point
冒号后解释point：That's not the only thing
└ 定语从句〔省略that，修饰 thing〕：the American economy needs
analysis.logic: 两个并列名词短语共同指出教育取向的偏差；冒号后的句子解释被忽略的要点，即经济需求并非只有学士学位。
notes: headlong表示“轻率而迅猛的、不顾一切的”。
anything less指低于学士学位的教育或资格。
the only thing the economy needs中省略了关系代词that。

sents.en: Yes, a bachelor's degree opens more doors.
sents.cn: 没错，学士学位能打开更多机会之门。

sents.en: But even now, 54 percent of the jobs in the country are middle-skill jobs, such as construction and high-skill manufacturing.
sents.cn: 但即使在今天，美国54%的岗位仍是建筑业和高技能制造业之类的中等技能岗位。

sents.en: But only 44 percent of workers are adequately trained.
sents.cn: 然而，只有44%的劳动者接受了充分培训。

sents.en: In other words, at a time when the working class has turned the country on its political head, frustrated that the opportunity that once defined America is vanishing, one obvious solution is staring us in the face.
sents.cn: 换言之，在工人阶层因曾经定义美国的机会正在消失而感到挫败、进而彻底改变国家政治格局之际，一个显而易见的解决方案就摆在我们面前。

analysis.trunk: 主句：one obvious solution is staring us in the face（一个显而易见的解决方案就摆在眼前）
structure: 衔接语：In other words
时间状语从句：at a time when the working class has turned the country on its political head
├ 定语从句(when，修饰 a time)：when the working class has turned the country on its political head
└ 过去分词短语补充working class：frustrated that the opportunity…is vanishing
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 opportunity)：that once defined America
主句：one obvious solution is staring us in the face
analysis.logic: at a time when交代政治背景，frustrated进一步解释工人阶层改变政治格局的原因，最后主句强调解决方案其实显而易见。
notes: turn something on its head意为“彻底颠覆、完全改变”。
frustrated that…是过去分词短语，补充说明working class的状态。
stare sb in the face是习语，指“明摆在某人眼前”。

sents.en: There is a gap in working-class jobs, but the workers who need those jobs most aren't equipped to do them.
sents.cn: 工人阶层岗位存在缺口，但最需要这些工作的人却不具备从事它们的技能。

sents.en: Koziatek's Manchester School of Technology High School is trying to fill that gap.
sents.cn: 科齐亚特克任教的曼彻斯特技术高中正努力填补这一缺口。

sents.en: Koziatek's school is a wake-up call.
sents.cn: 科齐亚特克的学校给人们敲响了警钟。

sents.en: When education becomes one-size-fits-all, it risks overlooking a nation's diversity of gifts.
sents.cn: 当教育变成千篇一律的模式时，它就可能忽视一个国家多种多样的天赋。

sents.en: While fossil fuels - coal, oil, gas - still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply, it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.
sents.cn: 尽管化石燃料——煤、石油和天然气——仍供应着全球约85%的能源，但有一点比以往任何时候都更加清楚：未来属于风能、太阳能等可再生能源。

analysis.trunk: 主句：it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources（比以往更清楚的是，未来属于可再生能源）
structure: 让步状语从句(while)：While fossil fuels - coal, oil, gas - still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply
└ 同位列举：coal, oil, gas〔解释 fossil fuels〕
主句：it's clearer than ever
└ 真正主语从句(that)：that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar
analysis.logic: while承认化石燃料当前仍占主导，主句用形式主语it和that真主语从句转向可再生能源代表未来的判断。
notes: while在此表示让步“尽管”，不是单纯时间关系。
it是形式主语，that从句是真正主语。
belong to在这里表示“归属于、是……的天下”。

sents.en: The move to renewables is picking up momentum around the world: They now account for more than half of new power sources going on line.
sents.cn: 全球向可再生能源转型的势头正在增强：在所有新增并网投产的发电来源中，可再生能源如今已占一半以上。

sents.en: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.
sents.cn: 部分增长源于各国政府和有远见的企业承诺为更清洁的能源提供资金。

sents.en: But increasingly the story is about the plummeting prices of renewables, especially wind and solar.
sents.cn: 但如今，事情越来越多地取决于可再生能源，尤其是风能和太阳能价格的暴跌。

sents.en: The cost of solar panels has dropped by 80 percent and the cost of wind turbines by close to one-third in the past eight years.
sents.cn: 过去八年，太阳能电池板的成本下降了80%，风力涡轮机的成本也下降了近三分之一。

sents.en: In many parts of the world renewable energy is already a principal energy source.
sents.cn: 在世界许多地区，可再生能源已经成为主要能源来源。

sents.en: In Scotland, for example, wind turbines provide enough electricity to power 95 percent of homes.
sents.cn: 例如在苏格兰，风力涡轮机提供的电力足以满足95%家庭的用电需求。

sents.en: While the rest of the world takes the lead, notably China and Europe, the United States is also seeing a remarkable shift.
sents.cn: 在世界其他地区，尤其是中国和欧洲领跑的同时，美国也正在经历显著转变。

sents.en: In March, for the first time, wind and solar power accounted for more than 10 percent of the power generated in the US, reported the US Energy Information Administration.
sents.cn: 美国能源信息署报告称，今年3月，风能和太阳能发电量首次占到美国总发电量的10%以上。

sents.en: President Trump has underlined fossil fuels - especially coal - as the path to economic growth.
sents.cn: 特朗普总统强调，化石燃料——尤其是煤炭——是通往经济增长的道路。

sents.en: In a recent speech in Iowa, he dismissed wind power as an unreliable energy source.
sents.cn: 他最近在艾奥瓦州的一次演讲中斥风能为不可靠的能源。

sents.en: But that message did not play well with many in Iowa, where wind turbines dot the fields and provide 36 percent of the state's electricity generation - and where tech giants like Microsoft are being attracted by the availability of clean energy to power their data centers.
sents.cn: 但这一说法并未得到许多艾奥瓦人的认同；该州田野间遍布风力涡轮机，风电占全州发电量的36%，而微软等科技巨头也因当地有清洁能源可为数据中心供电而被吸引至此。

analysis.trunk: 主句：that message did not play well with many in Iowa（那一说法未获许多艾奥瓦人认同）
structure: 主句：But that message did not play well with many in Iowa
├ 非限制性定语从句①(where，修饰 Iowa)：where wind turbines dot the fields and provide 36 percent of the state's electricity generation
└ 并列非限制性定语从句②(and where)：where tech giants like Microsoft are being attracted by the availability of clean energy
└ 不定式作后置定语：to power their data centers〔修饰 clean energy〕
analysis.logic: 主句指出政治表态在当地反响不佳；两个where从句分别用风电占比和科技企业选址解释原因。
notes: play well with sb表示“得到某人良好反响/认同”。
dot the fields意为“星罗棋布于田野”。
be attracted by the availability of…指因某种资源可获得而被吸引。

sents.en: The question "what happens when the wind doesn't blow or the sun doesn't shine?" has provided a quick put-down for skeptics.
sents.cn: “没有风或没有阳光时怎么办？”这个问题一直是怀疑者快速驳斥可再生能源的说辞。

sents.en: But a boost in the storage capacity of batteries is making their ability to keep power flowing around the clock more likely.
sents.cn: 但电池储能容量的提升，正使可再生能源更有可能维持全天候持续供电。

sents.en: The advance is driven in part by vehicle manufacturers, who are placing big bets on battery-powered electric vehicles.
sents.cn: 这一进展部分由汽车制造商推动，因为它们正对电池驱动的电动汽车下重注。

sents.en: Although electric cars are still a rarity on roads now, this massive investment could change the picture rapidly in coming years.
sents.cn: 尽管如今电动汽车在道路上仍属少见，这笔巨额投资却可能在未来几年迅速改变局面。

sents.en: While there's a long way to go, the trend lines for renewables are spiking.
sents.cn: 虽然前路依然漫长，可再生能源的发展趋势线却正在急剧上扬。

sents.en: The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up - perhaps just in time to have a meaningful effect in slowing climate change.
sents.cn: 能源来源的变革速度似乎正在加快——也许恰好来得及对减缓气候变化产生实质性影响。

analysis.trunk: 主句：The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up（能源来源的变革速度似乎正在加快）
structure: 主句：The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up
破折号后补充判断：perhaps just in time
└ 不定式作结果/目的补充：to have a meaningful effect
└ 介词短语：in slowing climate change
analysis.logic: 主句判断转型提速；破折号后的perhaps降低断言强度，并说明这种提速可能恰好赶上减缓气候变化所需的时间窗口。
notes: the pace of change意为“变化的速度”。
just in time to do表示“恰好来得及做”。
have an effect in doing表示“在做某事方面产生影响”。

sents.en: What Washington does - or doesn't do - to promote alternative energy may mean less and less at a time of a global shift in thought.
sents.cn: 在全球观念发生转变之际，华盛顿是否采取行动推动替代能源，其影响可能会越来越小。

sents.en: The power and ambition of the giants of the digital economy is astonishing - Amazon has just announced the purchase of the upmarket grocery chain Whole Foods for $13.5bn, but two years ago Facebook paid even more than that to acquire the WhatsApp messaging service, which doesn't have any physical product at all.
sents.cn: 数字经济巨头的力量和野心令人震惊——亚马逊刚刚宣布以135亿美元收购高端食品连锁店全食超市，而两年前，脸书收购完全没有实体产品的即时通信服务WhatsApp时，支付的金额甚至更高。

analysis.trunk: 并列主干：The power and ambition…is astonishing - Amazon has announced…, but Facebook paid even more…（数字巨头的力量令人震惊：亚马逊宣布收购，而脸书此前支付得更多）
structure: 总起句：The power and ambition of the giants of the digital economy is astonishing
破折号后例证分句①：Amazon has just announced the purchase of the upmarket grocery chain Whole Foods for $13.5bn
并列转折分句②(but)：two years ago Facebook paid even more than that
└ 目的状语：to acquire the WhatsApp messaging service
└ 非限制性定语从句(which)：which doesn't have any physical product at all
analysis.logic: 首句先作总体评价，破折号后用两笔巨额收购作证；but通过金额比较突出没有实体产品的数字服务也能获得更高估值。
notes: 主语power and ambition在此被视作整体概念，因此原文使用is。
upmarket表示“面向高端市场的”。
even more than that中的that指亚马逊收购全食超市所付的135亿美元。

sents.en: What WhatsApp offered Facebook was an intricate and finely detailed web of its users' friendships and social lives.
sents.cn: WhatsApp提供给脸书的，是一张由用户的友谊和社交生活构成的复杂而精细的网络。

sents.en: Facebook promised the European commission then that it would not link phone numbers to Facebook identities, but it broke the promise almost as soon as the deal went through.
sents.cn: 脸书当时曾向欧盟委员会承诺，不会把电话号码与脸书身份关联起来，但交易一完成不久，它就违背了这一承诺。

sents.en: Even without knowing what was in the messages, the knowledge of who sent them and to whom was enormously revealing and still could be.
sents.cn: 即使不知道消息内容，仅仅掌握谁把消息发给了谁，也极具揭示作用，而且现在依然如此。

sents.en: What political journalist, what party whip, would not want to know the makeup of the WhatsApp groups in which Theresa May's enemies are currently plotting?
sents.cn: 哪一位政治记者、哪一位党鞭会不想知道，特雷莎·梅的政敌眼下正在哪些WhatsApp群组里密谋，以及这些群组由谁组成？

sents.en: It may be that the value of Whole Foods to Amazon is not so much the 460 shops it owns, but the records of which customers have purchased what.
sents.cn: 全食超市对亚马逊的价值，也许主要不在于它拥有的460家门店，而在于哪些顾客购买过哪些商品的记录。

sents.en: Competition law appears to be the only way to address these imbalances of power.
sents.cn: 竞争法似乎是解决这些权力失衡问题的唯一途径。

sents.en: But it is clumsy.
sents.cn: 但这种手段很笨拙。

sents.en: For one thing, it is very slow compared to the pace of change within the digital economy.
sents.cn: 首先，与数字经济内部的变化速度相比，它的执行非常缓慢。

sents.en: By the time a problem has been addressed and remedied it may have vanished in the marketplace, to be replaced by new abuses of power.
sents.cn: 等到一个问题得到处理和纠正时，它或许早已从市场中消失，取而代之的则是新的权力滥用。

sents.en: But there is a deeper conceptual problem, too.
sents.cn: 此外还存在一个更深层的概念问题。

sents.en: Competition law as presently interpreted deals with financial disadvantage to consumers and this is not obvious when the users of these services don't pay for them.
sents.cn: 按照目前的解释，竞争法处理的是消费者在经济上遭受的不利；但这些服务的用户并不付费，因此这种不利并不明显。

analysis.trunk: 并列句：Competition law deals with financial disadvantage, and this is not obvious when users don't pay（竞争法处理经济损害，但免费服务中的损害并不明显）
structure: 分句①：Competition law as presently interpreted deals with financial disadvantage to consumers
└ 过去分词省略结构：as presently interpreted〔修饰/限定 Competition law〕
并列分句②(and)：this is not obvious
└ 时间/条件状语从句(when)：when the users of these services don't pay for them
analysis.logic: 第一分句界定现行竞争法关注的损害类型；第二分句指出用户不付费时，传统的经济损害标准难以显现。
notes: as presently interpreted可补全为as it is presently interpreted。
this指前面的financial disadvantage to consumers。
pay for them中的them指these services。

sents.en: The users of their services are not their customers.
sents.cn: 这些服务的用户并不是它们的顾客。

sents.en: That would be the people who buy advertising from them - and Facebook and Google, the two virtual giants, dominate digital advertising to the disadvantage of all other media and entertainment companies.
sents.cn: 真正的顾客是向它们购买广告的人；而脸书和谷歌这两大虚拟世界巨头主导着数字广告市场，使所有其他媒体和娱乐公司处于不利地位。

sents.en: The product they're selling is data, and we, the users, convert our lives to data for the benefit of the digital giants.
sents.cn: 它们出售的产品是数据，而我们这些用户则把自己的生活转化成数据，让数字巨头从中受益。

sents.en: Just as some ants farm the bugs called aphids for the honeydew they produce when they feed, so Google farms us for the data that our digital lives yield.
sents.cn: 正如某些蚂蚁饲养名为蚜虫的小虫，以获取它们进食时分泌的蜜露一样，谷歌也“饲养”我们，以获取我们的数字生活所产生的数据。

analysis.trunk: 类比结构：Just as ants farm aphids…, so Google farms us…（正如蚂蚁饲养蚜虫，谷歌也“饲养”我们）
structure: 类比分句(just as)：Just as some ants farm the bugs called aphids for the honeydew
├ 过去分词作后置定语：called aphids〔修饰 bugs〕
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 honeydew)：they produce when they feed
└ 时间状语从句(when)：when they feed
对应主句(so)：so Google farms us for the data
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 data)：that our digital lives yield
analysis.logic: just as…so…建立严格类比：蚂蚁保护并利用蚜虫获取蜜露，谷歌则维护服务并利用用户获取数据。
notes: just as A, so B表示“正如A，B也同样”。
farm在此是带批判意味的比喻用法，意为“饲养并从中获利”。
yield作动词表示“产生、产出”。

sents.en: Ants keep predatory insects away from where their aphids feed; Gmail keeps the spammers out of our inboxes.
sents.cn: 蚂蚁会赶走蚜虫取食处附近的捕食性昆虫；Gmail则会把垃圾邮件发送者挡在我们的收件箱之外。

sents.en: It doesn't feel like a human or democratic relationship, even if both sides benefit.
sents.cn: 即便双方都能获益，这种关系给人的感觉也既不人性化，也不民主。

sents.en: To combat the trap of putting a premium on being busy, Cal Newport, author of Deep Work: Rules for Focused Success in a Distracted World, recommends building a habit of "deep work" - the ability to focus without distraction.
sents.cn: 为了摆脱过分看重忙碌的陷阱，《深度工作：在分心世界中专注成功的法则》作者卡尔·纽波特建议养成“深度工作”的习惯，也就是不受干扰、专心致志的能力。

sents.en: There are a number of approaches to mastering the art of deep work - be it lengthy retreats dedicated to a specific task; developing a daily ritual; or taking a "journalistic" approach to seizing moments of deep work when you can throughout the day.
sents.cn: 掌握深度工作艺术的方法有很多：可以长期闭关专攻某项任务，可以建立每日固定仪式，也可以采取“新闻记者式”的方法，随时抓住一天中能够进行深度工作的片刻。

analysis.trunk: 主句：There are a number of approaches to mastering the art of deep work（掌握深度工作有多种方法）
structure: 存在句：There are a number of approaches
└ 介词短语作后置定语：to mastering the art of deep work
破折号后列举(be it)：
├ lengthy retreats dedicated to a specific task
├ developing a daily ritual
└ taking a 'journalistic' approach to seizing moments of deep work when you can throughout the day
analysis.logic: 主句提出方法多样，be it之后列举长期闭关、每日仪式和随时抓住机会三种路线。
notes: approach to中的to是介词，所以后接mastering。
be it A, B, or C是让步列举结构，意为“无论是A、B还是C”。
when you can后省略seize moments of deep work。

sents.en: Whichever approach, the key is to determine your length of focus time and stick to it.
sents.cn: 无论采用哪种方法，关键都是确定自己的专注时长并坚持下去。

sents.en: Newport also recommends "deep scheduling" to combat constant interruptions and get more done in less time.
sents.cn: 纽波特还建议采用“深度日程安排”，以对抗不断出现的干扰，在更短时间内完成更多工作。

sents.en: "At any given point, I should have deep work scheduled for roughly the next month.
sents.cn: 他写道：“在任何一个时间点，我都应该已为未来大约一个月安排好深度工作。

sents.en: Once on the calendar, I protect this time like I would a doctor's appointment or important meeting," he writes.
sents.cn: 一旦写进日程，我就会像对待就诊预约或重要会议那样保护这段时间。”

sents.en: Another approach to getting more done in less time is to rethink how you prioritise your day - in particular how we craft our to-do lists.
sents.cn: 要在更少时间内完成更多工作，另一种方法是重新考虑如何确定一天事务的优先级，尤其是如何编排待办事项清单。

sents.en: Tim Harford, author of Messy: The Power of Disorder to Transform Our Lives, points to a study in the early 1980s that divided undergraduates into two groups: some were advised to set out monthly goals and study activities; others were told to plan activities and goals in much more detail, day by day.
sents.cn: 《混乱：无序如何改变我们的生活》一书作者蒂姆·哈福德提到20世纪80年代初的一项研究：研究把大学生分成两组，一组被建议列出每月目标和学习活动，另一组则被要求按天制定详细得多的活动与目标计划。

analysis.trunk: 主句：Tim Harford points to a study（蒂姆·哈福德提到一项研究）
structure: 主语：Tim Harford
└ 同位语：author of Messy: The Power of Disorder to Transform Our Lives
谓语宾语：points to a study in the early 1980s
└ 定语从句(that)：that divided undergraduates into two groups
冒号后解释two groups：
├ 分句①：some were advised to set out monthly goals and study activities
└ 分句②：others were told to plan activities and goals in much more detail, day by day
analysis.logic: 主句引入研究，that从句说明分组方式，冒号后的两个被动句具体交代两组收到的不同规划建议。
notes: point to在此意为“援引、提到”。
advise sb to do与tell sb to do在句中都用了被动语态。
set out goals意为“列出、制定目标”。

sents.en: While the researchers assumed that the well-structured daily plans would be most effective when it came to the execution of tasks, they were wrong: the detailed daily plans demotivated students.
sents.cn: 研究人员原以为，结构严密的每日计划在执行任务时最为有效，但事实证明他们错了：过于详细的每日计划反而让学生失去动力。

sents.en: Harford argues that inevitable distractions often render the daily to-do list ineffective, while leaving room for improvisation in such a list can reap the best results.
sents.cn: 哈福德认为，不可避免的干扰往往会让每日待办清单失效，而在清单中给临场调整留出空间，反而能取得最佳结果。

sents.en: In order to make the most of our focus and energy, we also need to embrace downtime, or as Newport suggests, "be lazy".
sents.cn: 为了充分利用我们的专注力和精力，我们还需要接受休息时间，或者用纽波特的话说，要“懒惰”。

sents.en: "Idleness is not just a vacation, an indulgence or a vice; it is as indispensable to the brain as vitamin D is to the body…[idleness] is, paradoxically, necessary to getting any work done," he argues.
sents.cn: 他主张：“闲散不仅是假期、放纵或恶习；它对大脑而言，就像维生素D对身体一样不可或缺……矛盾的是，闲散是完成任何工作所必需的。”

analysis.trunk: 引语主干：Idleness is not just A; it is as indispensable to the brain as vitamin D is to the body; idleness is necessary to getting work done（闲散不只是A；它对大脑不可或缺；而且是完成工作的必要条件）
structure: 分句①：Idleness is not just a vacation, an indulgence or a vice
分号后分句②：it is as indispensable to the brain as vitamin D is to the body
省略号后总结：idleness is, paradoxically, necessary to getting any work done
插入性副词：paradoxically
引述说明：he argues
analysis.logic: 三层递进先否定对闲散的贬义理解，再用维生素D类比其必要性，最后得出看似矛盾的结论：休息是工作的前提。
notes: not just A承接后文更强的判断，不宜只译为简单并列。
as indispensable to A as B is to C表示“对A而言，就像B对C一样不可或缺”。
be necessary to中的to是介词，故后接getting。

sents.en: Srini Pillay, an assistant professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School, believes this counterintuitive link between downtime and productivity may be due to the way our brains operate.
sents.cn: 哈佛医学院精神病学助理教授斯里尼·皮莱认为，休息时间与生产效率之间这种反直觉的联系，可能源于我们大脑的运作方式。

sents.en: When our brains switch between being focused and unfocused on a task, they tend to be more efficient.
sents.cn: 当我们的大脑在专注于任务和不专注于任务的状态之间切换时，往往会更加高效。

sents.en: "What people don't realise is that in order to complete these tasks they need to use both the focus and unfocus circuits in their brain," says Pillay.
sents.cn: 皮莱说：“人们没有意识到，要完成这些任务，就需要同时使用大脑中的专注回路和非专注回路。”

sents.en: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms.
sents.cn: 与悲伤、恐惧和愤怒等所谓的基本情绪不同，内疚出现得稍晚一些，并伴随着儿童对社会规范和道德规范的理解不断加深。

sents.en: Children aren't born knowing how to say "I'm sorry"; rather, they learn over time that such statements appease parents and friends - and their own consciences.
sents.cn: 孩子并非天生就知道如何说“对不起”；相反，他们逐渐懂得，这类表态可以安抚父母和朋友，也能安抚自己的良心。

sents.en: This is why researchers generally regard so-called moral guilt, in the right amount, to be a good thing.
sents.cn: 这就是为什么研究人员通常认为，适量的所谓道德内疚是一件好事。

sents.en: In the popular imagination, of course, guilt still gets a bad rap.
sents.cn: 当然，在大众想象中，内疚仍然名声不佳。

sents.en: It is deeply uncomfortable - it's the emotional equivalent of wearing a jacket weighted with stones.
sents.cn: 它让人极度不适，就像在情感上穿着一件塞满石头的夹克。

sents.en: Yet this understanding is outdated.
sents.cn: 然而，这种理解已经过时。

sents.en: "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary - feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another.
sents.cn: 弗吉尼亚大学心理学研究员阿姆里莎·瓦伊什说：“人们在某种程度上重新关注或重新思考内疚是什么，以及内疚能发挥什么作用。”她还指出，这种复兴属于一种更广泛的认识：情绪并非非此即彼，在一种情境中有益的感受，在另一种情境中可能有害。

analysis.trunk: 引语 + says Amrisha Vaish, adding that...（瓦伊什说……，并补充指出……）
structure: 直接引语主干：There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking
├ 介词宾语从句①(about what)：what guilt is
└ 并列宾语从句②(what)：what role guilt can serve
主句倒装：says Amrisha Vaish
└ 伴随分词：adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition
└ 同位语从句(that)：emotions aren't binary
└ 破折号解释：feelings advantageous in one context may be harmful in another
analysis.logic: 直接引语先说明对内疚的重新认识；adding 引出作者对这股变化的归类，两个 that 层层说明“更广泛认识”的具体内容。
notes: what guilt is 与 what role guilt can serve 都是 about 的宾语从句。
binary 在此指非好即坏的二元划分。
advantageous in one context 与 harmful in another 形成情境对比。

sents.en: Jealousy and anger, for example, may have evolved to alert us to important inequalities.
sents.cn: 例如，嫉妒和愤怒或许是为了提醒我们注意重要的不平等而进化出来的。

sents.en: Too much happiness can be destructive.
sents.cn: 过度快乐也可能具有破坏性。

sents.en: And guilt, by prompting us to think more deeply about our goodness, can encourage humans to make up for errors and fix relationships.
sents.cn: 而内疚通过促使我们更深入地思考自身是否善良，可以鼓励人们弥补错误并修复关系。

sents.en: Guilt, in other words, can help hold a cooperative species together.
sents.cn: 换句话说，内疚有助于维系一个善于合作的物种。

sents.en: It is a kind of social glue.
sents.cn: 它是一种社会黏合剂。

sents.en: Viewed in this light, guilt is an opportunity.
sents.cn: 从这个角度看，内疚是一种契机。

sents.en: Work by Tina Malti, a psychology professor at the University of Toronto, suggests that guilt may compensate for an emotional deficiency.
sents.cn: 多伦多大学心理学教授蒂娜·马尔蒂的研究表明，内疚可能弥补某种情感缺失。

sents.en: In a number of studies, Malti and others have shown that guilt and sympathy may represent different pathways to cooperation and sharing.
sents.cn: 在多项研究中，马尔蒂等人已经证明，内疚和同情可能代表通往合作与分享的不同路径。

sents.en: Some kids who are low in sympathy may make up for that shortfall by experiencing more guilt, which can rein in their nastier impulses.
sents.cn: 一些同情心较弱的孩子可能会通过产生更多内疚来弥补这一不足，而这种内疚能够约束他们较为恶劣的冲动。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：Some kids may make up for that shortfall（一些孩子可能弥补这一不足）
structure: 主句：Some kids may make up for that shortfall
├ 定语从句(who，修饰 kids)：who are low in sympathy
├ 方式状语(by)：by experiencing more guilt
└ 非限制性定语从句(which，指 guilt)：which can rein in their nastier impulses
analysis.logic: who 指明孩子的特征，by 说明弥补不足的方式，which 再解释更多内疚为何能够发挥补偿作用。
notes: make up for：弥补、补偿。
be low in sympathy：同情心不足。
rein in：约束、控制。

sents.en: And vice versa: High sympathy can substitute for low guilt.
sents.cn: 反过来也一样：高度同情可以弥补内疚感不足。

sents.en: In a 2014 study, for example, Malti looked at 244 children.
sents.cn: 例如，在2014年的一项研究中，马尔蒂考察了244名儿童。

sents.en: Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations, she rated each child's overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions.
sents.cn: 她利用照护者评估和儿童自我观察，评定了每个孩子的总体同情水平，以及他们在做出违背道德的行为后产生负面情绪的倾向。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O1+O2：she rated each child's level and tendency（她评定了每个孩子的水平和倾向）
structure: 方式分词短语：Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations
主句：she rated
├ 并列宾语①：each child's overall sympathy level
└ 并列宾语②：his or her tendency to feel negative emotions
└ 时间状语(after)：after moral transgressions
analysis.logic: 句首分词交代评定依据；主句的两个并列宾语分别对应同情水平和违规后产生负面情绪的倾向。
notes: caregiver assessment：照护者评估。
tendency to do：做某事的倾向。
moral transgression：违背道德规范的行为。

sents.en: Then the kids were handed chocolate coins, and given a chance to share them with an anonymous child.
sents.cn: 随后，孩子们拿到了一些巧克力金币，并获得了与一名匿名儿童分享的机会。

sents.en: For the low-sympathy kids, how much they shared appeared to turn on how inclined they were to feel guilty.
sents.cn: 对于同情心较弱的孩子来说，他们分享多少似乎取决于他们有多容易感到内疚。

sents.en: The guilt-prone ones shared more, even though they hadn't magically become more sympathetic to the other child's deprivation.
sents.cn: 容易内疚的孩子分享得更多，尽管他们并没有神奇地变得更能同情另一个孩子所遭受的匮乏。

sents.en: "That's good news," Malti says.
sents.cn: 马尔蒂说：“这是个好消息。”

sents.en: "We can be prosocial because we caused harm and we feel regret."
sents.cn: “我们可以因为自己造成了伤害并感到后悔，而表现出亲社会行为。”

sents.en: Forests give us shade, quiet and one of the harder challenges in the fight against climate change.
sents.cn: 森林为我们提供阴凉与宁静，也给应对气候变化的斗争带来了较为棘手的挑战之一。

sents.en: Even as we humans count on forests to soak up a good share of the carbon dioxide we produce, we are threatening their ability to do so.
sents.cn: 就在我们人类指望森林吸收自己排放的大量二氧化碳时，我们也在威胁森林完成这一任务的能力。

analysis.trunk: 让步复句：Even as we count on forests..., we are threatening their ability...（尽管我们依赖森林……，却在威胁其能力）
structure: 让步/同时状语从句(Even as)：we humans count on forests
└ 目的不定式：to soak up a good share of the carbon dioxide
└ 定语从句〔省略 that，修饰 carbon dioxide〕：we produce
主句：we are threatening their ability
└ 不定式作后置定语：to do so
analysis.logic: Even as 把“依赖森林吸碳”和“削弱其吸碳能力”并置，形成鲜明反差；do so 指代 soak up carbon dioxide。
notes: count on：依赖、指望。
soak up：吸收。
do so 用来避免重复前面的动作。

sents.en: The climate change we are hastening could one day leave us with forests that emit more carbon than they absorb.
sents.cn: 我们正在加速的气候变化，可能有一天会让森林排放的碳多于其吸收的碳。

sents.en: Thankfully, there is a way out of this trap - but it involves striking a subtle balance.
sents.cn: 幸好，我们有办法摆脱这个困境，但这需要取得一种微妙的平衡。

sents.en: Helping forests flourish as valuable "carbon sinks" long into the future may require reducing their capacity to absorb carbon now.
sents.cn: 要让森林在遥远的未来仍作为宝贵的“碳汇”繁茂生长，可能需要现在先降低它们吸收碳的能力。

sents.en: California is leading the way, as it does on so many climate efforts, in figuring out the details.
sents.cn: 与许多气候行动一样，加利福尼亚州正在率先摸索其中的细节。

sents.en: The state's proposed Forest Carbon Plan aims to double efforts to thin out young trees and clear brush in parts of the forest.
sents.cn: 该州拟议中的《森林碳计划》旨在加倍努力，间伐森林部分区域的幼树并清除灌木。

sents.en: This temporarily lowers carbon-carrying capacity.
sents.cn: 这会暂时降低森林的碳承载能力。

sents.en: But the remaining trees draw a greater share of the available moisture, so they grow and thrive, restoring the forest's capacity to pull carbon from the air.
sents.cn: 但剩余树木能够获得更大份额的可用水分，因而可以生长繁盛，恢复森林从空气中吸收碳的能力。

sents.en: Healthy trees are also better able to fend off insects.
sents.cn: 健康的树木也更能抵御昆虫侵害。

sents.en: The landscape is rendered less easily burnable.
sents.cn: 这片土地也因此不那么容易燃烧。

sents.en: Even in the event of a fire, fewer trees are consumed.
sents.cn: 即便发生火灾，被烧毁的树木也会更少。

sents.en: The need for such planning is increasingly urgent.
sents.cn: 制定这种规划的需要日益迫切。

sents.en: Already, since 2010, drought and insects have killed over 100 million trees in California, most of them in 2016 alone, and wildfires have burned hundreds of thousands of acres.
sents.cn: 自2010年以来，干旱和昆虫已经导致加利福尼亚州逾一亿棵树死亡，其中大多数仅在2016年一年内死亡；野火也烧毁了数十万英亩土地。

sents.en: California plans to treat 35,000 acres of forest a year by 2020, and 60,000 by 2030 - financed from the proceeds of the state's emissions-permit auctions.
sents.cn: 加州计划到2020年每年治理3.5万英亩森林，到2030年每年治理6万英亩，资金来自该州排放许可拍卖的收益。

sents.en: That's only a small share of the total acreage that could benefit, about half a million acres in all, so it will be vital to prioritize areas at greatest risk of fire or drought.
sents.cn: 这只占全部可受益土地的一小部分，总计约50万英亩，因此优先治理火灾或干旱风险最大的地区至关重要。

analysis.trunk: 并列因果复句：That is only a small share..., so it will be vital to prioritize...（那只占一小部分，因此优先处理……至关重要）
structure: 分句①：That is only a small share of the total acreage
├ 定语从句(that)：that could benefit
└ 同位补充：about half a million acres in all
结果分句(so)：it will be vital
└ 真正主语不定式：to prioritize areas
└ 介词短语作后置定语：at greatest risk of fire or drought
analysis.logic: 前半句用规模对比说明资源有限，so 引出政策优先级；it 是形式主语，真正主语是后面的不定式。
notes: acreage：土地面积、英亩数。
in all：总计。
prioritize areas at greatest risk：优先处理风险最大的地区。

sents.en: The strategy also aims to ensure that carbon in woody material removed from the forests is locked away in the form of solid lumber or burned as biofuel in vehicles that would otherwise run on fossil fuels.
sents.cn: 该策略还旨在确保，从森林中移除的木质材料所含的碳，要么以实木木材的形式封存，要么作为生物燃料在原本会使用化石燃料的车辆中燃烧。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O从句：The strategy aims to ensure that carbon is locked away or burned（该策略旨在确保碳被封存或燃烧利用）
structure: 主句：The strategy also aims
└ 目的不定式：to ensure
└ 宾语从句(that)：carbon ... is locked away ... or burned as biofuel
├ 过去分词短语〔修饰 material〕：removed from the forests
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 vehicles)：that would otherwise run on fossil fuels
analysis.logic: ensure 后的 that 从句由两个并列被动谓语构成，说明木材中的碳有两种去向；otherwise 突出以生物燃料替代化石燃料。
notes: woody material：木质材料。
lock away：封存。
would otherwise do：否则本来会做……。

sents.en: New research on transportation biofuels is already under way.
sents.cn: 关于交通运输生物燃料的新研究已经在进行中。

sents.en: State governments are well accustomed to managing forests, but traditionally they've focused on wildlife, watersheds and opportunities for recreation.
sents.cn: 州政府很习惯管理森林，但传统上它们关注的是野生动物、流域以及休闲机会。

sents.en: Only recently have they come to see the vital part forests will have to play in storing carbon.
sents.cn: 直到最近，它们才开始认识到森林在储存碳方面必须发挥的关键作用。

sents.en: California's plan, which is expected to be finalized by the governor next year, should serve as a model.
sents.cn: 加州的计划预计将于明年由州长最终敲定，它应当成为一个范例。

sents.en: American farmers have been complaining of labor shortages for several years.
sents.cn: 几年来，美国农场主一直在抱怨劳动力短缺。

sents.en: The complaints are unlikely to stop without an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers.
sents.cn: 如果不彻底改革针对农业工人的移民规定，这些抱怨不太可能停止。

sents.en: Congress has obstructed efforts to create a more straightforward visa for agricultural workers that would let foreign workers stay longer in the U.S. and change jobs within the industry.
sents.cn: 国会阻挠了为农业工人设立一种更简明签证的努力；这种签证本可让外国工人在美国停留更久，并在该行业内部更换工作。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：Congress has obstructed efforts（国会阻挠了相关努力）
structure: 主句：Congress has obstructed efforts
└ 不定式作后置定语：to create a more straightforward visa
├ 介词短语作后置定语：for agricultural workers
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 visa)：that would let foreign workers stay longer in the U.S. and change jobs within the industry
analysis.logic: 不定式说明 efforts 的目标，that 从句继续说明这种签证能够赋予外国工人的两项并列便利。
notes: obstruct efforts to do：阻挠做某事的努力。
straightforward 在此指程序直接、简明。
let somebody do 中不定式不带 to。

sents.en: If this doesn't change, American businesses, communities, and consumers will be the losers.
sents.cn: 如果这种情况不改变，美国企业、社区和消费者都将成为输家。

sents.en: Perhaps half of U.S. farm laborers are undocumented immigrants.
sents.cn: 美国农业劳工中可能有一半是无证移民。

sents.en: As fewer such workers enter the country, the characteristics of the agricultural workforce are changing.
sents.cn: 随着进入美国的这类工人减少，农业劳动力的构成特征正在发生变化。

sents.en: Today's farm laborers, while still predominantly born in Mexico, are more likely to be settled rather than migrating and more likely to be married than single.
sents.cn: 如今的农业劳工虽然仍主要出生在墨西哥，但比过去更可能定居而非迁徙，也更可能已婚而非单身。

analysis.trunk: S+系动词+并列表语：Today's farm laborers are more likely to be settled and more likely to be married（如今的农业劳工更可能定居且已婚）
structure: 主句主语：Today's farm laborers
├ 让步插入语：while still predominantly born in Mexico
├ 表语①：are more likely to be settled rather than migrating
└ 并列表语②：and more likely to be married than single
analysis.logic: while 插入语保留劳工来源未变这一背景，两个 more likely 对称比较，突出迁移方式和婚姻状态的变化。
notes: predominantly：主要地。
settled rather than migrating：定居而非迁徙。
more likely to... than... 表示相对可能性。

sents.en: They're also aging.
sents.cn: 他们的年龄也在增长。

sents.en: At the start of this century, about one-third of crop workers were over the age of 35.
sents.cn: 本世纪初，大约三分之一的作物工人年龄超过35岁。

sents.en: Now more than half are.
sents.cn: 现在这一比例已超过一半。

sents.en: And picking crops is hard on older bodies.
sents.cn: 而采摘作物对年长者的身体负担很大。

sents.en: One oft-debated cure for this labor shortage remains as implausible as it's been all along: Native U.S. workers won't be returning to the farm.
sents.cn: 对于这种劳动力短缺，一个经常被争论的解决办法仍像从前一样不切实际：美国本土工人不会重返农场。

sents.en: Mechanization isn't the answer, either - not yet, at least.
sents.cn: 机械化也不是答案，至少目前还不是。

sents.en: Production of corn, cotton, rice, soybeans, and wheat has been largely mechanized, but many high-value, labor-intensive crops, such as strawberries, need labor.
sents.cn: 玉米、棉花、水稻、大豆和小麦的生产大多已经机械化，但草莓等许多高价值、劳动密集型作物仍然需要人工。

sents.en: Even dairy farms, where robots do a small share of milking, have a long way to go before they're automated.
sents.cn: 即使在机器人承担少量挤奶工作的奶牛场，实现自动化也还有很长的路要走。

sents.en: As a result, farms have grown increasingly reliant on temporary guest workers using the H-2A visa to fill the gaps in the workforce.
sents.cn: 因此，农场越来越依赖使用H-2A签证的临时客工来填补劳动力缺口。

sents.en: Starting around 2012, requests for the visas rose sharply; from 2011 to 2016 the number of visas issued more than doubled.
sents.cn: 大约从2012年起，这类签证的申请量急剧上升；从2011年到2016年，签发的签证数量增加了一倍多。

sents.en: The H-2A visa has no numerical cap, unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work, which is limited to 66,000 a year.
sents.cn: H-2A签证没有数量上限，这一点不同于非农业工作的H-2B签证，后者每年限额为6.6万份。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：The H-2A visa has no numerical cap（H-2A签证没有数量上限）
structure: 主句：The H-2A visa has no numerical cap
└ 比较插入语：unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work
└ 非限制性定语从句(which)：which is limited to 66,000 a year
analysis.logic: 主句陈述H-2A无上限，unlike 引入H-2B作对比，which 从句给出后者的具体年度限额。
notes: numerical cap：数量上限。
nonagricultural work：非农业工作。
be limited to：被限制在……。

sents.en: Even so, employers complain they aren't given all the workers they need.
sents.cn: 即便如此，雇主仍抱怨没有获得所需的全部工人。

sents.en: The process is cumbersome, expensive, and unreliable.
sents.cn: 这一流程繁琐、昂贵且不可靠。

sents.en: One survey found that bureaucratic delays led the average H-2A worker to arrive on the job 22 days late.
sents.cn: 一项调查发现，官僚程序造成的延误使普通H-2A工人平均晚22天到岗。

sents.en: The shortage is compounded by federal immigration raids, which remove some workers and drive others underground.
sents.cn: 联邦移民突击搜查进一步加剧了短缺，因为它们会带走一些工人，并迫使另一些工人转入地下。

sents.en: In a 2012 survey, 71 percent of tree-fruit growers and almost 80 percent of raisin and berry growers said they were short of labor.
sents.cn: 2012年的一项调查中，71%的树生水果种植者以及近80%的葡萄干和浆果种植者表示，他们缺少劳动力。

sents.en: Some western farmers have responded by moving operations to Mexico.
sents.cn: 一些西部农场主以把经营活动迁往墨西哥作为应对。

sents.en: From 1998 to 2000, 14.5 percent of the fruit Americans consumed was imported.
sents.cn: 1998年至2000年，美国人消费的水果中有14.5%依赖进口。

sents.en: Little more than a decade later, the share of imports was 25.8 percent.
sents.cn: 仅十多年后，进口所占比例就达到25.8%。

sents.en: In effect, the U.S. can import food or it can import the workers who pick it.
sents.cn: 实际上，美国要么进口食品，要么进口采摘食品的工人。

sents.en: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Dia Mirza and Adrian Grenier have a message for you: It's easy to beat plastic.
sents.cn: 阿诺德·施瓦辛格、迪娅·米尔扎和阿德里安·格雷尼尔要向你传达一个信息：战胜塑料很容易。

sents.en: They're part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day - encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis.
sents.cn: 他们是一群出演世界环境日新视频的名人中的一员；该视频鼓励作为消费者的你更换吸管、餐具等一次性塑料日用品，以应对塑料危机。

sents.en: The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics.
sents.cn: 为世界环境日汇总的关键信息确实包括呼吁各国政府制定法律，遏制一次性塑料制品。

sents.en: But the overarching message is directed at individuals.
sents.cn: 但总的信息是面向个人的。

sents.en: My concern with leaving it up to the individual, however, is our limited sense of what needs to be achieved.
sents.cn: 然而，我对把事情交给个人来做的担忧在于，我们对于必须实现什么目标认识有限。

sents.en: On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us.
sents.cn: 例如，单靠我们自己带购物袋去食品店或放弃塑料吸管，收效甚微，也不需要我们付出多少。

sents.en: They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have "done our bit" without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions - a kind of "moral licensing" that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge.
sents.cn: 这些行动甚至可能产生负面影响：它们满足了我们“尽到自己一份力”的需要，却从未推进到更大、更大胆、更有效的行动；这是一种“道德许可”，会缓解我们的担忧，使我们不再做得更多，也不再向当权者提出更多要求。

analysis.trunk: S+V+C：They could even be detrimental（这些行动甚至可能有害）
structure: 主句：They could even be detrimental
└ 结果/伴随分词：satisfying a need
├ 不定式作后置定语：to have done our bit
└ without 介词结构：without ever progressing onto bigger... actions
同位解释：a kind of moral licensing
└ 定语从句(that)：that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge
analysis.logic: 句子先判断小行动可能有害，再用分词和 without 说明其心理机制，最后用同位语定义“道德许可”，并由 that 从句展开后果。
notes: do our bit：尽自己的一份力。
allay concerns：缓解担忧。
those in charge：掌权者、负责人。

sents.en: While the conversation around our environment and our responsibility toward it remains centered on shopping bags and straws, we're ignoring the balance of power that implies that as "consumers" we must shop sustainably, rather than as "citizens" hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change.
sents.cn: 当有关环境及我们对环境责任的讨论仍围绕购物袋和吸管展开时，我们忽视了其中的权力关系：它暗示我们必须以“消费者”身份进行可持续购物，而不是以“公民”身份要求政府和行业承担责任、推动真正的系统性变革。

analysis.trunk: 时间/让步复句：While the conversation remains centered..., we're ignoring the balance of power（当讨论仍聚焦……时，我们忽视了权力关系）
structure: while 状语从句：the conversation ... remains centered on shopping bags and straws
主句：we're ignoring the balance of power
└ 定语从句(that)：that implies
└ 宾语从句(that)：as consumers we must shop sustainably, rather than as citizens hold our governments and industries to account
└ 目的不定式：to push for real systemic change
analysis.logic: while 把表层环保讨论与被忽视的权力结构对照；两个 that 依次修饰 balance 并给出其隐含要求，rather than 对比消费者和公民两种身份。
notes: remain centered on：仍以……为中心。
hold somebody to account：要求某人承担责任。
systemic change：系统性变革。

sents.en: It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority - or even most people's.
sents.cn: 重要的是要承认，环境并非每个人的优先事项，甚至也不是大多数人的优先事项。

sents.en: We shouldn't expect it to be.
sents.cn: 我们不应期待它成为所有人的优先事项。

sents.en: In her latest book, Why Good People Do Bad Environmental Things, Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural.
sents.cn: 韦尔斯利学院教授伊丽莎白·R. 德松布尔在其新作《好人为何做出有害环境之事》中主张，要集体改变大量人群的行为，最佳方式是让这种改变具有结构性。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O从句：Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that...（德松布尔主张……）
structure: 主句：Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues
└ 宾语从句(that)：the best way ... is for the change to be structural
├ 不定式作后置定语：to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people
└ 表语：for the change to be structural
analysis.logic: that 从句使用“the best way is...”框架；两个不定式分别说明要改变什么，以及最佳方式的结构性本质。
notes: large numbers of people：大量人群。
structural change：通过制度或结构实现的改变。
for + 名词 + to do 是不定式的逻辑主语结构。

sents.en: This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether.
sents.cn: 这可能意味着实施塑料税等政策，给危害环境的行为增加成本，或者彻底禁止一次性塑料制品。

sents.en: India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022."
sents.cn: 印度刚刚宣布，将“在2022年前消除该国所有一次性塑料”。

sents.en: There are also incentive-based ways of making better environmental choices easier, such as ensuring recycling is at least as easy as trash disposal.
sents.cn: 也有一些以激励为基础的方法可以让更环保的选择变得更容易，例如确保回收至少与丢弃垃圾一样方便。

sents.en: DeSombre isn't saying people should stop caring about the environment.
sents.cn: 德松布尔并不是说人们应该停止关心环境。

sents.en: It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.
sents.cn: 她说，只是个人行动过于缓慢，不能把它作为改变普遍行为的唯一途径，甚至不能作为主要途径。

sents.en: None of this is about writing off the individual.
sents.cn: 所有这些都不是要否定个人。

sents.en: It's just about putting things into perspective.
sents.cn: 这只是要正确看待各种因素的轻重。

sents.en: We don't have time to wait.
sents.cn: 我们没有时间等待。

sents.en: We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
sents.cn: 我们需要能够塑造集体行动并约束污染企业的进步政策，同时也需要积极参与、推动变革的公民。

sents.en: Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid.
sents.cn: 老鼠和其他动物需要高度敏锐地感知同伴发出的社会信号，以便识别可以合作的朋友和应当躲避的敌人。

sents.en: To find out if this extends to non-living beings, Laleh Quinn at the University of California, San Diego, and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect social signals from robotic rats.
sents.cn: 为弄清这种能力是否延伸到非生命体，加利福尼亚大学圣迭戈分校的拉莱·奎因及其同事测试了老鼠能否识别机器鼠发出的社会信号。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O从句：Laleh Quinn and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect...（奎因及其同事测试老鼠能否识别……）
structure: 目的不定式：To find out
└ 宾语从句(if)：if this extends to non-living beings
主句：Laleh Quinn ... and her colleagues tested
└ 宾语从句(whether)：whether rats can detect social signals from robotic rats
analysis.logic: 句首不定式交代研究目的，其中 if 引出待确认的问题；主句用 whether 从句说明实际测试内容。
notes: extend to：延伸到、适用于。
non-living beings：非生命体。
whether 引导名词性从句，表示“是否”。

sents.en: They housed eight adult rats with two types of robotic rat - one social and one asocial - for four days.
sents.cn: 他们让八只成年鼠与两类机器鼠共同生活四天，一类具有社会性，另一类不具有社会性。

sents.en: The robot rats were quite minimalist, resembling a chunkier version of a computer mouse with wheels to move around and colorful markings.
sents.cn: 这些机器鼠的设计非常简约，像是更粗壮的电脑鼠标，装有用于移动的轮子和彩色标记。

sents.en: During the experiment, the social robot rat followed the living rats around, played with the same toys, and opened cage doors to let trapped rats escape.
sents.cn: 实验期间，社会型机器鼠会跟随活鼠四处活动、玩同样的玩具，还会打开笼门，让被困的老鼠逃脱。

sents.en: Meanwhile, the asocial robot simply moved forwards and backwards and side to side.
sents.cn: 与此同时，非社会型机器鼠只是前后左右地移动。

sents.en: Next, the researchers trapped the robots in cages and gave the rats the opportunity to release them by pressing a lever.
sents.cn: 接着，研究人员把机器鼠困在笼中，让活鼠有机会通过按压杠杆将其放出。

sents.en: Across 18 trials each, the living rats were 52 per cent more likely on average to set the social robot free than the asocial one.
sents.cn: 在两种情形各18次试验中，活鼠释放社会型机器鼠的平均可能性比释放非社会型机器鼠高52%。

sents.en: This suggests that the rats perceived the social robot as a genuine social being, says Quinn.
sents.cn: 奎因说，这表明老鼠把社会型机器鼠当成了真正的社会性生命。

sents.en: The rats may have bonded more with the social robot because it displayed behaviors like communal exploring and playing.
sents.cn: 活鼠可能与社会型机器鼠建立了更深的联系，因为后者会表现出共同探索和玩耍等行为。

sents.en: This could lead to the rats better remembering having freed it earlier, and wanting the robot to return the favour when they get trapped, she says.
sents.cn: 她说，这可能使老鼠更清楚地记得自己之前曾释放过它，并希望自己受困时，机器鼠也能回报这一帮助。

analysis.trunk: S+V+O：This could lead to the rats remembering... and wanting...（这可能使老鼠记住……并希望……）
structure: 主句：This could lead to
├ 动名词复合结构①：the rats better remembering having freed it earlier
└ 并列动名词复合结构②：wanting the robot to return the favour
└ 时间状语从句(when)：when they get trapped
插入式报道语：she says
analysis.logic: lead to 后接两个并列的动名词内容，分别表示记忆和预期回报；when 从句限定回报发生的情形。
notes: lead to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词。
remember having done：记得曾经做过。
return the favour：回报帮助。

sents.en: "Rats have been shown to engage in multiple forms of reciprocal help and cooperation, including what is referred to as direct reciprocity where a rat will help another rat that has previously helped them," says Quinn.
sents.cn: 奎因说：“研究已经证明，老鼠会采取多种形式的互助与合作，其中包括所谓的直接互惠，即一只老鼠会帮助此前帮助过自己的另一只老鼠。”

sents.en: The readiness of the rats to befriend the social robot was surprising given its minimal design.
sents.cn: 考虑到这种机器鼠设计极其简单，活鼠愿意与社会型机器鼠交朋友这一点令人惊讶。

sents.en: The robot was the same size as a regular rat but resembled a simple plastic box on wheels.
sents.cn: 机器鼠与普通老鼠大小相同，但外形像一个装有轮子的简单塑料盒。

sents.en: "We'd assumed we'd have to give it a moving head and tail, facial features, and put a scent on it to make it smell like a real rat, but that wasn't necessary," says Janet Wiles at the University of Queensland in Australia, who helped with the research.
sents.cn: 参与这项研究的澳大利亚昆士兰大学学者珍妮特·怀尔斯说：“我们原以为必须给它装上会动的头和尾巴、面部特征，再加上气味，让它闻起来像真老鼠，但事实证明没有必要。”

analysis.trunk: 引语复句：We'd assumed..., but that wasn't necessary（我们原以为……，但那并无必要）
structure: 引语分句①：We'd assumed
└ 宾语从句〔省略 that〕：we'd have to give it..., and put a scent on it
└ 目的不定式：to make it smell like a real rat
转折分句(but)：that wasn't necessary
报道语：says Janet Wiles
└ 非限制性定语从句(who)：who helped with the research
analysis.logic: assumed 后的从句列出原本以为必需的拟真特征，but 否定这种必要性；who 补充说明怀尔斯与研究的关系。
notes: would have to：将不得不。
make it smell like...：使它闻起来像……。
that 指代前面整套拟真设计。

sents.en: The finding shows how sensitive rats are to social cues, even when they come from basic robots, says Wiles.
sents.cn: 怀尔斯说，这一发现显示了老鼠对社会线索有多么敏感，即便这些线索来自结构简单的机器人。

sents.en: Similarly, children tend to treat robots as if they are fellow beings, even when they display only simple social signals.
sents.cn: 同样，儿童往往会把机器人当作同类，即便机器人只表现出简单的社会信号。

sents.en: "We humans seem to be fascinated by robots, and it turns out other animals are too," says Wiles.
sents.cn: 怀尔斯说：“我们人类似乎会被机器人吸引，事实证明其他动物也是如此。”

sents.en: It is true that CEO pay has gone up - top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers on average, and since the mid-1970s, CEO pay for large publicly traded American corporations has, by varying estimates, gone up by about 500%.
sents.cn: 首席执行官薪酬确实上涨了：顶尖首席执行官的收入平均可能达到普通员工的300倍；据不同估算，自20世纪70年代中期以来，美国大型上市公司首席执行官的薪酬已上涨约500%。

analysis.trunk: S+系动词+表语从句：It is true that CEO pay has gone up（首席执行官薪酬上涨是事实）
structure: 形式主语结构：It is true
└ 真正主语从句(that)：CEO pay has gone up
├ 破折号补充：top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers
└ 并列分句(and)：since the mid-1970s, CEO pay ... has gone up by about 500%
└ 插入语：by varying estimates
analysis.logic: that 从句是句子的真正主语；后面用两个量化信息分别呈现薪酬倍数和历史涨幅，支撑“上涨”这一判断。
notes: 300 times the pay of...：……薪酬的300倍。
by varying estimates：根据不同估算。
go up by 500% 指涨幅约为500%。

sents.en: The typical CEO of a top American corporation now makes about $18.9 million a year.
sents.cn: 如今，美国一家顶级企业的普通首席执行官每年收入约为1890万美元。

sents.en: The best model for understanding the growth of CEO pay is that of limited CEO talent in a world where business opportunities for the top firms are growing rapidly.
sents.cn: 理解首席执行官薪酬增长的最佳模型是：在顶尖企业商业机会迅速增加的世界里，优秀首席执行官人才数量有限。

sents.en: The efforts of America's highest-earning 1% have been one of the more dynamic elements of the global economy.
sents.cn: 美国收入最高的1%人群所付出的努力，一直是全球经济中更具活力的因素之一。

sents.en: It's not popular to say, but one reason their pay has gone up so much is that CEOs really have upped their game relative to many other workers in the U.S. economy.
sents.cn: 这种说法并不讨喜，但他们的薪酬之所以大幅上涨，一个原因是相较于美国经济中的许多其他劳动者，首席执行官确实提升了自己的能力水平。

analysis.trunk: 转折复句：It's not popular to say, but one reason... is that...（这种说法不讨喜，但一个原因是……）
structure: 分句①：It's not popular to say
转折分句(but)：one reason ... is
├ 定语从句〔省略 why/that，修饰 reason〕：their pay has gone up so much
└ 表语从句(that)：CEOs really have upped their game
└ 比较状语：relative to many other workers in the U.S. economy
analysis.logic: but 将舆论接受度与作者解释转折连接；one reason...is that 是核心因果框架，relative to 给出比较基准。
notes: up one's game：提高能力或表现。
relative to：相对于。
reason 后省略的关系词在定语从句中作状语。

sents.en: Today's CEO, at least for major American firms, must have many mere skills than simply being able to "run the company."
sents.cn: 如今的首席执行官，至少是美国大公司的首席执行官，除了能够“经营公司”之外，还必须具备更多技能。

sents.en: CEOs must have a good sense of financial markets and maybe even how the company should trade in them.
sents.cn: 首席执行官必须对金融市场有良好判断，甚至可能还要懂得公司应如何在这些市场中交易。

sents.en: They also need better public relations skills than their predecessors, as the costs of even a minor slipup can be significant.
sents.cn: 他们还需要比前任具备更强的公共关系能力，因为哪怕一次小小的失误也可能代价高昂。

sents.en: Then there's the fact that large American companies are much more globalized than ever before, with supply chains spread across a larger number of countries.
sents.cn: 此外还有一个事实：美国大公司比以往任何时候都更加全球化，其供应链遍布更多国家。

sents.en: To lead in that system requires knowledge that is fairly mind-boggling.
sents.cn: 领导这样一个体系，需要极为庞杂、令人难以想象的知识。

sents.en: Plus, virtually all major American companies are becoming tech companies, one way or another.
sents.cn: 此外，几乎所有美国大公司都正以这样或那样的方式变成科技公司。

sents.en: Beyond this, major CEOs still have to do all the day-to-day work they have always done.
sents.cn: 除此之外，大公司的首席执行官仍要完成他们一向承担的全部日常工作。

sents.en: The common idea that high CEO pay is mainly about ripping people off doesn't explain history very well.
sents.cn: 那种认为高额首席执行官薪酬主要是在剥削他人的常见观点，并不能很好地解释历史。

sents.en: By most measures, corporate governance has become a lot tighter and more rigorous since the 1970s.
sents.cn: 按照大多数衡量标准，自20世纪70年代以来，公司治理已经严格、严谨得多。

sents.en: Yet it is principally during this period of stronger governance that CEO pay has been high and rising.
sents.cn: 然而，首席执行官薪酬居高不下且持续上涨，主要恰恰发生在治理更强的这一时期。

sents.en: That suggests it is in the broader corporate interest to recruit top candidates for increasingly tough jobs.
sents.cn: 这表明，为日益艰难的职位招募顶尖人选，符合公司更广泛的利益。

sents.en: Furthermore, the highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates, not to the cozy insider picks, another sign that high CEO pay is not some kind of depredation at the expense of the rest of the company.
sents.cn: 此外，最高的首席执行官薪酬给的是外部候选人，而不是关系亲密的内部人选；这进一步说明，高额首席执行官薪酬并非以公司其他成员为代价的某种掠夺。

analysis.trunk: 被动主句 + 同位解释：The highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates..., another sign that...（最高薪酬给外部人选，这是……的又一迹象）
structure: 主句：the highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates
└ 对比插入：not to the cozy insider picks
同位补充：another sign
└ 同位语从句(that)：high CEO pay is not some kind of depredation
└ 介词短语：at the expense of the rest of the company
analysis.logic: 外部候选人和内部熟人形成对比，同位语 another sign 将这一事实转化为反驳“掠夺说”的证据。
notes: cozy insider picks：关系亲密的内部人选。
depredation：掠夺、侵占。
at the expense of：以……为代价。

sents.en: And the stock market reacts positively when companies tie CEO pay to, say, stock prices, a sign that those practices build up corporate value not just for the CEO.
sents.cn: 而且，当公司把首席执行官薪酬与股价等指标挂钩时，股票市场会作出积极反应；这说明这些做法不仅为首席执行官本人，也为公司创造了价值。

sents.en: Madrid was hailed as a public health beacon last November when it rolled out ambitious restrictions on the most polluting cars.
sents.cn: 去年11月，马德里推出针对污染最严重车辆的雄心勃勃的限制措施时，曾被誉为公共卫生的灯塔。

sents.en: Seven months and one election day later, a new conservative city council suspended enforcement of the clean air zone, a first step toward its possible demise.
sents.cn: 七个月后，经历了一次选举，新上台的保守派市议会暂停执行清洁空气区规定，这是该区域可能走向终结的第一步。

sents.en: Mayor Jose Luis Martinez-Almeida made opposition to the zone a centrepiece of his election campaign, despite its success in improving air quality.
sents.cn: 市长何塞·路易斯·马丁内斯-阿尔梅达把反对该区域作为竞选活动的核心议题，尽管它已成功改善空气质量。

sents.en: A judge has now overruled the city's decision to stop levying fines, ordering them reinstated.
sents.cn: 如今，一名法官推翻了市政府停止罚款的决定，下令恢复罚款。

sents.en: But with legal battles ahead, the zone's future looks uncertain at best.
sents.cn: 但由于前方还有法律争端，该区域的未来充其量只能说前景不明。

sents.en: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically contentious, and therefore vulnerable.
sents.cn: 城市在被迫单独应对空气污染时所能采取的措施还有一个弱点：它们在政治上极具争议，因而十分脆弱。

sents.en: That's because they inevitably put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers - who must pay fees or buy better vehicles - rather than on to the car manufacturers whose cheating is the real cause of our toxic pollution.
sents.cn: 这是因为，这些措施不可避免地把清洁空气的成本强加给单个驾驶者——他们必须付费或购买更好的车辆——而不是强加给那些作弊行为才是有毒污染真正根源的汽车制造商。

analysis.trunk: 表语从句：That's because they put the costs on drivers rather than manufacturers（这是因为成本被强加给司机而非制造商）
structure: 主句：That is
└ 表语从句(because)：they inevitably put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers
├ 非限制性定语从句(who)：who must pay fees or buy better vehicles
└ 对比结构：rather than on to the car manufacturers
└ 定语从句(whose)：whose cheating is the real cause of our toxic pollution
analysis.logic: because 解释措施为何脆弱；rather than 对比实际承担成本者与应负责任者，who 和 whose 分别补充两方信息。
notes: put the costs on to somebody：把成本转嫁给某人。
rather than：而不是。
whose cheating：这些制造商的作弊行为。

sents.en: It's not hard to imagine a similar reversal happening in London.
sents.cn: 不难想象，类似的逆转会在伦敦发生。

sents.en: The new ultra-low emission zone (Ulez) is likely to be a big issue in next year's mayoral election.
sents.cn: 新的超低排放区很可能成为明年市长选举的一大议题。

sents.en: And if Sadiq Khan wins and extends it to the North and South Circular roads in 2021 as he intends, it is sure to spark intense opposition from the far larger number of motorists who will then be affected.
sents.cn: 如果萨迪克·汗获胜，并按计划于2021年把该区域扩展到南北环路，那么数量更多、届时将受影响的驾车者势必会强烈反对。

analysis.trunk: 条件复句：If Sadiq Khan wins and extends it..., it is sure to spark opposition（如果汗获胜并扩区，必将引发反对）
structure: 条件状语从句(if)：Sadiq Khan wins and extends it to ... roads in 2021
└ 方式状语从句(as)：as he intends
主句：it is sure to spark intense opposition
└ 介词短语：from the far larger number of motorists
└ 定语从句(who)：who will then be affected
analysis.logic: if 给出扩区假设，as 插入说明这是既定意图；主句预测结果，who 解释反对者为何会反对。
notes: be sure to：必定会。
spark opposition：引发反对。
the far larger number of：数量大得多的……。

sents.en: It's not that measures such as London's Ulez are useless.
sents.cn: 这并不是说伦敦超低排放区之类的措施毫无用处。

sents.en: Far from it.
sents.cn: 恰恰相反。

sents.en: Local officials are using the levers that are available to them to safeguard residents' health in the face of a serious threat.
sents.cn: 面对严重威胁，地方官员正在运用手中可用的手段来保护居民健康。

sents.en: The zones do deliver some improvements to air quality, and the science tells us that means real health benefits - fewer heart attacks, strokes and premature births, less cancer, dementia and asthma.
sents.cn: 这些区域确实能够在一定程度上改善空气质量，而科学告诉我们，这意味着真正的健康收益：心脏病发作、中风和早产减少，癌症、痴呆和哮喘也减少。

sents.en: Fewer untimely deaths.
sents.cn: 过早死亡也会减少。

sents.en: But mayors and councilors can only do so much about a problem that is far bigger than any one city or town.
sents.cn: 但对于一个远远超出任何一座城市或城镇范围的问题，市长和议员能做的毕竟有限。

sents.en: They are acting because national governments - Britain's and others across Europe - have failed to do so.
sents.cn: 他们之所以采取行动，是因为英国以及欧洲其他国家的中央政府都未能有所作为。

sents.en: Restrictions that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas - city centres, "school streets", even individual roads - are a response to the absence of a larger effort to properly enforce existing regulations and require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance.
sents.cn: 禁止高污染车辆进入特定区域——市中心、“学校街道”，甚至个别道路——是对更大范围行动缺失的一种回应；这种更大行动本应妥善执行现有法规，并要求汽车公司让其车辆达到规定标准。

analysis.trunk: S+系动词+表语：Restrictions ... are a response to the absence of a larger effort（限制措施是对更大行动缺失的回应）
structure: 主语：Restrictions
└ 定语从句(that)：that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas
└ 破折号举例：city centres, school streets, even individual roads
系表结构：are a response to the absence of a larger effort
├ 不定式①：to properly enforce existing regulations
└ 并列不定式②：(to) require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance
analysis.logic: that 界定限制措施内容；两个并列不定式说明缺失的全国性行动本应做什么。
notes: keep cars out of：禁止车辆进入。
bring...into compliance：使……达到规定要求。
absence of an effort：相关行动的缺失。

sents.en: Wales has introduced special low speed limits to minimise pollution.
sents.cn: 威尔士已经推出特殊的低速限速措施，以减少污染。

sents.en: We're doing everything but insist that manufacturers clean up their cars.
sents.cn: 除了坚持要求制造商清洁其汽车，我们什么都做了。

sents.en: Now that members of Generation Z are graduating college this spring - the most commonly-accepted definition says this generation was born after 1995, give or take a year - the attention has been rising steadily in recent weeks.
sents.cn: 随着Z世代成员在今年春季大学毕业——最普遍接受的定义认为这一代人大约出生于1995年之后——近几周他们受到的关注持续增加。

analysis.trunk: 时间状语从句 + 主句：Now that Generation Z are graduating..., the attention has been rising（既然Z世代正在毕业，关注度持续上升）
structure: 原因/时间状语从句(Now that)：members of Generation Z are graduating college this spring
└ 破折号插入：the most commonly accepted definition says
└ 宾语从句(that)：this generation was born after 1995, give or take a year
主句：the attention has been rising steadily in recent weeks
analysis.logic: Now that 给出关注增加的现实背景；两个破折号之间插入Z世代的出生年份定义，主句落到近期关注趋势。
notes: now that：既然、由于现在已经。
give or take a year：上下相差一年左右。
steadily：持续稳定地。

sents.en: Gen Zs are about to hit the streets looking for work in a labor market that's tighter than it's been in decades.
sents.cn: Z世代即将走上街头求职，而劳动力市场之紧俏是几十年来未见的。

sents.en: And employers are planning on hiring about 17 percent more new graduates for jobs in the U.S. this year than last, according to a survey conducted by the National Association of Colleges and Employers.
sents.cn: 美国全国大学与雇主协会的一项调查显示，雇主计划今年在美国招聘的新毕业生比去年多约17%。

sents.en: Everybody wants to know how the people who will soon inhabit those empty office cubicles will differ from those who came before them.
sents.cn: 每个人都想知道，即将坐进那些空办公隔间的人会与前人有何不同。

sents.en: If "entitled" is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.
sents.cn: 如果说“自以为应得一切”是最常用于千禧一代——无论是否公平，指1981至1995年出生者——的形容词，那么Z世代的关键词就是务实和谨慎。

analysis.trunk: 条件对比句：If 'entitled' is the adjective applied to millennials, the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious（如果千禧一代的标签是……，Z世代的关键词则是……）
structure: 条件从句(if)：entitled is the most common adjective applied to millennials
├ 评注插入：fairly or not
└ 同位解释：those born between 1981 and 1995
主句：the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious
analysis.logic: if 在这里并非真实条件，而是建立代际标签对比；插入语承认对千禧一代评价可能不公。
notes: entitled：自认为理应获得特殊待遇的。
applied to：用于描述。
catchword：关键词、流行标签。
