sents.en: "Some states require physicians to report, others allow but do not mandate reports, while a few consider a report a breach of confidentiality.
sents.cn: "一些州要求医生上报，另一些州允许但不强制上报，还有少数州则认为上报构成泄密。

sents.en: There could be liability and penalties if a physician does not act in accordance with state laws on reporting and confidentiality," she counseled.
sents.cn: 如果医生不依照所在州有关上报和保密的法律行事，可能要承担法律责任并受到处罚。"她提醒道。

sents.en: Part of the problem in keeping older drivers safe is that the difficulties are addressed piecemeal by different professions with different focuses, including gerontologists, highway administration officials, automotive engineers and others, said gerontologist Elizabeth Dugan.
sents.cn: 老年驾驶者安全问题之所以难以解决，部分原因在于，不同专业领域各有侧重、各自零散地处理这些困难；其中包括老年学专家、公路管理官员、汽车工程师等，老年学家伊丽莎白·杜根说。

analysis.trunk: Part of the problem is that the difficulties are addressed piecemeal（部分问题在于这些困难被零散处理）
structure: 主句：Part of the problem in keeping older drivers safe is
└ 表语从句(that)：that the difficulties are addressed piecemeal
├ 方式/施事：by different professions with different focuses
└ 举例分词结构：including gerontologists, highway administration officials, automotive engineers and others
引述来源：said gerontologist Elizabeth Dugan
analysis.logic: 表语从句解释problem的具体内容：不同专业各有重点，导致问题被割裂处理；including列出profession的例子。
notes: piecemeal 意为“零散地、缺少统筹地”。
with different focuses 修饰 professions。
keeping older drivers safe 是problem的介词补足成分。

sents.en: "There's not a National Institute of Older Driver Studies," she said.
sents.cn: 她说："我们并没有一个国家老年驾驶研究所。"

sents.en: "We need better evidence on what makes drivers unsafe" and what can help, said Dugan.
sents.cn: 杜根说："对于哪些因素会使驾驶者变得不安全，以及什么办法能够奏效，我们需要更充分的证据。"

sents.en: One thing that does seem to work is requiring drivers to report in person for license renewal.
sents.cn: 有一种办法似乎确实有效，那就是要求驾驶者本人到场办理驾照续期。

sents.en: Mandatory in-person renewal was associated with a 31 percent reduction in fatal crashes involving drivers 85 or older, according to one study.
sents.cn: 一项研究显示，强制本人到场续期与85岁及以上驾驶者致命事故减少31%有关。

sents.en: Passing vision tests also produced a similar decline in fatal crashes for those drivers, although there appeared to be no benefit from combining the two.
sents.cn: 视力测试合格也使这些驾驶者的致命事故出现了类似降幅，不过将两种措施结合似乎并不会产生额外收益。

sents.en: Many older drivers don't see eye doctors or can't afford to.
sents.cn: 许多老年驾驶者不看眼科医生，或者负担不起相关费用。

sents.en: Primary care providers have their hands full and may not be able to follow through with patients who have trouble driving because they can't turn their heads or remember where they are going - or have gotten shorter and haven't changed their seat settings sufficiently to reach car pedals easily.
sents.cn: 基层医疗人员本就忙得不可开交，可能无力继续跟进那些驾驶有困难的患者；这些患者也许无法转头或记不住目的地，也许身高变矮后没有充分调整座椅，因而难以轻松踩到汽车踏板。

analysis.trunk: Providers may not be able to follow through with patients（基层医疗人员可能无法继续跟进患者）
structure: 并列分句一：Primary care providers have their hands full
并列分句二：and may not be able to follow through with patients
└ 定语从句(who)：who have trouble driving
└ 原因状语从句(because)：because they can't turn their heads or remember ... or have gotten shorter ...
├ 并列原因一：can't turn their heads or remember where they are going
└ 并列原因二：have gotten shorter and haven't changed their seat settings sufficiently to reach ...
analysis.logic: 主句先说明基层医疗人员忙碌并难以跟进；who锁定需要跟进的患者，because后以并列结构列出身体、认知和座椅调整方面的驾驶困难。
notes: have one's hands full 意为“忙得不可开交”。
follow through with patients 指继续跟进并落实照护。
where they are going 是remember的宾语从句。

sents.en: As long as there are other cars on the roads, self-driving cars won't solve the problems of crashes, said Dugan.
sents.cn: 杜根说，只要道路上还有其他汽车，自动驾驶汽车就无法解决撞车问题。

sents.en: Avoiding dangers posed by all those human drivers would require too many algorithms, she said.
sents.cn: 她说，要避开所有人类驾驶者造成的危险，需要的算法实在太多。

sents.en: But we need to do more to improve safety, said Dugan.
sents.cn: 但杜根表示，我们需要采取更多行动来提高安全性。

sents.en: "If we're going to have 100-year lives, we need cars that a 90-year-old can drive comfortably."
sents.cn: "如果人类将拥有百岁人生，我们就需要让90岁老人也能舒适驾驶的汽车。"

sents.en: If you look at the apps on your phone, chances are you have at least one related to your health - and probably several.
sents.cn: 看看手机里的应用，你很可能至少有一个与健康有关，而且大概还不止一个。

sents.en: Whether it is a mental health app, a fitness tracker, a connected health device or something else, many of us are taking advantage of this technology to keep better track of our health in some shape or form.
sents.cn: 无论是心理健康应用、健身追踪器、联网健康设备还是其他东西，我们中许多人都在利用这项技术，以某种方式更好地记录自己的健康状况。

sents.en: Recent research from the Organization for the Review of Care and Health Applications found that 350,000 health apps were available on the market, 90,000 of which launched in 2020 alone.
sents.cn: 医疗与健康应用评审组织最近的研究发现，市场上已有35万个健康应用，仅2020年就上线了9万个。

sents.en: While these apps have a great deal to offer, it is not always clear how the personal information we input is collected, safeguarded and shared online.
sents.cn: 这些应用虽然大有用处，但我们输入的个人信息如何被收集、保护和在线分享，往往并不清楚。

sents.en: Existing health privacy law, such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, is primarily focused on the way hospitals, doctors' offices, clinics and insurance companies store health records online.
sents.cn: 现行健康隐私法，例如《健康保险可携性与责任法案》，主要关注医院、诊所、医生办公室和保险公司如何在线存储健康记录。

analysis.trunk: Existing health privacy law is focused on the way（现行健康隐私法主要关注这种方式）
structure: 主句：Existing health privacy law is primarily focused on the way
├ 插入举例：such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
└ 定语从句〔省略that/in which，修饰 way〕：hospitals, doctors' offices, clinics and insurance companies store health records online
analysis.logic: 句子核心是法律关注the way；中间such as给出法律实例，末尾从句具体说明受监管主体如何在线保存健康记录。
notes: be focused on 意为“重点关注”。
the way 后的关系词常被省略。
Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act 常简称HIPAA。

sents.en: The health information these apps and health data tracking wearables are collecting typically do not receive the same legal protections.
sents.cn: 这些应用和健康数据追踪可穿戴设备所收集的健康信息，通常得不到同等的法律保护。

sents.en: Without additional protections in place, companies may share (and potentially monetize) personal health information in a way consumers may not have authorized or anticipated.
sents.cn: 在缺少额外保护的情况下，企业可能以消费者未曾授权或预料的方式分享个人健康信息，并可能将其变现。

sents.en: In 2021, Flo Health faced a Federal Trade Commission (FTC) investigation.
sents.cn: 2021年，Flo Health接受了美国联邦贸易委员会的调查。

sents.en: The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims, the company took control of users' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties."
sents.cn: 联邦贸易委员会在一份申诉中指称："尽管作出了明确的隐私承诺，该公司仍掌控了用户的敏感生育数据，并将其分享给第三方。"

sents.en: Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order requiring the company to get app users' express affirmative consent before sharing their health information as well as to instruct the third parties to delete the data they had obtained.
sents.cn: Flo Health与联邦贸易委员会以同意令方式和解：公司必须先取得应用用户明确的肯定同意，才能分享其健康信息，同时还须指示第三方删除它们已经获取的数据。

analysis.trunk: Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order（Flo Health与联邦贸易委员会以同意令和解）
structure: 主句：Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order
└ 现在分词短语〔修饰 Consent Order〕：requiring the company
├ 宾补一：to get app users' express affirmative consent before sharing ...
└ 宾补二：as well as to instruct the third parties to delete the data
└ 定语从句(that)：they had obtained
analysis.logic: 主干交代和解方式；requiring说明同意令的两项要求，as well as连接取得同意和指示删数，that从句限定已被第三方获取的数据。
notes: Consent Order 是监管和解中的“同意令”。
express affirmative consent 指明确、主动作出的同意。
before sharing 的逻辑主语是 company。

sents.en: Section 5 of the FTC Act empowers the FTC to initiate enforcement action against unfair or deceptive acts, meaning the FTC can only act after the fact if a company's privacy practices are misleading or cause unjustified consumer harm.
sents.cn: 《联邦贸易委员会法》第5条授权该委员会对不公平或欺骗性行为采取执法行动，这意味着，只有当一家公司的隐私做法具有误导性或给消费者造成不正当损害后，委员会才能事后介入。

sents.en: While the FTC is doing what it can to ensure apps are keeping their promises to consumers around the handling of their sensitive health information, the rate at which these health apps are hitting the market demonstrates just how immense of a challenge this is.
sents.cn: 联邦贸易委员会正尽力确保各应用兑现妥善处理消费者敏感健康信息的承诺，但健康应用进入市场的速度表明，这项挑战极其艰巨。

analysis.trunk: The rate demonstrates how immense a challenge this is（这种速度表明挑战极其艰巨）
structure: 让步状语从句(While)：While the FTC is doing what it can
├ 目的状语(to)：to ensure
└ 宾语从句：apps are keeping their promises to consumers around the handling of ... information
主句：the rate ... demonstrates
├ 定语从句(at which)：at which these health apps are hitting the market
└ 宾语从句：just how immense of a challenge this is
analysis.logic: While承认监管机构正在尽力，主句随后转折指出应用上市速度揭示了问题规模；at which把rate与上市动作连接起来。
notes: do what it can 指“尽其所能”。
keep one's promises 指“兑现承诺”。
hit the market 意为“进入市场、上市”。

sents.en: As to the prospects for federal legislation, commentators suggest that comprehensive federal privacy legislation seems unlikely in the short term.
sents.cn: 至于联邦立法的前景，评论人士认为，短期内似乎不太可能出台全面的联邦隐私法。

sents.en: States have begun implementing their own solutions to shore up protections for consumer-generated health data.
sents.cn: 各州已经开始实施自己的方案，以加强对消费者生成的健康数据的保护。

sents.en: California has been at the forefront of state privacy efforts with the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018.
sents.cn: 加利福尼亚州凭借2018年出台的《加州消费者隐私法案》，一直走在各州隐私保护工作的前列。

sents.en: Virginia, Colorado and Utah have also recently passed state consumer data privacy legislation.
sents.cn: 弗吉尼亚州、科罗拉多州和犹他州最近也通过了本州的消费者数据隐私法。

sents.en: U.S. customers historically tipped people they assumed were earning most of their income via tips, such as restaurant servers earning less than the minimum wage.
sents.cn: 过去，美国顾客会给那些被认为主要依靠小费获得收入的人付小费，例如工资低于最低工资标准的餐厅服务员。

sents.en: In the early 2010s, a wide range of businesses started processing purchases with iPads and other digital payment systems.
sents.cn: 2010年代初，各类商家开始使用iPad和其他数字支付系统处理消费付款。

sents.en: These systems often prompted customers to tip for services that were not previously tipped.
sents.cn: 这些系统常常会提示顾客为过去不用给小费的服务支付小费。

sents.en: Today's tip requests are often not connected to the salary and service norms that used to determine when and how people tip.
sents.cn: 如今的索要小费往往已脱离过去决定人们何时以及如何给小费的工资和服务惯例。

sents.en: Customers in the past nearly always paid tips after receiving a service, such as at the conclusion of a restaurant meal, after getting a haircut or once a pizza was delivered.
sents.cn: 过去，顾客几乎总是在接受服务之后才付小费，例如一顿餐饭结束、理完发或披萨送达之后。

sents.en: That timing could reward high-quality service and give workers an incentive to provide it.
sents.cn: 这样的时间安排能够奖励优质服务，并激励员工提供优质服务。

sents.en: It's becoming more common for tips to be requested beforehand.
sents.cn: 而现在，事先要求支付小费的情况越来越常见。

sents.en: And new tipping technology may even automatically add tips.
sents.cn: 新的小费技术甚至可能自动加上小费。

sents.en: The prevalence of digital payment devices has made it easier to ask customers for a tip.
sents.cn: 数字支付设备的普及，让商家更容易向顾客索要小费。

sents.en: That helps explain why tip requests are creeping into new kinds of services.
sents.cn: 这有助于解释为什么索要小费正逐渐渗入新的服务类型。

sents.en: Customers now routinely see menus of suggested default options - often well above 20% of what they owe.
sents.cn: 如今，顾客经常会看到一组建议的默认小费选项，而这些数额往往远高于应付金额的20%。

sents.en: The amounts have risen from 10% or less in the 1950s to 15% around the year 2000 to 20% or higher today.
sents.cn: 小费比例已经从20世纪50年代的10%或更低，上升到2000年前后的15%，再升至如今的20%或更高。

sents.en: This increase is sometimes called tipflation - the expectation of ever-higher tip amounts.
sents.cn: 这种上涨有时被称为"小费通胀"，即人们被期待支付越来越高的小费。

sents.en: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US$2.13 an hour.
sents.cn: 小费一直是传统上依赖小费的服务业劳动者的重要收入来源，例如餐饮业；这些行业中领取小费者的最低时薪可低至2.13美元。

analysis.trunk: Tipping has been a vital source of income（小费一直是重要收入来源）
structure: 主句：Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers
├ 介词短语〔限定 workers〕：in historically tipped services
├ 举例：like restaurants
└ 非限制性定语从句(where)：where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US$2.13 an hour
analysis.logic: 主句说明小费的重要性；in短语限定传统依赖小费的行业，where从句再用极低的法定时薪解释为什么小费对这些劳动者至关重要。
notes: tipped services 指按惯例会给从业者小费的服务行业。
tipped minimum wage 指适用于领取小费劳动者的最低工资。
as low as 强调数额低至某一水平。

sents.en: Tip creep and tipflation are now further supplementing the income of many low-wage service workers.
sents.cn: 小费适用范围扩张和小费通胀，如今正进一步补充许多低工资服务业劳动者的收入。

sents.en: Notably, tipping primarily benefits some of these workers, such as waiters, but not others, such as cooks and dishwashers.
sents.cn: 值得注意的是，小费主要让其中一部分劳动者受益，例如服务员，却没有惠及另一部分人，例如厨师和洗碗工。

sents.en: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages, some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement towards no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
sents.cn: 为了确保所有员工都获得公平工资，一些餐厅曾禁止收取小费并提高价格，但这场转向无小费服务的运动基本已经偃旗息鼓。

analysis.trunk: Some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement has fizzled out（一些餐厅禁收小费并涨价，但这场运动已式微）
structure: 目的状语(to)：To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages
└ 宾语从句(that)：that all employees were paid fair wages
并列分句一：some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices
转折分句二(but)：this movement towards no-tipping services has largely fizzled out
analysis.logic: 不定式先说明改革目的，主句给出禁小费和涨价两项做法，but随后指出这一改革趋势最终没有延续。
notes: ensure that 意为“确保……”。
movement towards 指“向某种模式转变的运动或趋势”。
fizzle out 意为“逐渐失败、不了了之”。

sents.en: So to increase employee wages without raising prices, more employers are succumbing to temptations of tip creep and tipflation.
sents.cn: 因此，为了在不涨价的情况下提高员工工资，越来越多雇主开始屈从于扩大小费范围和推高小费的诱惑。

sents.en: However, many customers are frustrated because they feel they are being asked for too high of a tip too often.
sents.cn: 然而，许多顾客感到恼火，因为他们觉得自己被过于频繁地要求支付过高的小费。

sents.en: And, as our research emphasizes, tipping now seems to be more coercive, less generous, and often completely dissociated from service quality.
sents.cn: 而且，正如我们的研究所强调的，如今付小费似乎更带有强迫性、更少出于慷慨，并且往往与服务质量完全脱节。

analysis.trunk: Tipping seems to be more coercive, less generous, and dissociated from service quality（付小费似乎更具强迫性、更少出于慷慨且与服务质量脱节）
structure: 主句：tipping now seems to be more coercive, less generous, and often completely dissociated from service quality
├ 插入状语：as our research emphasizes
└ 并列表语：more coercive / less generous / dissociated from service quality
analysis.logic: 句子用三个并列表语概括现代小费制度的变化：压力增强、慷慨意味减弱、与服务质量失去联系；插入语标明这是研究结论。
notes: coercive 指带有强迫或施压性质。
dissociated from 意为“与……分离、脱节”。
less generous 描述给小费不再主要是自愿慷慨行为。

sents.en: When it was established, the National Health Service (NHS) was visionary: offering high-quality, timely care to meet the dominant needs of the population it served.
sents.cn: 英国国民医疗服务体系创立时极具远见：它提供优质、及时的医疗服务，以满足当时服务人群的主要需求。

sents.en: Nearly 75 years on, with the UK facing very different health challenges, it is clear that the model is out of date.
sents.cn: 近75年过去，英国面对的健康挑战已经大不相同，显然这一模式已经过时。

sents.en: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates, we are lagging behind many of our peers.
sents.cn: 从预期寿命到癌症和婴儿死亡率，我们都落后于许多同类国家。

sents.en: With more than 6.8 million on waitlists, healthcare is becoming increasingly inaccessible for those who cannot opt to pay for private treatment; and the cost of providing healthcare is increasingly squeezing our investment in other public services.
sents.cn: 候诊名单上已有超过680万人，无法选择自费接受私立医疗的人越来越难获得医疗服务；与此同时，医疗成本也日益挤压我们对其他公共服务的投入。

analysis.trunk: Healthcare is becoming inaccessible; the cost is squeezing investment（医疗服务愈发难以获得，成本正挤压其他投入）
structure: with复合背景：With more than 6.8 million on waitlists
并列分句一：healthcare is becoming increasingly inaccessible for those
└ 定语从句(who)：who cannot opt to pay for private treatment
并列分句二：and the cost of providing healthcare is increasingly squeezing our investment in other public services
analysis.logic: With先给出候诊规模，分号两侧再并列说明可及性下降和公共资金被挤压两种后果；who限定无法购买私立医疗的人群。
notes: waitlist 指等待接受医疗服务的名单。
opt to do 意为“选择做某事”。
squeeze investment 指成本压力压缩可用于其他领域的投资。

sents.en: As demand for healthcare continues to grow, pressures on the workforce - which is already near breaking point - will only become more acute.
sents.cn: 随着医疗需求持续增长，本已接近崩溃临界点的医护队伍将面临更加严峻的压力。

sents.en: Many of the answers to the crisis in health and care are well rehearsed.
sents.cn: 应对医疗和照护危机的许多办法，人们早已反复讨论。

sents.en: We need to be much better at reducing and diverting demand on health services, rather than simply managing it.
sents.cn: 我们必须更有效地减少医疗服务需求并将其分流，而不能只是管理这些需求。

sents.en: Much more needs to be invested in communities and primary care to reduce our reliance on hospitals.
sents.cn: 社区和基层医疗需要获得更多投入，以降低我们对医院的依赖。

sents.en: And capacity in social care needs to be greater, to support the growing number of people living with long-term conditions.
sents.cn: 社会照护的服务能力也需要增强，才能支持日益增多的长期病患者。

sents.en: Yet despite two decades of strategies and a number of major health reforms, we have failed to make meaningful progress on any of these aims.
sents.cn: 然而，尽管过去二十年出台了多项战略并实施了数次重大医疗改革，我们在这些目标上都未能取得实质性进展。

sents.en: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled "Reimagining health", supported by ten former health ministers.
sents.cn: 正因如此，Reform智库在十位前卫生大臣的支持下，启动了一项名为"重新构想健康"的新研究计划。

sents.en: Together, we are calling for a much more open and honest conversation about the future of health in the UK, and an "urgent rethink" of the hospital-centric model we retain.
sents.cn: 我们共同呼吁，就英国医疗的未来展开一场更加公开、坦诚的讨论，并"紧急重新思考"我们仍在沿用的以医院为中心的模式。

analysis.trunk: We are calling for a conversation and an urgent rethink（我们呼吁开展讨论并紧急反思）
structure: 主句：Together, we are calling for a much more open and honest conversation ... and an urgent rethink ...
├ 并列宾语一：a ... conversation about the future of health in the UK
└ 并列宾语二：an urgent rethink of the hospital-centric model
└ 定语从句〔省略that，修饰 model〕：we retain
analysis.logic: call for后并列两个名词中心：conversation和rethink；末尾省略关系代词的从句说明需要反思的是英国仍在保留的模式。
notes: call for 意为“呼吁、要求”。
hospital-centric 指“以医院为中心的”。
retain 在此意为“继续保留、沿用”。

sents.en: This must begin with the question of how we maximise the health of the nation, rather than "fix" the NHS.
sents.cn: 这种反思必须从一个问题开始：我们如何最大限度提升全民健康，而不是如何"修好"国民医疗服务体系。

sents.en: It is estimated, for example, that healthcare accounts for only about 20% of health outcomes.
sents.cn: 例如，据估计医疗服务本身只决定约20%的健康结果。

sents.en: Much more important are the places we live, work and socialise - yet there is no clear cross-government strategy for improving these social determinants of health.
sents.cn: 更重要的是我们生活、工作和社交的环境，但政府各部门之间并没有一项明确战略来改善这些健康的社会决定因素。

sents.en: Worse, when policies like the national obesity strategy are scrapped, taxpayers are left with the hefty price tag of treating the illnesses, like diabetes, that result.
sents.cn: 更糟的是，国家肥胖战略之类的政策一旦被取消，纳税人便不得不承担治疗由此产生的糖尿病等疾病的高昂费用。

sents.en: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.
sents.cn: Reform希望探讨，权力和资源应如何在我们的医疗体系中分配。

sents.en: What health functions should remain at the centre, and what should be given to local leaders, often responsible for services that create health, and with a much better understanding of the needs of their populations?
sents.cn: 哪些医疗职能应保留在中央，哪些应交给地方领导者？这些领导者往往负责那些能够促进健康的服务，也更加了解当地居民的需求。

analysis.trunk: What functions should remain, and what should be given to local leaders?（哪些职能应保留，哪些应交给地方领导者？）
structure: 并列疑问分句一：What health functions should remain at the centre
并列疑问分句二：and what should be given to local leaders
├ 分词短语〔补充 local leaders〕：often responsible for services
│   └ 定语从句(that)：that create health
└ 并列补充：and with a much better understanding of the needs of their populations
analysis.logic: 两个what疑问分句对照中央和地方的职能分配；后面的responsible和with结构补充说明地方领导者更适合承接部分职能的理由。
notes: at the centre 在本文语境中指中央层级。
services that create health 指能改善健康决定因素的公共服务。
their populations 指各地方领导者所服务的当地居民。

sents.en: Heat action plans, or HAPs, have been proliferating in India in the past few years.
sents.cn: 过去几年，热浪行动计划（简称HAP）在印度迅速增多。

sents.en: In general, an HAP spells out when and how officials should issue heat warnings and alert hospitals and other institutions.
sents.cn: 一般来说，热浪行动计划会明确规定，官员应在何时、以何种方式发布高温预警，并通知医院及其他机构。

sents.en: Nagpur's plan, for instance, calls for hospitals to set aside "cold wards" in the summer for treating heatstroke patients, and advises builders to give construction laborers a break from work on very hot days.
sents.cn: 例如，那格浦尔的计划要求医院在夏季预留"冷却病房"治疗中暑患者，并建议建筑商在极热天气让建筑工人暂停工作、休息一下。

analysis.trunk: Nagpur's plan calls for hospitals to set aside wards and advises builders to give laborers a break（那格浦尔计划要求医院预留病房，并建议建筑商让工人休息）
structure: 主句并列谓语一：Nagpur's plan calls for hospitals to set aside cold wards
├ 时间状语：in the summer
└ 目的状语(for)：for treating heatstroke patients
并列谓语二：and advises builders to give construction laborers a break from work
└ 时间状语：on very hot days
analysis.logic: plan作共同主语，通过calls for和advises并列提出医疗与劳动保护两类措施；两个不定式分别说明医院和建筑商应采取的行动。
notes: call for sb to do 意为“要求某人做某事”。
set aside 在此意为“留出、预留”。
heatstroke 指中暑，尤指严重热射病。

sents.en: But implementation of existing HAPs has been uneven, according to a report from the center for Policy Research.
sents.cn: 不过，政策研究中心的一份报告指出，现有热浪行动计划的落实情况并不均衡。

sents.en: Many lack adequate funding, it found.
sents.cn: 报告发现，许多计划缺少足够资金。

sents.en: And their triggering thresholds often are not customized to the local climate.
sents.cn: 而且，这些计划触发预警的阈值往往没有根据当地气候定制。

sents.en: In some areas, high daytime temperatures alone might serve as an adequate trigger for alerts.
sents.cn: 在一些地区，仅凭白天的高温也许就足以触发预警。

sents.en: But in other places, nighttime temperatures or humidity might be as important a gauge of risk as daytime highs.
sents.cn: 但在其他地方，夜间温度或湿度对衡量风险的重要性可能不亚于白天的最高温度。

sents.en: Mumbai's April heat stroke deaths highlighted the need for more nuanced and localized warnings, researchers say.
sents.cn: 研究人员说，孟买4月发生的中暑死亡事件凸显了更细致、更贴合当地情况的预警之必要。

sents.en: That day's high temperature of roughly 36°C was 1°C shy of the heat wave alert threshold for coastal cities set by national meteorological authorities.
sents.cn: 当天最高温度约为36摄氏度，仅比国家气象部门为沿海城市设定的热浪预警阈值低1摄氏度。

sents.en: But the effects of the heat were amplified by humidity - an often neglected factor in heat alert systems - and the lack of shade at the late-morning outdoor ceremony.
sents.cn: 但高温的影响因湿度这一在高温预警系统中常被忽视的因素而加剧，上午较晚时段举行的户外活动又缺少遮阴。

analysis.trunk: The effects were amplified by humidity and the lack of shade（高温影响因湿度和缺少遮阴而加剧）
structure: 主句：the effects of the heat were amplified by humidity and the lack of shade
├ 同位插入说明〔修饰 humidity〕：an often neglected factor in heat alert systems
└ 介词短语〔修饰 lack of shade〕：at the late-morning outdoor ceremony
analysis.logic: 被动主干指出两项放大高温影响的因素；破折号之间的同位语专门解释湿度为何容易被现行预警忽略。
notes: amplify 在此意为“加剧、放大影响”。
neglected factor 指常被忽视的因素。
late-morning 指上午较晚、接近中午的时段。

sents.en: To help improve HAPs, urban planner Kotharkar's team is working on a model plan that outlines best practices and could be adapted to local conditions.
sents.cn: 为帮助改进热浪行动计划，城市规划师科塔卡尔的团队正在制定一份示范方案；它概述最佳实践，并可根据当地条件加以调整。

sents.en: Among other things, she says, all cities should create a vulnerability map to help focus responses on the populations most at risk.
sents.cn: 她说，除此之外，所有城市都应绘制一张脆弱性地图，以便将应对措施集中到风险最高的人群。

sents.en: Such mapping doesn't need to be complex, Kotharkar says.
sents.cn: 科塔卡尔说，这种地图不必复杂。

sents.en: "A useful map can be created by looking at even a few key parameters."
sents.cn: "哪怕只考察几个关键参数，也能绘制出一张实用的地图。"

sents.en: For example, neighborhoods with a large elderly population or informal dwellings that cope poorly with heat could get special warnings or be bolstered with cooling centers.
sents.cn: 例如，老年人口众多的社区，或者难以抵御高温的非正规住房区，可以收到专项预警，也可以通过增设纳凉中心来增强应对能力。

sents.en: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
sents.cn: 那格浦尔项目已经绘制了风险与脆弱性地图，使科塔卡尔能够告诉官员，今年夏季一旦发生热浪，应重点关注哪些社区。

sents.en: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.
sents.cn: 研究人员说，热浪行动计划不应只包括短期应急措施，还应提出能够让社区更加凉爽的中长期措施。

analysis.trunk: HAPs shouldn't just include responses but also recommend measures（行动计划不应只含应急响应，还应提出中长期措施）
structure: 主句：HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses but also recommend medium- to long-term measures
├ 并列结构：not just include A but also recommend B
└ 定语从句(that)：that could make communities cooler
插入引述来源：researchers say
analysis.logic: not just...but also...把计划从应急处置扩展到长期降温；that从句进一步界定中长期措施的目标。
notes: medium- to long-term 是共享term的省略写法。
emergency responses 指突发高温时的应急响应。
make communities cooler 包括绿化、建筑改造等结构性措施。

sents.en: In Nagpur, for example, Kotharkar's team has been able to advise city officials about where to plant trees to provide shade.
sents.cn: 例如在那格浦尔，科塔卡尔的团队已经能够就应在何处植树造阴，为市政官员提供建议。

sents.en: HAPs could also guide efforts to retrofit homes or modify building regulations.
sents.cn: 热浪行动计划还可指导住宅改造或建筑法规修订工作。

sents.en: "Reducing deaths in an emergency is a good target to have, but it's the lowest target," says Climate researcher Chandni Singh.
sents.cn: 气候研究人员钱德妮·辛格说："减少紧急情况下的死亡固然是一个应有的目标，但那只是最低层次的目标。"

sents.en: Navigating beyond the organised pavements and parks of our urban spaces, desire paths are the unofficial footprints of a community, revealing the unspoken preferences, shared shortcuts and collective choices of humans.
sents.cn: 在城市空间规划整齐的人行道和公园之外，意愿小径是一个群体留下的非正式足迹，显露出人们没有说出口的偏好、共同选择的捷径和集体抉择。

sents.en: Often appearing as trodden dirt tracks through otherwise neat green spaces, these routes of collective disobedience cut corners, bisect lawns and cross hills, representing the natural capability of people (and animals) to go from point A to point B most effectively.
sents.cn: 这些集体"不服从"的路线常以踩出来的土路出现在原本整洁的绿地中；它们抄近路、穿过草坪和山坡，体现了人和动物以最高效率从A点到B点的天然能力。

analysis.trunk: These routes cut corners, bisect lawns and cross hills（这些路线抄近路、穿草坪、越山坡）
structure: 现在分词短语〔描述外观〕：Often appearing as trodden dirt tracks through otherwise neat green spaces
主句：these routes of collective disobedience cut corners, bisect lawns and cross hills
└ 现在分词短语〔结果/说明〕：representing the natural capability of people (and animals)
└ 不定式〔修饰 capability〕：to go from point A to point B most effectively
analysis.logic: 句首描述小径如何出现，主干列出三种穿行方式，末尾representing将这些行为概括为人和动物寻找最高效路线的能力。
notes: trodden dirt tracks 指被反复踩出的土路。
cut corners 既可字面指切过拐角，也有“走捷径”之意。
otherwise neat 表示若没有这些小径，绿地本来很整齐。

sents.en: Urban planners interpret desire paths as more than just convenient shortcuts; they offer valuable insights into the dynamics between planning and behaviour.
sents.cn: 城市规划师认为，意愿小径不只是方便的捷径，它们还能为理解规划与行为之间的互动提供宝贵线索。

sents.en: Ohio State University allowed its students to navigate the Oval, a lawn in the centre of campus, freely, then proceeded to pave the desire paths, creating a web of effective routes students had established.
sents.cn: 俄亥俄州立大学先让学生自由穿行校园中央一片名为"椭圆草坪"的草地，随后把学生走出来的意愿小径铺成路，形成一张高效路线网。

sents.en: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact, or primarily, aesthetics.
sents.cn: 然而，其他规划者仍不愿将意愿小径纳入正式规划，理由是担心安全、环境影响，尤其是美观问题。

sents.en: A Reddit webpage devoted to the phenomenon, boasting nearly 50,000 members, showcases images of local desire paths adorned with signs instructing pedestrians to adhere to designated walkways, underscoring the rebellious nature inherent in these human-made tracks.
sents.cn: 一个专门讨论这种现象、拥有近五万名成员的Reddit页面，展示了各地意愿小径的图片；有些小径旁竖着要求行人走指定道路的标牌，反而凸显了这些人为踩出的小路内在的反叛性质。

analysis.trunk: A Reddit webpage showcases images（一个Reddit页面展示图片）
structure: 主句：A Reddit webpage ... showcases images of local desire paths
├ 过去分词短语〔修饰 webpage〕：devoted to the phenomenon
├ 现在分词短语〔补充 webpage〕：boasting nearly 50,000 members
├ 过去分词短语〔修饰 paths〕：adorned with signs
│   └ 现在分词短语〔修饰 signs〕：instructing pedestrians to adhere to designated walkways
└ 结果状语：underscoring the rebellious nature inherent in these human-made tracks
analysis.logic: 主干很短，其余多个分词短语逐层修饰页面、路径和标牌，最后underscoring点出“越禁止越体现反叛”的含义。
notes: boast 在此意为“拥有”，不一定含贬义。
adhere to designated walkways 指遵守要求、走指定人行道。
inherent in 意为“内在于、固有于”。

sents.en: This clash highlights an ongoing struggle between the organic, user-driven evolution of public spaces and the desire for a visually curated and controlled urban environment.
sents.cn: 这种冲突凸显出一场持续的较量：一边是公共空间由使用者推动的自然演化，另一边则是对视觉上经过设计、受到控制的城市环境的追求。

sents.en: The Wickquasgeck Trail is an example of a historical desire path, created by Native Americans to cross the forests of Manhattan and move between settlements quickly.
sents.cn: 威克夸斯盖克小径是一条历史悠久的意愿小径；美洲原住民开辟它，是为了穿越曼哈顿的森林，在定居点之间快速往来。

sents.en: This trail, when Dutch colonists arrived, was widened and made into one of the main trade roads across the island, known at the time as de Heere Straat, or Gentlemen's Street.
sents.cn: 荷兰殖民者到来后，这条小径被拓宽，变成横贯曼哈顿岛的主要贸易道路之一，当时称作de Heere Straat，也就是"绅士街"。

sents.en: Following the British assumption of control in New York, the street was renamed Broadway.
sents.cn: 英国控制纽约后，这条街被改名为百老汇。

sents.en: Notably, Broadway stands out as one of the few areas in NYC that defies the grid-based system applied to the rest of the city, cutting a diagonal across parts of the city.
sents.cn: 值得注意的是，百老汇是纽约市少数不遵循其他地区网格化布局的地带之一，以对角线斜穿城市部分区域。

sents.en: In online spaces, desire paths have sparked a fascination that can approach obsession, with the Reddit page serving as a hub.
sents.cn: 在网络空间里，意愿小径激起了一种近乎痴迷的兴趣，而那个Reddit页面正是爱好者的聚集地。

sents.en: Contributors offer a wide array of stories, from little-known new shortcuts to long-established alternate routes.
sents.cn: 投稿者分享了各种各样的故事，从鲜为人知的新捷径到存在已久的替代路线，不一而足。

sents.en: Animal desire paths, such as ducks forging trails through frozen ponds or dogs carving direct routes in gardens, highlight the adaptability of these trails in both human and animal experiences.
sents.cn: 鸭子在结冰池塘上踩出路线、狗在花园中开辟直达小路等动物意愿小径，说明这种小径在人类和动物的活动中都具有适应性。

sents.en: As desire paths criss-cross through both physical and virtual landscapes, they stand as a proof of the collective insistence on forging unconventional routes and embracing the spirit of communal choice.
sents.cn: 当意愿小径纵横于现实和虚拟空间时，它们证明了群体坚持开辟非常规路线、拥抱共同选择精神的力量。

analysis.trunk: They stand as a proof of the collective insistence（它们成为群体坚持的证明）
structure: 时间/伴随状语从句(As)：As desire paths criss-cross through both physical and virtual landscapes
主句：they stand as a proof of the collective insistence
└ 介词短语(on)：on forging unconventional routes and embracing the spirit of communal choice
└ 并列动名词：forging ... and embracing ...
analysis.logic: As从句把意愿小径的存在范围扩展到现实与网络，主句用两个并列动名词概括其象征意义：开辟非常规路线和坚持共同选择。
notes: criss-cross 意为“纵横交错地穿过”。
insistence on 指“对……的坚持”。
communal choice 强调群体共同形成的选择。

sents.en: Ask people about public libraries and a certain image springs to mind: dusty, old-fashioned, the sort of place you enjoyed as a child but, rather like a British seaside town, would you go there now?
sents.cn: 向人们提起公共图书馆，脑海中往往会浮现某种形象：尘土飞扬、陈旧过时，是小时候喜欢去的那种地方；但它又有点像英国海滨小镇——你现在还会去吗？

analysis.trunk: Ask people and a certain image springs to mind（向人们提起图书馆，某种形象便浮现出来）
structure: 祈使条件/引入：Ask people about public libraries
主句：and a certain image springs to mind
└ 冒号后同位说明(image)：dusty, old-fashioned, the sort of place
├ 定语从句〔省略that，修饰 place〕：you enjoyed as a child
└ 转折插入与疑问：but, rather like a British seaside town, would you go there now?
analysis.logic: 句子先用祈使结构模拟提问场景，再列出刻板印象；最后以插入类比和反问，把“童年喜欢”与“现在还去不去”形成对照。
notes: spring to mind 意为“立刻浮现在脑海中”。
the sort of place 后省略关系代词that。
rather like 表示“颇有点像”。

sents.en: And anyway - aren't they all closing?
sents.cn: 况且，它们不是都在关闭吗？

sents.en: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
sents.cn: 然而事实截然不同，甚至令人吃惊；文化部门委托我对英格兰公共图书馆开展独立评审时，我发现了这一点，评审报告已于昨日发布。

analysis.trunk: The reality is startlingly different（现实截然不同）
structure: 主句：The reality is startlingly different
└ 方式状语从句(as)：as I discovered
└ 时间状语从句(when)：when the culture department commissioned me
└ 宾补不定式：to conduct an independent review of English public libraries
└ 过去分词短语〔修饰 review〕：published yesterday
analysis.logic: 主干先否定刻板印象，as说明作者如何得知，when再交代受委托评审的具体情境；published yesterday修饰评审报告。
notes: startlingly different 意为“不同得令人吃惊”。
commission sb to do 指“委托某人做某事”。
published yesterday 可理解为评审报告于昨日发布。

sents.en: As I visited libraries up and down the country, I was surprised to learn there are more than twice the number of libraries (2,892) as there are branches of McDonald's.
sents.cn: 我走访全国各地的图书馆后惊讶地得知，图书馆共有2,892家，数量是麦当劳门店的两倍多。

sents.en: Enter any one of them and you will find a hive of activity.
sents.cn: 走进其中任何一家，你都会看到一派繁忙景象。

sents.en: While books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support.
sents.cn: 书籍现在是、也永远应该是每家图书馆的核心，但图书馆还提供大量其他服务，包括就业建议、语言课程以及数字接入与支持。

sents.en: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.
sents.cn: 有些图书馆设有商业与知识产权中心，可以帮助企业主和创业者。

sents.en: Many have nurses on site to carry out basic health checks, with a link to the GP's surgery.
sents.cn: 许多图书馆有护士驻点开展基础健康检查，并与全科医生诊所相连。

sents.en: There are libraries where young people can borrow a Fifa-standard football free.
sents.cn: 有些图书馆还允许年轻人免费借用达到国际足联标准的足球。

sents.en: In return for all of this, you'll be asked for precisely nothing.
sents.cn: 作为这些服务的回报，你所需支付的恰恰是什么也没有。

sents.en: There will be no charge and you will never be asked to justify or explain yourself; you will simply be welcomed in, offered help if you need it, and left alone if you do not.
sents.cn: 这里不收取任何费用，也绝不会要求你说明或解释自己；你只会受到欢迎，需要时有人帮助，不需要时则可以不受打扰。

sents.en: There is no other institution, public or private, that can say the same.
sents.cn: 无论公共还是私人机构，没有其他任何机构能作出同样的承诺。

sents.en: Yet still our libraries are often overlooked and underappreciated.
sents.cn: 可即便如此，我们的图书馆仍常常被忽视和低估。

sents.en: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
sents.cn: 到访图书馆的总人次正在下降，而地方政府持续承受财政压力，许多图书馆也举步维艰。

sents.en: The number of libraries that have closed since 2010 is disputed.
sents.cn: 自2010年以来究竟关闭了多少家图书馆，各方说法不一。

sents.en: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
sents.cn: 英国特许公共财政与会计协会的一项年度调查认为，全英关闭数量接近800家；英格兰艺术委员会掌握的官方统计数据则记录了英格兰关闭230家。

sents.en: It is, of course, 230 libraries too many.
sents.cn: 当然，哪怕230家也多得令人无法接受。

sents.en: So if we are to protect our libraries for future generations, we must raise awareness of them and the work they do.
sents.cn: 因此，如果要为后代保护图书馆，我们就必须提高人们对图书馆及其工作的认识。

sents.en: The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.
sents.cn: 评审报告建议开展全国统一品牌宣传，让图书馆在现实空间中更加醒目；恢复一项允许会员凭同一张卡使用全国任何图书馆的计划；并为儿童自动办理会员资格。

analysis.trunk: The review recommends a campaign, the reintroduction of a scheme, and memberships（评审建议开展宣传、恢复计划并提供会员资格）
structure: 主句：The review recommends 三个并列宾语
├ 宾语一：a national branding campaign
│   └ 目的状语：to give libraries a stronger physical presence
├ 宾语二：the reintroduction of a scheme
│   └ 不定式〔说明 scheme〕：to enable members to use their card in any library in the country
└ 宾语三：automatic memberships for children
analysis.logic: recommend后用三个名词短语列出政策包；两个to do分别说明宣传活动和会员互通计划的具体目的或内容。
notes: branding campaign 指统一品牌识别与宣传活动。
physical presence 在此指现实环境中的可见度和存在感。
automatic memberships 指无需另行申请即可获得会员资格。

sents.en: If we don't use them, we will end up losing them.
sents.cn: 如果我们不使用图书馆，最终就会失去它们。

sents.en: And for those who haven't been to a library for some time, they may be surprised by what they find.
sents.cn: 而那些已经有一段时间没去过图书馆的人，也许会对自己看到的一切感到惊喜。

sents.en: According to our research, around one in five workers in the UK talk to AI like a friend, looking for guidance on personal and professional problems.
sents.cn: 我们的研究显示，英国约五分之一的劳动者会像和朋友交谈一样同人工智能对话，向它寻求个人和职业问题的指导。

sents.en: Our data shows that engaging with AI like this can leave us feeling heard and less isolated.
sents.cn: 我们的数据表明，以这种方式与人工智能互动，能让我们觉得自己的声音被听见，也不再那么孤独。

sents.en: But, with this newfound connection, many of us share sensitive, sometimes highly confidential information, even though over a third of people don't realise that AI platforms may not be very good at keeping our secrets...secret.
sents.cn: 然而，伴随这种新建立的联系，我们中许多人会分享敏感、有时甚至高度机密的信息，尽管超过三分之一的人没有意识到，人工智能平台也许并不很擅长把我们的秘密……守成秘密。

analysis.trunk: Many of us share sensitive information, even though people don't realise the risk（许多人分享敏感信息，尽管人们没有意识到风险）
structure: 转折主句：But ... many of us share sensitive, sometimes highly confidential information
├ with介词短语〔背景〕：with this newfound connection
└ 让步状语从句(even though)：even though over a third of people don't realise
└ 宾语从句(that)：that AI platforms may not be very good at keeping our secrets ... secret
analysis.logic: 主句指出亲密感促使人们分享机密；even though揭示认知落差，that从句具体说明许多人没有意识到平台保密能力有限。
notes: newfound connection 指刚建立起来的亲近感。
over a third of 意为“超过三分之一的”。
secrets...secret 用重复和省略号制造强调效果。

sents.en: For businesses, the implications are worrying.
sents.cn: 对企业来说，这些影响令人担忧。

sents.en: Consider Microsoft Copilot, for example.
sents.cn: 以微软Copilot为例。

sents.en: It gains Microsoft broad rights to the data inputted or outputted by any user - rights to use this data in any way it sees fit; it can even share it with third parties.
sents.cn: 它让微软对任何用户输入或输出的数据拥有广泛权利——微软可以按自己认为合适的任何方式使用这些数据，甚至可以与第三方分享。

analysis.trunk: It gains Microsoft broad rights; it can share the data（它让微软获得广泛权利，微软甚至可以分享数据）
structure: 分号前分句：It gains Microsoft broad rights to the data
├ 过去分词短语〔修饰 data〕：inputted or outputted by any user
└ 破折号同位说明(rights)：rights to use this data in any way
└ 定语从句〔省略that，修饰 way〕：it sees fit
分号后分句：it can even share it with third parties
analysis.logic: 第一分句提出广泛数据权利，破折号后解释权利范围；分号后进一步递进，指出数据还可能被分享给第三方。
notes: inputted or outputted 指用户输入给AI或AI输出的数据。
see fit 意为“认为合适”。
third parties 指服务双方以外的第三方。

sents.en: This means that any sensitive business information could potentially be exposed to the world.
sents.cn: 这意味着任何敏感的商业信息都有可能暴露给全世界。

sents.en: Employers are taking note and taking action.
sents.cn: 雇主已经注意到这一点，并开始采取行动。

sents.en: According to our research, 25% have decided to either outright ban AI or regulate its use within their organisations.
sents.cn: 我们的研究显示，25%的雇主已经决定要么彻底禁止人工智能，要么对其在组织内部的使用加以规范。

sents.en: But even with these policies in place, some employees choose to break the rules.
sents.cn: 但即使制定了这些政策，一些员工仍会选择违规。

sents.en: They have their reasons - around 63% of them report that using AI increases their productivity, and some even feel AI offers more help than their human colleagues.
sents.cn: 他们自有理由：约63%的人表示，使用人工智能提高了自己的生产率；有些人甚至觉得，人工智能比人类同事提供的帮助更多。

sents.en: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.
sents.cn: 这形成了一种微妙的平衡：一边要利用人工智能带来的生产率提升，一边又要承担机密数据泄露的风险。

sents.en: Employers need to manage AI tools with the same level of care as any other form of data sharing or storage.
sents.cn: 雇主需要像管理其他任何形式的数据分享或存储一样谨慎地管理人工智能工具。

sents.en: There's also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed - 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI.
sents.cn: 此外，还有一个亟待弥合的知识缺口：40%的受访者不确定人工智能生成内容的所有权究竟归谁。

sents.en: By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.
sents.cn: 通过确立与人工智能互动的最佳做法，并制定随技术演进而更新的政策，企业可以推动人工智能生态朝积极方向转变。

sents.en: With AI's potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience, it's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy.
sents.cn: 人工智能有潜力简化我们的职业生活、处理行政事务并改善工作体验，因此我们有责任谨慎把握其使用方式，让它在不损害隐私的前提下为我们提供支持。

analysis.trunk: It's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously（谨慎把握人工智能的使用方式取决于我们）
structure: with复合背景：With AI's potential to simplify ..., do ... and enhance ...
└ 三个并列不定式：to simplify / (to) do / (to) enhance
主句〔形式主语〕：it's up to us
└ 真正主语不定式：to navigate its usage cautiously
└ 目的/结果从句(so)：so it supports us without compromising our privacy
analysis.logic: With先列出AI的三项潜力，主句把责任落到使用者身上，so从句给出谨慎使用应达到的目标：获得支持但不牺牲隐私。
notes: do the admin 指处理行政性、事务性工作。
it's up to us 表示“责任或决定权在我们”。
without compromising 意为“不以损害……为代价”。

sents.en: There's no need to back away from progress, as long as we're equipped with the knowledge and tools to make sure AI remains a friend.
sents.cn: 只要我们具备相应知识和工具，能够确保人工智能始终是朋友，就没有必要拒绝进步。

sents.en: And this is where the challenge lies.
sents.cn: 而挑战恰恰就在这里。

sents.en: There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it's easy to fall victim.
sents.cn: 市面上的产品如此之多，又有巨额广告和营销预算为其推广，人们很容易上当受骗。

sents.en: But by building a culture of digital responsibility within our businesses, we can create a future where AI can help us without spilling the beans.
sents.cn: 但只要在企业内部营造数字责任文化，我们就能创造这样一个未来：人工智能可以帮助我们，同时不泄露秘密。

sents.en: Since the 2008 launch of the high-speed rail network between Rome and Milan, trains have become the preferred means of travel across Italy for locals and tourists alike.
sents.cn: 自2008年罗马至米兰高速铁路网开通以来，火车已经成为当地居民和游客在意大利各地出行的首选方式。

sents.en: Fast trains can cover the 500km between the two cities in three hours.
sents.cn: 高速列车可在三小时内跑完两座城市之间的500公里。

sents.en: The network also connects Naples, Bologna, Florence and Turin.
sents.cn: 该铁路网还连接那不勒斯、博洛尼亚、佛罗伦萨和都灵。

sents.en: In many cases, it is the best option - in terms of travel time and cost - for both leisure and business travellers.
sents.cn: 在许多情况下，无论休闲还是商务出行，从时间和费用来看，高铁都是最佳选择。

sents.en: This is why the recent severe delays caused by numerous maintenance works have thrown the rail industry into chaos at a time when most people head on holiday, which matters for business in a country where tourism accounts for 10 percent of GDP.
sents.cn: 因此，近期大量维修工程造成的严重延误，在大多数人外出度假之际让铁路行业陷入混乱；而在一个旅游业占国内生产总值10%的国家，这会影响商业。

analysis.trunk: This is why the delays have thrown the industry into chaos（这就是这些延误使铁路业陷入混乱的原因）
structure: 主句：This is why the recent severe delays ... have thrown the rail industry into chaos
├ 过去分词短语〔修饰 delays〕：caused by numerous maintenance works
├ 时间状语从句(when)：at a time when most people head on holiday
└ 非限制性定语从句(which)：which matters for business in a country
└ 定语从句(where)：where tourism accounts for 10 percent of GDP
analysis.logic: why从句承接上文铁路受欢迎的背景；两个从句继续说明延误恰逢度假期，并在旅游业占比高的国家具有商业影响。
notes: throw ... into chaos 意为“使……陷入混乱”。
head on holiday 指启程度假。
account for 意为“占据某一比例”。

sents.en: Disruptions have become increasingly frequent with train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage.
sents.cn: 运行中断越来越频繁，列车延误如今已成为意大利媒体报道的固定内容。

sents.en: Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane, the publicly controlled group that owns train operator Trenitalia and the national train network RFI, said 23 percent of all high-speed trains it operated were late in 2023.
sents.cn: 意大利国家铁路公司是一家受公共控制的集团，旗下拥有列车运营商Trenitalia和国家铁路网运营商RFI；该集团表示，2023年其运营的所有高速列车中有23%晚点。

analysis.trunk: Ferrovie said 23 percent of trains were late（意大利国家铁路公司称23%的列车晚点）
structure: 主句：Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane said
├ 同位语：the publicly controlled group
│   └ 定语从句(that)：that owns train operator Trenitalia and the national train network RFI
└ 宾语从句〔省略that〕：23 percent of all high-speed trains ... were late in 2023
└ 定语从句〔省略that，修饰 trains〕：it operated
analysis.logic: 两个嵌套的定语从句分别交代集团资产和晚点列车范围，去掉后主干只是“公司称23%的高铁晚点”。
notes: publicly controlled 指由公共部门控股或控制。
train operator 与 train network 分别是列车运营商和铁路网运营主体。
it operated 中it指Ferrovie。

sents.en: The huge improvements in Italy's obsolete infrastructure partly explained the disruption, said Ferrovie.
sents.cn: 意大利国家铁路公司称，对意大利老旧基础设施进行的大规模改进，在一定程度上造成了这些运行中断。

sents.en: RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026.
sents.cn: 铁路网运营商RFI是欧洲复苏基金最大的单一受益者，计划到2026年投入240亿欧元。

sents.en: Ferrovie will invest a total of €124bn in infrastructure over the next 10 years.
sents.cn: 意大利国家铁路公司将在未来十年向基础设施投入总计1,240亿欧元。

sents.en: But lack of capacity is another problem.
sents.cn: 但运力不足是另一个问题。

sents.en: Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable.
sents.cn: 交通经济学家安德烈亚·朱里钦说，计划中的投资将带来改善，但在此期间出现运行中断不可避免。

sents.en: "We have a mixed system, there is no spare capacity and as soon as there's a hiccup on the line, the situation becomes highly complex," he said.
sents.cn: 他说："我们采用混合系统，没有备用运力；线路上一有小故障，情况就会变得极其复杂。"

sents.en: A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities.
sents.cn: 所谓混合系统，是指高速列车在某些线路或穿越大城市时，必须在普通铁路轨道上行驶。

sents.en: If there's congestion or, for example, a local train breaks down, the entire high-speed network is affected.
sents.cn: 一旦发生拥堵，或者比如一列普通列车出现故障，整个高速铁路网都会受到影响。

sents.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
sents.cn: 升级将带来的最重要变化之一，是通过修建地下铁路连接线，在某些城市中心将高铁线路与普通线路分离。

sents.en: Improvements will also come from the high-density technology and satellite signalling that RFI has been investing in for years, say experts.
sents.cn: 专家表示，RFI多年来投资的高密度技术和卫星信号系统也将带来改善。

sents.en: It will allow for a reduction of the distance between high-speed trains travelling on the same line at any given time, which should mean a significant increase in capacity and traffic fluidity, according to Giuricin.
sents.cn: 朱里钦说，这将缩短同一时刻在同一线路上运行的高速列车之间所需保持的间隔，从而应能显著提高运力和运行流畅度。

analysis.trunk: It will allow for a reduction of the distance（它将使列车间隔缩短）
structure: 主句：It will allow for a reduction of the distance between high-speed trains
└ 现在分词短语〔修饰 trains〕：travelling on the same line at any given time
非限制性定语从句(which)：which should mean a significant increase in capacity and traffic fluidity
引述来源：according to Giuricin
analysis.logic: 主句说明技术可缩短同线列车间隔，which概括这一整件事并推出运力和流畅度提高的结果。
notes: allow for 在此意为“使……成为可能”。
distance 实际指安全运行间隔。
traffic fluidity 指交通或列车运行的流畅程度。

sents.en: In 2023, Chicago lost one of its most beloved street festivals.
sents.cn: 2023年，芝加哥失去了最受喜爱的街头节庆活动之一。

sents.en: The Silver Room Block Party, staged by Hyde Park community leader Eric Williams, announced it would not return in 2024.
sents.cn: 由海德公园社区领袖埃里克·威廉斯主办的"银屋街区派对"宣布，活动不会在2024年回归。

sents.en: What began as a small neighborhood gathering blossomed into a massive cultural event, welcoming tens of thousands of people each year over nearly two decades before abruptly shutting down.
sents.cn: 这项活动最初只是一次小型社区聚会，随后发展成大型文化盛会；近二十年来每年吸引数万人参加，却最终突然停办。

sents.en: Williams pointed to rising production costs and declining attendee donations as primary reasons the Silver Room Block Party could not continue, highlighting a reality that all street festival organizers face right now.
sents.cn: 威廉斯指出，制作成本上升和参加者捐款减少，是银屋街区派对无法继续举办的主要原因；这也揭示了当下所有街头节庆组织者都面对的现实。

analysis.trunk: Williams pointed to costs and donations as reasons（威廉斯指出成本和捐款是主要原因）
structure: 主句：Williams pointed to rising production costs and declining attendee donations as primary reasons
└ 定语从句〔省略why，修饰 reasons〕：the Silver Room Block Party could not continue
现在分词短语〔结果/补充〕：highlighting a reality
└ 定语从句(that)：that all street festival organizers face right now
analysis.logic: 主句列出停办原因，省略why的从句说明这些原因导致何事；highlighting把个案上升为所有街头节庆共同面对的现实。
notes: point to A as B 意为“指出A是B”。
attendee donations 指参加者在活动现场作出的捐款。
highlighting 的逻辑主语是前面整件事。

sents.en: The cost of producing a street festival in Chicago has skyrocketed.
sents.cn: 在芝加哥，举办街头节庆的成本已经飙升。

sents.en: Security, entertainment, portable restrooms, insurance and even basics such as fencing and staffing have all become significantly more expensive.
sents.cn: 安保、娱乐演出、移动厕所、保险，甚至围栏和工作人员等基本项目，都变得贵得多。

sents.en: At the same time, donations at festival gates have dropped dramatically.
sents.cn: 与此同时，节庆入口处收到的捐款大幅下降。

sents.en: Chicago's summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they're in and the city of Chicago as whole.
sents.cn: 芝加哥的夏季节庆不只是娱乐活动，它们还是经济引擎，直接造福活动所在社区和整个芝加哥市。

sents.en: Street festivals drive foot traffic to local businesses and foster the kind of cultural vibrancy that makes our city special.
sents.cn: 街头节庆为当地商家带来客流，并培育使这座城市独具魅力的文化活力。

sents.en: We often hear people ask why we solicit donations at our entry points, especially when the city's largest festivals like the Chicago Jazz Festival do not request donations.
sents.cn: 我们经常听到有人问，为什么要在入口处募捐，尤其是芝加哥爵士音乐节等全市最大型节庆并不要求捐款。

sents.en: The fact is, unlike those large, city-produced music festivals, your neighborhood street festivals receive no city funding and rely on a combination of sponsorships, vendor fees and gate donations to cover their costs.
sents.cn: 事实是，与那些由市政府举办的大型音乐节不同，社区街头节庆得不到市政府拨款，只能依靠赞助费、摊位费和入场捐款共同覆盖成本。

analysis.trunk: Festivals receive no city funding and rely on three sources（社区节庆没有市政府拨款，只能依赖三类资金）
structure: 主句：The fact is
└ 表语内容：your neighborhood street festivals receive no city funding and rely on ...
├ 比较介词短语：unlike those large, city-produced music festivals
├ 并列谓语一：receive no city funding
└ 并列谓语二：rely on a combination of sponsorships, vendor fees and gate donations
└ 目的状语：to cover their costs
analysis.logic: unlike先建立城市主办大型节庆与社区节庆的对比，两个并列谓语说明后者无拨款、靠自筹，末尾to cover交代资金用途。
notes: city-produced 指由市政府组织举办。
vendor fees 指摊商或参展商缴纳的费用。
gate donations 指活动入口处募集的捐款。

sents.en: Wicker Park Fest has long been one of Chicago's most anticipated summer festivals, drawing upward of 70,000 attendees for a full weekend of live indie music, local art, small business vendors and, most importantly, community connection.
sents.cn: 柳条公园节长期以来一直是芝加哥最令人期待的夏季节庆之一，整个周末的独立音乐现场演出、本地艺术、小企业摊位，以及最重要的社区联结，吸引了七万多人参加。

sents.en: In 2024, Wicker Park Fest saw record-breaking attendance.
sents.cn: 2024年，柳条公园节的到场人数创下纪录。

sents.en: Despite the turnout, gate donations reached their lowest point in our history.
sents.cn: 尽管参加者众多，入口捐款却降至该活动有史以来的最低点。

sents.en: This year, we've been forced to scale back the footprint of the fest.
sents.cn: 今年，我们被迫缩小节庆活动的规模。

sents.en: We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park's unique spirit and reputation as festgoers have come to expect.
sents.cn: 我们将取消一个舞台、减少演出者并作出更多削减以降低成本；与此同时，我们仍力求让节庆一如既往地充满活力、支持本地艺术家和企业，并忠实延续柳条公园独特的精神与声誉，达到节庆参与者已经形成的期待。

analysis.trunk: We are eliminating, booking fewer and making cuts, while striving to keep the festival vibrant（我们在取消、缩减和削支，同时努力保持节庆活力）
structure: 主句三个并列谓语：We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts
└ 目的状语：to reduce our costs
让步/伴随结构：all while striving to keep the festival
├ 宾补一：as vibrant as ever
├ 宾补二：as supportive of local artists and businesses
└ 宾补三：as true to Wicker Park's unique spirit and reputation
└ 方式/比较从句(as)：as festgoers have come to expect
analysis.logic: 主句列出三项削减措施，while强调削减与维持品质同时进行；三个as...结构并列说明希望保留的活动特征。
notes: scale back 指缩小规模。
all while 表示“与此同时仍然……”。
true to 意为“忠实于、不偏离”。

sents.en: This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you'll remember that they exist because of community support.
sents.cn: 今年夏天，当你享受自己喜爱的社区街头节庆时，我希望你记得，它们之所以存在，是因为有社区支持。

sents.en: A thriving summer festival season doesn't happen by accident; it happens when we all chip in.
sents.cn: 繁荣的夏季节庆季不会凭空出现；只有大家共同出一份力，它才能实现。
